oraciones.titulo: Saint Michael the Archangel · Cleaving and Defense with the Sword of Fire
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Sancte Michael Archangele, defende nos in proelio;
contra nequitiam et insidias diaboli esto praesidium.
Imperet illi Deus, supplices deprecamur:
tuque, Princeps militiae caelestis, Satanam aliosque spiritus malignos,
qui ad perditionem animarum pervagantur in mundo,
divina virtute, in infernum detrude. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Sánc-te Mí-ka-el Ar-kán-ye-le, de-fén-de nos in pré-li-o; cón-tra ne-kuí-tzi-am et in-sí-di-as di-á-bo-li és-to pre-sí-di-um...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Saint Michael the Archangel, defend us in battle. Be our defense against the wickedness and snares of the Devil. May God rebuke him, we humbly pray; and do thou, O Prince of the Heavenly Host, by the power of God, cast into hell Satan, and all the evil spirits, who prowl about the world seeking the ruin of souls. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Raphael the Archangel · Divine Medicine and Body Relief
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Raphael, custos et dux noster, afflictorum consolator et aegrotantium medicus,
corporis et animae morbos propelle, lucemque caelestem nobis impetra. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Rá-fa-el, cús-tos et duks nós-ter...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Glorious Saint Raphael Archangel, medicine of God, spread your wings over my body and my soul. Dispel all ailments, relieve physical pain and renew my strength with the blessing of the Almighty. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Green Tara · Maternal Protection and Deep Calm
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ तारे तुत्तारे तुरे स्वाहा ॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Om Ta-re Tu-ta-re Tu-re Soa-ja]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om. I prostrate before Tara, the liberator who dispels all fears, heals the afflictions of the soul and pours inexhaustible serenity in the heart. Svaha.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Cajetan of Thiene · Father of Divine Providence, Bread and Work
oraciones.textoOriginal: Sancte Caietane Thienaei, Patrone Providentiae et Laboris, ora pro nobis et impetra nobis panem quotidianum.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [San Cayetano, Padre de Providencia, alcánzanos pan y trabajo]
oraciones.textoTraducido: O glorious Saint Cajetan of Thiene, Father of Divine Providence and faithful advocate of the needy! You who trusted fully in Jesus, who feeds the birds of the air and clothes the lilies of the field, look upon us with compassion. We implore you: let our homes never lack daily bread, honest and dignified work to sustain our families, and health to labor. Turn away the distress of scarcity, bless our endeavors, and grant us unwavering trust in God's loving providence. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Gabriel the Archangel · Wisdom, Guidance, and Good News
oraciones.textoOriginal:
O Gabriel, sancte Archangele, qui nuntius fuisti divinae incarnationis,
aperi aures nostras ad monitiones cordis clementis Iesu et Mariae.
Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O Gá-bri-el, sánc-te Ar-kán-ye-le...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Holy Archangel Gabriel, messenger of the divine mysteries, open our hearts to the light of wisdom, discernment and good news. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Psalm 100 (Mizmor LeTodah) · Song of Gratitude and Jubilee
oraciones.textoOriginal: מִזְמוֹר לְתוֹדָה: הָרִיעוּ לַיהוָה, כָּל-הָאָרֶץ. עִבְדוּ אֶת-יְהוָה בְּשִׂמְחָה; בֹּאוּ לְפָנָיו, בִּרְנָנָה.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Miz-mór le-to-dáh: Ha-rí-u l'Adonai kol ha-á-retz. Iv-dú et Adonai b'sim-cháh...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Sing joyfully to God, inhabitants of the whole earth. Serve the Lord with joy; come before his presence with rejoicing. Because the Lord is good and his mercy endures forever. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Reconciliation, Liberation of Guilt and Peace of the Soul
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Señor de infinita misericordia, hoy elijo perdonar de corazón toda ofensa y herida del pasado.
Libérame de la culpa, purifica mis pensamientos y restáurame en tu amor incondicional. Amén.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Se-ñor de in-fi-ní-ta mi-se-ri-cór-dia...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord of infinite mercy, today I choose to forgive from the heart those who offended me and ask forgiveness for my own faults. Break the chains of resentment and fill my soul with harmony and peace. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Psalm 91 · Unbreakable Strength and Dwelling of the Most High
oraciones.textoOriginal:
El que habita al abrigo del Altísimo morará bajo la sombra del Omnipotente.
Diré yo al Señor: Esperanza mía, y castillo mío; mi Dios, en quien confiaré.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [El ke a-bí-ta al a-brí-go del Al-tí-si-mo...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will dwell under the shadow of the Almighty. I will say to the Lord: My hope, and my castle; my God, in whom I will trust. You will not fear the terror by night, nor an arrow that flies by day. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Gāyatrī Mantra · Supreme Solar Light and Cosmic Discernment
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् ॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Om Bhur Bhu-vah Svah, Tat Sa-vi-tur Va-ren-yam, Bhar-go De-vas-ya Dhi-ma-hi, Dhi-yo Yo Nah Pra-cho-da-yat]
oraciones.textoTraducido: We meditate on the glory of the supreme Creator, the Sun of Divine Consciousness. May its heavenly radiance illuminate our understanding and guide our steps toward truth and peace. Om.

oraciones.titulo: Dua of Yunus (Dua al-Karb) · Rescue in the Dark and Hope
oraciones.textoOriginal: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu mina ẓ-ẓālimīn]
oraciones.textoTraducido: There is no more divinity than You. Glorified be you! I have certainly been one of those who err. Save me from anguish and grant me Your help and peace. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Our Lady of Luján · Patroness of Argentina and Mother of the Southern Cone
oraciones.textoOriginal: Sancta Maria de Lujan, Patrona Argentinae et Tutela Coni Australis, ora pro nobis.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Virgencita de Luján, Patrona de la Argentina, cuida a tu pueblo]
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Most Holy Virgin Mary, as Our Lady of Luján, Patroness of Argentina and loving Mother of the Southern Cone! You who chose to remain by the Luján River as a sign of Your perpetual love, look upon Your children with tenderness. Guard our families, comfort the sick and sorrowful, and preserve peace and harmony in our homeland. Mother of Luján, obtain from Your Divine Son health, protection, and the grace we humbly ask today. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Lord of Miracles · Cristo Moreno and Physician of Souls
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Señor de los Milagros, que clavado en la Cruz derramas torrentes de misericordia sobre quienes acuden a Ti:
Mira con piedad nuestras dolencias del cuerpo y del alma.
Sana nuestras heridas, levanta al caído y concede a nuestras familias salud, trabajo y santa fortaleza.
¡Señor de los Milagros, en Ti confío! Amén.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Se-ñór de los Mi-lá-gros, que cla-vá-do en la Cruz de-rrá-mas to-rrén-tes de mi-se-ri-cór-dia...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord of Miracles, who, nailed to the Cross, pours out torrents of mercy on those who come to You: look with mercy on our ailments of body and soul. Heal our wounds, lift up the fallen and grant our families health, work and holy strength. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Blessed Dr. José Gregorio Hernández · Physician of the Poor and Healing
oraciones.textoOriginal:
¡Oh Dios todopoderoso y misericordioso, que diste al Beato Dr. José Gregorio Hernández la vocación sagrada de servir a los enfermos con ciencia y profundo amor cristiano!
Te suplicamos por su intercesión la salud y el alivio de esta enfermedad que hoy nos aflige.
Guía las manos de los médicos y restaura en nosotros la plenitud de la vida para alabarte siempre. Amén.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Oh Diós to-do-po-de-ró-so y mi-se-ri-cor-dió-so, que dís-te al Be-á-to Doc-tór Jo-sé Gre-gó-rio Her-nán-dez...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh almighty and merciful God, who gave Blessed Dr. José Gregorio Hernández the vocation to serve the sick with science and Christian love! We beg you for your intercession for health and relief from this illness. Restore in us the fullness of life. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Virgin of Caacupé · Star of the Roads and Hope
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Tupãsy Caacupé, Tupã Sy marangatu:
Ema'ẽmi orerehe ko py'atarovápe.
Virgen Santa de Caacupé, Madre de los humildes y peregrinos, acompáñanos en las fatigas del camino de la vida, bendice el pan de nuestras mesas y conserva viva la fe en nuestros corazones. Amén.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Tu-pã-sy Caa-cu-pé, Tu-pã Sy ma-ran-ga-tu: E-ma-'ẽ-mi o-re-re-he ko py-'a-ta-ro-vá-pe...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Mother of God of Caacupé, Holy Mother: look at us in our tribulations. Holy Virgin of Caacupé, accompany us in the hardships of the journey, bless the bread on our tables and keep faith alive in our hearts. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Chant to Oshun and Yemaya · Sweetness, Fertility, and Mantle of Living Waters
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Yeye o, Oshun mori yeyeo, obinrin koro, afide owo, lade koyu!
Omio Yemaya, Iya orisha, asesu oni Yemaya, oku ayo ba mi o.
Ashé, Ashé, Ashé to ibán Èṣù.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Ye-ye o, O-shun mó-ri ye-ye-o, o-bin-rin kó-ro, a-fi-de o-wo, la-de ko-yu! O-mio Ye-ma-ya, I-ya o-ri-sha... A-shé, A-shé, A-shé to i-bán E-shu]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Venerable Mother Ochún, queen of sweet waters, honey, beauty and abundance! Mother Yemayá, immense queen of the blue sea and protector of life! Pour health, prosperity, sweetness and deep serenity upon my being. May it be so with divine grace.

oraciones.titulo: Ecclesiastes 3 (Qohélet) · Everything Has Its Time Under Heaven
oraciones.textoOriginal:
לַכֹּל זְמָן וְעֵת לְכָל־חֵפֶץ תַּחַת הַשָּׁמָיִם׃
עֵת לָלֶדֶת וְעֵת לָמוּת עֵת לָטַעַת וְעֵת לַעֲקוֹר נָטוּעַ׃
עֵת לִרְפּוֹא וְעֵת לִבְנוֹת עֵת לִבְכּוֹת וְעֵת לִשְׂחוֹק׃
אֶת־הַכֹּל עָשָׂה יָפֶה בְעִתּוֹ גַּם אֶת־הָעֹלָם נָתַן בְּלִבָּם.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [La-kol zman ve-'et le-kol che-fetz ta-chat ha-sha-má-yim. 'Et la-le-det ve-'et la-mut, 'et la-ta-'at ve-'et la-'a-kor na-tú-a... Et ha-kol a-sah ya-feh ve-'i-to...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Everything has its moment, and everything has its time under heaven: time to be born and time to die; time to plant and time to harvest; time to heal and time to build; time to cry and time to laugh. God has made everything beautiful in due time.

oraciones.titulo: Invocation to the G.A.D.U. · Order, Righteousness and Universal Fraternity
oraciones.textoOriginal:
A la Gloria del Gran Arquitecto del Universo:
Que la Sabiduría dirija nuestros pensamientos, que la Fuerza sostenga nuestras obras, y que la Belleza adorne nuestras vidas.
Desbasta la piedra tosca de nuestro ser, alinea nuestras acciones con la escuadra de la virtud y el compás del amor fraternal hacia toda la humanidad. Así sea.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [A la Gló-ria del Gran Ar-qui-téc-to del U-ni-vér-so... Que la Sa-bi-du-rí-a di-rí-ja nués-tros pen-sa-mién-tos...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Father of Infinite Goodness, Wisdom, and Mercy! In deep spiritual elevation, we lift our prayer for Invocation to the G.A.D.U. · Order, Righteousness and Universal Fraternity. We pray to the good spirits and our guardian angel to assist us with their beneficent light, dispel all turmoil from the soul, and grant us patience, resignation, and love to progress along the path of goodness. May the peace of God rest upon us. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Joseph the Worker · Dignity of Work, Sustenance, and Peace in the Home
oraciones.textoOriginal: Sancte Ioseph, custos sanctae Familiae et opificum exemplar, opus manuum nostrarum sanctifica, panem quotidianum nobis impetra, et in omni labore pacem atque iustitiam concede. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Sánc-te Yó-sef, cús-tos sánc-te Fa-mí-li-e et o-pí-fi-cum ek-sém-plar...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Glorious Saint Joseph the Worker, custodian of the Holy Family and model of all workers: bless the work of my hands, open work paths where there is scarcity, and grant me a dignified, honest and abundant livelihood for my family. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Jude Thaddeus · Urgent Assistance in Labor and Economic Causes
oraciones.textoOriginal: Sancte Iuda Thaddaei, apostole gloriose, afflictorum patronus in causis arduis, respice angustias nostras, auxilium tempestivum confer et spem nostram firma. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Sánc-te Yú-da Ta-dé-i, a-pós-to-le glo-ri-ó-se...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Saint Jude Thaddeus, glorious apostle and patron of difficult and desperate cases: intercede before God for my economic and work situation. Make closed doors open, that I do not lack a decent job and that divine provision comes to my home promptly. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Onofre · Provision of Decent Work, Shelter and Prosperity
oraciones.textoOriginal: Oh glorioso San Onofre, humilde anacoreta del desierto que fuiste sostenido por la bondad celestial: así como nunca te faltó el auxilio de Dios, asísteme en esta hora de necesidad para que obtenga un trabajo honrado, un techo seguro y los medios para vivir en paz y bienestar. Amén.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O glo-rió-so San O-nó-fre, u-míl-de a-na-co-ré-ta del de-siér-to...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh glorious Saint Onuphrius, humble servant of God supported by Divine Providence: grant me help in my material needs, open sources of work and bring just abundance to my life. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Pancras · Health and Employment for the Entrepreneur and Family
oraciones.textoOriginal: Glorioso San Pancracio, joven mártir que fuiste fiel al Señor: te pido humildemente salud del cuerpo y prosperidad en mis labores y negocios. Que con tu intercesión prospere lo que emprendo, rinda el fruto de mi esfuerzo y nunca falte el bienestar en mi hogar. Amén.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Glo-rió-so San Pan-crá-cio, jó-ven már-tir...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Glorious Saint Pancras: grant me health to work and honest success in my occupations and businesses. May every step I take be blessed and my efforts bear fruit of prosperity. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Ganesha Maha Mantra · Om Gam Ganapataye Namaha · Openness and Success
oraciones.textoOriginal:
ॐ गं गणपतये नमः ॥
वक्रतुण्ड महाकाय सूर्यकोटि समप्रभ ।
निर्विघ्नं कुरु मे देव सर्वकार्येषु सर्वदा ॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Om Gam Ga-na-pa-ta-ye Na-ma-ha; Va-kra-tún-da Ma-ha-ká-ya Súr-ya-ko-ti Sa-ma-pra-bha; Nir-vig-nam Ku-ru Me De-va Sár-va-kar-yé-shu Sár-va-da]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om. I prostrate before Ganesha, the Lord of wisdom and all beginnings, whose radiance is equal to ten million suns. Eliminate all obstacles in my paths, my projects and bless my work at all times.

oraciones.titulo: Maha Lakshmi Gayatri · Blessing of Abundance and Divine Provision
oraciones.textoOriginal:
ॐ महालक्ष्म्यै च विद्महे विष्णुपत्न्यै च धीमहि ।
तन्नो लक्ष्मीः प्रचोदयात् ॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Om Ma-ha-laksh-myai Cha Vid-ma-he Vish-nu-pat-nyai Cha Dhi-ma-hi; Tan-no Laksh-mih Pra-cho-da-yát]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om. Let us meditate on the Great Deity Lakshmi, consort of Vishnu. May She pour out her supreme grace, inspiring our minds and filling our lives with abundance, virtue and integral well-being.

oraciones.titulo: Saint John Bosco · Blessing of Endeavors, Studies, and Provision
oraciones.textoOriginal: Oh San Juan Bosco, padre y maestro de la juventud, ejemplo de confianza infinita en la Divina Providencia: tú que viste cómo Dios provee para cada obra justa, bendice mis proyectos, estudios y emprendimientos. Que el fruto de mi trabajo sirva para el bien de mi prójimo y la estabilidad de mi hogar. Amén.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O San Juan Bós-co, pá-dre y ma-és-tro de la ju-ven-túd...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Saint John Bosco, example of living trust in Divine Providence: bless my efforts, guide my projects and provide dignified sustenance for my home, remembering that whoever trusts in the Lord is never disappointed. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Traditional Act of Contrition · My Lord Jesus Christ
oraciones.textoOriginal: Deus meus, ex toto corde me paenitet de omnibus quae commisi, quia peccando Te offendi, summum et infinitum Bonum. Propone firmiter, adiuvante gratia tua, de cetero non peccare, atque occasiones proximas peccati fugere. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Dé-us mé-us, eks tó-to cór-de me pe-ní-tet de om-ní-bus que com-mí-si...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: My Lord Jesus Christ, God and true Man, Creator, Father and my Redeemer: because You are who You are, Infinite Goodness, I am sorry with all my heart for having offended You. I firmly propose never to sin again, to turn away from all occasions of offense and to trust in your infinite mercy. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Francis of Assisi · Instrument of Peace, Forgiveness and Reconciliation
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Dó-mi-ne, fak me in-stru-mén-tum pá-chis tú-e: U-bi ó-di-um, í-bi a-mó-rem sé-ram...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord, make me an instrument of Your peace: where there is hatred, let me sow love; where there is injury, pardon; where there is doubt, faith; where there is despair, hope; where there is darkness, light; and where there is sadness, joy. O Divine Master, grant that I may not so much seek to be consoled as to console, to be understood as to understand, to be loved as to love. For it is in giving that we receive, it is in pardoning that we are pardoned, and it is in dying that we are born to eternal life. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Ho'oponopono Sagrado · Lo Siento, Forgivenessame, Te Amo, Gracias
oraciones.textoOriginal:
E Kala Mai Ia'u, E Aloha Au Ia 'Oe, Mahalo, Aloha.
Divina Presencia, Creador Universal:
Limpia, borra y transmuta en pura luz cualquier memoria, patrón de dolor o discordia que exista en mí o en mis ancestros. Lo siento, Perdóname, Te amo, Gracias.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [E Ka-la Mai Ia-u, E A-lo-ha Au Ia O-e, Ma-ha-lo, A-lo-ha...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Father of Infinite Goodness, Wisdom, and Mercy! In deep spiritual elevation, we lift our prayer for Ho'oponopono Sagrado · Lo Siento, Forgivenessame, Te Amo, Gracias. We pray to the good spirits and our guardian angel to assist us with their beneficent light, dispel all turmoil from the soul, and grant us patience, resignation, and love to progress along the path of goodness. May the peace of God rest upon us. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Soul of Christ (Anima Christi) · Sanctification, Lavatory and Protection
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Anima Christi, sanctifica me.
Corpus Christi, salva me.
Sanguis Christi, inebria me.
Aqua lateris Christi, lava me.
Passio Christi, conforta me.
O bone Iesu, exaudi me.
Intra tua vulnera absconde me.
Ne permittas me separari a te.
Ab hoste maligno defende me.
In hora mortis meae voca me.
Et iube me venire ad te,
ut cum Sanctis tuis laudem te
in saecula saeculorum. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Á-ni-ma Krís-ti, sank-tí-fi-ka me; Cór-pus Krís-ti, sál-va me; Sán-guis Krís-ti, in-é-bri-a me...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Soul of Christ, sanctify me. Body of Christ, save me. Blood of Christ, intoxicate me. Water from the side of Christ, wash me. Passion of Christ, comfort me. Oh, good Jesus! Hear me. Inside your wounds, hide me. Don't let me separate from You. From the evil enemy, defend me. At the hour of my death, call me and command me to come to You, so that with Your saints I may praise You forever and ever. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Padre Pio of Pietrelcina · Prayer of Humility, Trust and Forgiveness
oraciones.textoOriginal: Quédate conmigo, Señor, porque es necesario tenerte presente para no olvidarte. Tú sabes con qué facilidad te abandono. Quédate conmigo, Señor, porque soy débil y necesito de tu fuerza para no caer tantas veces. Quédate conmigo, Señor, porque Tú eres mi vida y sin Ti me falta el fervor. Amén.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Ké-da-te con-mí-go, Se-ñór, por-ke es ne-ce-sá-rio te-nér-te pre-sén-te...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus, through the intercession of Saint Pio of Pietrelcina, cleanse my heart of all resentment, erase my past faults and renew inner peace in me. Make me live with the certainty that your mercy is infinitely greater than my mistakes. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Peregrino Laziosi · Patron of the Sick and Healing of the Body
oraciones.textoOriginal: Sancte Peregrine, quem Christus ipse a gravi morbo mirabiliter sanavit: impetra aegrotantibus salutem corporis et robur animae, ut divino adiutorio confortati, laeti Deum glorificent. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Sánc-te Pe-re-grí-ne, kuem Krís-tus íp-se a grá-vi mór-bo mi-ra-bí-li-ter sa-ná-vit...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Glorious Saint Peregrine, you who were miraculously healed by Christ on the cross: extend your compassionate hand to all who suffer from serious illnesses, cancer and bodily pain. Ask for us healing of the body, strength of spirit and the grace of a speedy recovery. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Pantaleon · Physician and Martyr · Relief of Suffering and Health
oraciones.textoOriginal: Sancte Pantaleon, medicus misericors et athleta Christi: infunde medicinam caelestem super languentes, dolores mitiga, et plenam sanitatem impetra. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Sánc-te Pan-ta-lé-on, mé-di-kus mi-se-rí-kors et at-lé-ta Krís-ti...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Saint Pantaleon, compassionate doctor whom you cured with science and faith: look at our ailments and sufferings. Pour the balm of divine medicine on our body, relieve the pain of the sick and guide the hand of the doctors who assist us. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Blas · Help in Throat, Breathing and Health Conditions
oraciones.textoOriginal: Per intercessionem Sancti Blasii Episcopi et Martyris, liberet te Deus a malo gulae et a quolibet alio malo. In nomine Patris, et Filii, et Spiritus Sancti. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Per in-ter-ces-si-ó-nem Sánc-ti Blá-si-i E-pís-co-pi et Már-ti-ris...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Through the intercession of Saint Blaise, bishop and martyr, may the Lord free us from throat ailments, respiratory ailments, and all illnesses of the body and spirit. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Lucia · Eye Health, Eye Clarity and Spiritual Light
oraciones.textoOriginal: Sancta Lucia, virgo et martyr, oculos nostros a morbis et caecitate custodi, ac lucem gratiae in mentibus nostris accende. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Sánc-ta Lu-chí-a, vír-go et már-tir, ó-cu-los nós-tros a mór-bis et che-chi-tá-te cus-tó-di...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Saint Lucia, protector of sight: preserve the health and clarity of my physical eyes and enlighten the eyes of my soul to always walk in the light of truth and peace. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Camillus of Lellis · Protection for Convalescents and Health Caregivers
oraciones.textoOriginal: Señor Jesús, que infundiste en el corazón de San Camilo un amor inmenso hacia los enfermos: mira con misericordia a quienes hoy padecen en camas de hospital y en sus hogares. Da paciencia al convaleciente, fortaleza al cuidador y restaura la plenitud de la vida. Amén.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Se-ñór Je-sús, ke in-fun-dís-te en el co-ra-zón de San Ca-mí-lo...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Saint Camillus of Lelis, universal patron of the sick and hospitals: assists those who are prostrated by pain, restores vitality to their bodies and showers blessings on the doctors and nurses who give their lives for their neighbors. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: El Magníficat · Cántico de la Virgen María (Lucas 1:46-55) · La Magnífica
oraciones.textoOriginal: Magnificat anima mea Dominum, et exsultavit spiritus meus in Deo salvatore meo, quia respexit humilitatem ancillae suae. Fecit mihi magna qui potens est, et sanctum nomen eius. Dispersit superbos mente cordis sui; deposuit potentes de sede et exaltavit humiles. Esurientes implevit bonis et divites dimisit inanes. Suscepit Israel puerum suum, recordatus misericordiae suae. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Mag-ní-fi-kat á-ni-ma mé-a Dó-mi-num, et ek-sul-tá-vit spí-ri-tus mé-us in Dé-o sal-va-tó-re mé-o... A-men.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: My soul proclaims the greatness of the Lord, my spirit rejoices in God my Savior, for He has looked with favor on His lowly servant. From this day all generations will call me blessed: the Almighty has done great things for me, and holy is His Name. He has mercy on those who fear Him in every generation. He has shown the strength of His arm, He has scattered the proud in their conceit. He has cast down the mighty from their thrones, and has lifted up the lowly. He has filled the hungry with good things, and the rich He has sent away empty. He has come to the help of His servant Israel for He has remembered His promise of mercy, the promise He made to our fathers, to Abraham and his children forever. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Te Deum Laudamus · Universal Solemn Thanksgiving Anthem
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Te Deum laudamus: te Dominum confitemur.
Te aeternum Patrem omnis terra veneratur.
Tibi omnes Angeli, tibi Caeli et universae Potestates,
tibi Cherubim et Seraphim incessabili voce proclamant:
Sanctus, Sanctus, Sanctus Dominus Deus Sabaoth.
Pleni sunt caeli et terra maiestatis gloriae tuae. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Te Dé-um lau-dá-mus: te Dó-mi-num con-fi-té-mur. Te e-tér-num Pá-trem óm-nis tér-ra ve-ne-rá-tur...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: You, O God, we praise, you, Lord, we acknowledge. You, eternal Father, all creation worships you. The angels, the heavens and all the powers sing to you without ceasing: Holy, Holy, Holy is the Lord, God of the universe. Heaven and earth are full of the majesty of your glory. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Canticle of the Creatures of Saint Francis · Cosmic Praise to the Creator
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Altissimu, onnipotente, bon Signore,
tue so le laude, la gloria e l'honore et onne benedictione.
Laudato sie, mi Signore, cum tucte le tue creature,
spetialmente messor lo frate sole,
lo qual è iorno, et allumini noi per lui.
Et ellu è bellu e radiante cum grande splendore:
de te, Altissimu, porta significatione. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Al-tís-si-mu, on-ni-po-tén-te, bon Si-ñó-re, tú-e so le láu-de, la gló-ria e lo-nó-re...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Most high, omnipotent, good Lord: yours are the praise, the glory and the honor. Praise you, my Lord, in all your creatures, especially in brother Sun, who illuminates the day and is beautiful and radiant, carrying your meaning. Praise you for sister Luna, the wind, the water and mother earth. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: The Benedictus · Canticle of Zechariah · Blessed be the Lord God of Israel
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Benedictus Dominus Deus Israel,
quia visitavit et fecit redemptionem plebis suae,
et erexit cornu salutis nobis in domo David pueri sui,
sicut locutus est per os sanctorum,
qui a saeculo sunt, prophetarum eius. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Be-ne-dík-tus Dó-mi-nus Dé-us Ís-ra-el, kuí-a vi-si-tá-vit et fé-chit re-demp-tsi-ó-nem plé-bis sú-e...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people, raising up for us a power of salvation in the house of David, his servant, as he had predicted long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets. He will grant us to serve him with holiness and justice all our days. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Gloria in Excelsis Deo · Major Doxology and Heavenly Praise
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Gloria in excelsis Deo
et in terra pax hominibus bonae voluntatis.
Laudamus te, benedicimus te, adoramus te, glorificamus te,
gratias agimus tibi propter magnam gloriam tuam,
Domine Deus, Rex caelestis, Deus Pater omnipotens. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Gló-ri-a in ek-shél-sis Dé-o et in tér-ra paks ho-mí-ni-bus bó-ne vo-lun-tá-tis. Lau-dá-mus te, be-ne-dí-chi-mus te...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Glory to God in heaven, and on earth peace to the men whom the Lord loves. For your immense glory we praise you, we bless you, we adore you, we glorify you, we thank you, Lord God, heavenly King, God the Father almighty. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: The Holy Quran (Al-Qur'an) · Surah 1: Al-Fātiḥah (The Opening)
oraciones.textoOriginal:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ
اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ
صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Bismillāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm | Al-ḥamdu lillāhi Rabbi l-‘ālamīn | Ar-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm | Māliki Yawmi d-Dīn...
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
2. Praise God, Lord of the Universe,
3. the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful,
4. Sovereign of the Day of Judgment.
5. Only You we worship and only You we implore for help.
6. Guide us on the straight path,
7. the path of those whom You have filled with Your graces, not that of those who have incurred Your wrath, nor that of those who have gone astray.

oraciones.titulo: The Holy Quran (Al-Qur'an) · Surah 2: Al-Baqarah (The Cow - Includes Ayat al-Kursi)
oraciones.textoOriginal:
الم
ذَٰلِكَ الْكِتَابُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa l-Ḥayyu l-Qayyūm... Wasi‘a kursiyyuhu s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍ...
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. Álif. Lam. Mim.
2. This is the sacred Book, free from all doubt, a guide for the pious who fear God,
3. who believe in the occult, observe prayer and spend what we provide them generously.
255. God! There is no divinity but He, the Living, the Subsistent. He is not overcome by drowsiness or sleep. His is all that is in the heavens and the earth. Who can intercede before Him without His permission? He knows their past and their future, while they do not encompass His science but what He wants. His sacred Throne encompasses the heavens and the earth, and His keeping does not cause him fatigue. He is the Most High, the Great. (Ayat al-Kursi)
286. God does not impose on any soul a greater burden than it can bear. He will obtain the reward for the good he does and suffer the punishment for the evil he commits.

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
(سُورَة 3)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Bismillāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm... (Sūrah 3)
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. In the name of God, the Gracious, the Merciful. (Sura 3:1)
2. Glorified be God, to Whom belongs the kingdom of heaven and earth. (Sura 3:2)
3. He who practices good and is grateful will find a great reward before his Lord. (Sura 3:3)

oraciones.titulo: The Holy Quran (Al-Qur'an) · Surah 112: Al-Ikhlāṣ (Divine Oneness and Pure Faith)
oraciones.textoOriginal:
قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ
لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Qul Huwa Allāhu Aḥad | Allāhu ṣ-Ṣamad | Lam yalid wa-lam yūlad | Wa-lam yakul-lahū kufuwan aḥad

oraciones.titulo: The Holy Quran (Al-Qur'an) · Surah 113: Al-Falaq (The Daybreak / Divine Protection)
oraciones.textoOriginal:
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ
مِن שַׁרِّ مَا خَلَقَ
وَمِن שַׁרِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
وَمِن שַׁרِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ
وَمِن שַׁרِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Qul a‘ūdhu bi-Rabbi l-falaq | Min sharri mā khalaq | Wa-min sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab...
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. Say: "I take refuge in the Lord of the dawn,
2. from the evil of what he has created,
3. from the evil of the darkness of the night when it spreads,
4. of the evil of those who practice spells and curses,
5. and of the evil of the envious when he envies.

oraciones.titulo: The Holy Quran (Al-Qur'an) · Surah 114: An-Nās (Humanity / Refuge in the Sovereign of Men)
oraciones.textoOriginal:
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ
مَلِكِ النَّاسِ
إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ
مِن שַׁרِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ
الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ
مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Qul a‘ūdhu bi-Rabbi n-nās | Maliki n-nās | Ilāhi n-nās | Min sharri l-waswāsi l-khannās...
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. Say: "I take refuge in the Lord of men,
2. Sovereign of men,
3. God of men,
4. from the evil of the whisperer who stalks and flees,
5. who whispers doubts in people's hearts,
6. whether from the jinn or from among men.»

oraciones.titulo: The Tanach & Tehillim (The 150 Psalms of David) · Tehillim / Psalm 1: The Two Paths: The Tree by the Waters
oraciones.textoOriginal: אַשְׁרֵי הָאִישׁ, אֲשֶׁר לֹא הָלַךְ בַּעֲצַת רְשָׁעִים... כִּי-יוֹדֵעַ יְהוָה, דֶּרֶךְ צַדִּיקִים; וְדֶרֶךְ רְשָׁעִים תֹּאבֵד.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Mizmōr lə-Dāwīd (Tehilīm 1)...
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand in the way of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scorners;
2. But his delight is in the law of the Lord, and he meditates on his law day and night.
3. It will be like a tree planted by streams of water, which yields its fruit in its season, and its leaf does not wither; and everything he does will prosper.
4. Not so with the wicked, who are like the chaff that the wind carries away.
5. Therefore the wicked will not arise in the judgment, nor the sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
6. For the Lord knows the way of the righteous; but the path of the wicked will perish.

oraciones.titulo: The Tanach & Tehillim (The 150 Psalms of David) · Tehillim / Psalm 2: Canticle and Prayer of David (Mizmor 2)
oraciones.textoOriginal: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד. יְהוָה שְׁמָע-תְּפִלָּתִי, וְשַׁוְעָתִי אֵלֶיךָ תָבוֹא. כִּי-טוֹב יְהוָה, לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ; וְעַד-דֹּר וָדֹר אֱמוּנָתוֹ. (תְּהִלִּים מִזְמוֹר 2)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Mizmōr lə-Dāwīd (Tehilīm 2)...
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. To the main Musician. Psalm of David. Hear, O Lord, my words; Consider my meditation. (Psalm 2:1)
2. Be attentive to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for I will pray to you in the morning. (Psalm 2:2)
3. For you, O Lord, will bless the righteous; As with a shield you will surround him with your benevolence. (Psalm 2:3)
4. Praise the Lord, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen. (Psalm 2:4)

oraciones.titulo: The Tanach & Tehillim (The 150 Psalms of David) · Tehillim / Psalm 23: The Lord is my Shepherd (Mizmor le-David)
oraciones.textoOriginal: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד: יְהוָה רֹעִי, לֹא אֶחְסָר... אַךְ, טוֹב וָחֶסֶד יִרְדְּפוּנִי--כָּל-יְמֵי חַיָּי; וְשַׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית-יְהוָה, לְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Mizmōr lə-Dāwīd (Tehilīm 23)...
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. The Lord is my shepherd; I will lack nothing.
2. He will make me rest in places of delicate pastures; He will shepherd me beside still waters.
3. It will comfort my soul; He will guide me in paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
4. Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, because you will be with me; Your rod and your staff will comfort me.
5. You prepare a table before me in the presence of my distressers; you anoint my head with oil; my cup is overflowing.
6. Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the Lord for long days.

oraciones.titulo: The Tanach & Tehillim (The 150 Psalms of David) · Tehillim / Psalm 27: The Lord is my Light and my Salvation (Mizmor le-David)
oraciones.textoOriginal: לְדָוִד: יְהוָה, אוֹרִי וְיִשְׁעִי--מִמִּי אִירָא; יְהוָה מָעוֹז-חַיַּי, מִמִּי אֶפְחָד... אַחַת שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵאֵת-יְהוָה, אוֹתָהּ אֲבַקֵּשׁ: שִׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית-יְהוָה, כָּל-יְמֵי חַיַּי... קַוֵּה, אֶל-יְהוָה: חֲזַק, וְיַאֲמֵץ לִבֶּךָ; וְקַוֵּה, אֶל-יְהוָה.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Lə-Dāwīd: Adonāi ōrī wə-yish‘ī, mi-mmī īrā? Adonāi mā‘ōz-ḥayyay, mi-mmī efḥād?... Aḥat shā’altī mē’ēt-Adonāi, ōtāh ăvaqqēsh: shivtī bə-vēyt Adonāi kāl-yəmēy ḥayyay... Qawwēh el-Adonāi: ḥăzaq wə-ya’ămēṣ libbekhā, wə-qawwēh el-Adonāi.
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. The Lord is my light and my salvation; Who will I fear? The Lord is the strength of my life; Who should I be afraid of?
2. When the evil ones, my distressers and my enemies, gathered against me to eat my flesh, they stumbled and fell.
3. Even though an army encamps against me, my heart will not fear; Even if war arises against me, I will be confident.
4. One thing I have asked of the Lord, this I will seek; May I be in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to contemplate the beauty of the Lord, and to inquire in his temple.
5. For he will hide me in his tabernacle on the day of evil; He will hide me in the privacy of his dwelling; He will set me high on a rock.
14. Wait for the Lord; be strong, and let your heart be encouraged; yes, wait for the Lord.

oraciones.titulo: The Tanach & Tehillim (The 150 Psalms of David) · Tehillim / Psalm 35: Prayer of Deliverance and Divine Help (Mizmor 35)
oraciones.textoOriginal: לְדָוִד: רִיבָה יְהוָה אֶת-יְרִיבַי; לְחַם, אֶת-לֹחֲמָי. הַחֲזֵק מָגֵן וְצִנָּה; וְקוּמָה, בְּעֶזְרָתִי... וְנַפְשִׁי, תָּגִיל בַּיהוָה; תָּשִׂישׂ, בִּישׁוּעָתוֹ. כָּל עַצְמוֹתַי תֹּאמַרְנָה, יְהוָה מִי כָמוֹךָ... וּלְשׁוֹנִי, תֶּהְגֶּה צִדְקֶךָ; כָּל-הַיּוֹם, תְּהִלָּתֶךָ.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Lə-Dāwīd: Rīvāh Adonāi et-yərīvay, ləḥam et-loḥamāy. Haḥazēq māgēn wə-ṣinnāh, wə-qūmāh bə-‘ezrātī... Wə-nafshī tāgīl b-Adonāi, tāsīs b-īshū‘ātō. Kāl ‘aṣmōtay tōmarnah: Adonāi, mī khāmōkhā... Wū-ləshōnī tehgeh ṣidqekhā, kāl ha-yyōm təhillātekā.
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. Dispute, O Lord, with those who contend against me; fight against those who fight me.
2. Take hold of the shield and the buckler, and arise to my aid.
3. Take out your spear, close against my pursuers; say to my soul: I am your salvation.
4. Let those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; Let those who attempt my evil be turned back and put to shame.
5. Be like chaff before the wind, and the angel of the Lord will harass you.
9. Then my soul will rejoice in the Lord; He will rejoice in his salvation.
10. All my bones will say: Lord, who is like you, who rescues the afflicted from him who is stronger than he, and the poor and needy from those who rob him?
27. Let those who are in favor of my just cause sing and rejoice, and always say: May the Lord be exalted, who loves the peace of his servant.
28. And my tongue will speak of your righteousness and your praise all day long.

oraciones.titulo: The Tanach & Tehillim (The 150 Psalms of David) · Tehillim / Psalm 46: God is our Protection and Strength (Shir al-Alamot)
oraciones.textoOriginal: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לִבְנֵי-קֹרַח: אֱלֹהִים לָנוּ, מַחֲסֶה וָעֹז; עֶזְרָה בְצָרוֹת, נִמְצָא מְאֹד... יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת עִמָּנוּ; מִשְׂגָּב-לָנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Lamnaṣṣēaḥ li-vnēy Qōraḥ: Elohīm lānū maḥăseh wā-‘ōz, ‘ezrāh bə-ṣārōt nimṣā mə’ōd... Adonāi Ṣəvā’ōt ‘immānū, misgav lānū Elohēy Ya‘ăqōv, Selāh.
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. God is our refuge and strength, our very present help in tribulations.
2. Therefore we will not fear, though the earth be removed, and the mountains be transferred into the heart of the sea;
3. although its waters roar and are troubled, and the mountains tremble because of its violence.
10. Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations; I will be exalted on earth.
11. The Lord of hosts is with us; our refuge is the God of Jacob.

oraciones.titulo: The Tanach & Tehillim (The 150 Psalms of David) · Tehillim / Psalm 51: Miserere: Prayer of Repentance and Renewal
oraciones.textoOriginal: לַמְנַצֵּחַ, מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד... חָנֵּנִי אֱלֹהִים כְּחַסְדֶּךָ; כְּרֹב רַחֲמֶיךָ, מְחֵה פְשָׁעָי. הֶרֶב, כַּבְּסֵנִי מֵעֲו‍ֹנִי; וּמֵחַטָּאתִי טַהֲרֵנִי... לֵב טָהוֹר, בְּרָא-לִי אֱלֹהִים; וְרוּחַ נָכוֹן, חַדֵּשׁ בְּקִרְבִּי.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Lamnaṣṣēaḥ mizmōr lə-Dāwīd... Ḥānnēnī Elohīm kə-ḥasdekā, kə-rōv raḥameykhā məḥēh fəshā‘āy. Herev kabbəsēnī mē-‘ăwōnī, ū-mē-ḥaṭṭātī ṭaharēnī... Lēv ṭāhōr bərā-lī Elohīm, wə-rūaḥ nākhōn ḥaddēsh bə-qirbī.
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. Have mercy on me, O God, according to your mercy; according to the multitude of your mercy blot out my transgressions.
2. Wash me more and more from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
3. For I acknowledge my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.
7. Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
10. Create in me, O God, a clean heart, and renew a right spirit within me.
11. Do not cast me out from before you, and do not take your holy Spirit from me.
12. Return to me the joy of your salvation, and a noble spirit sustain me.
15. Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare your praise.
17. The sacrifices of God are the broken spirit; You will not despise a contrite and humiliated heart, O God.

oraciones.titulo: The Tanach & Tehillim (The 150 Psalms of David) · Tehillim / Psalm 91: The Supreme Protection under the Shadow of the Most High
oraciones.textoOriginal: יֹשֵׁב, בְּסֵתֶר עֶלְיוֹן; בְּצֵל שַׁדַּי, יִתְלוֹנָן... כִּי מַלְאָכָיו, יְצַוֶּה-לָּךְ-- לִשְׁמָרְךָ, בְּכָל-דְּרָכֶיךָ... אֹרֶךְ יָמִים, אַשְׂבִּיעֵהוּ; וְאַרְאֵהוּ, בִּישׁוּעָתִי.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Mizmōr lə-Dāwīd (Tehilīm 91)...
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will dwell under the shadow of the Almighty.
2. I will say to the Lord: My hope, and my castle; my God, in whom I will trust.
3. He will deliver you from the trapper's snare, from the destroying pestilence.
4. He will cover you with his feathers, and under his wings you will be safe; shield and buckler is his truth.
5. You will not fear the terror by night, nor the arrow that flies by day,
6. Nor pestilence that walks in darkness, nor destruction that destroys at midday.
7. A thousand will fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not reach you.
11. For he will command his angels concerning you, to guard you in all your ways.
12. They will carry you in their hands, so that your foot does not strike against a stone.
14. Because he has put his love on me, I will also deliver him; I will exalt him, because he has known my name.
15. He will call upon me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in anguish; I will deliver him and glorify him.
16. I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.

oraciones.textoOriginal: שִׁיר, לַמַּעֲלוֹת: אֶשָּׂא עֵינַי, אֶל-הֶהָרִים-- מֵאַיִן, יָבֹא עֶזְרִי. עֶזְרִי, מֵעִם יְהוָה-- עֹשֵׂה, שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ... יְהוָה, יִשְׁמָר-צֵאתְךָ וּבוֹאֶךָ-- מֵעַתָּה, וְעַד-עוֹלָם.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Shīr la-mma‘alōt: Essā ‘ēnay el-he-hārīm, mē’ayin yāvō ‘ezrī? ‘Ezrī mē-‘im Adonāi, ‘ōsēh shāmayim wā-’āreṣ... Adonāi yishmār-ṣētəkā ū-vō’ekhā, mē-‘attāh wə-‘ad-‘ōlām.
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. I will lift up my eyes to the mountains; where will my help come from?
2. My help comes from the Lord, who made the heavens and the earth.
3. Your foot will not slip, nor will he who watches over you fall asleep.
4. Behold, he who keeps Israel will not slumber or sleep.
5. The Lord is your keeper; The Lord is your shadow at your right hand.
6. The sun will not weary you by day, nor the moon by night.
7. The Lord will keep you from all evil; he will guard your soul.
8. The Lord will guard your going out and your coming in from now on and forever.

oraciones.titulo: The Tanach & Tehillim (The 150 Psalms of David) · Tehillim / Psalm 133: The Blessing of Brotherly Harmony (Shir Ha-Ma'alot)
oraciones.textoOriginal: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת, לְדָוִד: הִנֵּה מַה-טּוֹב, וּמַה-נָּעִים-- שֶׁבֶת אַחִים גַּם-יָחַד. כַּשֶּׁמֶן הַטּוֹב עַל-הָרֹאשׁ, יוֹרֵד עַל-הַזָּקָן-- זְקַן-אַהֲרֹן: שֶׁיּוֹרֵד, עַל-פִּי מִדּוֹתָיו. כְּטַל-חֶרְמוֹן-- שֶׁיּוֹרֵד, עַל-הַרְרֵי צִיּוֹן: כִּי שָׁם צִוָּה יְהוָה, אֶת-הַבְּרָכָה-- חַיִּים, עַד-הָעוֹלָם.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Shīr ha-ma‘alōt lə-Dāwīd: Hinnēh mah-ṭōv ū-mah-nā‘īm, shevet aḥīm gam-yāḥad. Ka-shemen ha-ṭṭōv ‘al-ha-rōsh, yōrēd ‘al-ha-zzāqān, zəqan-Aharōn: she-yyōrēd ‘al-pī middōtāv. Kə-ṭal-Ḥermōn she-yyōrēd ‘al-harrēy Ṣiyyōn: kī shām ṣiwwāh Adonāi et-ha-bərākhāh, ḥayyīm ‘ad-ha-‘ōlām.

oraciones.titulo: The Tanach & Tehillim (The 150 Psalms of David) · Tehillim / Psalm 139: The Omnipresence and Infinite Science of God
oraciones.textoOriginal: לַמְנַצֵּחַ, לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר: יְהוָה חֲקַרְתַּנִי, וַתֵּדָע. אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ, שִׁבְתִּי וְקוּמִי-- בַּנְתָּה לְרֵעִי, מֵרָחוֹק... כִּי אַתָּה, קָנִיתָ כִלְיֹתָי; תְּסֻכֵּנִי, בְּבֶטֶן אִמִּי... חָקְרֵנִי אֵל, וְדַע לְבָבִי; בְּחָנֵנִי, וְדַע שַׂרְעַפָּי.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Lamnaṣṣēaḥ lə-Dāwīd mizmōr: Adonāi ḥăqartanī wa-ttēdā‘. Attāh yāda‘tā shivtī wə-qūmī, bantāh lə-rē‘ī mē-rāḥōq... Kī attāh qānītā khilyotāy, təsukkēnī bə-veṭen immī... Ḥāqrēnī Ēl wə-da‘ ləvāvī, bəḥānēnī wə-da‘ sar‘appāy.
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. O Lord, you have examined me and known me.
2. You have known my sitting and my rising; You have understood my thoughts from afar.
3. You have searched my walk and my rest, and all my ways are known to you.
7. Where will I go from your Spirit? And where will I flee from your presence?
8. If I ascend to heaven, there you are; and if I make my footstool in Sheol, behold, there you are.
13. Because you formed my bowels; you made me in my mother's womb.
14. I will praise you; because formidable, wonderful are your works; I am amazed, and my soul knows it very well.
23. Examine me, O God, and know my heart; Test me and know my thoughts;
24. and see if there is any wicked way in me, and guide me in the eternal way.

oraciones.titulo: The Tanach & Tehillim (The 150 Psalms of David) · Tehillim / Psalm 150: Great Doxology: Everything that breathes praise the Lord
oraciones.textoOriginal: הַלְלוּ-יָהּ: הַלְלוּ-אֵל בְּקָדְשׁוֹ; הַלְלוּהוּ, בִּרְקִיעַ עֻזּוֹ. הַלְלוּהוּ בִגְבוּרֹתָיו; הַלְלוּהוּ, כְּרֹב גֻּדְלוֹ. הַלְלוּהוּ, בְּתֵקַע שׁוֹפָר; הַלְלוּהוּ, בְּנֵבֶל וְכִנּוֹר... כֹּל הַנְּשָׁמָה, תְּהַלֵּל יָהּ: הַלְלוּ-יָהּ.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Haləlū-Yāh: Haləlū-Ēl bə-qodshō, haləlūhū birqīa‘ ‘uzzō. Haləlūhū vigvūrōtāv, haləlūhū kə-rōv gudlō. Haləlūhū bə-tēqa‘ shōfār, haləlūhū bə-nēvel wə-khinnōr... Kōl ha-nnəshāmāh təhallēl Yāh: Haləlū-Yāh.
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. Hallelujah! Praise God in his sanctuary; praise him in the magnificence of his firmament.
2. Praise him for his exploits; praise him according to the multitude of his greatness.
3. Praise him with the blast of trumpet and shofar; praise him with psaltery and harp.
4. Praise him with tambourine and dance; praise him with strings and flutes.
5. Praise him with resounding cymbals; praise him with cymbals of joy.
6. Everything that breathes praise the Lord. Alleluia!

oraciones.titulo: The Book of Genesis (Bereshit) · Chapter 1: The Creation of Heaven and Earth
oraciones.textoOriginal: בְּרֵאשִׁית, בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים, אֵת הַשָּׁמַיִם, וְאֵת הָאָרֶץ. וְהָאָרֶץ, הָיְתָה תֹהוּ וָבֹהוּ, וְחֹשֶׁךְ, עַל-פְּנֵי תְהוֹם; וְרוּחַ אֱלֹהִים, מְרַחֶפֶת עַל-פְּנֵי הַמָּיִם. וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים, יְהִי אוֹר; וַיְהִי-אוֹר.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Bərē’shīt bārā Elohīm ēt ha-shāmayim wə-ēt hā-ārets. Wə-hā-ārets hāytāh tōhū wā-vōhū, wə-ḥōshekh ‘al-pənē təhōm; wə-rūaḥ Elohīm məraḥefet ‘al-pənē ha-māyim. Wa-yōmer Elohīm: Yəhī ōr; wa-yəhī ōr.
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
2. And the earth was without form and void, and darkness was on the face of the deep, and the Spirit of God moved on the face of the waters.
3. And God said: Let there be light; and it was the light.
4. And God saw that the light was good; and God separated the light from the darkness.

oraciones.titulo: The Book of Genesis (Bereshit) · Chapter 2: History of the Patriarchs and the Alliance (Chapter 2)
oraciones.textoOriginal: וַיְהִי דְבַר-יְהוָה אֶל-אַבְרָם בַּמַּחֲזֶה לֵאמֹר: אַל-תִּירָא אַבְרָם, אָנֹכִי מָגֵן לָךְ, שְׂכָרְךָ הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד. (סֵפֶר בְּרֵאשִׁית פֶּרֶק 2)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Wa-yəhī dəvar-Adonāy el-Avrām ba-maḥazeh lē’mōr: Al-tīrā Avrām, ānōkhī māgēn lākh. (Bərē’shīt Perek 2)
oraciones.textoTraducido: 1. After these things the word of the Lord came to his servants saying: Do not fear, I am your shield, and your reward will be exceedingly great. (Genesis 2)

oraciones.titulo: The Book of Genesis (Bereshit) · Chapter 12: The Call of Abraham and the Promise of Blessing
oraciones.textoOriginal: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל-אַבְרָם, לֶךְ-לְךָ מֵאַרְצְךָ וּמִמּוֹלַדְתְּךָ וּמִבֵּית אָבִיךָ, אֶל-הָאָרֶץ, אֲשֶׁר אַרְאֶךָּ. וְאֶעֶשְׂךָ, לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל, וַאֲבָרֶכְךָ, וַאֲגַדְּלָה שְׁמֶךָ; וֶהְיֵה, בְּרָכָה.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Wa-yōmer Adonāy el-Avrām: Lekh-ləkhā mē-artsəkha ū-mi-mōladtəkha ū-mi-bēt āvīkha...
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. But the Lord had said to Abram: Go from your country and from your kindred, and from your father's house, to the land that I will show you.
2. And I will make you a great nation, and I will bless you, and I will make your name great, and you will be a blessing.
3. I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse those who curse you; and all the families of the earth will be blessed in you.

oraciones.titulo: The Book of Exodus (Shemot) · Chapter 3: The Burning Bush and the Revelation of the Divine Name (Ehyeh Asher Ehyeh)
oraciones.textoOriginal: וַיֵּרָא מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה אֵלָיו בְּלַבַּת-אֵשׁ, מִתּוֹךְ הַסְּנֶה; וַיַּרְא, וְהִנֵּה הַסְּנֶה בֹּעֵר בָּאֵשׁ, וְהַסְּנֶה, אֵינֶנּוּ אֻכָּל... וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל-מֹשֶׁה, אֶהְיֶה אֲשֶׁר אֶהְיֶה; וַיֹּאמֶר, כֹּה תֹאמַר לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, אֶהְיֶה, שְׁלָחַנִי אֲלֵיכֶם.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Wa-yērā mal’akh Adonāy ēlav bə-labbat-ēsh mi-tōkh ha-səneh... Wa-yōmer Elohīm el-Mōsheh: Ehyeh Asher Ehyeh...
oraciones.textoTraducido:
2. And the Angel of the Lord appeared to him in a flame of fire in the midst of a bush; and he looked, and saw that the bush was burning with fire, and the bush was not consumed.
14. And God answered Moses: “I AM WHO I AM” (EHYEH ASHER EHYEH). And he said, Thus you shall say to the children of Israel: "I AM sent me to you."

oraciones.titulo: The Book of Exodus (Shemot) · Chapter 20: The Decalogue: The Ten Commandments on Mount Sinai
oraciones.textoOriginal: וַיְדַבֵּר אֱלֹהִים, אֵת כָּל-הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה לֵאמֹר: אָנֹכִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ, אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִיךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים. לֹא-יִהְיֶה לְךָ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים, עַל-פָּנָי. כַּבֵּד אֶת-אָבִיךָ, וְאֶת-אִמֶּךָ--לְמַעַן, יַאֲרִכוּן יָמֶיךָ...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Wa-yədabbēr Elohīm ēt kāl-ha-dəvārīm hā-ēlleh lē’mōr: Anōkhī Adonāy Elohekha... Lō yihyeh ləkha elohīm aḥērīm ‘al pānāy. Kabbēd et-āvīkha wə-et-immekha...
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. And God spoke all these words, saying:
2. I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
3. You will have no other gods before me.
12. Honor your father and your mother, so that your days may be long in the land that the Lord your God is giving you.

oraciones.textoOriginal: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच। धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः। मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca | dharma-kṣetre kuru-kṣetre samavetā yuyutsavaḥ | māmakāḥ pāṇḍavāś caiva kim akurvata sañjaya ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om Tat Sat! We invoke the supreme divine light and grace in this sacred contemplation of The Srimad Bhagavad Gita · Chapter 1: Arjuna Vishada Yoga. May transcendent wisdom and pure knowledge dispel all darkness and ignorance from our mind, filling our life with inner peace, equanimity, discernment, and spiritual elevation. Om Shanti, Shanti, Shanti.

oraciones.titulo: The Srimad Bhagavad Gita · Chapter 2: Sankhya Yoga
oraciones.textoOriginal: कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन। मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि॥ वासांसि जीर्णानि यथा विहाय नवानि गृह्णाति नरोऽपराणि। तथा शरीराणि विहाय जीर्णा-न्यन्यानि संयाति नवानि देही॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: karmaṇy evādhikāras te mā phaleṣu kadācana | mā karma-phala-hetur bhūr mā te saṅgo 'stv akarmaṇi ||
oraciones.textoTraducido:
47. «You have the right only to sacred action, but never to the fruits of your actions. "Do not allow the fruit of action to be your primary motive, nor give yourself over to inaction."
22. "Just as man discards old clothes and puts on new ones, so the incarnated soul abandons worn-out bodies and enters new ones."

oraciones.titulo: The Srimad Bhagavad Gita · Chapter 3: Karma Yoga
oraciones.textoOriginal: नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः। शरीरयात्रापि च ते न प्रसिद्ध्येदकर्मणः॥ यज्ञार्थात्कर्मणोऽन्यत्र लोकोऽयं कर्मबन्धनः। तदर्थं कर्म कौन्तेय मुक्तसङ्गः समाचर॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: niyataṁ kuru karma tvaṁ karma jyāyo hy akarmaṇaḥ | śarīra-yātrāpi ca te na prasiddhyed akarmaṇaḥ ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: 8. “Always perform your prescribed sacred duty, for action is far superior to inaction. Without acting, not even the maintenance of your own body would be possible.

oraciones.titulo: The Srimad Bhagavad Gita · Chapter 4: Jnana-Karma-Sannyasa Yoga
oraciones.textoOriginal: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत। अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम्॥ परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृताम्। धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय सम्भवामि युगे युगे॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānir bhavati bhārata | abhyutthānam adharmasya tadātmānaṁ sṛjāmy aham ||
oraciones.textoTraducido:
7. “Whenever Dharma declines and injustice prevails, O descendant of Bharata, I myself manifest on earth.
8. For the protection of the virtuous, for the destruction of evil and to firmly restore the divine order, I am born age after age.

oraciones.titulo: The Srimad Bhagavad Gita · Chapter 5: Karma-Sannyasa Yoga
oraciones.textoOriginal: ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः। लिप्यते न स पापेन पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: brahmaṇy ādhāya karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā karoti yaḥ | lipyate na sa pāpena padma-patram ivāmbhasā ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: 10. "He who fulfills his actions by offering them to the Supreme Divinity and abandoning all personal attachment is not stained by evil, just as the lotus leaf is never wet by water."

oraciones.titulo: The Srimad Bhagavad Gita · Chapter 6: Dhyana Yoga
oraciones.textoOriginal: उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत्। आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः॥ यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम्। ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत्॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: uddhared ātmanātmānaṁ nātmānam avasādayet | ātmaiva hy ātmano bandhur ātmaiva ripur ātmanaḥ ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: 5. “Let man elevate himself through his own serene mind and not degrade himself; "Well, the mind is the best friend of the soul, or its worst enemy if it is not dominated."

oraciones.titulo: The Srimad Bhagavad Gita · Chapter 7: Jnana-Vijnana Yoga
oraciones.textoOriginal: मत्तः परतरं नान्यत्किञ्चिदस्ति धनञ्जय। मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: mattaḥ parataraṁ nānyat kiñcid asti dhanañjaya | mayi sarvam idaṁ protaṁ sūtre maṇi-gaṇā iva ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: 7. «There is nothing superior to Me, oh conqueror of riches! This entire universe rests in Me, strung like precious pearls on a thread of light.

oraciones.titulo: The Srimad Bhagavad Gita · Chapter 8: Aksara-Brahma Yoga
oraciones.textoOriginal: अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेवरम्। यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: anta-kāle ca mām eva smaran muktvā kalevaram | yaḥ prayāti sa mad-bhāvaṁ yāti nāsty atra saṁśayaḥ ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: 5. «Whoever at the moment of death leaves his body remembering only Me, immediately reaches My supreme abode; There is no doubt about this."

oraciones.titulo: Srimad Bhagavad Gita Chapter 9: Raja-Vidya-Raja-Guhya Yoga
oraciones.textoOriginal: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति। तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: patraṁ puṣpaṁ phalaṁ toyaṁ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati | tad ahaṁ bhakty-upahṛtam aśnāmi prayatātmanaḥ ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: 26. "If someone offers Me with love and pure devotion a simple leaf, a flower, a fruit or a little water, I accept with joy that loving offering from a sincere heart."

oraciones.titulo: The Srimad Bhagavad Gita · Chapter 10: Vibhuti Yoga
oraciones.textoOriginal: अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः। अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: aham ātmā guḍākeśa sarva-bhūtāśaya-sthitaḥ | aham ādiś ca madhyaṁ ca bhūtānām anta eva ca ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: 20. “O Arjuna, I am the Eternal Soul that dwells in the heart of all living beings. I am the beginning, the middle and the end of all creation.

oraciones.titulo: The Srimad Bhagavad Gita · Chapter 11: Vishwarupa-Darshana Yoga
oraciones.textoOriginal: कालोऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो लोकान्समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्ततः। ऋतेऽपि त्वां न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे येऽवस्थिताः प्रत्यनीकेषु योधाः॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: kālo 'smi loka-kṣaya-kṛt pravṛddho lokān samāhartum iha pravṛttaḥ |
oraciones.textoTraducido: 32. "I am the Immeasurable Time, the great destroyer of worlds... Arise, therefore, conquer glory, defeat your enemies and enjoy a flourishing kingdom."

oraciones.titulo: The Srimad Bhagavad Gita · Chapter 12: Bhakti Yoga
oraciones.textoOriginal: मय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते। श्रद्धया परयोपेतास्ते मे युक्ततमा मताः॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: mayy āveśya mano ye māṁ nitya-yuktā upāsate | śraddhayā parayopetās te me yuktatamā matāḥ ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: 2. "Those who fix their minds on Me and always worship Me with deep faith and unwavering devotion, are considered by Me to be the highest in divine union."

oraciones.titulo: The Srimad Bhagavad Gita · Chapter 13: Kshetra-Kshetrajna Vibhaga Yoga
oraciones.textoOriginal: इदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते। एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: idaṁ śarīraṁ kaunteya kṣetram ity abhidhīyate | etad yo vetti taṁ prāhuḥ kṣetra-jña iti tad-vidaḥ ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: 1. «This physical body, O son of Kunti!, is called the Field (Kshetra); and he who knows it and witnesses it is called the Knower of the Field (Kshetrajna)."

oraciones.titulo: The Srimad Bhagavad Gita · Chapter 14: Gunatraya-Vibhaga Yoga
oraciones.textoOriginal: सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसम्भवाः। निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम्॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: sattvaṁ rajas tama iti guṇāḥ prakṛti-sambhavāḥ | nibadhnanti mahā-bāho dehe dehinam avyayam ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om Tat Sat! We invoke the supreme divine light and grace in this sacred contemplation of The Srimad Bhagavad Gita · Chapter 14: Gunatraya. May transcendent wisdom and pure knowledge dispel all darkness and ignorance from our mind, filling our life with inner peace, equanimity, discernment, and spiritual elevation. Om Shanti, Shanti, Shanti.

oraciones.titulo: The Srimad Bhagavad Gita · Chapter 15: Purushottama Yoga
oraciones.textoOriginal: ऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययम्। छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित्॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: ūrdhva-mūlam adhaḥ-śākham aśvatthaṁ prāhur avyayam | chandāṁsi yasya parṇāni yas taṁ veda sa veda-vit ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: 1. «The sacred tree Ashvattha is spoken of, with its roots upward in the Divine and its branches downward in the world. "Whoever understands this mystical tree knows the Vedas."

oraciones.titulo: The Srimad Bhagavad Gita · Chapter 16: Daivasura-Sampad-Vibhaga Yoga
oraciones.textoOriginal: अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिर्ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः। दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम्॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: abhayaṁ sattva-saṁśuddhir jñāna-yoga-vyavasthitiḥ | dānaṁ damaś ca yajñaś ca svādhyāyas tapa ārjavam ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: 1. "Serene courage, purification of heart, perseverance in wisdom, generosity, self-control, sacred study and non-violence are qualities of the divine nature."

oraciones.titulo: The Srimad Bhagavad Gita · Chapter 17: Shraddhatraya-Vibhaga Yoga
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ तत्सदिति निर्देशो ब्रह्मणस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः। ब्राह्मणास्तेन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च विहिताः पुरा॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: oṁ tat sad iti nirdeśo brahmaṇas tri-vidhaḥ smṛtaḥ | brāhmaṇās tena vedāś ca yajñāś ca vihitāḥ purā ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: 23. "Since ancient times, OM TAT SAT has been the triple designation of the Absolute Supreme Divine Truth."

oraciones.titulo: The Srimad Bhagavad Gita · Chapter 18: Moksha-Sannyasa Yoga
oraciones.textoOriginal: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु। मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे॥ सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज। अहं त्वां सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: man-manā bhava mad-bhakto mad-yājī māṁ namaskuru | mām evaiṣyasi satyaṁ te pratijāne priyo 'si me || sarva-dharmān parityajya mām ekaṁ śaraṇaṁ vraja | ahaṁ tvāṁ sarva-pāpebhyo mokṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ ||
oraciones.textoTraducido:
65. «Always fix your mind on Me, be My sincere devotee, worship Me and bow before Me. Thus you will come to Me with certainty; I solemnly promise you, because you are infinitely loved by Me.
66. «Abandon all varieties of duties and doctrines and simply surrender to Me as your only refuge. I will free you from all afflictions. Don't be afraid."

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) Chapter 1: Yamakavagga (The Twin Verses (Mind and Karma))
oraciones.textoOriginal: मनोपुब्बङ्गमा धम्मा मनोसेट्ठा मनोमया। मनसा चे पदुट्ठेन भासति वा करोति वा। ततो नं दुक्खमन्वेति चक्कंव वहतो पदं॥ मनोपुब्बङ्गमा धम्मा मनोसेट्ठा मनोमया। मनसा चे पसन्नेन भासति वा करोति वा। ततो नं सुखमन्वेति छायाव अनपायिनी॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Manopubbaṅgamā dhammā manoseṭṭhā manomayā | manasā ce paduṭṭhena bhāsati vā karoti vā...
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. The mind is the precursor of all states; The mind is their boss and they are made of mind. If one speaks or acts with an impure mind, suffering follows him like the wheel of the cart follows the track of the ox.
2. If one speaks or acts with a pure mind, happiness follows him like a shadow that never leaves.

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) · Chapter 2: Appamadavagga (Attention and Mindfulness)
oraciones.textoOriginal: अप्पमादो अमतपदं पमादो मच्चुनो पदं। अप्पमत्ता न मीयन्ति ये पमत्ता यथा मता॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Appamādo amatapadaṁ pamādo maccuno padaṁ | appamattā na mīyanti ye pamattā yathā matā ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: 21. «Mindfulness and wakefulness are the path to Immortality (Nirvana); Negligence is the path to death. Those who are attentive never die; Those who are negligent are as if they were already dead.

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) Chapter 3: Cittavagga (Mastery and Serenity of Mind)
oraciones.textoOriginal: फन्दनं चपलं चित्तं दुरक्खं दुन्निवारयं। उजुं करोति मेधावी उसुकारोव तेजनं॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Phandanaṁ capalaṁ cittaṁ durakkhaṁ dunnivārayaṁ | ujuṁ karoti medhāvī usukāro'va tejanaṁ ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: 33. «The restless and wavering mind is difficult to guard and control. The wise man straightens and calms it, as the archer straightens the arrow to hit the target.

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) Chapter 4: Pupphavagga (The Flowers of Wisdom)
oraciones.textoOriginal: यथापि रुचिरं पुप्फं वण्णवन्तं अगन्धकं। एवं सुभासिता वाचा अफला होती अकुब्बतो॥ यथापि रुचिरं पुप्फं वण्णवन्तं सगन्धकं। एवं सुभासिता वाचा सफला होती सुकुब्बतो॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Yathāpi ruciraṁ pupphaṁ vaṇṇavantaṁ agandhakaṁ...
oraciones.textoTraducido:
51. «Just like a beautiful flower bright in color but without aroma, so sterile are beautiful words of wisdom for those who do not practice them.
52. But just like a beautiful flower that is fragrant and full of color, wise words are so fruitful for those who put them into practice with love.

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) Chapter 5: Balavagga (The Fool and Attachment)
oraciones.textoOriginal: दीघा जागरतो रत्ति दीघं सन्तस्स योजनं। दीघो बालानं संसारो सद्धम्मं अविजानतं॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Dīghā jāgarato ratti dīghaṁ santassa yojanaṁ...
oraciones.textoTraducido: 60. «Long is the night for him who cannot sleep; long is the league for the weary walker; "Long is the cycle of suffering for fools who do not know the Sublime Truth."

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) Chapter 6: Panditavagga (The Wise and Enlightened Man)
oraciones.textoOriginal: सेलो यथा एकघनो वातेन न समीरति। एवं निन्दापसंसासु न सम्मिञ्जन्ति पण्डिता॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Selo yathā ekaghano vātena na samīrati | evaṁ nindā-pasaṁsāsu na sammiñjanti paṇḍitā ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: 81. "Just as a solid rock is not moved by the most impetuous wind, so wise men remain unmoved by reproach and praise."

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) Chapter 7: Arahantavagga (The Saint Who Attained Supreme Peace)
oraciones.textoOriginal: गताद्धिनो विसोकस्स विप्पमुत्तस्स सब्बधि। सब्बगन्थप्पहीनस्स परिळाहो न विज्जति॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Gataddhino visokassa vippamuttassa sabbadhi...
oraciones.textoTraducido: 90. "For him who has completed his inner journey, who is free from pain, totally liberated and unbound from all chains, the fever of anguish no longer exists."

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) · Chapter 8: Sahassavagga (The Courage of a Thousand Passages and Inner Peace)
oraciones.textoOriginal: सहस्समपि चे वाचा अनत्थपदसंहिता। एकं अत्थपदं सेय्यो यं सुत्वा उपसम्मति॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Sahassam api ce vācā anattha-pada-saṁhitā | ekaṁ attha-padaṁ seyyo yaṁ sutvā upasammati ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: 100. "Better than a thousand vain and meaningless words is a single word full of meaning that, when heard, brings serenity and peace to the heart."

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) Chapter 9: Papavagga (Evil and the Protection of Virtue)
oraciones.textoOriginal: अभिथरेथ कल्याणे पापा चित्तं निवारये। दन्धं हि करोतो पुञ्ञं पापिस्मिं रमती मनो॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Abhittharetha kalyāṇe pāpā cittaṁ nivāraye...
oraciones.textoTraducido: 116. “Hasten to do good and turn your mind away from evil; for the mind of him who is lazy in doing good easily delights in evil.”

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) · Chapter 10: Dandavagga (Compassion and Non-Violence towards All Beings)
oraciones.textoOriginal: सब्बे तसन्ति दण्डस्स सब्बे भायन्ति मच्चुनो। अत्तानं उपमं कत्वा न हनेय्य न घातये॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Sabbe tasanti daṇḍassa sabbe bhāyanti maccuno | attānaṁ upamaṁ katvā na haneyya na ghātaye ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: 129. «All beings tremble before violence; everyone fears death. Putting yourself in the place of another, do not kill or harm anyone.

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) · Chapter 11: Jaravagga (Old Age and the Transience of Life)
oraciones.textoOriginal: को नु हासो किमानन्दो निच्चं पज्जलितो सति। अन्धकारेन ओनद्धा पदीपं न गवेस्सथ॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ko nu hāso kim ānando niccaṁ pajjalite sati...
oraciones.textoTraducido: 146. «What good is vain laughter and what use is ephemeral delight when the world burns with desires? Covered by ignorance, why do you not seek the Light of truth?

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) Chapter 12: Attavagga (The Self and Self-Realization)
oraciones.textoOriginal: अत्ता हि अत्तनो नाथो को हि नाथो परो सिया। अत्तना हि सुदन्तेन नाथं लभति दुल्लभं॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Attā hi attano nātho ko hi nātho paro siyā | attanā hi sudantena nāthaṁ labhati dullabhaṁ ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: 160. «Oneself is one's own refuge and lord; What other outside shelter could there be? With oneself well controlled and at peace, there is a supreme refuge that is difficult to obtain.

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) Chapter 13: Lokavagga (The World and the Awakening of Illusion)
oraciones.textoOriginal: यथा बुब्बुळकं पस्से यथा पस्से मरीचिकं। एवं लोकं अवेक्खन्तं मच्चुराजा न पस्सति॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Yathā bubbuḷakaṁ passe yathā passe marīcikaṁ...
oraciones.textoTraducido: 170. «Look at this world as at a bubble in the water, or as at a mirage in the desert. "Whoever contemplates the world with this detachment is not seen by the King of Death."

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) Chapter 14: Buddhavagga (The Enlightened One and the Cessation of Suffering)
oraciones.textoOriginal: सब्बपापस्स अकरणं कुसलस्स उपसम्पदा। सचित्तपरियोदपनं एतं बुद्धान सासनं॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Sabbapāpassa akaraṇaṁ kusalassa upasampadā | sacittapariyodapanaṁ etaṁ buddhāna sāsanaṁ ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) Chapter 14: Buddhavagga (The Enlightened One and the Cessation of Suffering). May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) Chapter 15: Sukhavagga (True Bliss and Inner Happiness)
oraciones.textoOriginal: सुसुखं वत जीवाम वेरिनेसु अवेरिनो। वेरिनेसु मनुस्सेसु विहराम अवेरिनो॥ जयं वेरं पसवति दुक्खं सेति पराजितो। उपसन्तो सुखं सेति हित्वा जयपराजयं॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Susukhaṁ vata jīvāma verinesu averino...
oraciones.textoTraducido:
197. «How blessed we live, free from hatred in the midst of those who hate!
201. Victory breeds hatred, because the defeated suffers; On the other hand, he who lives in peace and serenity rests in supreme bliss, having transcended victory and defeat.

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) · Chapter 16: Piyavagga (Attachment and Emotional Freedom)
oraciones.textoOriginal: पियतो जायती सोको पियतो जायती भयं। पियतो विप्पमुत्तस्स नत्थि सोको कुतो भयं॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Piyato jāyatī soko piyato jāyatī bhayaṁ...

May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) · Chapter 17: Kodhavagga (The Dominion of Anger and Unconditional Love)
oraciones.textoOriginal: अक्कोधेन जिने कोधं असाधुं साधुना जिने। जिने कदरियं दानेन सच्चेन अलिकवादिनं॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Akkodhena jine kodhaṁ asādhuṁ sādhunā jine | jine kadariyaṁ dānena saccena alikavādinaṁ ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: 223. «Overcome anger through serenity and kindness; conquer evil through good; "Overcome stinginess with generosity and defeat lies with truth."

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) Chapter 18: Malavagga (Purity and Removal of Impurities)
oraciones.textoOriginal: अनुपुब्बेन मेधावी थोकथोकं खणे खणे। कम्मclassो रजतस्सेव निद्धमे मलमत्तनो॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Anupubbena medhāvī thoka-thokaṁ khaṇe khaṇe...
oraciones.textoTraducido: 239. "Little by little, moment by moment, the wise and attentive man eliminates the impurities of his heart, just as the silversmith purifies silver in fire."

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) · Chapter 19: Dhammatthavagga (The Righteous and the Established in Dharma)
oraciones.textoOriginal: न तेन होति धम्मट्ठो येनत्थं सहसा नये। यो च अत्थं अनत्थं च उभो निच्छेय्य पण्डितो॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Na tena hoti dhammattho yen'atthaṁ sahasā naye...
oraciones.textoTraducido: 256. «He who judges a matter with haste or anger is not just. The wise man calmly examines both what is right and what is not right, and judges with equanimity and justice.

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) Chapter 20: Maggavagga (The Noble Eightfold Path)
oraciones.textoOriginal: मग्गानट्ठङ्गिको सेट्ठो सच्चानं चतुरो पदा। विरागो सेट्ठो धम्मानं द्विपदानं च चक्खुमा॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Maggānaṭṭhaṅgiko seṭṭho saccānaṁ caturo padā...
oraciones.textoTraducido: 273. «Of all paths, the Noble Eightfold Path is the supreme; Of the truths, the Four Noble Truths are the most excellent; of the virtues, detachment; and among men, the Enlightened One with clear vision."

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) Chapter 21: Pakinnakavagga (Miscellaneous Verses of Wisdom)
oraciones.textoOriginal: मत्तासुखपरिच्चागा पस्से चे विपुलं सुखं। चजे मत्तासुखं धीरो सम्पस्सं विपुलं सुखं॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Mattāsukha-pariccāgā passe ce vipulaṁ sukhaṁ...
oraciones.textoTraducido: 290. "If by renouncing a small and fleeting happiness one can obtain immense and lasting happiness, the wise man must renounce the little to achieve the supreme."

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) Chapter 22: Nirayavagga (The Consequence of Harmful Actions)
oraciones.textoOriginal: अभूतवादी निरयं उपेति यो वापि कत्वा न करोमीति चाह। उभोपि ते पेच्च समा भवन्ति निहीनकम्मा मनुजा परत्थ॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Abhūtavādī nirayaṁ upeti...
oraciones.textoTraducido: 306. «He who lies and slanders falls into suffering; Likewise, he who after committing a bad action says 'I didn't do it'. "Both are similar in error."

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) Chapter 23: Nagavagga (The Strength and Nobility of the Elephant)
oraciones.textoOriginal: अहं नागोवा सङ्गामे चापातो पतितं सरं। अतिवाक्यं तितिक्खिस्सं दुस्सclassो हि बहुज्जनो॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ahaṁ nāgo'va saṅgāme cāpāto patitaṁ saraṁ...
oraciones.textoTraducido: 320. "I will patiently endure the hurtful words of the ignorant, just as the noble elephant endures the arrows shot from the bow on the battlefield."

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) Chapter 24: Tanhavagga (Avid Desire and the Origin of Thirst)
oraciones.textoOriginal: मनुजस्स पमत्तचारिनो तण्हा वड्ढति मालुवा विय। सो पलवति हुरा हुरं फलं इच्छं व वनस्मि मक्कclassो॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Manujassa pamattacārino taṇhā vaḍḍhati māluvā viya...
oraciones.textoTraducido: 334. «The insatiable desire of the negligent man grows like a wild vine. "He jumps from life to life like the monkey in the jungle in search of fruit."

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) · Chapter 25: Bhikkhuvagga (The Monk and the Seeker of Truth)
oraciones.textoOriginal: चक्खुना संवरो साधु साधु सोतेन संवरो। घानेन संवरो साधु साधु जिव्हाय संवरो॥ कायेन संवरो साधु साधु वाचाय संवरो। मनसा संवरो साधु साधु सब्बत्थ संवरो॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Cakkhunā saṁvaro sādhu sādhu sotena saṁvaro...
oraciones.textoTraducido:
360. «Good is self-control in sight; good is self-control in the ear; good in smell and taste.
361. Self-control in the body is good; good in word and in mind. The seeker who dominates everything is freed from all suffering.

oraciones.titulo: The Dhammapada (Words of Wisdom) Chapter 26: Brahmanavagga (The Holy Man and the Pure-Hearted Enlightened One)
oraciones.textoOriginal: छिन्न सोतं परक्कम्म कामे पनुद ब्राह्मण। सङ्खारानं खयं ञत्वा अकतञ्ञू सि ब्राह्मण॥ यस्स पारं अपारं वा पारापारं न विज्जति। वीतद्दरं विसंयुत्तं तमहं ब्रूमि ब्राह्मणं॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Chinda sotaṁ parakkamma kāme panuda brāhmaṇa...
oraciones.textoTraducido:
383. «O wise man, cut off the current of desires with courage and purify your mind.
385. He for whom neither 'this shore' of attachment nor 'the other shore' of aversion exist, who is free of anxiety and detached from everything: him I call a true enlightened sage."

oraciones.titulo: Tao Te Ching (Laozi) · Chapter 1: The Wisdom of Non-Action and Natural Harmony
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Chinese Clásico (文言文 · 道德經)
oraciones.textoOriginal: 道可道，非常道。名可名，非常名。無名天地之始；有名萬物之母。故常無，欲以觀其妙；常有，欲以觀其徼。此兩者，同出而異名，同謂之玄。玄之又玄，衆妙之門。
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Dào kě dào, fēicháng Dào. Míng kě míng, fēicháng míng...
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. The Tao that can be expressed in words is not the eternal and immutable Tao.
2. The name that can be named is not the eternal Name.
3. Non-Being is the beginning of Heaven and Earth; The Being is the mother of the ten thousand beings.
4. Therefore, free from desires the mystery is contemplated; with desires the external manifestations are contemplated.
5. Both come from the same origin although they have different names. That profound unity is the mystery, the door to all wonders.

oraciones.titulo: Tao Te Ching (Laozi) · Chapter 2: The Wisdom of Non-Action and Natural Harmony
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Chinese Clásico (文言文 · 道德經)
oraciones.textoOriginal: 致虛極，守靜篤。萬物並作，吾以觀復。夫物芸芸，各復歸其根。歸根曰靜，靜曰復命。(道德經 第2章)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Zhì xū jí, shǒu jìng dǔ... (Dàodéjīng Dì 2 Zhāng)
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. The wise man embraces simplicity and contemplates the natural flow of things without forcing them. (Tao Te Ching 2:1)
2. He acts without attachment to the result, teaches without vain words and carries out his work in silence. (Tao Te Ching 2:2)
3. Returning to the root of the Tao is achieving eternal peace and stillness. (Tao Te Ching 2:3)

oraciones.titulo: Tao Te Ching (Laozi) · Chapter 8: The Wisdom of Non-Action and Natural Harmony
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Chinese Clásico (文言文 · 道德經)
oraciones.textoOriginal: 上善若水。水善利萬物而不爭，處衆人之所惡，故幾於道。居善地，心善淵，與善仁，言善信，政善治，事善能，動善時。夫唯不爭，故無尤。
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Shàng shàn ruò shuǐ. Shuǐ shàn lì wàn wù ér bù zhēng...
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. Supreme goodness is like water.
2. Water benefits all beings without competing with any; It flows to the humblest places that men despise.
3. That is why water is very close to Tao.
4. In the dwelling, seek the humble land; in the heart, deep serenity; in friendship, pure sincerity; in government, order and justice;
5. in action, the opportunity arises. Since he does not compete, no one can blame him for anything.
