oraciones.guiaFonetica: Espíritu Santo, aquieta el ruido del entorno para oír tu suave susurro.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy Spirit, quiet the noise around you to hear your soft whisper.

oraciones.titulo: The Daniel Fast (21 Days) · Day 12: Breaking Generational Ties
oraciones.textoOriginal: Cancelo en la cruz todo patrón destructivo del pasado; somos nueva criatura en Cristo.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Cancelo en la cruz todo patrón destructivo del pasado; somos nueva criatura en Cristo.
oraciones.textoTraducido: I cancel on the cross every destructive pattern of the past; We are a new creature in Christ.

oraciones.titulo: The Daniel Fast (21 Days) · Day 13: A Heart of Gratitude
oraciones.textoOriginal: Te alabo, Padre, por tu fidelidad constante y tus infinitas misericordias cada mañana.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Te alabo, Padre, por tu fidelidad constante y tus infinitas misericordias cada mañana.
oraciones.textoTraducido: I praise you, Father, for your constant faithfulness and your infinite mercies each morning.

oraciones.titulo: The Daniel Fast (21 Days) · Day 14: The Power of Intercessory Prayer
oraciones.textoOriginal: Clamo hoy por los enfermos, los afligidos y quienes no conocen tu salvación.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Clamo hoy por los enfermos, los afligidos y quienes no conocen tu salvación.
oraciones.textoTraducido: I cry out today for the sick, the afflicted and those who do not know your salvation.

oraciones.titulo: The Daniel Fast (21 Days) · Day 15: Faith that Moves Mountains
oraciones.textoOriginal: Aumenta mi fe, Señor; declaro que las murallas caen ante tu presencia majestuosa.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Aumenta mi fe, Señor; declaro que las murallas caen ante tu presencia majestuosa.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Increase my faith, Lord; I declare that the walls fall before your majestic presence.

oraciones.titulo: The Daniel Fast (21 Days) · Day 16: Purity of Thoughts and Mind of Christ
oraciones.textoOriginal: Someto todo pensamiento a la obediencia de Cristo Jesús.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Someto todo pensamiento a la obediencia de Cristo Jesús.
oraciones.textoTraducido: I submit every thought to the obedience of Christ Jesus.

oraciones.titulo: The Daniel Fast (21 Days) · Day 17: Love and Compassion in Action
oraciones.textoOriginal: Hazme instrumento de tu amor y consuelo para quienes sufren a mi alrededor.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Hazme instrumento de tu amor y consuelo para quienes sufren a mi alrededor.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Make me an instrument of your love and comfort for those who suffer around me.

oraciones.titulo: The Daniel Fast (21 Days) · Day 18: Vision and Purpose of Life
oraciones.textoOriginal: Despierta en mí el propósito eterno para el cual me creaste. Heme aquí, envíame a mí.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Despierta en mí el propósito eterno para el cual me creaste. Heme aquí, envíame a mí.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Awaken in me the eternal purpose for which you created me. Here I am, send me.

oraciones.titulo: The Daniel Fast (21 Days) · Day 19: Unspeakable Joys in the Spirit
oraciones.textoOriginal: Llena mi boca de alabanza y mi alma de regocijo en todo tiempo.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Llena mi boca de alabanza y mi alma de regocijo en todo tiempo.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Fill my mouth with praise and my soul with joy at all times.

oraciones.titulo: The Daniel Fast (21 Days) · Day 20: Heavenly Answer on the Way
oraciones.textoOriginal: Espero con gozosa expectativa la manifestación de tus promesas en mi vida.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Espero con gozosa expectativa la manifestación de tus promesas en mi vida.
oraciones.textoTraducido: I await with joyful expectation the manifestation of your promises in my life.

oraciones.titulo: The Daniel Fast (21 Days) · Day 21: Full Victory, Anointing, and Thanksgiving
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Gracias, Señor, por tu revelación, fortaleza y victoria total! Salgo transformado en el poder de tu Santo Espíritu. ¡Amén y amén!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: ¡Gracias, Señor, por tu revelación, fortaleza y victoria total! Salgo transformado en el poder de tu Santo Espíritu. ¡Amén y amén!
oraciones.textoTraducido: Thank you, Lord, for your revelation, strength and total victory! I come out transformed in the power of your Holy Spirit. Amen and amen!

oraciones.titulo: Song of Songs · Chapter 1: The Desire for Communion and the Perfume of the Beloved
oraciones.textoOriginal: שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים, אֲשֶׁר לִשְׁלֹמֹה: יִשָּׁקֵנִי מִנְּשִׁיקוֹת פִּיהוּ, כִּי-טוֹבִים דֹּדֶיךָ מִיָּיִן. לְרֵיחַ שְׁמָנֶיךָ טוֹבִים, שֶׁמֶן תּוּרַק שְׁמֶךָ; עַל-כֵּן, עֲלָמוֹת אֲהֵבוּךָ. מָשְׁכֵנִי, אַחֲרֶיךָ נָּרוּצָה; הֱבִיאַנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ חֲדָרָיו, נָגִילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בָּךְ, נַזְכִּירָה דֹדֶיךָ מִיַּיִן, מֵישָׁרִים אֲהֵבוּךָ.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Shīr ha-Shīrīm ashér li-Shlomóh: Yishakéni mineshikót píhu, ki-tovím dodéja miyáyin. Leréach shemanécha tovím, shémen turák shemécha, al-kén alamót ahevúcha. Mashchéni, acharécha narútza; hevi'áni hamélech chadarav, nagílah venismecháh bach...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. Oh, that he would kiss me with kisses from his mouth! Because your loves are better than wine.
2. Besides the smell of your sweet ointments, your name is like poured ointment; That's why the maidens love you.
3. Attract me; We will run after you. The king has taken me into his chambers; we will rejoice and be glad in you; We will remember your loves more than the wine; they rightly love you.

oraciones.titulo: Song of Songs · Chapter 2: The Rose of Sharon and the Spiritual Spring
oraciones.textoOriginal: אֲנִי חֲבַצֶּלֶת הַשָּׁרוֹן, שׁוֹשַׁנַּת הָעֲמָקִים. כְּשׁוֹשַׁנָּה בֵּין הַחוֹחִים, כֵּן רַעְיָתִי בֵּין הַבָּנוֹת... קוֹל דּוֹדִי, הִנֵּה-זֶה בָּא; מְדַלֵּג, עַל-הֶהָרִים, מְקַפֵּץ, עַל-הַגְּבָעוֹת. עָנָה דוֹדִי, וְאָמַר לִי: קוּמִי לָךְ רַעְיָתִי יָפָתִי, וּלְכִי-לָךְ. כִּי-הִנֵּה הַסְּתָיו, עָבָר; הַגֶּשֶׁם, חָלַף הָלַךְ לוֹ. הַנִּצָּנִים נִרְאוּ בָאָרֶץ, עֵת הַזָּמִיר הִגִּיעַ.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Aní chavatzélet ha-Sharón, shoshannát ha-amakím. Keshoshannáh béin ha-chochím, kén ra'yatí béin ha-banót... Kōl dodí, hinéh-zéh ba; medalég al-he-harím, mekapétz al-ha-geva'ót. Anáh dodí ve'amár li: Kúmi lach ra'yatí yafātí, u-lechi-lach...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. I am the rose of Sharon, and the lily of the valley.
2. As the lily among the thorns, so is my friend among the maidens.
3. The voice of my beloved! Behold, he comes leaping over the mountains, leaping over the hills.
4. My beloved spoke, and said to me: Arise, O my friend, my fair one, and come. For behold, the winter has passed, it has moved away, the rain is gone; The flowers have been shown on the earth, the time of song has come.

oraciones.titulo: Song of Songs · Chapter 3: The Night Search and the Meeting of the Soul
oraciones.textoOriginal: עַל-מִשְׁכָּבִי, בַּלֵּילוֹת, בִּקַּשְׁתִּי, אֵת שֶׁאָהֲבָה נַפְשִׁי; בִּקַּשְׁתִּיו, וְלֹא מְצָאתִיו. אָקוּמָה נָּא וַאֲסוֹבְבָה בָעִיר, בַּשְּׁוָקִים וּבָרְחֹבוֹת--אֲבַקְשָׁה, אֵת שֶׁאָהֲבָה נַפְשִׁי... כִּמְעַט, שֶׁעָבַרְתִּי מֵהֶם, עַד שֶׁמָּצָאתִי, אֵת שֶׁאָהֲבָה נַפְשִׁי; אֲחַזְתִּיו, וְלֹא אַרְפֶּנּוּ.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Al mishkaví bal-leilót bikáshti ét she-ahaváh nafshí; bikashtív ve-lo metzatív. Akúmah na va'asovaváh va'ír, bash-shvakím u-var-chovót, avaksháh ét she-ahaváh nafshí... Kim'át she-avárti mehém, ad she-matzáti ét she-ahaváh nafshí; achaztív ve-lo arpénu.]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. At night I searched in my bed for the one my soul loves; I looked for it, and I didn't find it.
2. And I said, I will arise now, and go around the city; Through the streets and through the squares I will look for the one my soul loves; I looked for it, and I didn't find it.
3. The guards who patrol the city found me, and I said to them: Have you seen him whom my soul loves?
4. As soon as I had passed from them a little, I immediately found him whom my soul loves; I grabbed him, and I didn't let go.

oraciones.titulo: Song of Songs · Chapter 4: Immaculate Beauty and the Sacred Garden
oraciones.textoOriginal: הִנָּךְ יָפָה רַעְיָתִי, הִנָּךְ יָפָה--עֵינַיִךְ יוֹנִים, מִבַּעַד לְצַמָּתֵךְ... כֻּלָּךְ יָפָה רַעְיָתִי, וּמוּם אֵין בָּךְ. לִבַּבְתִּנִי, אֲחֹתִי כַלָּה; לִבַּבְתִּינִי בְּאַחַד מֵעֵינַיִךְ, בְּאַחַד עֲנָק מִצַּוְּרֹנָיִךְ. גַּן נָעוּל, אֲחֹתִי כַלָּה; גַּל נָעוּל, מַעְיָן חָתוּם. עוּרִי צָפוֹן וּבוֹאִי תֵימָן, הָפִיחִי גַנִּי יִזְּלוּ בְשָׂמָיו.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Hinnách yafáh ra'yatí, hinnách yafáh, eináyich yoním mibá'ad letzammātēch... Kullách yafáh ra'yatí, u-múm éin bach. Libavtíni achotí challáh, libavtíni be-achád me-eináyich... Gan na'úl achotí challáh, gal na'úl ma'yán chatúm. Úri tzafón u-vó'i teimán, hafíchi ganní yizzelú vesamáv.]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. Behold, you are beautiful, my friend; behold, you are beautiful; Your eyes between your locks are like a dove's.
2. You are all beautiful, my friend, and there is no stain in you.
3. You caught my heart, sister, my wife; You have captured my heart with one of your eyes, with a choker from your neck.
4. You are a closed garden, my sister, my wife; fountain closed, spring sealed.
5. Arise, Aquilon, and come, Austro; blow into my garden, let its aromas be released.

oraciones.titulo: Song of Songs · Chapter 5: The Call in the Night and the Excellence of the Beloved
oraciones.textoOriginal: אֲנִי יְשֵׁנָה, וְלִבִּי עֵר; קוֹל דּוֹדִי דוֹפֵק, פִּתְחִי-לִי אֲחֹתִי רַעְיָתִי יוֹנָתִי תַמָּתִי... דּוֹדִי צַח וְאָדוֹם, דָּגוּל מֵרְבָבָה. רֹאשׁוֹ, כֶּתֶם פָּז; קְוֻצּוֹתָיו, תַּלְתַּלִּים, שְׁחֹרוֹת, כָּעוֹרֵב... חִכּוֹ, מַמְתַקִּים, וְכֻלּוֹ, מַחֲמַדִּים; זֶה דוֹדִי וְזֶה רֵעִי, בְּנוֹת יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Aní yeshenáh ve-libí ér; kōl dodí dofék: Pitchi-li achotí ra'yatí yonatí tammatí... Dodí tzách ve-adóm, dagúl me-revaváh. Roshó kétom paz, kevutzotáv taltallím, shechorót ka-orév... Chikkó mamtakím ve-chulló machamadím; zeh dodí ve-zeh re'í, benót Yerushaláyim.]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. I slept, but my heart was awake. It is the voice of my beloved who calls: Open to me, my sister, my friend, my dove, my perfect one, because my head is full of dew.
2. My beloved is white and blond, singled out among ten thousand.
3. His head is like the finest gold; His curly hair, black as a raven.
4. His palate, very sweet, and all of it covetable. Such is my beloved, such is my friend, oh maidens of Jerusalem.

oraciones.titulo: Song of Songs · Chapter 6: Mutual Belonging and Beauty like the Dawn
oraciones.textoOriginal: אָנָה הָלַךְ דּוֹדֵךְ, הַיָּפָה בַּנָּשִׁים; אָנָה פָּנָה דוֹדֵךְ, וּנְבַקְשֶׁנּוּ עִמָּךְ. אֲנִי לְדוֹדִי וְדוֹדִי לִי, הָרֹעֶה בַּשּׁוֹשַׁנִּים... מִי-זֹאת הַנִּשְׁקָפָה, כְּמוֹ-שָׁחַר; יָפָה כַלְּבָנָה, בָּרָה כַּחַמָּה, אֲיֻמָּה, כַּנִּדְגָּלוֹת.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Anah halách dodéch hay-yafáh ban-nashím; anah panáh dodéch unevakshennú immách. Aní le-dodí ve-dodí li, ha-ro'éh bash-shoshanním... Mi zot han-nishkafáh kemó-sháchar, yafáh chal-levanáh, baráh kachammáh, ayummáh kan-nidgalót.]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. Where has your beloved gone, oh most beautiful of women? Where has your beloved gone, and will we seek him with you?
2. I am my beloved's, and my beloved is mine; he feeds among the lilies.
3. Beautiful are you, O my friend, like Tirzah; to desire, like Jerusalem; imposing as armies in order.
4. Who is this that appears like the dawn, beautiful like the moon, bright like the sun, imposing like armies in order?

oraciones.titulo: Song of Songs · Chapter 7: Delightful Love and the Sacred Dance
oraciones.textoOriginal: מַה-יָּפוּ פְעָמַיִךְ בַּנְּעָלִים, בַּת-נָדִיב; חַמּוּקֵי יְרֵכַיִךְ--כְּמוֹ חֲלָאִים, מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי אָמָּן... מַה-יָּפִית, וּמַה-נָּעַמְתְּ--אַהֲבָה, בַּתַּעֲנוּגִים. זֹאת קוֹמָתֵךְ דָּמְתָה לְתָמָר, וְשָׁדַיִךְ לְאַשְׁכֹּלוֹת... אֲנִי לְדוֹדִי, וְעָלַי תְּשׁוּקָתוֹ. לְכָה דוֹדִי נֵצֵא הַשָּׂדֶה, נָלִינָה בַּכְּפָרִים.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Mah yafú fe'amáyich ban-ne'alím bat-nadív; chammukéi yerecháyich kemó chala'ím, ma'aséh yedéi ammān... Mah yafít u-mah na'ámt, ahaváh bat-ta'anugím. Zot komatēch dametáh le-tamár... Aní le-dodí ve-aláy teshukatō. Lecháh dodí netzéi has-sadéh, nalínah bak-kefarím.]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. How beautiful are your feet in shoes, O prince's daughter! The contours of your thighs are like jewels, the work of an excellent master.
2. How beautiful you are, and how soft, oh delightful love!
3. Your stature is like a palm tree, and your breasts are like bunches of grapes.
4. I am my beloved's, and he is pleased with me.
5. Come, oh my beloved, let us go out into the countryside, let us dwell in the villages. Let us rise in the morning to the vineyards; there I will give you my loves.

oraciones.titulo: Song of Songs · Chapter 8: The Inextinguishable Seal and Love Strong as Death
oraciones.textoOriginal: שִׂימֵנִי כַחוֹתָם עַל-לִבֶּךָ, כַּחוֹתָם עַל-זְרוֹעֶךָ--כִּי-עַזָּה כַמָּוֶת אַהֲבָה, קָשָׁה כִשְׁאוֹל קִנְאָה: רְשָׁפֶיהָ--רִשְׁפֵּי, אֵשׁ שַׁלְהֶבֶתְיָה. מַיִם רַבִּים, לֹא יוּכְלוּ לְכַבּוֹת אֶת-הָאַהֲבָה, וּנְהָרוֹת, לֹא יִשְׁטְפוּהָ; אִם-יִתֵּן אִישׁ אֶת-כָּל-הוֹן בֵּיתוֹ, בָּאַהֲבָה--בּוֹז, יָבוּזוּ לוֹ.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Siméni cha-chotám al libbécha, ka-chotám al zero'écha; ki-azzáh cha-mávet ahaváh, kasháh chish'ól kin'áh: Reshafeyha rishpéi ésh shalhevétyah. Màyim rabbím lo yuchlú lechabbót et ha-ahaváh, u-neharót lo yishtefúha...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
1. Put me as a seal on your heart, as a mark on your arm; because love is strong as death, jealousy as hard as Sheol; its embers, embers of fire, strong flame.
2. Many waters will not be able to quench love, nor will rivers drown it. If a man gave all the goods of his house for this love, he would certainly be despised by everything.
3. Flee, my beloved, and be like the roe deer, or the fawn, upon the mountains of aromas.

oraciones.titulo: The Lord's Prayer · The Lord's Prayer (Pater Noster)
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Pater noster, qui es in caelis,
sanctificetur nomen tuum.
Adveniat regnum tuum.
Fiat voluntas tua, sicut in caelo et in terra.
Panem nostrum quotidianum da nobis hodie,
et dimitte nobis debita nostra,
sicut et nos dimittimus debitoribus nostris.
Et ne nos inducas in tentationem,
sed libera nos a malo. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Pá-ter nós-ter, kwi es in ché-lis, sank-ti-fi-ché-tur nó-men tú-um. Ad-vé-ni-at réñ-num tú-um. Fí-at vo-lún-tas tú-a, sí-kut in ché-lo et in tér-ra. Pá-nem nós-trum kwo-ti-di-á-num da nó-bis hó-di-e, et di-mít-te nó-bis dé-bi-ta nós-tra, sí-kut et nos di-mít-ti-mus de-bi-tó-ri-bus nós-tris. Et ne nos in-dú-kas in ten-ta-tzi-ó-nem, sed lí-be-ra nos a má-lo. A-men.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Our Father who art in heaven, hallowed be your Name; your Kingdom come to us; Your will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread; forgive us our trespasses, as we also forgive those who trespass against us; do not lead us into temptation, and deliver us from evil. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: The Hail Mary · Angelic Greeting and Prayer to the Mother of God
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Ave Maria, gratia plena, Dominus tecum.
Benedicta tu in mulieribus,
et benedictus fructus ventris tui, Iesus.
Sancta Maria, Mater Dei,
ora pro nobis peccatoribus,
nunc et in hora mortis nostrae. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Á-ve Ma-rí-a, grá-tzi-a plé-na, Dó-mi-nus té-kum. Be-ne-dík-ta tu in mu-li-é-ri-bus, et be-ne-dík-tus frúk-tus vén-tris tú-i, Yé-sus. Sánk-ta Ma-rí-a, Má-ter Dé-i, ó-ra pro nó-bis pek-ka-tó-ri-bus, nunk et in hó-ra mór-tis nós-tre. A-men.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Hail Mary, full of grace; the Lord is with you. Blessed are you among all women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Glory to the Father · Minor Doxology to the Holy Trinity
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Gloria Patri, et Filio, et Spiritui Sancto.
Sicut erat in principio, et nunc, et semper,
et in saecula saeculorum. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Gló-ri-a Pá-tri, et Fí-li-o, et Spi-rí-tu-i Sánk-to. Sí-kut é-rat in prin-chí-pi-o, et nunk, et sém-per, et in sé-ku-la se-ku-ló-rum. A-men.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, now and forever, forever and ever. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Hail Regina · God Hail you, Queen and Mother of Mercy
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Salve, Regina, Mater misericordiae,
vita, dulcedo, et spes nostra, salve.
Ad te clamamus exsules filii Hevae,
ad te suspiramus, gementes et flentes in hac lacrimarum valle.
Eia, ergo, advocata nostra, illos tuos misericordes oculos ad nos converte;
et Iesum, benedictum fructum ventris tui, nobis post hoc exsilium ostende.
O clemens, o pia, o dulcis Virgo Maria. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Sál-ve, Re-jí-na, Má-ter mi-se-ri-kór-di-e, ví-ta, dul-ché-do, et spes nós-tra, sál-ve. Ad te kla-má-mus ék-su-les fí-li-i É-ve, ad te sus-pi-rá-mus, je-mén-tes et flén-tes in hak la-kri-má-rum vál-le. É-ya, ér-go, ad-vo-ká-ta nós-tra, íl-los tú-os mi-se-ri-kór-des ó-ku-los ad nos kon-vér-te; et Yé-sum, be-ne-dík-tum frúk-tum vén-tris tú-i, nó-bis post hok ek-sí-li-um os-tén-de. O klé-mens, o pí-a, o dúl-chis Vír-go Ma-rí-a. A-men.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: God save you, Queen and Mother of mercy, life, sweetness and our hope; God save you. We call you the banished children of Eve; We sigh to you, moaning and crying, in this valley of tears. Come, then, Lady, our lawyer, turn your merciful eyes to us; and after this exile show us Jesus, blessed fruit of your womb. Oh clement, oh pious, oh sweet Virgin Mary! Pray for us, Holy Mother of God, so that we may be worthy of achieving the promises of Our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Apostles' Creed · Profession of Apostolic Faith (Symbolum Apostolorum)
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Credo in Deum Patrem omnipotentem, Creatorem caeli et terrae.
Et in Iesum Christum, Filium eius unicum, Dominum nostrum,
qui conceptus est de Spiritu Sancto, natus ex Maria Virgine,
passus sub Pontio Pilato, crucifixus, mortuus, et sepultus,
descendit ad inferos, tertia die resurrexit a mortuis,
ascendit ad caelos, sedet ad dexteram Dei Patris omnipotentis,
inde venturus est iudicare vivos et mortuos.
Credo in Spiritum Sanctum, sanctam Ecclesiam catholicam, sanctorum communionem,
remissionem peccatorum, carnis resurrectionem, vitam aeternam. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Kré-do in Dé-um Pá-trem om-ni-po-tén-tem, Kre-a-tó-rem ché-li et tér-re. Et in Yé-sum Krís-tum, Fí-li-um é-yus ú-ni-kum, Dó-mi-num nós-trum... A-men.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: I believe in God, Almighty Father, Creator of heaven and earth. I believe in Jesus Christ, his only Son, our Lord, who was conceived by the work and grace of the Holy Spirit, was born of the Virgin Mary, suffered under the power of Pontius Pilate, was crucified, died and buried, descended into hell, on the third day he rose from the dead, ascended to heaven and is seated at the right hand of God, the Father almighty. From there he must come to judge the living and the dead. I believe in the Holy Spirit, the holy Catholic Church, the communion of saints, the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body and eternal life. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Nicene-Constantinopolitan Creed · Symbol of the Universal Faith
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Credo in unum Deum, Patrem omnipotentem, factorem caeli et terrae, visibilium omnium et invisibilium.
Et in unum Dominum Iesum Christum, Filium Dei unigenitum, et ex Patre natum ante omnia saecula.
Deum de Deo, lumen de lumine, Deum verum de Deo vero, genitum, non factum, consubstantialem Patri:
per quem omnia facta sunt. Qui propter nos homines et propter nostram salutem descendit de caelis.
Et incarnatus est de Spiritu Sancto ex Maria Virgine, et homo factus est.
Crucifixus etiam pro nobis sub Pontio Pilato; passus et sepultus est, et resurrexit tertia die, secundum Scripturas,
et ascendit in caelum, sedet ad dexteram Patris.
Et iterum venturus est cum gloria, iudicare vivos et mortuos, cuius regni non erit finis.
Et in Spiritum Sanctum, Dominum et vivificantem: qui ex Patre Filioque procedit.
Qui cum Patre et Filio simul adoratur et conglorificatur: qui locutus est per prophetas.
Et unam, sanctam, catholicam et apostolicam Ecclesiam.
Confiteor unum baptisma in remissionem peccatorum.
Et exspecto resurrectionem mortuorum, et vitam venturi saeculi. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Kré-do in ú-num Dé-um, Pá-trem om-ni-po-tén-tem, fak-tó-rem ché-li et tér-re, vi-si-bí-li-um óm-ni-um et in-vi-si-bí-li-um... A-men.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: I believe in one God, Almighty Father, Creator of heaven and earth, of everything visible and invisible. I believe in one Lord, Jesus Christ, the only Son of God, born of the Father before all ages: God from God, Light from Light, true God from true God, begotten, not created, of the same nature as the Father, by whom all things were made; who for us men and for our salvation came down from heaven, and by the power of the Holy Spirit was incarnated from Mary, the Virgin, and became man; and for our cause he was crucified in the time of Pontius Pilate; He suffered and was buried, and rose again on the third day, according to the Scriptures, and ascended into heaven, and is seated at the right hand of the Father; and he will come again with glory to judge the living and the dead, and his kingdom will have no end. I believe in the Holy Spirit, Lord and giver of life, who proceeds from the Father and the Son, who with the Father and the Son receives the same worship and glory, and who spoke through the prophets. I believe in the Church, which is one, holy, catholic and apostolic. I confess that there is only one baptism for the forgiveness of sins. I hope for the resurrection of the dead and the life of the future world. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: I Confess (Confiteor) · Prayer of Humility and Forgiveness (Through My Fault)
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Confiteor Deo omnipotenti, et vobis fratres,
quia peccavi nimis cogitatione, verbo, opere et omissione:
mea culpa, mea culpa, mea maxima culpa.
Ideo precor beatam Mariam semper Virginem,
omnes Angelos et Sanctos, et vos fratres,
orare pro me ad Dominum Deum nostrum. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Kon-fí-te-or Dé-o om-ni-po-tén-ti, et vó-bis frá-tres, kwí-a pek-ká-vi ní-mis ko-ji-ta-tzi-ó-ne, vér-bo, ó-pe-re et o-mis-si-ó-ne: mé-a kúl-pa, mé-a kúl-pa, mé-a mák-si-ma kúl-pa. Í-de-o pré-kor be-á-tam Ma-rí-am sém-per Vír-ji-nem, óm-nes Án-je-los et Sánk-tos, et vos frá-tres, o-rá-re pro me ad Dó-mi-num Dé-um nós-trum. A-men.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: I confess before Almighty God and before you, brothers, that I have sinned greatly in thought, word, deed and omission: because of my fault, because of my fault, because of my great fault. That is why I pray to Holy Mary, ever Virgin, to the Angels, to the Saints and to you, brothers, to intercede for me before God, our Lord. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: My Guardian Angel · Traditional Prayer of Custody and Protection
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Angele Dei, qui custos es mei,
me, tibi commissum pietate superna,
illumina, custodi, rege et guberna. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Án-je-le Dé-i, kwi kús-tos es mé-i, me, tí-bi kom-mís-sum pi-e-tá-te su-pér-na, il-lú-mi-na, kus-tó-di, ré-je et gu-bér-na. A-men.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: My guardian angel, sweet company, do not forsake me night or day. Don't leave me alone because I would be lost, until I rest in the arms of Jesus, Joseph and Mary. Angel of the Lord, who by divine providence is my guardian, enlighten me, protect me, govern me and govern me on this day and throughout my life. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: The Sign of the Holy Cross · Consecration and Victory over Enemies
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Per signum Sanctae Crucis de inimicis nostris libera nos, Deus noster.
In nomine Patris, et Filii, et Spiritus Sancti. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Per síñ-num Sánk-te Krú-chis de in-i-mí-chis nós-tris lí-be-ra nos, Dé-us nós-ter. In nó-mi-ne Pá-tris, et Fí-li-i, et Spi-rí-tus Sánk-ti. A-men.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: By the sign of the Holy Cross, deliver us from our enemies, Lord our God. In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Sweet Mother · Maternal Consecration and Daily Blessing
oraciones.textoOriginal: Dulce Madre, no te alejes, tu vista de mí no apartes. Ven conmigo a todas partes y nunca solo me dejes. Ya que me proteges tanto como verdadera Madre, haz que me bendiga el Padre, el Hijo y el Espíritu Santo. Amén.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Dúl-se Má-dre, no te a-lé-jes, tu vís-ta de mí no a-pár-tes...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Sweet Mother, don't go away, don't take your eyes off me. Come with me everywhere and never leave me alone. Since you protect me so much as a true Mother, may the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit bless me. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: The Memorare of Saint Bernard · Intercession of the Blessed Virgin
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Memorare, o piissima Virgo Maria,
non esse auditum a saeculo, quemquam ad tua currentem praesidia,
tua implorantem auxilia, tua petentem suffragia, esse derelictum.
Ego tali animatus confidentia, ad te, Virgo Virginum, Mater, curro,
ad te venio, coram te gemens peccator assisto.
Noli, Mater Verbi, verba mea despicere;
sed audi propitia et exaudi. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Me-mo-rá-re, o pi-ís-si-ma Vír-go Ma-rí-a, non és-se au-dí-tum a sé-ku-lo... A-men.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Remember, O most gracious Virgin Mary, that never was it known that anyone who fled to thy protection, implored thy help, or sought thy intercession was left unaided. Inspired with this confidence, I fly unto thee, O Virgin of virgins, my Mother; to thee do I come, before thee I stand, sinful and sorrowful. O Mother of the Word Incarnate, despise not my petitions, but in thy mercy hear and answer me. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: The Angelus · Mystery of the Incarnation and Midday Greeting
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Angelus Domini nuntiavit Mariae. Et concepit de Spiritu Sancto.
Ecce ancilla Domini. Fiat mihi secundum verbum tuum.
Et Verbum caro factum est. Et habitavit in nobis.
Ora pro nobis, sancta Dei Genetrix. Ut digni efficiamur promissionibus Christi. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Án-je-lus Dó-mi-ni nun-tzi-á-vit Ma-rí-e. Et kon-ché-pit de Spi-rí-tu Sánk-to... A-men.]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
V. The Angel of the Lord announced to Mary.
A. And she conceived by the power of the Holy Spirit.
(God save you Mary...)
V. Behold the handmaid of the Lord.
R. May it be done to me according to your word.
(God save you Mary...)
V. And the Word became flesh.
A. And he lived among us.
(God save you Mary...)
V. Pray for us, Holy Mother of God.
A. So that we are worthy of achieving the promises of Our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Regina Caeli · Easter Joy and Triumph of the Resurrection
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Regina caeli, laetare, alleluia.
Quia quem meruisti portare, alleluia.
Resurrexit, sicut dixit, alleluia.
Ora pro nobis Deum, alleluia.
Gaude et laetare, Virgo Maria, alleluia.
Quia surrexit Dominus vere, alleluia. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Re-jí-na ché-li, le-tá-re, al-le-lú-ya. Kwi-a kwem me-ru-ís-ti por-tá-re, al-le-lú-ya. Re-sur-rék-sit, sí-kut dík-sit, al-le-lú-ya... A-men.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Queen of heaven, rejoice, hallelujah. Because the Lord, whom you deserved to carry in your womb, hallelujah. He has risen according to his word, hallelujah. Pray for us to God, hallelujah. Rejoice and be glad, Virgin Mary, hallelujah. Because the Lord has truly risen, hallelujah. Oh God, who through the resurrection of your Son has filled the world with joy, grant us through the intercession of his Mother to achieve eternal joys. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Oración del Justo Juez · Escudo Divino de Protección contra Enemigos y Peligros
oraciones.textoOriginal: Santísimo Justo Juez, Hijo de María Santísima: que ojos tengan y no me vean, manos tengan y no me toquen, armas tengan y no me hieran. Cúbreme con el manto de la Santísima Trinidad. Amén.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [San-tí-si-mo Jus-to Jwes, Í-jo de Ma-rí-a San-tí-si-ma... A-mén.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Most Holy Righteous Judge, Son of the Virgin Mary, let not my body be forsaken nor my blood be shed. Wherever I walk, let Your hands guide me and Your power deliver me from dangers, betrayals, unjust prisons, and ill will. If they have eyes, let them not see me; if they have hands, let them not touch me; if they have feet, let them not reach me; if they have weapons, let them not harm me. Let their irons bend, their blades shatter, their firearms jam, their ropes snap, and their tongues falter when they seek to do me harm. May my body be wrapped in the mantle of the Most Holy Trinity and guided by Saint Joseph's staff. Peace be with me, by day and by night. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Santo Niño de Atocha · Auxilio de los Prisioneros, Caminantes y Desamparados
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Oh pacientísimo Niño de Atocha, protector de los desamparados! Con tu canasta de pan bendito y tu calabacita de agua, socórreme y guía mis pasos en paz. Amén.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O pa-syen-tí-si-mo y dūl-se Ní-nyo de A-tó-cha... A-mén.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: O most patient and sweet Child of Atocha! Sovereign protector of the afflicted, shield of prisoners, comfort of the sick, and guide of travelers: I come before You imploring Your infinite mercy. You who wear the sandals of love to visit the helpless and feed the needy with Your holy basket of bread and never-failing gourd of water: look upon my distress and aid me in my need. Unbind all chains of suffering, protect workers and travelers, and bless my home. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Nuestra Señora de Juquila · Madre Milagrosa de Oaxaca y Auxilio en la Necesidad
oraciones.textoOriginal: Madre querida, Virgen de Juquila, virgen morenita de la serranía oaxaqueña: Tú que saliste ilesa del fuego voraz, desata mis dificultades y bendice mi hogar. Amén.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Má-dre ke-rí-da, Vír-jen de Ju-kí-la, vir-jen mo-re-ní-ta de O-a-xá-ka... A-mén.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Dear Mother, Virgin of Juquila, sweet protector of Oaxaca and comforter of the afflicted: at Your feet I lay my sorrows and my needs. You who emerged unharmed from the consuming fire to show God's love: look upon me with mercy. Untie the knots in my path, remove difficulties, bless the sustenance of my home, heal illnesses, and grant the grace I faithfully implore. Virgin of Juquila, cover us with Your holy mantle and forsake us not. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Nuestra Señora del Carmen · Manto Santo y Promesa del Escapulario
oraciones.textoOriginal: Flos Carmeli, Vitis florigera, splendor caeli, Virgo puerpera singularis. Mater mitis, sed viri nescia, Carmelitis da privilegia, Stella Maris. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Flos Kar-mé-li, Ví-tis flo-rí-je-ra, splén-dor ché-li, Vír-go pu-ér-pe-ra sin-gu-lá-ris... Stél-la Má-ris. A-men.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Virgin of Mount Carmel, most loving Mother and Queen of Carmel! You who gave the Holy Scapular as a pledge of maternal protection and sign of salvation: cover my family and me with Your holy mantle. Defend us in body and soul, deliver us from harm, and lead us safely to eternal glory. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: The Black Christ of the Lord of Esquipulas · Healing, Redemption and Miraculous Peace
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Señor de Esquipulas, Cristo Negro milagroso! Ante tu imagen sagrada me postro con fe inquebrantable, suplicando el bálsamo de tu perdón y la salud de mi cuerpo y de mi alma.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Se-nyór de Es-ki-pú-las, Krís-to Né-gro mi-la-gró-so...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Lord of Esquipulas, blessed Black Christ! Sacred image of crucified love and beacon of hope for millions of souls: before your merciful presence I prostrate with a contrite heart. You who hear the cry of the sufferer on his bed of pain and renew the strength of the dejected, touch my life with your divine right hand. Heal my illnesses, dispel my sorrows, forgive my offenses and grant my home peace and heavenly harmony. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Mary of Guadalupe · Mother of Tepeyac and Queen of the Americas
oraciones.textoOriginal: Cuix amo nican nica nimonantzin? ¿No estoy yo aquí que soy tu Madre? ¿No estás bajo mi sombra y resguardo? ¿No soy yo la fuente de tu alegría? ¿No estás en el cruce de mis brazos?
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Kwish á-mo ni-kan ní-ka ni-mo-nán-tzin? No es-toy yo a-kí ke soy tu Má-dre...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Saint Mary of Guadalupe, Mystical Rose of Mexico and Mother of the Americas! Remember your tender words in Tepeyac: «Am I not here, your Mother? Are you not under my shadow and protection? With that infinite confidence of children we come to you. Cover us under the starry mantle of your protection, keep disease, violence and discord from our lives, and guide our steps towards your divine Son Jesus. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Our Lady of San Juan of the Lagos · Relief and Restoration of the Sick
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Virgencita de San Juan de los Lagos, Madre admirable y protectora celestial! Tú que restauraste la vida y la salud en tu primer prodigio, intercede por nosotros.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Vir-jen-sí-ta de San Jwan de los Lá-gos...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Most Pure Virgin of San Juan de los Lagos! Before your tender and miraculous image I come with a heart full of faith. You who since ancient times have manifested the power of God, healing the hopeless, consoling the sad and restoring peace to the troubled: cast your maternal gaze on me. Grant us physical and spiritual health, bless our path and obtain for us the grace that we humbly implore from you today. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Our Lady of Zapopan · The General, Peacemaker and Protector of Storms
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Oh Purísima Virgen de Zapopan, Madre de Gracia y Pacificadora de las tormentas! Defiende nuestras familias y derrama la serenidad en nuestras tierras.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O Pu-rí-si-ma Vír-jen de Sa-pó-pan...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Most Pure Virgin of Zapopan, Protective Mother and Queen of Peace! You who with your presence calmed wars, warded off epidemics and calmed storms: be our shield and strength. Dispel every storm that threatens our home, remove danger from our paths and keep the living flame of faith and hope lit in our hearts. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Benedict of Nursia · The Holy Cross and Prayer of Exorcism (Vade Retro Satana)
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Crux Sacra Sit Mihi Lux! Non Draco Sit Mihi Dux!
Vade Retro Satana! Numquam Suade Mihi Vana!
Sunt Mala Quae Libas: Ipse Venena Bibas! In nomine Patris, et Filii, et Spiritus Sancti. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Krux Sák-ra Sit Mí-ki Lux! Non Drá-ko Sit Mí-ki Dux! Vá-de Ré-tro Sa-tá-na! Núm-kwam Swá-de Mí-ki Vá-na! Sunt Má-la Kwe Lí-bas: Íp-se Ve-né-na Bí-bas! A-men.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: The Holy Cross be my light! May not the infernal dragon be my guide! Get away, Satan! Don't suggest vain things to me! Poison is what you offer: drink your own poisons yourself! Most Holy Father Saint Benedict, by the virtue of the Holy Cross and your powerful intercession, free me from all evil eyes, witchcraft, snares of the enemy, pestilence and envy. May the peace of Christ reign in my home and in my spirit forever. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Rita of Casia · Advocate of Desperate and Impossible Causes
oraciones.textoOriginal: Bajo el peso del dolor y la prueba, a ti recurro gloriosa Santa Rita, a quien llaman con devoción la Santa de los Imposibles.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Bá-jo el pé-so del do-lór y la prwé-ba, a ti re-kúr-ro glo-ri-ó-sa Sán-ta Rí-ta...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh glorious Saint Rita of Casia, undefeated lawyer of desperate and impossible cases! At your feet I prostrate with a sorry soul and full of anguish. You who participated in Jesus' crown of thorns and achieved unprecedented graces for your heroic patience and your ardent faith: intercede for me in this cause that humanly seems to have no solution. Reach me from God the grace that I long for, and give me the strength to always accept his holy will. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Martha the Dominator · Expiration of Difficulties and Urgent Causes
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Oh Santa Marta dichosa, que hospedaste al Maestro en Betania y venciste con la cruz al dragón! Vence mis temores y allana mis dificultades.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O Sán-ta Már-ta di-chó-sa, ke os-pe-dás-te al Ma-és-tro...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh blessed and happy Santa Marta! Host of Our Lord Jesus Christ and example of tireless service: you who defeated the fearsome beast of Tarascon with the sign of the Holy Cross, grant me the strength to conquer my fears, overcome adversity and emerge victorious from this urgent tribulation. Be my refuge in times of trouble and grant me the grace that I place today at the feet of your holy intercession. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: San Martín Caballero (San Martín de Tours) · Prosperidad, Apertura del Negocio y Trabajo
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡En el nombre de Dios Todopoderoso, San Martín Caballero, saca la sal de mi casa y negocio, y tráeme la buena fortuna y el trabajo honesto! Amén.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [En el nóm-bre de Dyos To-do-po-de-ró-so, San Mar-tín Ka-ba-lyé-ro... A-mén.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Almighty God, Saint Martin Caballero, remove all misfortune and hardship from my home and business, and bring honest labor, good fortune, and noble clients! Just as you shared your cloak with the beggar in whom you recognized Christ, grant to my home daily bread, health, and heavenly blessings. Cut through all obstacles and envy with your blessed sword. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Charbel Makhlouf · Ribbon Prayer, Healing and Spiritual Peace
oraciones.textoOriginal: Mar Charbel, pray for us. Ya Mar Sharbel, tcheffah feena end Rabba. ¡Oh ermitaño de Dios y padre de los milagros!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Mar Shar-bel, tchef-fah fee-na end Rab-ba. O er-mi-tá-nyo de Dyos...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: O God, infinitely holy and glorified in your saints! You who inspired Saint Charbel the path of silent prayer, austerity and perfect charity, and granted him the heavenly gift of performing miracles and healing bodies and souls: pour out relief in my afflictions through his intercession. Just as I tie this ribbon with faith and hope, untie the knots of my suffering and grant me the healing and grace that I implore today. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Expedito · Undefeated Lawyer for Just and Urgent Causes
oraciones.textoOriginal: Hodie! Cras non, hodie! Sancte Expedite, martyre Christi, in angustiis nostris festina adiuvare nos. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Ó-di-e! Kras non, ó-di-e! Sánk-te Eks-pe-dí-te, már-ti-re Krís-ti... A-men.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: My Saint Expeditus of just and urgent causes! Brave martyr and warrior of Christ, come to my aid in this hour of affliction and despair. You who do not postpone until tomorrow what God can do today (Hodie!), intercede before Our Lord so that this distressing knot may be untied, my need may be promptly resolved and peace may return to my spirit. I promise to make your name known with gratitude and devotion. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Mark the Evangelist · Pacification of Enemies, Peace, and Concord
oraciones.textoOriginal: San Marcos de León, que amansaste a la fiera y al león, amansa a quienes con ira o injusticia pretendan perturbar mi paz.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [San Már-kos de Le-ón, ke a-man-sás-te a la fyé-ra y al le-ón...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Saint Mark of León, glorious evangelist of Christ! You who with the word of the Gospel tamed the dragons of pride and dominated the wildest beast: come to my aid to appease all discord, enmity and resentment. Bend the arrogance of those who judge me unfairly, transform anger into reconciliation and make peace and fraternal understanding flourish where conflict reigns. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Cipriano · Cleaving of Witchcraft, Bad Arts and Home Protection
oraciones.textoOriginal: Por la gracia de Dios y tu santa conversión, glorioso San Cipriano, deshaz toda atadura, brujería, maleficio y mala lengua que contra mí se haya levantado.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Por la grá-sya de Dyos y tu sán-ta kon-ver-syón, glo-ri-ó-so San Si-pri-á-no...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh glorious Saint Cyprian, bishop and blessed martyr! By divine grace and the power of the Name of Jesus Christ to which you consecrated yourself after conquering darkness: cut and annul all ties, curses, envy, witchcraft, hidden work or bad intentions that have been cast against me, my family, my home or my work. May your holy protection be an impenetrable wall and may the light of Christ dispel every shadow of evil. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Ramón Nonato · Closure of Bad Tongues and Protection of Maternity
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Oh glorioso San Ramón Nonato, cuyo candado en los labios guardó la fidelidad y la pureza de la palabra! Calla toda lengua maliciosa y protege el vientre materno.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O glo-ri-ó-so San Ra-món No-ná-to, kú-yo kan-dá-do en los lá-byos...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh glorious San Ramón Nonato, protector of the innocent and protector of pregnant mothers! You who suffered the martyrdom of the lock on your lips to seal your testimony of faith: put a holy lock on the murmuring, false and slanderous tongues that seek to damage my honor and the peace of my home. Defend mothers at the time of childbirth and keep children in your blessed custody. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Anthony of Padua · Finding of Lost Causes, Holy Love and Bread of the Poor
oraciones.textoOriginal:
Si quaeris miracula, mors, error, calamitas, daemon, lepra fugiunt, aegri surgunt sani.
Cedunt mare, vincula, membra resque perditas petunt et accipiunt iuvenes et cani. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Si kwé-ris mi-rá-ku-la, mors, ér-ror, ka-lá-mi-tas, dé-mon, lé-pra fú-ji-unt... A-men.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh blessed Saint Anthony of Padua, lily of purity and evangelical doctor! You who had the joy of holding the Child Jesus in your arms and were blessed with the gift of finding what was lost and returning peace to the afflicted: help me in this need. Help me recover what I have lost (peace, health, harmony or sustenance), strengthen the bonds of true love and always bless the bread of our home. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Chaplet of Divine Mercy · Revealed to Saint Faustina Kowalska
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ojcze Przedwieczny, ofiaruję Ci Ciało i Krew, Duszę i Bóstwo... Dla Jego bolesnej męki, miej miłosierdzie dla nas i całego świata. Święty Boże, Święty Mocny, Święty Nieśmiertelny, zmiłuj się nad nami.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Oí-che Pshe-dvyéch-ny... Dlya Yé-go bo-lés-ney mén-ki... Shvyén-ty Bó-zhe, Shvyén-ty Móts-ny...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
Eternal Father, I offer you the Body and Blood, the Soul and Divinity of your most beloved Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, as propitiation for our sins and those of the entire world.

For his painful Passion, have mercy on us and on the whole world.

Holy God, Holy Mighty One, Holy Immortal, have mercy on us and on the whole world. (x3)

Jesus, I trust in You. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of the Shipwrecked · Prayer of Charity and Spiritual Rescue (Allan Kardec)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Torna tu vista, Dios mío, hacia esta infeliz criatura, no me desampares, Señor! En medio del embravecido mar de las pruebas del mundo, sálvame.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Tór-na tu vís-ta, Dyos mí-o, a-syá és-ta in-fe-lís krya-tú-ra...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Turn your gaze, my God, towards this unhappy creature, do not forsake me, Lord! You are the beacon of light in the midst of the storm of life. To you, God of infinite mercy, I come like a shipwrecked man in the midst of the raging sea of ​​my earthly trials. Extend your beneficent hand, send your angels and protective spirits to calm the winds of despair and guide my boat towards the shore of consolation, peace and redemption. Lord, save me, I perish! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer for the Afflicted · Resignation and Strength in Trials (Allan Kardec)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Si la prueba es dura, Dios de justicia soberana, danos la fuerza para soportarla sin quejarnos y bendecir tu mano paternal.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Si la prwé-ba es dú-ra, Dyos de jus-tí-sya so-be-rá-na...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Almighty God, sovereign Lord of the worlds! If the trial I go through is part of the law of atonement and progress that governs my spirit, give me the holy resignation so as not to murmur against your designs. Make him understand that the temporary sufferings of the Earth are seeds of light for eternity. Calm my anguish, bless my heart and allow the good spirits to pour the dew of consolation on my forehead. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Evocation to Good Spirits and Spiritual Guides (Allan Kardec)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Alabados seáis, espíritus puros del Señor, mensajeros del bien y heraldos de la verdad eterna.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [A-la-bá-dos se-áys, es-pí-ri-tus pú-ros del Se-nyór...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Almighty God, good spirits who assist me and guide me along the path of truth! I beg you to grant me your assistance on this day. Inspire high thoughts in my mind, dispel the darkness of doubt and remove imperfect or disturbing spirits from my environment. Be my counselors in difficulties and make me worthy of the peace of God. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer for the Sick in Soul and Body (Allan Kardec)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Señor, tu soberana bondad no rechaza a ninguna de tus criaturas; extiende sobre los que sufren en su cuerpo el bálsamo bienhechor de tus fluidos salutíferos.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Se-nyór, tu so-be-rá-na bon-dád no re-chá-sa a nin-gú-na de tus krya-tú-ras...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord, Father of mercy and doctor of souls! Direct your compassionate gaze on those who suffer in body or spirit. Allow spiritual doctors and beneficent spirits to imbue your being with fluids of health, regeneration and relief. If illness is an indispensable test for his purification, grant him the patience and courage to endure it; and if it is your will, restore the harmony of his health for your greater glory. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer for Enemies and Persecutors (Allan Kardec)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Señor Jesús, que rogaste por tus verdugos diciendo: «Padre, perdónalos porque no saben lo que hacen»: concédeme perdonar a los que me ofenden.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Se-nyór Je-sús, ke ro-gás-te por tus ver-dú-gos...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord, God of infinite justice and mercy! I place before your presence those who persecute me, slander me or wish me harm. Do not allow hatred, revenge or resentment to reside in my heart. Illuminate their consciences with the light of repentance and understanding, and allow me to return good for evil. May your peace be poured out upon us and extinguish all vestiges of earthly animosity. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Gratitude for the Trials Overcome (Allan Kardec)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Dios mío, gracias te doy por haberme concedido la fuerza necesaria para atravesar la prueba y no desfallecer en el camino del deber.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Dyos mí-o, grá-syas te doy por a-vér-me kon-se-dí-do la fwér-sa ne-se-sá-rya...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Sovereign and compassionate God! With a soul overflowing with gratitude, I thank you for having sustained me in moments of affliction and for the light you made shine in the middle of my dark night. Thank you for the protective spirits that guarded me and for the inner strength that renewed my hope. May this lesson strengthen my faith, increase my love for my brothers and bring me closer every day to your divine goodness. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to the Seven African Powers · Prayer of Intercession, Protection, and Guidance
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Oh, Siete Potencias Africanas! Ustedes que son mensajeras de Dios y guías de la humanidad, me postro ante ustedes con humildad para implorar su infinita misericordia. Maferefún Changó, Ochún, Yemayá, Obatalá, Oggún, Orunlá y Eleggúa.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Ma-fe-re-fún Chan-gó, O-chún, Ye-ma-yá, O-ba-ta-lá, Og-gún, O-run-lá y E-leg-gú-a...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
Oh, Seven African Powers! You who are messengers of God and guides of humanity, I prostrate before you with humility to implore your infinite mercy.

Oh, Changó (owner of justice and fire), give me strength.
Oh, Ochún (mother of love and gold), bring me prosperity.
Oh, Yemayá (queen of the sea and life), cleanse me with your sacred waters.
Oh, Obatalá (father of peace and whiteness), cover me with your mantle of wisdom.
Oh, Oggún (warrior and owner of iron), defend my path from every enemy.
Oh, Orunlá (fortune teller), reveal to me the good and ward off the evil.
Oh, Eleggúa (owner of the roads), open the doors of fortune and close those of evil.

Guide my steps, remove the obstacles from my life and grant me the spiritual and material peace that I so need. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of the Seven Doors and the Seven Spirits of Fortune
oraciones.textoOriginal: Abro mis puertas, con el fin y la buena fe, a los siete espíritus de la fortuna. Que la Dicha, la Salud y la Bendición del Dios Todopoderoso reinen en esta morada.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Á-bro mis pwér-tas, kon el fin y la bwé-na fe, a los syé-te es-pí-ri-tus de la for-tú-na...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
I open my doors, with purpose and good faith, to the seven spirits of fortune. May they come to my house one day, may Happiness and Health be at my doors.

For the seven Main Towns, for the seven Sacred Books, for the seven Candelabra of the Temple of Solomon, for the seven Bones of the Head of God, for the Holy Guardian Angels Saint Michael the Archangel, Saint Raphael, Saint Gabriel, Guide and Guardian of God.

And may the Blessing of God the Almighty Father, of the Son and of the Holy Spirit descend upon this house and upon me. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Solemn Invocation to the Seven Powers in the Name of the Eternal Father
oraciones.textoOriginal: En el Nombre del Padre Eterno, del Hijo Redentor y del Espíritu Santo que todo lo ilumina: invoco en este instante sagrado la fuerza viva de las Siete Potencias.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [En el Nóm-bre del Pá-dre E-tér-no, del Í-jo Re-den-tór y del Es-pí-ri-tu Sán-to...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
In the Name of the Eternal Father, the Redeemer Son and the Holy Spirit who illuminates everything, I present myself with humility and determination before the Celestial Throne. I invoke in this sacred moment the living force of the Seven Powers that surround the Saint among the Saints. With firm faith I spiritually kneel before you and beseech your divine intercession before the Great Power of Almighty God.

By the Sweet and Holy Name of Jesus, I call and implore you: listen to my sincere request. May my prayer be answered, may my paths be opened and may prosperity flow towards me like an abundant and unstoppable river.

Changó, warrior of fire and justice, defend me from every visible and invisible enemy.
Ochún, sweet mother of gold and abundance, pour prosperity and love into my life.
Yemayá, queen of the deep waters, cleanse my paths and guide my steps with wisdom.
Obatalá, father of purity and clarity, cover my destiny with your white mantle of peace.
Ogún, lord of iron and work, break every obstacle and strengthen my will.
Orula, wise fortune teller of destiny, align my future with blessings and triumph.
Eleguá, owner of the roads, opens the correct doors and closes those that do not suit me.

May all negativity be put aside. May all scarcity be transformed into abundance. May every closed door be opened by divine decree. Today I declare that my spirit receives peace, my mind clarity and my hands prosperity. Seven glorious Powers, intercede for me before the Most High. So it is, so it will be and it is done. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to the Holy Cross of Jesus Christ · Holy Wood and Defense against Dangers
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Oh Santa Cruz! Madero Hermoso en donde murió mi Señor para darme eterna luz y librarme del contrario. Santa Cruz de Jesucristo, rechazad de mí toda arma cortante y de fuego, descartad de mí todo mal y presérvame de accidentes corporales y temporales.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O Sán-ta Krus! Ma-dé-ro Er-mó-so en dón-de mu-ryó mi Se-nyór...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
Almighty God who have suffered death on the tree of the cross for our sins: accompany me.

Holy Cross of Jesus Christ, have mercy on me.
Holy Cross of Jesus Christ, reject from me all sharp weapons and firearms.
Holy Cross of Jesus Christ, pour out all good on me.
Holy Cross of Jesus Christ, cast away all evil from me.
Holy Cross of Jesus Christ, let it illuminate the path of health and salvation.
Holy Cross of Jesus Christ, reject from me every attempt to kill and preserve me from bodily and temporal accidents.

In honor of the precious Blood of Jesus Christ and his holy Resurrection: that just as it is true that Jesus Christ was born in Bethlehem, died on the Cross and rose victorious, so may He deign to free me from the attacks of my visible and invisible enemies from today and forever. Make the evil spirit depart from me. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Padre Pio of Pietrelcina · Supplication in Desperate Cases and Impossible Causes
oraciones.textoOriginal: Oh Dios misericordioso, Tú que has elegido al Padre Pío y lo has elevado ante la cruz del mundo: obtiéneme por su potente intercesión la solución para mi causa imposible.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O Dyos mi-se-ri-kor-dyó-so, Tu ke as e-le-jí-do al Pá-dre Pí-o...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
In the Name of the Father, of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Oh merciful God! You who have chosen Holy Father Pio of Pietrelcina and marked him with the sacred stigmata of the Passion of your Son for the consolation of the afflicted: look at my hurt and anguished spirit.

Most gracious Father Pio, you who work wonders for those who call upon you with living faith and do not abandon desperate and urgent causes: I turn to your powerful protection. Take my supplication in your wounded hands (mention your request here) and present it to the Merciful Heart of Jesus. You who wiped away so many tears on earth, obtain for me peace, forgiveness of my sins and the grace that I fervently ask of you. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Jude Thaddeus · Lawyer for Desperate Cases (Promise to Saint Brigida)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Apóstol gloriosísimo de Nuestro Señor Jesucristo, aclamado por los fieles con el dulce título de Abogado de los Casos Desesperados: hazme sentir tu poderosa intercesión.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [A-pós-tol glo-ryo-sí-si-mo de Nwés-tro Se-nyór Je-su-krís-to...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
In the Name of the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit.

Most glorious Apostle of Our Lord Jesus Christ, acclaimed by the faithful with the sweet title of Lawyer of Desperate Cases: make me feel your powerful intercession, alleviating the very serious need in which I find myself.

For the close kinship that unites you to Our Lord Jesus Christ, for the hardships that you suffered for Him and for the promise that the divine Savior made to Saint Brigid to help those who came to your aid: obtain for me from the God of mercies the grace that I ask of you with unlimited confidence.

Glorious Apostle Saint Jude Thaddeus, pray for us and come quickly to my aid in this hour of affliction. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Anthony of Padua · The Gentlest of Saints (Whisper my Petition to the Child Jesus)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Oh bendito San Antonio, el más gentil de todos los santos: tu amor por Dios y tu caridad te hicieron merecedor de poseer dones milagrosos. Susurra mi petición al Niño Jesús.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O ben-dí-to San An-tó-nyo, el mas jen-tíl de tó-dos los sán-tos...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
In the Name of the Father, of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Oh blessed Saint Anthony, the most gentle and tender of all saints! Your love for God and your inexhaustible charity for creatures made you worthy of holding the Divine Child Jesus in your arms.

I beg you to intercede on my behalf. Come closer with love and whisper my humble request in the ear of the Child Savior, who was so pleased to rest on your heart.

Oh Saint Anthony, saint of miracles and father of the compassionate! Hear my prayer, relieve my distress and grant me the grace that I place today with living faith in your beneficent hands. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Expedite · Litany of Urgent Rescue and Strength in the Tribulation
oraciones.textoOriginal: San Expedito, que pereciste gloriosamente por la espada, ruega por mí. Patrono de la juventud y modelo de soldados: ¡no dejes para mañana lo que puedas hacer hoy!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [San Eks-pe-dí-to, ke pe-re-sís-te glo-ryo-sa-mén-te por la es-pá-da...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
In the Name of the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit.

Saint Expedite, who gave everything for Christ and perished gloriously for faith, pray for me.
Saint Expedite, patron of students, model of soldiers and protector of travelers, pray for me.
Saint Expedite, advocate of sinners, health of the sick and mediator in trials, pray for me.
Saint Expedite, consolation of the afflicted and undefeated help in urgent matters, pray for me.

Holy blessed! Don't put off until tomorrow what you can do today. Come quickly to rescue me, present my anguish to the Lord Jesus and grant that my requests may be answered with fidelity, courage and in a timely manner. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Ayat al-Kursi · The Throne Verse (Supreme Protection and Divine Sovereignty)
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Allāhu lā ilāha illā Huwa l-Ḥayyu l-Qayyūm, lā ta’khudhuhū sinatu-wwa-lā nawm; lahū mā fi-s-samāwāti wa mā fi-l-arḍ, man dha-l-ladhī yashfa‘u ‘indahū illā bi-idhnih, ya‘lamu mā bayna aydīhim wa mā khalfahum... wa Huwa l-‘Aliyyu l-‘Aẓīm.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: God! There is no god but He, the Living, the Self-Subsisting. Neither drowsiness nor sleep takes hold of Him. His is all that is in the heavens and the earth. Who can intercede before Him except with His consent? He knows what was before them and what will be after them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Throne encompasses the heavens and the earth, and His preservation does not cause you fatigue. And He is the Most High, the Great. (Quran 2:255)

oraciones.titulo: Sayyid al-Istighfar · The Master Supplication of Forgiveness and Purification of the Soul
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Allāhumma Anta Rabbī lā ilāha illā Anta, khalaqtanī wa anā ‘abduka, wa anā ‘alā ‘ahdika wa wa‘dika ma-staṭa‘tu, a‘ūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣana‘tu, abū’u laka bi-ni‘matika ‘alayya, wa abū’u bi-dhanbī fa-ghfir lī, fa-innahū lā yaghfiru dh-dhunūba illā Anta.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh God! You are my Lord, there is no deity but You. You have created me and I am Your servant. I keep my pact and my promise with You to the extent of my strength. I take refuge in You from the evil I have committed. I acknowledge before You all the blessings You have granted me, and I confess before You my faults and sins: forgive me, for surely no one forgives sins except You. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Du'a Qunut · Nightly Supplication for Firmness, Guidance and Blessing
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ ، وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ ، وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ ، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ ، وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلَا يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ ، إِنَّهُ لَا يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ ، وَلَا يَعِזُّ مَنْ عَادَيْتَ ، تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَتَعَالَيْتَ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Allāhumma ihdinī fī-man hadayt, wa ‘āfinī fī-man ‘āfayt, wa tawallanī fī-man tawallayt, wa bārik lī fī-mā a‘ṭayt, wa qinī sharra mā qaḍayt... tabārakta Rabbanā wa ta‘ālayt.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh God! Guide me among those whom You have guided, grant me health and well-being among those whom You have healed, take me under Your custody and protection among those whom You have protected, bless for me all that You have granted me and preserve me from the evil that You have decreed. Certainly You decree and no one decrees about You. He whom You support will not be humiliated nor will he who opposes You be exalted. Blessed and Exalted are you, our Lord! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Traveler's Du'a · Prayer for Protection on the Road and Travel
oraciones.textoOriginal: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ . اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَٰذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَىٰ ، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَىٰ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Subḥāna l-ladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahū muqrinīn, wa innā ilā Rabbinā la-munqalibūn. Allāhumma innā nas'aluka fī safarinā hādhā l-birra wa t-taqwā...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Glorified be He who has put this at our service, since we would not have been able to dominate it by our strength; and truly to our Lord we must return. Oh God! We ask You on this journey of ours for piety, righteousness and works that are pleasing to You. Oh God! Make this path easy for us, be You our Companion on the journey and the Protector of our family and property. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Al-Mu'awwidhatayn · Sacred Refuge against the Evil Eye, Envy and Darkness
oraciones.textoOriginal: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ . قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Qul a‘ūdhu bi-Rabbi l-falaq, min sharri mā khalaq, wa min sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab, wa min sharri n-naffāthāti fī l-‘uqad, wa min sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad... Qul a‘ūdhu bi-Rabbi n-nās...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Say: I take refuge in the Lord from the dawn, from the evil of what He has created, from the evil of darkness when it gathers, from the evil of those who blow into the knots to do harm, and from the evil of the envious when he envies. Say: I take refuge in the Lord of mankind, the Sovereign of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the fleeing whisperer, who whispers in the breasts of men. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Invocation to the Seven Archangels of Celestial Light · Protection, Healing and Guidance
oraciones.textoOriginal: En el nombre del Creador Todopoderoso, invoco el coro de los Siete Santos Arcángeles de la Luz: Miguel, Gabriel, Rafael, Uriel, Chamuel, Jofiel y Zadquiel. Sean mi escudo y mi guía.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Mi-ja-el, Gav-ri-el, Re-fa-el, U-ri-el, Sha-mu-el, Yo-fi-el, Tzad-ki-el...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
In the name of God the Omnipotent Father, Creator of the Universe and Source of all Love:

I invoke the sacred presence of the Seven Archangels of Light to guard my life:
• Archangel Saint Michael on my right, with your sword of light defend me from all evil.
• Archangel Saint Gabriel on my left, bring me wisdom, peace and mental clarity.
• Archangel Saint Raphael in front of me, heal my body, my mind and guide my steps.
• Archangel Saint Uriel behind my back, pour out provision, abundance and serenity.
• Archangel Chamuel over my heart, expand divine love and reconciliation.
• Archangel Jophiel upon my mind, enlighten me with knowledge and sacred beauty.
• Archangel Zadquiel in my soul, transmutes all pain into blessing and forgiveness.

May the seven rays of heavenly light seal my home and grant me victory in God. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Gabriel Archangel · Celestial Messenger, Mental Clarity and Good News
oraciones.textoOriginal: Gavri'el, mal'aj ha-besorah ve-ha-emet. ¡Oh Santo Arcángel Gabriel, embajador de Dios!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Gav-ri-él, mal-áj ha-be-so-ráh ve-ha-e-mét...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh glorious Archangel Saint Gabriel, strength of God and messenger of the Incarnation! You who brought the Virgin Mary the good news of salvation and opened the heavens with your announcement of light: descend upon my life. Dispel the confusion of my thoughts, relieve the anguish of my mind and bring me the good news that my heart longs for. Be my guide in important decisions and teach me to fulfill God's will with joy. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Uriel Archangel · Fire of God, Provision, Abundance and Divine Wisdom
oraciones.textoOriginal: Uri'el, esh Elohim ve-or ha-chochmah. ¡Oh Arcángel Uriel, llama de la providencia divina!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [U-ri-él, esh E-lo-hím ve-or ha-joj-máh...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Archangel Saint Uriel, sacred fire of God and inexhaustible channel of Divine Providence! I come to you at this moment to implore your ruby-gold ray of light and abundance. Dispel all lack, fear of scarcity and material blockage in my life. Open the paths of honest prosperity, fill my mind with creative and productive ideas, and make sure that sustenance, dignity and peace are never lacking on my table and in my home. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Chamuel Archangel · Unconditional Love, Reconciliation and Finding Good
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Hebrew Místico (חַמּוּאֵל - Aquel que busca a Dios)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Chamu'el, mal'aj ha-ahavah ve-ha-shalom. ¡Oh Arcángel Chamuel, mensajero del amor celestial!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Ja-mu-él, mal-áj ha-a-ha-váh ve-ha-sha-lóm...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Powerful and loving Archangel Saint Chamuel, emanation of divine love and infinite compassion! Envelop my heart and my relationships with your pink ray of harmony and tenderness. Heal the wounds caused by heartbreak, misunderstandings and resentment; restore peace in my family and help me find what seems lost: faith, honest love, peace of mind and brotherly harmony. May the love of God be my eternal strength. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Jophiel Archangel · Beauty of God, Illumination of the Mind and Wisdom
oraciones.textoOriginal: Yofi'el, or ha-da'at ve-ha-tiferet. ¡Oh Arcángel Jofiel, resplandor dorado de la sabiduría eterna!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Yo-fi-él, or ha-dá-at ve-ha-ti-fé-ret...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Archangel Saint Jophiel, bearer of the golden yellow ray of wisdom and divine illumination! Descend upon my mind and my spirit. Dispel the shadows of ignorance, doubt and discouragement. Fill my thoughts with order, optimism and discernment to make wise and fair decisions. Allow me to perceive the beauty of divine creation in every moment and walk with lucidity and peace. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Zadquiel Archangel · Violet Flame of Mercy, Forgiveness and Liberation
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Hebrew Bíblico (צַדְקִיאֵל - Justicia y Misericordia de Dios)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Tzadki'el, mal'aj ha-chesed ve-ha-rachamim. ¡Oh Arcángel Zadquiel, dispensador de la misericordia divina!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Tzad-ki-él, mal-áj ha-jé-sed ve-ha-ra-ja-mím...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Glorious Archangel Saint Zadquiel, minister of divine mercy and guardian of the violet flame of transmutation! I implore you to cleanse my soul of all resentment, past pain, guilt or bitterness. Help me to forgive from the heart and receive divine forgiveness. Transmute all dense or negative energy into light, peace and inner freedom, and allow me to be spiritually reborn under the grace of the Almighty. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Sacramental Prayer of Bread · Holy Supper (Doctrine and Covenants 20 / Moroni 4)
oraciones.textoOriginal: O God, the Eternal Father, we ask thee in the name of thy Son, Jesus Christ, to bless and sanctify this bread to the souls of all those who partake of it...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O God, di E-tér-nal Fá-der, wi ask di in de neim ov dai San, Jí-sas Kraist...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: O God, Eternal Father, in the name of Jesus Christ, your Son, we ask you to bless and sanctify this bread for the souls of all who partake of it, that they may eat it in memory of the body of your Son, and testify before you, O God, Eternal Father, that they are willing to take upon themselves the name of your Son, and to always remember him, and to keep his commandments which he has given them, so that they may always have his Spirit with them. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Sacramental Water Prayer · Holy Supper (Doctrine and Covenants 20 / Moroni 5)
oraciones.textoOriginal: O God, the Eternal Father, we ask thee in the name of thy Son, Jesus Christ, to bless and sanctify this water to the souls of all those who drink of it...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O God, di E-tér-nal Fá-der, wi ask di in de neim ov dai San, Jí-sas Kraist...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: O God, Eternal Father, in the name of Jesus Christ, your Son, we ask you to bless and sanctify this water for the souls of all who drink of it, so that they may do so in memory of the blood of your Son, which was shed for them; so that they may testify before you, O God, the Eternal Father, that they always remember him, so that they may have his Spirit with them. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Invocation of Opening of the Sacramental Meeting · Presence of the Holy Spirit
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Spanish Canónico Santo de los Últimos Días
oraciones.textoOriginal: Nuestro querido Padre Celestial, nos reunimos en este día sagrado con corazones agradecidos para adorarte y recordar el sacrificio expiatorio de tu Amado Hijo Jesucristo.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Nwés-tro ke-rí-do Pá-dre Se-les-tyál...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Our dear Heavenly Father, in the sacred name of your Son Jesus Christ we present ourselves before You with reverence and gratitude. We thank you for the gift of life, for the restored Gospel, and for the opportunity to gather together in brotherhood. We beseech Thee to pour out Thy Holy Spirit upon this meeting, that our hearts may be instructed, comforted, and uplifted in righteousness. Bless our families and be with us always. In the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Spiritual Warfare Prayer and the Armor of God (Ephesians 6:10-18)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ἐνδύσασθε τὴν πανοπλίαν τοῦ Θεοῦ... Ceñid vuestros lomos con la verdad, y vestíos con la coraza de justicia, y calzados los pies con el celo del evangelio de la paz.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [En-dý-sas-the ten pa-no-plí-an tu The-ú...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
In the Almighty Name of Jesus Christ I am strengthened in the Lord and in the power of his might. I take on this day all the Armor of God to resist on the evil day and remain firm:

• I gird my loins with the belt of divine Truth.
• I put on the Breastplate of Justice that covers my heart.
• I shod my feet with the preparation of the Gospel of Peace.
• I take the Shield of Faith, with which I extinguish all the fiery darts of the evil one.
• I take the Helmet of Salvation that protects my mind from all thoughts contrary to God.
• And I wield the Sword of the Spirit, which is the living and effective Word of God.

No weapon formed against me or against my family will prosper, for greater is he who is in us than he who is in the world. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Faith and Acceptance of Jesus Christ as Personal Savior (New Birth)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Señor Jesús: reconozco que soy pecador y que necesito tu salvación. Creo con todo mi corazón que moriste en la cruz por mis pecados y resucitaste al tercer día.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Se-nyór Je-sús: re-ko-nós-ko ke soy pe-ka-dór y ke ne-se-sí-to tu sal-va-syón...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy and Almighty Father! In the supreme name of Jesus Christ, we come before Thy glorious presence, proclaiming the power and victory of Thy living Word over Prayer of Faith and Acceptance of Jesus Christ as Personal Savior (New Birth). Release Thy anointing and the fire of Thy Holy Spirit upon our life, tear down every obstacle, heal every infirmity, and fill us with supernatural strength and joy. To Thee be all the glory, honor, and power forever! Amen and amen.

oraciones.titulo: Cry for Deliverance, Breaking of Chains and Blessing of the Home
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡En el Nombre de Jesús rompemos toda cadena de ruina, división, enfermedad y opresión! Declaramos que esta casa es territorio santo de Dios.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [En el Nóm-bre de Je-sús rom-pé-mos tó-da ka-dé-na...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, in the Name above all names, the Name of Jesus of Nazareth! We rise in faith and spiritual authority to declare freedom and peace over our lives and our home. We break every yoke of disease, ruin, oppression, discord or fear. We cry out for the blood of the Lamb of God on the lintels of our doors. May the presence of the Holy Spirit flood every corner, bringing healing, prosperity and unbreakable joy. We declare victory and blessing in the Name of Jesus! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Adoration and Opening of Christian Evangelical Worship
oraciones.textoOriginal: Dios todopoderoso, digno de suprema alabanza: nos congregamos en tu santo templo para exaltar tu Nombre y recibir la edificación de tu Palabra.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Dyos to-do-po-de-ró-so, díg-no de su-pré-ma a-la-bán-sa...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy and Almighty Father! In the supreme name of Jesus Christ, we come before Thy glorious presence, proclaiming the power and victory of Thy living Word over Prayer of Adoration and Opening of Christian Evangelical Worship. Release Thy anointing and the fire of Thy Holy Spirit upon our life, tear down every obstacle, heal every infirmity, and fill us with supernatural strength and joy. To Thee be all the glory, honor, and power forever! Amen and amen.

oraciones.titulo: Triratna Vandana · Sacred Refuge in the Three Jewels: Buddha, Dharma and Sangha
oraciones.textoOriginal:
बुद्धं शरणं गच्छामि । धर्मं शरणं गच्छामि । संघं शरणं गच्छामि ॥
Buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi. Dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi. Saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Búd-dham sa-ra-nam gach-chá-mi. Dhám-mam sa-ra-nam gach-chá-mi. Sán-gham sa-ra-nam gach-chá-mi.]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
I take refuge in the Buddha, the Enlightened and Awakened One.
I take refuge in the Dharma, the Supreme Teaching and Universal Truth.
I take refuge in the Sangha, the Noble Community of practitioners of the Way.

For the second time, I take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma and in the Sangha.
For the third time, I take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma and in the Sangha.
May this refuge dispel illusion, awaken compassion in my mind and lead me to true peace. Sadhu, Sadhu, Sadhu.

oraciones.titulo: Prajnaparamita Hridaya Sutra · The Heart Sutra of Great Transcendent Wisdom
oraciones.textoOriginal:
गते गते पारगते पारसंगते बोधि स्वाहा ॥
Gate gate pāragate pārasaṃgate bodhi svāhā.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Gá-te, gá-te, pá-ra-ga-te, pá-ra-sam-ga-te, bó-dhi swá-ha.]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
Form is emptiness, emptiness is form. Form is not different from emptiness, emptiness is not different from form. So are sensations, perceptions, impulses and consciousness.

There is no origin, there is no extinction; there is no impurity, there is no purity; there is no increase or decrease. Therefore, in emptiness there is no suffering, no cause of suffering, no cessation, no path.

Without obstacles in the mind, there is no fear; freed from all illusion, the supreme Nirvana is reached.

Gone, gone, gone beyond, gone totally beyond to the other shore of enlightenment. Swaha!

oraciones.titulo: Mantra of the Medicine Buddha (Bhaisajyaguru) Healing of Diseases and Suffering
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ नमो भगवते भैषज्यगुरु वैडूर्यप्रभराजाय तथागतायार्हते सम्यक्सम्बुद्धाय तद्यथा ॐ भैषज्ये भैषज्ये महाभैषज्ये भैषज्यराजे समुद्गते स्वाहा ॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Tad-ya-thá: Om Bhai-shaj-ye Bhai-shaj-ye Ma-ha-bhai-shaj-ye Bhai-shaj-ya-rá-je Sa-mud-ga-te Swá-ha.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om. I prostrate before the Lord Medicine Buddha, the Lapis Lazuli King of Light, the Enlightened One and Perfect Healer. O Healer, Great Healer, King of Physicians, dispel all disease from the body, purify the poisons of attachment, aversion and ignorance in the mind, and restore perfect health and harmony in all beings! Svaha.

oraciones.titulo: Metta Bhavana · Universal Prayer of Benevolent Love and Loving Kindness
oraciones.textoOriginal: Sabbe sattā sukhi hotu, sabbe sattā averā hontu, sabbe sattā abyāpajjhā hontu, sabbe sattā anīghā hontu, sabbe sattā sukhī attānaṃ pariharantu.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Sáb-be sat-tá su-jí hó-tu, sáb-be sat-tá a-ve-rá hón-tu, sáb-be sat-tá suk-jí at-tá-nam pa-ri-ha-rán-tu.]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
May all sentient beings be full of peace and happy.
May all beings be free from enmity, hatred and resentment.
May all beings be free from physical and mental affliction and suffering.
May all beings find health, serenity and true joy.

Just as a mother protects her only child with her own life, may my mind cultivate an unlimited and benevolent love towards all beings in the universe, above, below and in all directions. Amen / Sadhu.

oraciones.titulo: Maha Mantra Om Mani Padme Hum · The Jewel in the Lotus of Infinite Compassion
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ मणि पद्मे हूँ ॥ Om Mani Padme Hum.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Om Ma-ni Pad-me Jum]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om. I contemplate the sacred Jewel in the heart of the Lotus. I invoke the infinite compassion of Avalokiteshvara (Chenrezig) upon all realms of existence. May the six sacred syllables purify pride, jealousy, desire, ignorance, greed and anger, transforming them into the six divine wisdoms. May compassion and peace flourish in every heart. Hum.

oraciones.titulo: Miraculous Prayer · Prayer for Divine Intervention in Times of Great Need
oraciones.textoOriginal: Amado Dios, he buscado un instante de calma para elevar una oración hasta Ti y decirte que hoy te necesito más que nunca. Mi corazón está lleno de preocupaciones y es por eso que acudo a tu bondad para pedirte que intervengas en mi vida de una manera muy especial y milagrosa.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [A-má-do Dyos, e bus-ká-do un ins-tán-te de kál-ma pá-ra e-le-vár ú-na o-ra-syón ás-ta Ti...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
In the Name of the Father, of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Dear God, I have sought a moment of calm to raise a prayer to You and tell You that today I need You more than ever. My heart is full of worries and needs and that is why I turn to your goodness, to ask you to intervene in my life in a very special and miraculous way.

You better than anyone know my soul, my desires, my pains and my intentions; You also know the size of my faith and the fervor with which I have cried out to you so many times. Lord, I know that You have the power to do anything and that is why in this prayer I surrender my need to You and ask You to perform a miracle to improve my life.
