I pray that your kind hands are working in my life and in the lives of the people I love: that where there is pain, you be peace; that where there is illness, You be health; that where there is injustice, You be truth and that where there is scarcity, You be prosperity and abundance.

I also want to ask you to free me from the heavy burden of anxiety and worries about the future. Help me to be strengthened in your word and to depend on you at all times. Heavenly Father, You are the light that clarifies my path and the strength that I will never lack. I thank You for Your benevolence, for Your constant guidance and I trust that You have a wonderful plan for me.

Dear God, thank you for hearing my prayer and because I know that You will answer it. Please bless my life and my hopes, guide my steps and do not let my faith shipwreck when difficulties arise. I will continue forward with faith, because I trust in your love and your goodness and I know that in your name, my life will be filled with peace, health, plenitude, prosperity and great miracles. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Divine Providence on the First Day of Every Month · House, Clothing and Sustenance
oraciones.textoOriginal: Divina Providentia, concede nobis clementiam tuam. ¡Oh Divina Providencia! ¡Concédeme tu clemencia y tu infinita bondad! De rodillas a tus plantas, a Ti caridad portento, te pido para los míos casa, vestido y sustento.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Di-ví-na Pro-vi-dén-tzi-a, kon-ché-de nó-bis kle-mén-tzi-am tú-am. O Di-ví-na Pro-vi-dén-sya...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
In the Name of the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit.

Oh Divine Providence! Grant me your clemency and your infinite goodness!

On my knees at your feet, to You, charity and wonder, I ask You for mine: house, clothing and sustenance.

Grant us health and lead us on the right path, and may virtue always guide our destiny. You are all my hope, You are my comfort, I believe in You, I hope in You and I trust in You.

Your Divine Providence extends at every moment, so that we never lack a home, clothing and sustenance, nor the holy sacraments at the last moment. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Consecration of the Home to the Holy Trinity and Divine Providence
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Santísima Trinidad, Padre, Hijo y Espíritu Santo, un solo Dios en tres Personas! Consagro mi hogar a tu Divina Providencia para que reine la bendición, el trabajo digno y la concordia.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [San-tí-si-ma Tri-ni-dád, Pá-dre, Í-jo y Es-pí-ri-tu Sán-to...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
In the Name of the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Oh Holy Trinity, One and True God, sovereign Source of all life and universal Providence! To You I consecrate my heart, my family, my house and all my projects. I thank you for the air I breathe, for my daily bread and for the constant protection with which you cover your loved ones.

Pour out your grace on our home, remove discord, scarcity, temptations and dangers. May your Divine Providence reign in our decisions and may we never depart from your holy law of love. Glory to the Father, glory to the Son and glory to the Holy Spirit. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Joseph · Ancient and Very Effective Prayer (It has never failed)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Oh San José, cuya protección es tan grande, tan fuerte y tan eficaz ante el trono de Dios! A ti confío todos mis intereses y mis deseos.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O San Jo-sé, kú-ya pro-tek-syón es tan grán-de, tan fwér-te y tan e-fi-kás...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Saint Joseph, whose protection is so great, so strong and so effective before the throne of God! To you I surrender all my interests, my afflictions and my desires. Assist me, glorious Patriarch, with your powerful intercession, and obtain for me from your Divine Son all the spiritual and temporal blessings that I need. May I fully trust in your paternal protection, may my hope never be disappointed. I promise to always honor you as my special protector. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Cristóbal · Protector of Drivers, Drivers and Travelers
oraciones.textoOriginal: Dame, Señor, mano firme y mirada vigilante para que a mi paso no cause daño a nadie. San Cristóbal bendito, sé mi custodio en el camino.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Dá-me, Se-nyór, má-no fír-me y mi-rá-da vi-ji-lán-te...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Give me, Lord, a firm hand and a watchful look, so that I do not cause harm to anyone in my path. To You, God of goodness, who gives life and preserves it, I humbly beg You to preserve my life today and that of those who travel with me. Deliver me from accidents, recklessness, mechanical dangers and assaults. Glorious Saint Christopher, you who crossed the turbulent waters carrying the Child Jesus on your shoulders, accompany me in every curve and make me arrive safely at my destination. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Pancras · Youthful Martyr of Health, Employment, and Prosperity
oraciones.textoOriginal: Sancte Pancrati, pro Christo martyr inclite, ora pro nobis. ¡Oh glorioso San Pancracio, abogado de la salud y el trabajo honrado!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Sánk-te Pan-krá-tzi, pro Krís-to már-tir ín-kli-te...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh glorious Saint Pancratius, young saint and admirable martyr! For the ardent love that you professed for Jesus Christ until your blood was shed, I come to you with sincere faith. You who are proclaimed by the faithful people as an advocate of health and honest work: intercede before God so that my home never lacks decent sustenance, productive employment and the physical well-being of my family. Drive away ruin and grant us to prosper in peace and grace. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Roch · Protection against Epidemics, Plagues, and Blessing of Pets
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Oh glorioso San Roque, siervo fiel de Dios y consuelo de los enfermos contagiosos! Líbranos de pestes, epidemias y ampara a nuestros animales.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O glo-ri-ó-so San Ró-ke, syér-vo fyél de Dyos...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh glorious Saint Roch, pilgrim of charity and consolation of the sick! For that divine favor that freed you from the contagion of the plague assisted by the faithful little dog who brought you your daily bread: extend your protection over our house. Preserve us from all infectious diseases, viruses and epidemics; Heals the bedridden sick and blesses the animals and pets that live with us in the home. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Francis of Assisi · Make me an Instrument of your Peace (Peace Prayer)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Signore, fa di me uno strumento della tua pace. Dove è odio, fa ch'io porti l'amore. Dove è offesa, ch'io porti il perdono.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Si-nyó-re, fa di me ú-no stru-mén-to dél-la tú-a pá-che...]

oraciones.titulo: Saint Teresa of Ávila · Let Nothing Disturb Thee (Nada Te Turbe)
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Spanish Místico Clásico del Siglo de Oro
oraciones.textoOriginal: Nada te turbe, nada te espante. Todo se pasa, Dios no se muda. La paciencia todo lo alcanza; quien a Dios tiene nada le falta: Sólo Dios basta.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Ná-da te túr-be, ná-da te es-pán-te. Tó-do se pá-sa, Dyos no se mú-da...]

oraciones.titulo: Saint Lucia · Eye Health, Eye Healing and Spiritual Clarity
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Oh gloriosa Santa Lucía, virgen y mártir invicta! Tú que consagraste tus ojos al Señor y fuiste coronada con la luz celestial: sana la vista de mi cuerpo y de mi alma.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O glo-ri-ó-sa Sán-ta Lu-sí-a, vír-jen y már-tir in-vík-ta...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh glorious Saint Lucia, resplendent star of holiness and protector of sight! I come to you with filial trust to beg you to preserve and heal the eyes of my body from all ailment, blindness, fatigue or illness. But above all, grant me the grace to keep the eyes of my soul clean, so that they never fall into the darkness of sin and can always contemplate the truth and goodness of God. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Barbara · Protection against Lightning, Storms, and Sudden Death
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Santa Bárbara bendita, que en el cielo estás escrita con papel y tinta bendita! Libra mi casa y mi familia de tempestades, rayos y fuego.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Sán-ta Bár-ba-ra ben-dí-ta, ke en el syé-lo es-tás es-krí-ta...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Blessed Saint Barbara, illustrious virgin and courageous martyr! You who were comforted by Jesus in your prison and received the promise to free those who honor your memory from storms, fires, lightning and sudden death: be my protection in the hours of storm. Calm the storms of nature and the storms of life, and defend us with your victorious palm from all enemies and unforeseen dangers. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Virgin Mary Untying Knots · Daily Prayer to Untie the Knots of Life
oraciones.textoOriginal: Santa María, llena de la presencia de Dios, durante los días de tu vida aceptaste con humildad la voluntad del Padre. Desata los nudos que asfixian mi alma.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Sán-ta Ma-rí-a, lyé-na de la pre-sén-sya de Dyos...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy Mary, Mother of God and our Mother, who with a maternal heart unties the knots that suffocate our lives: to your merciful hands today I deliver the ties that prevent me from moving forward (mention your difficulty or knot). You who with your patience and intercession untied the knot of human disobedience, untie the obstacles to my family, my work and my health. Deliver me from discouragement and lead me by the hand to the peace of your Son Jesus Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal · Spring of Graces and Rays of Light
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ô Marie conçue sans péché, priez pour nous qui avons recours à vous. ¡Oh María sin pecado concebida, rogad por nosotros que recurrimos a Vos!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O Ma-rí kon-sí san pe-shé, pri-yé pur nu ki a-vón re-kúr a vu...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Immaculate Virgin of the Miraculous Medal! You who manifested yourself to Saint Catherine Labouré with open hands spilling luminous rays of blessings over the earth: look at me with eyes of mercy. Pour upon my life those rays of divine grace that many forget to ask for. Protect me under your blessed mantle and reach me from Jesus the miracle that I ask of you with faith. Oh Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who turn to you! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Du'a upon Awakening · Gratitude for Life and Renewal of the Soul
oraciones.textoOriginal: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Al-ḥamdu lillāhi l-ladhī aḥyānā ba‘da mā amātanā wa ilayhi n-nushūr.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Praise be to God, Who has restored us to life after causing us to die (in sleep), and to Him is the final return. Praise God for the gift of a new day of life, health and opportunity to do good. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Du'a before Sleep · Entrustment of the Spirit and Night Peace
oraciones.textoOriginal: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي ، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ ، فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا ، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Bi-smika Rabbī waḍa‘tu janbī, wa bika arfa‘uh, fa-in amsakta nafsī fa-rḥamhā, wa in arsaltahā fa-ḥfaẓhā bi-mā taḥfaẓu bihī ‘ibādaka ṣ-ṣāliḥīn.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: In Your Name, O my Lord, I lay down my body, and with Your help I will rise. If you retain my soul during sleep, have mercy on it; and if You restore her to life, protect her as You protect Your righteous servants. In Your Name, O God, I live and die. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Du'a when Leaving the House · Absolute Trust and Protection of God
oraciones.textoOriginal: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Bismi-llāh, tawakkaltu ‘alā-llāh, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā bi-llāh.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of God, I put all my trust in God, and there is no power or strength but in God. Oh God! I take refuge in You from going astray or being led astray, from slipping or being made to slip, from oppressing or being oppressed, from being ignorant or being acted ignorantly towards me. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Du'a of Yūnus (Jonah) · Supplication in Darkness and Liberation from Anguish
oraciones.textoOriginal: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Lā ilāha illā Anta, subḥānaka innī kuntu mina ẓ-ẓālimīn.]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
There is no divinity but You, Glorified be You! I have certainly been one of the transgressors. (Quran 21:87)

Oh God of infinite mercy! Just as You responded to the prophet Jonah in the depths of the sea and in the darkness of the whale's belly, hear my cry in the midst of this tribulation and bring me out of distress into the light of Your blessing. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Du'a of Ayyūb (Job) · Patient Supplication for the Healing of Pain and Illness
oraciones.textoOriginal: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Annī massaniya ḍ-ḍurru wa Anta Arḥamu r-rāḥimīn.]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
Truly affliction and sickness have overtaken me, but You are the Most Merciful of the merciful. (Quran 21:83)

Oh my Lord, Supreme Healer! Look at my pain and physical weakness; renew my strength and pour Your healing balm on my body and soul as You did with Your faithful servant Ayyūb. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Du'a of Mūsa (Moses) · Clarity, Eloquence and Expansion of the Chest
oraciones.textoOriginal: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Rabbi-shraḥ lī ṣadrī, wa yassir lī amrī, wa-ḥlul ‘uqdatam-mil-lisānī, yafqahū qawlī.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: My Lord! Expand my chest and fill it with serenity, facilitate my task, and untie the knot of my tongue so that they understand my words. (Quran 20:25-28) Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Du'a against Debts, Sadness and Material Distress
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Allāhumma innī a‘ūdhu bika mina l-hammi wa l-ḥazan, wa a‘ūdhu bika mina l-‘ajzi wa l-kasal, wa a‘ūdhu bika mina l-jubni wa l-bukhl, wa a‘ūdhu bika min ghalabati d-dayni wa qahri r-rijāl.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh God! I take refuge in You from anxiety and sadness, I take refuge in You from helplessness and laziness, I take refuge in You from cowardice and greed, and I take refuge in You from the burden of debt and the oppression of people. Open for me the doors of lawful and abundant sustenance. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Du'a for Parents · Mercy and Filial Blessing (Quran 17:24)
oraciones.textoOriginal: رَّبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Rabbi-rḥamhumā kamā rabbayānī ṣaghīrā.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: My Lord! Have mercy and mercy on my parents, just as they raised and cared for me when I was little. (Quran 17:24) Forgive their faults, fill their lives with health and blessing, and reward them with the highest Paradise. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Gayatri Mantra · The Enlightenment of the Intellect and the Light of the Spiritual Sun
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् ॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Om Bhūr Bhuvaḥ Svaḥ, Tat Savitur Vareṇyaṃ, Bhargo Devasya Dhīmahi, Dhiyo Yo Naḥ Pracodayāt.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om. We meditate on the supreme glory of the Divine Creator Sun (Savitur), the Source of universal Light on earth, in space and in the heavens. May His heavenly radiance purify our hearts and illuminate our intellect toward eternal truth. Amen / Om Shanti.

oraciones.titulo: Maha Mrityunjaya Mantra · Victory over Death, Healing, and Longevity
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् । उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय मामृतात् ॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Om Tryambakaṃ Yajāmahe Sugandhiṃ Puṣṭi-vardhanam, Urvārukam-iva Bandhanān Mṛtyor Mukṣīya Māmṛtāt.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om. We worship Lord Shiva, the Three-Eyed, fragrant and nourishing of all beings. Just as the ripe fruit gently falls from the vine, free us from the bonds of illness, fear and physical death, and lead us to the immortality of the soul. Svaha.

oraciones.titulo: Shanti Mantra · From Illusion to Truth, from Darkness to Light
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ असतो मा सद्गमय । तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय । मृत्योर्मा अमृतं गमय । ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Om Asato Mā Sad-Gamaya, Tamaso Mā Jyotir-Gamaya, Mṛtyor-Mā Amṛtaṃ Gamaya. Om Śāntiḥ Śāntiḥ Śāntiḥ.]

oraciones.titulo: Maha Lakshmi Ashtakam · Divine Abundance, Prosperity and Grace at Home
oraciones.textoOriginal: नमस्तेऽस्तु महामाये श्रीपीठे सुरपूजिते । शङ्खचक्रगदाहस्ते महालक्ष्मि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ ॐ श्रीं ह्रीं क्लीं महालक्ष्म्यै नमः ॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Namaste'stu Mahā-māye Śrī-pīṭhe Sura-pūjite, Śaṅkha-cakra-gadā-haste Mahā-lakṣmi Namo'stu Te. Om Śrīṃ Hrīṃ Klīṃ Mahālakṣmyai Namaḥ.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Greetings to You, Divine Mother Maha Lakshmi, source of prosperity and beloved of devotees! You who hold the lotus and shower gold coins of blessing and grace upon the world: bless my home. Dispel all scarcity and debt, open the paths of noble abundance and fill my life with spiritual and material harmony. Namaste.

oraciones.titulo: White Tara (Sita Tara) · Long Life, Healing, and Transcendental Purification
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ तारे तुत्तारे तुरे मम आयुः पुण्य ज्ञान पुष्टिं कुरु स्वाहा ॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Om Tāre Tuttāre Ture Mama Āyuḥ Puṇya Jñāna Puṣṭiṃ Kuru Svāhā.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om. I prostrate before the Noble Mother White Tara, with her seven eyes of compassionate wisdom. Grant to me and all beings the prolongation of life, spiritual merit, supreme wisdom and perfect physical and mental health. Svaha.

oraciones.titulo: Manjushri Mantra · The Flaming Sword of Transcendental Wisdom
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ अ र प च न धीः ॥ Om A Ra Pa Ca Na Dhīḥ.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Om A Ra Pa Tsa Na Dhih]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om. May the sword of light of Bodhisattva Manjushri cut the ignorance, confusion and attachments in my mind at the root. May the sacred syllable Dhih awaken perfect memory, eloquence, understanding of sacred texts and liberating wisdom. Dhih, Dhih, Dhih.

oraciones.titulo: The Nembutsu · Devotion and Refuge in the Infinite Light of Amitabha Buddha
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Japanese Litúrgico & Sanskrit (南無阿弥陀仏)
oraciones.textoOriginal: 南無阿弥陀仏 · Namu Amida Butsu · Namo Amitabhaya Buddhaya.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Ná-mu A-mí-da Bút-su]
oraciones.textoTraducido: I take refuge in Buddha Amitabha, the Lord of Infinite Light and Eternal Life. May your boundless compassion envelop my heart, cleanse my past faults and guide me with serenity towards the Pure Land of Peace and Awakening. Namu Amida Butsu.

oraciones.titulo: The Jesus Prayer (of the Heart) · Hesychast Prayer for Inner Purification
oraciones.textoOriginal: Κύριε Ἰησοῦ Χριστέ, Υἱὲ τοῦ Θεοῦ, ἐλέησόν με τὸν ἁμαρτωλόν.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Ký-ri-e I-e-sú Jris-té, Y-i-é tu The-ú, e-le-i-són me ton ha-mar-to-lón.]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God, have mercy on me, a sinner.

In every breath and in the sacred silence of my heart, I pronounce your Holy Name: Lord Jesus, Light of the world, dissipate the shadows of my mind, cleanse my soul and pour out your divine peace over my entire being. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: To the Celestial King · Orthodox Invocation to the Holy Spirit Comforter
oraciones.textoOriginal: Βασιλεῦ οὐράνιε, Παράκλητε, τὸ Πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας... Царю Небесный, Утешителю, Душе истины...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Ba-si-lév u-rá-ni-e, Pa-rá-kli-te, to Pnév-ma tes a-li-thí-as...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Heavenly King, Comforter, Spirit of Truth, who is everywhere and fills everything! Treasure of all good things and Giver of life: come and dwell in us, purify us from every stain and save our souls, O Kind One! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Saint Ephrem the Syrian · Prayer of Humility, Chastity, and Patience
oraciones.textoOriginal: Κύριε καὶ Δέσποτα τῆς ζωῆς μου, πνεῦμα ἀργίας, περιεργίας, φιλαρχίας καὶ ἀργολογίας μή μοι δῷς.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Ký-ri-e ke Dés-po-ta tes zo-és mu...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
Lord and Sovereign of my life! Remove from me the spirit of laziness, despondency, lust for power and vain talk.

Rather grant me, your servant, the spirit of chastity, humility, patience and love.

Yes, my Lord and King! Grant me to see my own faults and not judge my brother; for You are blessed forever and ever. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Sacred Prayer to Chango (Kábíyèsí) · Master of Thunder, Justice, and Victory
oraciones.textoOriginal: Kábíyèsí Changó, Olueko koso, erula ogge, elueko nita ogodo. Changó Oba Koso, bendice mi fuerza y haz justicia en mi camino.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Ka-bi-ye-sí Chan-gó, O-lwé-ko kó-so, e-rú-la og-gé...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Olofin and the Holy Orishas, we lift our devotion and prayer for Sacred Prayer to Chango (Kábíyèsí) · Master of Thunder, Justice, and Victory. We come with reverence before the blessed spiritual powers to remove all negativity, disturbance and heavy burdens, firmly opening the pathways to health, peace, progress and abundance in our home. Ashé to iban Eshu! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Sacred Prayer to Obatalá (Jekua Baba) · Whiteness, Peace of Mind and Firmness of Head
oraciones.textoOriginal: Obatalá Oba Tasa, Oba Tano, Ayaguna, Jekua Babá. Cubre mi cabeza (Ori) con tu manto blanco de sabiduría y aleja las tinieblas.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O-ba-ta-lá O-ba Ta-sa, O-ba Ta-no, A-ya-gú-na, Je-kwá Ba-bá...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Olofin and the Holy Orishas, we lift our devotion and prayer for Sacred Prayer to Obatalá (Jekua Baba) · Whiteness, Peace of Mind and Firmness of Head. We come with reverence before the blessed spiritual powers to remove all negativity, disturbance and heavy burdens, firmly opening the pathways to health, peace, progress and abundance in our home. Ashé to iban Eshu! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Sacred Prayer to Babalu Aye (Saint Lazarus) · Healing of Illnesses and Relief
oraciones.textoOriginal: Babalú Ayé Agronika, Asojano, Chakuata. Con tu perro fiel y tu escobilla de ajonjolí, limpia mi cuerpo de toda dolencia y llaga.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Ba-ba-lú A-yé Ag-ro-ní-ka, A-so-já-no, Cha-kwá-ta...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh venerable Babalú Ayé, miraculous saint and father of compassion for the sick! You who know the suffering of the prostrate body and the heaviness of affliction: extend your blessing upon me. With your sacred brush sweep away the illness, the pain and the heaviness of my body; restore the vitality of my bones and grant me the health and strength to move forward. Maferefún Babalú Ayé. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Consecration of Holy Saturday (Sabbat) · Rest and Communion with the Creator
oraciones.textoOriginal: Señor Dios Creador: al ponerse el sol entramos en las horas santas de tu bendito Sábado, memorial de la Creación y sello de tu amor.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Se-nyór Dyos Kre-a-dór: al po-nér-se el sol en-trá-mos en las ó-ras sán-tas...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Heavenly Father, we come with confidence before the throne of Thy grace, anchored in the promises of Thy Holy Word and in the blessed hope of Christ's soon return. We present this earnest prayer for Prayer of Consecration of Holy Saturday (Sabbat) · Rest and Communion with the Creator: guard our lives, establish our steps in Thy holy commandments, and fill us with Thy heavenly peace. Through the merits of Jesus Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of the Blessed Hope · The Second Coming of Christ (Maranatha)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Maranatha! ¡Ven, Señor Jesús! Aguardamos la bendita esperanza y la manifestación gloriosa de nuestro gran Dios y Salvador Jesucristo.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Ma-ra-na-thá! Ven, Se-nyór Je-sús!...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Dear Lord Jesus, in the midst of a world broken by pain and trials, our eyes remain fixed on the promise of your glorious return in the clouds of heaven. Keep our lamp of faith lit, comfort those who cry and help us live each day prepared and sharing the message of salvation. Yes, come quickly, Lord Jesus! Maranatha. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: The Psalm of Nephi · Trust in the Rock of Salvation (2 Nephi 4:16-35)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Oh, miserable hombre que soy! Sí, mi corazón se aflige a causa de mi carne; mi alma se duele a causa de mis iniquidades... Mas sé en quién he confiado.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O, mi-se-rá-ble óm-bre ke soy!... Mas se en kyen e kon-fyá-do.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Lord! I have trusted you and I will trust you forever. I will not put my trust in the arm of flesh. I know that you will give abundantly to anyone who asks you; yes, my God will give me if I do not ask improperly. Therefore I will raise my voice to you; yes, I will cry to you, my God, the rock of my salvation. Guide me along the straight path, remove my enemies from my path and close the doors of sin before me. In the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Moroni's Promise · Search for Truth and Spiritual Witness (Moroni 10:4-5)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Y cuando recibáis estas cosas, quisiera exhortaros a que preguntéis a Dios, el Eterno Padre, en el nombre de Cristo, si no son verdaderas estas cosas...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Y kwan-do re-si-váys és-tas kó-sas... pre-gun-téis a Dyos...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Eternal Heavenly Father, in the holy name of your Son Jesus Christ I come to You with a sincere heart and with true intention, having faith in Christ. I ask you to manifest the truth of your word to my soul through the power of the Holy Spirit. Open my understanding to discern the light from darkness and grant my spirit the certainty and peace that only come from You. In the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Archangel Metatron · Sacred Geometry, Elevation of Consciousness and Divine Light
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Hebrew Místico (מֶטַטְרוֹן - Príncipe de la Presencia)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Metatron, Sar ha-Panim ve-ha-Kavod. ¡Oh Arcángel Metatrón, custodio del Árbol de la Vida y de la Luz Trascendente!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Me-tat-rón, Sar ha-Pa-ním ve-ha-Ka-vód...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Powerful Archangel Metatron, angel of divine presence and chancellor of the heavens! I call on you to project your Sacred Cube of Light onto my auric field, my mind and my spirit. Clear all low vibrational thoughts, align my energy centers with divine will, and elevate my consciousness toward love, wisdom, and universal truth. Thank you for illuminating my path. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Archangel Raziel · Revelation of the Divine Mysteries and Hidden Wisdom
oraciones.textoOriginal: Razi'el, mal'aj ha-sodot ve-ha-chochmah ha-elyonah. ¡Oh Arcángel Raziel, guardián del conocimiento sagrado!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Ra-zi-él, mal-áj ha-so-dót ve-ha-joj-máh ha-el-yo-náh...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Archangel Raziel, guardian of the supreme mysteries and wisdom of the Creator! Allow your rainbow ray of light to illuminate my inner discernment. Help me understand the profound lessons behind every experience in my life, dispel all ignorance and open my spiritual eyes to walk in harmony with the divine laws of the universe. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Nossa Senhora Aparecida (Our Lady Aparecida) · Queen and Patroness of Brazil
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ó incomparável Senhora da Conceição Aparecida, Mãe de Deus, Rainha dos Anjos, Advogada dos pecadores, refúgio e consolação dos aflitos e atribulados! Virgem Santíssima, cheia de poder e de bondade, lançai sobre nós um olhar favorável.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O in-kom-pa-rá-vel Se-nyó-ra da Kon-sey-sao A-pa-re-sí-da...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh incomparable Lady of the Appearing Conception, Mother of God, Queen of the Angels and consolation of the afflicted! Holy Virgin, full of power and goodness, turn your compassionate gaze towards us in all our needs. Protect our families, defend our country and protect those most in need. Remember, most pious Mother, that it has never been heard that any of those who have come to you have been abandoned. Grant us the grace and peace that we humbly implore. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: São Jorge Guerreiro (Saint Jorge) · Prayer of the Cloak and Weapons of Protection
oraciones.textoOriginal: Eu andarei vestido e armado com as armas de São Jorge para que meus inimigos, tendo pés não me alcancem, tendo mãos não me peguem, tendo olhos não me vejam, e nem em pensamentos eles possam me fazer mal.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Ew an-da-réy ves-tí-do e ar-má-do kom as ár-mas de Sao Jór-je...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
I will walk dressed and armed with the weapons of Saint George, so that my enemies, having feet, do not reach me, having hands do not touch me, having eyes do not see me, and not even in thoughts can harm me.

Firearms will not reach my body, knives and spears will break without touching my body, ropes and chains will break without my body being tied.

May Jesus Christ protect and defend me with the power of his Holy and Divine Grace; The Virgin of Nazareth covers me with her sacred mantle, protecting me in all my ways, and Saint George, with his spear and his victorious shield, defends me from all evil. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Caritas Prayer (Prece of Cáritas) · Elevation, Charity, and Universal Light
oraciones.textoOriginal: Deus, nosso Pai, que tendes poder e bondade, dai a força àquele que passa pela provação, dai a luz àquele que procura a verdade, ponde no coração do homem a compaixão e a caridade.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Déws, nós-so Pay, ke tén-des po-dér e bon-dá-de, day a fór-sa a-ké-le...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Father of Infinite Goodness, Wisdom, and Mercy! In deep spiritual elevation, we lift our prayer for Caritas Prayer (Prece of Cáritas) · Elevation, Charity, and Universal Light. We pray to the good spirits and our guardian angel to assist us with their beneficent light, dispel all turmoil from the soul, and grant us patience, resignation, and love to progress along the path of goodness. May the peace of God rest upon us. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Dr. Adolfo Bezerra of Menezes · The Physician of the Poor (Healing and Spiritual Relief)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Nós Te rogamos, Pai de infinita bondade, a graça de permitir aos espíritos benfeitores, sob a égide do Dr. Bezerra de Menezes, o alívio e a cura dos nossos males físicos e espirituais.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Nos Tchi ro-gá-mos, Pay de in-fi-ní-ta bon-dá-de... Dr. Be-zér-ra de Me-né-zes...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
We beg you, Father of infinite goodness and mercy, for the grace to allow the beneficent spirits, under the direction of the beloved Dr. Adolfo Bezerra de Menezes, to pour salutary and balsamic fluids over our body and our mind.

May the emissaries of good dispel all ailments, calm the afflictions of the sick, purify the atmosphere of our home and renew our strength to fulfill our earthly trials with patience and love. Through Jesus, our Master. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Chico Xavier · Prayer for Serenity, Patience, and Harmony in the Home
oraciones.textoOriginal: Senhor, ensina-me a calar quando a cólera me queimar a alma. Ajuda-me a compreender que a paciencia é a chave da paz e que o amor tudo supera.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Se-nyór, en-sí-na-me a ka-lár kwan-do a kó-le-ra me key-már a ál-ma...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
Lord, teach me to be silent when anger threatens to disturb my peace. Help me to sow forgiveness where there was offense, and understanding where there was discord.

Make my home a haven of tolerance and charity; Grant me the strength to accept what I cannot change and the good will to transform what is in my hands. May the serenity of Jesus dwell in my heart today and always. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Father Cícero do Juazeiro (Meu Padrinho) · Protection of the Afflicted and Living Faith
oraciones.textoOriginal: Meu Padrinho Padre Cícero, servo humilde de Deus e consolador dos romeiros do Juazeiro: intercedei por nós junto a Jesus e Maria Santíssima.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Mew Pa-drí-nyo Pá-dre Sí-se-ro, sér-vo u-míl-de de Déws...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
My Godfather Father Cícero de Juazeiro! Good and zealous servant of God, comforter of the afflicted and protector of the humble and peasants: look with compassion on my needs and fatigue.

You who dedicated your life to blessing, advising and helping the people in their greatest droughts and anguish, intercede before the Virgin of Sorrows and Our Lord Jesus Christ so that we may achieve the blessing of bread, health and peace in our lives. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Iemanjá (Odofiaba) · Queen of the Sea, Mantle of Sacred Waters and Maternal Blessing
oraciones.textoOriginal: Odofiaba, Salve Rainha do Mar, mãe de todas as cabeças! Lava com tuas ondas sagradas as aflições da minha alma e traz a paz ao meu coração.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O-do-fi-á-ba, Sál-ve Ray-nyá do Mar, may de tó-das as ka-bé-sas...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Odofiaba, Mother Iemanjá, Sovereign of the Seas and protector of families! With your sacred and crystalline waves, cleanse and purify my mind and body of any heavy burden, anguish or negative energy. Pour sweetness, peace, harmony and health upon my home. Accept my prayers in your maternal lap and lead me along paths of light and prosperity. Hail Iemanjá. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Ogum (Ogunhê) · Overcomer of Obstacles, Road Opening, and Victory
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ogunhê meu Pai Ogum! Senhor dos caminhos, das batalhas e das vitórias. Com tua espada forjada no fogo divino, quebra todas as demandas e abre minhas estradas.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O-gun-yé mew Pay O-gúm! Se-nyór dos ka-mí-nyos...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Olofin and the Holy Orishas, we lift our devotion and prayer for Ogum (Ogunhê) · Overcomer of Obstacles, Road Opening, and Victory. We come with reverence before the blessed spiritual powers to remove all negativity, disturbance and heavy burdens, firmly opening the pathways to health, peace, progress and abundance in our home. Ashé to iban Eshu! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Oxum (Ora Yê Yê Ô) · Lady of Waterfalls, Gold, Love and Fertility
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ora Yê Yê Ô Oxum, mãe das águas doces, da doçura e da fertilidade! Banha meu ser com tuas águas douradas e atrai o amor e a abundância.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O-ra Ye Ye O O-shúm, may das á-gwas dó-ses...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Olofin and the Holy Orishas, we lift our devotion and prayer for Oxum (Ora Yê Yê Ô) · Lady of Waterfalls, Gold, Love and Fertility. We come with reverence before the blessed spiritual powers to remove all negativity, disturbance and heavy burdens, firmly opening the pathways to health, peace, progress and abundance in our home. Ashé to iban Eshu! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Pretos Velhos (Adorei as Almas) · Ancestral Wisdom, Humility, Forgiveness, and Peace
oraciones.textoOriginal: Adorei as Almas! Benditas almas dos Pretos Velhos, dai-me a vossa bênção de humildade, paciência e sabedoria para vencer as dores do mundo.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [A-do-réy as Ál-mas! Ben-dí-tas ál-mas dos Pré-tos Vé-lyos...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Father of Infinite Goodness, Wisdom, and Mercy! In deep spiritual elevation, we lift our prayer for Pretos Velhos (Adorei as Almas) · Ancestral Wisdom, Humility, Forgiveness, and Peace. We pray to the good spirits and our guardian angel to assist us with their beneficent light, dispel all turmoil from the soul, and grant us patience, resignation, and love to progress along the path of goodness. May the peace of God rest upon us. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Akathistos Hymn to the Most Holy Theotokos Triumphal Kontakion: To the Invincible Captain
oraciones.textoOriginal: Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ στρατηγῷ τὰ νικητήρια, ὡς λυτρωθεῖσα τῶν δεινῶν εὐχαριστήρια, ἀναγράφω σοι ἡ Πόλις σου, Θεοτόκε· ἀλλ' ὡς ἔχουσα τὸ κράτος ἀπροσμάχητον, ἐκ παντοίων με κινδύνων ἐλευθέρωσον, ἵνα κράζω σοι· Χαῖρε, Νύμφη ἀνύμφευτε.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Te hy-per-má-cho stra-te-gó ta ni-ke-té-ri-a, hos ly-tro-thí-sa ton di-nón ev-ja-ris-té-ri-a... Ché-re, Ným-fe a-ným-fev-te.]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
To you, the invincible captain and victorious defender, we your servants, delivered from tribulations and dangers, consecrate this hymn of victory and thanksgiving, O Mother of God (Theotokos)!

And you who possess invincible power, free us from all kinds of dangers and evils, so that we may acclaim you: Rejoice, oh ever Virgin and Immaculate Bride! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Seraphim of Sarov · Prayer of Easter Joy and Grace of the Holy Spirit
oraciones.textoOriginal: Преподобне отче Серафиме, моли Бога о нас! «Христос воскресе, радость моя!» Adquiere el Espíritu de Paz y miles a tu alrededor se salvarán.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Pre-po-dób-ne ót-che Se-ra-fí-me, mo-lí Bó-ga o nas!...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the Living God! Through the intercession of the Most Holy Theotokos and the blessed memory and help of Saint Seraphim of Sarov · Prayer of Easter Joy and Grace of the Holy Spirit, pour out Your Holy Spirit upon our life. Purify our mind in the stillness of prayer, grant us health, patience and forgiveness of sins, and guide us to the eternal peace of Your heavenly Kingdom. Amen!

oraciones.titulo: Saint Nicholas of Mira and Bari · Excellent Wonderworker, Protection of the Poor and Travelers
oraciones.textoOriginal: Κανόνα πίστεως καὶ εἰκόνα πραότητος... Santo obispo Nicolás, regla de fe e imagen de mansedumbre, maestro de templanza para tu grey.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Ka-nó-na pís-te-os ke i-kó-na pra-ó-te-tos...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
Oh most holy and blessed bishop Saint Nicholas of Mira and Bari, great miracle worker and defender of the faith! You who were a consolation to the afflicted, savior of the innocent unjustly condemned and generous benefactor of the poor and sailors: hear my cry.

Deliver me from temporal and spiritual dangers, remove scarcity from my table and grant my home peace, abundance and righteousness in God. Pray for us before the Throne of the Heavenly King. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint John Chrysostom · Prayer of the Hours of the Day and Night for the Protection of the Soul
oraciones.textoOriginal: Κύριε, μὴ στερήσῃς με τῶν ἐπουρανίων σου ἀγαθῶν. Κύριε, λύτρωσαί με τῶν αἰωνίων βασάνων. Señor, no me prives de tus bienes celestiales.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Ký-ri-e, me ste-rí-ses me ton e-pu-ra-ní-on su a-ga-thón...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
Lord, do not deprive me of your heavenly goods.
Lord, deliver me from eternal torments.
Lord, if I sinned in mind, word or action, forgive me.
Lord, free me from all ignorance, forgetfulness, cowardice and insensitivity.
Lord, free me from all temptation and abandonment.
Lord, illuminate my heart darkened by evil desires.
Lord, as a man I sinned, but You, as a merciful God, have mercy on me.
Lord, send your grace to my aid so that I may glorify your Holy Name. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Hymn Axion Estin · Worthy is Truly Praise You, Most Pure Mother of God
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ἄξιόν ἐστιν ὡς ἀληθῶς μακαρίζειν σε τὴν Θεοτόκον, τὴν ἀειμακάριστον καὶ παναμώμητον καὶ μητέρα τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν. Τὴν τιμιωτέραν τῶν Χερουβεὶμ καὶ ἐνδοξοτέραν ἀσυγκρίτως τῶν Σεραφείμ...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Ák-si-ón es-tin hos a-li-thós ma-ka-rí-zin se ten The-o-tó-kon... Ten ti-mi-o-té-ran ton Je-ru-vím...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
It is truly worthy to praise you, oh Mother of God (Theotokos), ever blessed, most pure and Mother of our God.

You who are more honorable than the Cherubim and incomparably more glorious than the Seraphim; You who without corruption gave birth to the Word of God: you, true Mother of God, we exalt and glorify you forever. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Morning Prayer of the Holy Elders of Óptina · Serenity and Daily Surrender
oraciones.textoOriginal: Господи, дай мне с душевным спокойствием встретить все, что принесет мне наступающий день. Господи, дай мне вполне предаться воле Твоей святой.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Gós-po-di, day mne s du-shév-nym spo-kóy-stvi-yem fstre-tít' vsyo...]
oraciones.textoTraducido:
Lord, grant me to receive with spiritual serenity everything that this day that begins brings me. Grant me to surrender completely to your holy and sovereign will.

Every hour of this day, instruct me and sustain me in all things. Whatever news I receive today, teach me to receive it with a calm spirit and with the firm conviction that your holy will is fulfilled in everything.

Guide my thoughts and feelings in all my words and actions. In unforeseen events, do not allow me to forget that everything is sent by You. Teach me to act righteously and sensibly with each member of my family, without bittering or disturbing anyone. Lord, give me strength to endure the fatigue of the coming day. Guide my will yourself and teach me to pray, to believe, to hope, to suffer, to forgive and to love. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Pantaleon Wonderworker · Great Martyr and Physician, Healer of the Sick
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ἀθλοφόρε ἅγιε καὶ ἰαματικὲ Παντελεῆμον, πρέσβευε τῷ ἐλεήμονι Θεῷ, ἵνα πταισμάτων ἄφεσιν παράσχῃ ταῖς ψυχαῖς ἡμῶν.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Ath-lo-fó-re há-gi-e ke i-a-ma-ti-ké Pan-te-le-é-mon...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the Living God! Through the intercession of the Most Holy Theotokos and the blessed memory and help of Saint Pantaleon Wonderworker · Great Martyr and Physician, Healer of the Sick, pour out Your Holy Spirit upon our life. Purify our mind in the stillness of prayer, grant us health, patience and forgiveness of sins, and guide us to the eternal peace of Your heavenly Kingdom. Amen!

oraciones.titulo: Hanuman Chalisa – Initial Dohas of Devotion and Purification
oraciones.textoOriginal:
श्रीगुरु चरन सरोज रज निज मनु मुकुरु सुधारि।
बरनउँ रघुबर बिमल जसु जो दायकु फल चारि॥
बुद्धिहीन तनु जानिके सुमिरौ पवन-कुमार।
बल बुधि बिद्या देहु मोहिं हरहु कलेस बिकार॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Shri Guru Charana Saroja Raja Nija Manu Mukuru Sudhari | Baranau Raghuvara Bimala Jasu Jo Dayaku Phala Chari || Buddhihina Tanu Janike Sumirau Pawana Kumara | Bala Budhi Bidya Dehu Mohi Harahu Kalesha Bikara ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Having cleansed the mirror of my mind with the dust of the lotus feet of my Spiritual Master, I chant the pure glory of Lord Rama, who bestows the four fruits of life (Dharma, Artha, Kama and Moksha). Knowing that I lack wisdom, I focus on You, O Son of the Wind! Grant me strength, wisdom and knowledge, and remove from me all the afflictions and impurities of the heart.

oraciones.titulo: Hanuman Chalisa – Verses 1 to 10 (Strength, Glory and Service to Rama)
oraciones.textoOriginal:
जय हनुमान ज्ञान गुन सागर। जय कपीस तिहुँ लोक उजागर॥
राम दूत अतुलित बल धामा। अंजनि-पुत्र पवनसुत नामा॥
महाबीर बिक्रम बजरंगी। कुमति निवार सुमति के संगी॥
कंचन बरन बिराज सुबेसा। कानन कुंडल कुंचित केसा॥
हाथ बज्र औ ध्वजा बिराजै। काँधे मूँज जनेऊ साजै॥
संकर सुवन केसरीनंदन। तेज प्रताप महा जग बंदन॥
बिद्यावान गुनी अति चातुर। राम काज करिबे को आतुर॥
प्रभु चरित्र सुनिबे को रसिया। राम लखन सीता मन बसिया॥
सूक्ष्म रूप धरि सियहिं दिखावा। बिकट रूप धरि लंक जरावा॥
भीम रूप धरि असुर सँहारे। रामचंद्र के काज संवारे॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Jai Hanumana Gyana Guna Sagara | Jai Kapisa Tihu Loka Ujagara || Rama Duta Atulita Bala Dhama | Anjani Putra Pawanasuta Nama || Mahabira Bikrama Bajarangi | Kumati Niwara Sumati Ke Sangi || Kanchana Barana Biraja Subesa | Kanana Kundala Kunchita Kesa || Hatha Bajra Au Dhwaja Birajai | Kandhe Munja Janeu Sajai || Sankara Suwana Kesarinandana | Teja Pratapa Maha Jaga Bandana || Bidyawana Guni Ati Chatura | Rama Kaja Karibe Ko Aatura || Prabhu Charitra Sunibe Ko Rasiya | Rama Lakhana Sita Mana Basiya || Sukshma Rupa Dhari Siyahin Dikhawa | Bikata Rupa Dhari Lanka Jarawa || Bhima Rupa Dhari Asura Samhare | Ramachandra Ke Kaja Samware ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Victory to Hanuman, infinite ocean of wisdom and virtue! Victory to the Lord of the wise who illuminates the three worlds! You are the emissary of Lord Rama, abode of incomparable strength, son of Anjana and the Wind. Great hero, with a diamond body, you dispel bad thoughts and accompany those with a noble mind. Your golden glow shines, with hoops in your ears and curly hair. In your hands you carry the lightning bolt and the sacred flag. Being the incarnation of Shiva and son of Kesari, the entire universe worships your glory. You possess all knowledge and virtue, always ready to serve God. With a face full of joy you listen to the passages of Lord Rama, eternally dwelling in the hearts of Rama, Lakshmana and Sita.

oraciones.titulo: Hanuman Chalisa – Verses 11 to 20 (Protection and Triumph over Obstacles)
oraciones.textoOriginal:
लाय सजीवन लखन जियाये। श्रीरघुबीर हरषि उर लाये॥
रघुपति कीन्ही बहुत बड़ाई। तुम मम प्रिय भरतहि सम भाई॥
सहस बदन तुम्हरो जस गावैं। अस कहि श्रीपति कंठ लगावैं॥
सनकादिक ब्रह्मादि मुनीसा। नारद सारद सहित अहीसा॥
जम कुबेर दिगपाल जहाँ ते। कबि कोबिद कहि सके कहाँ ते॥
तुम उपकार सुग्रीवहिं कीन्हा। राम मिलाय राजपद दीन्हा॥
तुम्हरो मंत्र बिभीषन माना। लंकेस्वर भए सब जग जाना॥
जुग सहस्र जोजन पर भानू। लील्यो ताहि मधुर फल जानू॥
प्रभु मुद्रिका मेलि मुख माहीं। जलधि लाँघि गये अचरज नाहीं॥
दुर्गम काज जगत के जेते। सुगम अनुग्रह तुम्हरे तेते॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Laya Sajivana Lakhana Jiyaye | Shri Raghabira Harashi Ura Laye || Raghupati Kinhi Bahuta Badai | Tuma Mama Priya Bharatahi Sama Bhai || Sahasa Badana Tumharo Jasa Gavain | Asa Kahi Shripati Kantha Lagavain || Sanakadika Brahmadika Munisa | Narada Sarada Sahita Ahisa || Jama Kubera Digapala Jahan Te | Kabi Kobida Kahi Sake Kahan Te || Tuma Upakara Sugrivahin Kinha | Rama Milaya Rajapada Dinha || Tumharo Mantra Bibhishana Mana | Lankeswara Bhaye Saba Jaga Jana || Juga Sahasra Jojana Para Bhanu | Lilyo Tahi Madhura Phala Janu || Prabhu Mudrika Meli Mukha Mahin | Jaladhi Langhi Gaye Acharaja Nahin || Durgama Kaja Jagata Ke Jete | Sugama Anugraha Tumhare Tete ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: You brought the Sanjivani herb and saved the life of Lakshmana, filling the heart of Lord Rama with joy. Rama praised you saying, 'You are as beloved to me as my own brother Bharata.' All the celestial sages, Brahma, Narada, Saraswati and the king of snakes sing your praises. How can earthly poets describe your greatness? You helped Sugriva by introducing him to Rama and restoring his kingdom to him. Vibhishana followed your advice and became king of Lanka. You jumped to the sun thousands of leagues away believing it was a sweet fruit. With the ring of the Lord on your lips you crossed the ocean without hesitation. All the difficult tasks of this world become easy and attainable by Your divine grace.

oraciones.titulo: Hanuman Chalisa · Verses 21 to 30 (Destruction of Evil and Total Healing)
oraciones.textoOriginal:
राम दुआरे तुम रखवारे। होत न आज्ञा बिनु पैसारे॥
सब सुख लहै तुम्हारी सरना। तुम रक्षक काहू को डर ना॥
आपन तेज सम्हारो आपै। तीनों लोक हाँक तें काँपै॥
भूत पिसाच निकट नहिं आवै। महाबीर जब नाम सुनावै॥
नासै रोग हरै सब पीरा। जपत निरंतर हनुमत बीरा॥
संकट तें हनुमान छुड़ावै। मन क्रम बचन ध्यान जो लावै॥
सब पर राम तपस्वी राजा। तिन के काज सकल तुम साजा॥
और मनोरथ जो कोई लावै। सोइ अमित जीवन फल पावै॥
चारों जुग परताप तुम्हारा। है परसिद्ध जगत उजियारा॥
साधु संत के तुम रखवारे। असुर निकंदन राम दुलारे॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Rama Duare Tuma Rakhaware | Hota Na Aagya Binu Paisare || Saba Sukha Lahai Tumhari Sarana | Tuma Rakshaka Kahu Ko Dara Na || Aapana Teja Samharo Aapai | Tinon Loka Hanka Ten Kampai || Bhuta Pisacha Nikata Nahin Aavai | Mahabira Jaba Nama Sunavai || Nasai Roga Harai Saba Pira | Japata Nirantara Hanumata Bira || Sankata Ten Hanumana Chhudavai | Mana Krama Bachana Dhyana Jo Lavai || Saba Para Rama Tapaswi Raja | Tina Ke Kaja Sakala Tuma Saja || Aura Manoratha Jo Koi Lavai | Soi Amita Jivana Phala Pavai || Charon Juga Paratapa Tumhara | Hai Parasiddha Jagata Ujiyara || Sadhu Santa Ke Tuma Rakhaware | Asura Nikandana Rama Dulare ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: You are the gatekeeper of Lord Rama; No one can enter without your consent. Those who take refuge in you find all happiness and well-being; Under your protection there is nothing to fear. Your own roar makes the three worlds shake. Negative spirits, shadows and demons flee in terror when the name of Hanuman is pronounced. All diseases are destroyed and all pain disappears by constantly repeating the name of brave Hanuman. Whoever meditates on you with thought, word and action is freed from all crisis and tribulation. You are the protector of the holy and virtuous, destroyer of evil and the favorite son of God.

oraciones.titulo: Hanuman Chalisa · Verses 31 to 40 and Final Dohas (Spiritual Victory)
oraciones.textoOriginal:
अष्ट सिद्धि नौ निधि के दाता। अस बर दीन जानकी माता॥
राम रसायन तुम्हरे पासा। सदा रहो रघुपति के दासा॥
तुम्हरे भजन राम को पावै। जनम जनम के दुख बिसरावै॥
अंतकाल रघुबरपुर जाई। जहाँ जन्म हरि-भक्त कहाई॥
और देवता चित्त न धरई। हनुमत सेइ सर्ब सुख करई॥
संकट कटै मिटै सब पीरा। जो सुमिरै हनुमत बलबीरा॥
जै जै जै हनुमान गोसाईं। कृपा करहु गुरुदेव की नाईं॥
जो सत बार पाठ कर कोई। छूटहि बंदि महा सुख होई॥
जो यह पढ़ै हनुमान चलीसा। होय सिद्धि साखी गौरीसा॥
तुलसीदास सदा हरि चेरा। कीजै नाथ हृदय मँह डेरा॥
पवनतनय संकट हरन मंगल मूरति रूप।
राम लखन सीता सहित हृदय बसहु सुर भूप॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ashta Siddhi Nau Nidhi Ke Data | Asa Bara Dina Janaki Mata || Rama Rasayana Tumhare Pasa | Sada Raho Raghupati Ke Dasa || Tumhare Bhajana Rama Ko Pavai | Janama Janama Ke Dukha Bisaravai || Antakala Raghubarapura Jai | Jahan Janma Hari-Bhakta Kahai || Aura Devata Chitta Na Dharai | Hanumata Sei Sarba Sukha Karai || Sankata Katai Mitai Saba Pira | Jo Sumirai Hanumata Balabira || Jai Jai Jai Hanumana Gosain | Kripa Karahu Gurudeva Ki Nain || Jo Sata Bara Patha Kara Koi | Chhutahi Bandi Maha Sukha Hoi || Jo Yaha Padhai Hanumana Chalisa | Hoya Siddhi Sakhi Gaurisa || Tulasidasa Sada Hari Chera | Kijai Natha Hridaya Manha Dera || Pavanatanaya Sankata Harana Mangala Murati Rupa | Rama Lakhana Sita Sahita Hridaya Basahu Sura Bhupa ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Mother Sita bestowed upon you the gift of bestowing the eight mystical powers (Ashta Siddhis) and the nine spiritual riches (Nidhi). You possess the supreme elixir of Love for Rama and remain His faithful servant forever. By singing your glories you reach God and the sufferings of past lives are erased. Whoever sings this hymn a hundred times is freed from all bonds and achieves supreme bliss. Whoever reads the Hanuman Chalisa obtains divine grace, witnessed by Lord Shiva. O Son of the Wind, destroyer of afflictions and personification of auspicious blessings! He dwells forever in my heart along with Rama, Lakshmana and Sita. Om Peace, Peace, Peace!

oraciones.titulo: Shiva Tandava Stotram · Hymn of Cosmic Ecstasy and Victory
oraciones.textoOriginal:
जटाटवीगलज्जलप्रवाहपावितस्थले
गलेऽवलम्ब्य लम्बितां भुजङ्गतुङ्गकालिकाम्।
डमड्डमड्डमड्डमन्निनादवड्डमर्वयं
चकार चण्डताण्डवं तनोतु नः शिवः शिवम्॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Jatatavigalajjala Pravahapavitasthale | Galeavalambya Lambitam Bhujangatungamalikam || Damaddamaddamaddaman Ninadavaddamarvayam | Chakara Chandatandavam Tanotu Nah Shivah Shivam ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: With His neck purified by the flow of water gushing from His tangled hair like a thick forest, wearing on His neck a garland of majestic snakes, and beating His sacred drum (Damaru) to the rhythm of 'damat, damat, damat', Lord Shiva performs His vigorous cosmic dance (Tandava). May He shower upon us all blessings of prosperity, peace and infinite purity!

oraciones.titulo: Mahishasura Mardini Stotram – Invocation of Victory a the Madre Durga
oraciones.textoOriginal:
अयि गिरिनन्दिनि नन्दितमेदिनि विश्वविनोदिनि नन्दिनुते
गिरिवरविन्ध्यशिरोऽधिनिवासिनि विष्णुविलासिनि जिष्णुनुते।
भगवति हे शितिकण्ठकुटुम्बिनि भूरिकुटुम्बिनि भूरिकृते
जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ayi Girinandini Nanditamedini Vishvavinodini Nandinute | Girivaravindhyashirodhinivasini Vishnuvilasini Jishnunute || Bhagavati He Shitikanthakutumbini Bhurikutumbini Bhurikrite | Jaya Jaya He Mahishasuramardini Ramyakapardini Shailasute ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Daughter of the Mountain, who fills the entire Earth with joy, who brings joy to the entire universe and whom the wise men venerate! You who reside on the summits of the Vindhya mountains and delight the Supreme Lord; Oh Mother of all creation and consort of Shiva! Victory, victory to You, O Destroyer of the forces of ignorance and darkness (Mahishasura), of beautiful braided tresses, Divine Mother of the Cosmos!

oraciones.titulo: Sri Suktam – Vedic Invocation to Abundance, Purity and Divine Grace
oraciones.textoOriginal:
हिरण्यवर्णां हरिणीं सुवर्णरजतस्रजाम्।
चन्द्रां हिरण्मयीं लक्ष्मीं जातवेदो म आवह॥
तां म आवह जातवेदो लक्ष्मीमनपगामिनीम्।
यस्यां हिरण्यं विन्देयं गामश्वं पुरुषानहम्॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Hiranyavarnam Harinim Suvarnarajatasrajam | Chandram Hiranmayim Lakshmim Jatavedo Ma Aavaha || Tam Ma Aavaha Jatavedo Lakshmimanapagaminnim | Yasyam Hiranyam Vindeyam Gamashvam Purushanaham ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Sacred Fire (Agni)! Invoke for me Goddess Lakshmi, resplendent with the brilliance of pure gold, radiant like the full moon, adorned with necklaces of gold and silver. Invoke that kind Lakshmi who never departs from one who lives in righteousness, by whose grace dignified prosperity, family peace, sustenance and well-being flourish for all beings.

oraciones.titulo: Ganesh Atharvashirsha · Supreme Hymn of Wisdom and Road Opening
oraciones.textoOriginal:
ॐ नमस्ते गणपतये। त्वमेव प्रत्यक्षं तत्त्वमसि।
त्वमेव केवलं कर्ताऽसि। त्वमेव केवलं धर्ताऽसि।
त्वमेव केवलं हर्ताऽसि। त्वमेव सर्वं खल्विदं ब्रह्मासि।
त्वं साक्षादात्माऽसि नित्यम्। ऋतं वच्मि। सत्यं वच्मि॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Namaste Ganapataye | Tvameva Pratyaksham Tattvamasi | Tvameva Kevalam Karta'si | Tvameva Kevalam Dharta'si | Tvameva Kevalam Harta'si | Tvameva Sarvam Khalvidam Brahmasi | Tvam Sakshadatm'asi Nityam | Ritam Vachmi | Satyam Vachmi ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh! Salutations to You, Lord of wisdom (Ganesha). You are the supreme and manifest truth. You are the Creator, the Sustainer and the Dissolver of all that exists. Verily You are the Supreme Universal Reality (Brahman) and the Eternal Soul in all hearts. I proclaim the universal divine law; I proclaim the absolute Truth. Protect my mind, my words, my ways and grant me lucidity and success in every noble work.

oraciones.titulo: Durga Chalisa – Hymn to the Madre Suprema Protectora
oraciones.textoOriginal:
नमो नमो दुर्गे सुख करनी। नमो नमो दुर्गे दुःख हरनी॥
निरंकार है ज्योति तुम्हारी। तिहूँ लोक फैली उजियारी॥
शशि ललाट मुख महाविशाला। नेत्र लाल भृकुटि विकराला॥
रूप मातु को अधिक सुहावे। दरश करत जन अति सुख पावे॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Namo Namo Durge Sukha Karani | Namo Namo Durge Dukha Harani || Nirankara Hai Jyoti Tumhari | Tihun Loka Phaili Ujiyari || Shashi Lalata Mukha Mahavishala | Netra Lala Bhrikuti Vikarala || Rupa Matu Ko Adhika Suhave | Darasha Karata Jana Ati Sukha Pave ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Salutations to You, O Mother Durga, causer of all happiness and bliss. Salutations to You, who destroy all pain, sorrow and sadness. Your light is infinite and illuminates the three worlds. The glow of the moon shines on your forehead and your presence fills the hearts of those who seek your protection with peace. Kind mother, be our shield and grant us victory over our weaknesses!

oraciones.titulo: Navagraha Shanti Stotram · Prayer for Planetary Harmony and Cosmic Peace
oraciones.textoOriginal:
ब्रह्मामुरारिस्त्रिपुरान्तकारी भानुः शशी भूमिसुतो बुधश्च।
गुरुश्च शुक्रः शनिराहुकेतवः कुर्वन्तु सर्वे मम सुप्रभातम्॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Brahma Muraris Tripurantakari Bhanuh Shashi Bhumisuto Budhashcha | Gurushcha Shukrah Shani Rahu Ketavah Kurvantu Sarve Mama Suprabhatam ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om Tat Sat! We invoke the supreme divine light and grace in this sacred contemplation of Navagraha Shanti Stotram · Prayer for Planetary Harmony and Cosmic Peace. May transcendent wisdom and pure knowledge dispel all darkness and ignorance from our mind, filling our life with inner peace, equanimity, discernment, and spiritual elevation. Om Shanti, Shanti, Shanti.

oraciones.titulo: Mool Mantar – Sacred Declaration of Divine Unity (Ik Onkar)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ੴ सति नामु करता पुरखु निरभउ निरवैरु अकाल मूरति अजूनी सैभं गुर प्रसादि ॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ik Onkar Sat Naam Karta Purakh Nirbhau Nirvair Akal Moorat Ajooni Saibhang Gur Parsaad ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: There is One Supreme Creator God. His Name is Eternal Truth. He is the Maker of all, without fear, without hatred or enmity, Immortal, Unborn, Self-existent, Realized by the pure grace of the Spiritual Master. Meditate on His truth: He was the truth in the beginning of the ages, He is the truth today, and He will be the truth forever.

oraciones.titulo: Japji Sahib – Pauri 1: The Purification of the Soul and the Fulfillment of the Hukam
oraciones.textoOriginal: सोचै सोचि न होवई जे सोची लख वार ॥ चूपै चूप न होवई जे लाइ रहा लिव तार ॥ भुखिआ भुख न उतरी जे बंना पुरीआ भार ॥ सहस सिआणपा लख होहि त इक न चलै नालि ॥ किव सचिआरा होईऐ किव कूडै तुटै पालि ॥ हुकमि रजाई चलणा नानक लिखिआ नालि ॥ १ ॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Sochai Soch Na Hovai Je Sochi Lakh Vaar | Choopai Choop Na Hovai Je Laai Rahaa Liv Taar | Bhukhiyaa Bhukh Na Utari Je Banna Pureeyaa Bhaar | Sahas Siaanpaa Lakh Hohi Ta Ik Na Chalai Naal | Kiv Sachiaraa Hoiai Kiv Koorai Tutai Paal | Hukam Razai Chalna Nanak Likhiya Naal || 1 ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Even if one washes millions of times, the mind is not purified only with external rituals. Although deep silence is maintained, the inner bustle does not stop. Even if one possesses the riches of entire worlds, the longing of the soul is not satisfied. Thousands of human cunning will not work in the divine presence. How, then, to reach the truth and tear down the wall of illusion? Nanak says: Walking in harmony with the Divine Will (Hukam) inscribed in the depths of the being.

oraciones.titulo: Lotus Sutra (Chapter 25) – The Universal Gate of Guanyin / Kannon
oraciones.textoOriginal: 世尊妙相具，我今重問彼，佛子何因緣，名為觀世音？具足妙相尊，偈答無盡意：汝聽觀音行，善應諸方所，弘誓深如海，歷劫不思議，侍多千億佛，發大清淨願。聞名及見身，心念不空過，能滅諸有苦。
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Shìzūn miàoxiàng jù, wǒ jīn chóng wèn bǐ, Fózǐ hé yīnyuán, míng wéi Guānshìyīn? Jùzú miàoxiāng zūn, jì dá Wújìnyì: Rǔ tīng Guānyīn xíng, shàn yīng zhū fāng suǒ, Hóngshì shēn rú hǎi, lì jié bùsǐyì, Shì duō qiān yì Fó, fā dà qīngjìng yuàn. Wén míng jí jiàn shēn, xīnnniàn bù kōng guò, Néng miè zhū yǒu kǔ.
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Lotus Sutra (Chapter 25). May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Da Bei Zhou (大悲咒) – Great Dharani Mantra of Infinite Compassion
oraciones.textoOriginal: 南無喝囉怛那哆囉夜耶。南無阿唎耶。婆盧羯帝爍鉢囉耶。菩提薩埵婆耶。摩訶薩埵婆耶。摩訶迦盧尼迦耶。唵。薩皤囉罰曳。數怛那怛寫。南無悉吉栗埵伊蒙阿唎耶。婆盧吉帝室佛囉楞 your 駄婆。
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Namo Ratna Trayaya | Namo Arya Avalokiteshvaraya Bodhisattvaya Mahasattvaya Mahakarunikaya | Om Sarva Raviye Shudhanadasya | Namo Skritva Imam Arya Avalokiteshvara...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I take refuge in the Three Sacred Jewels. I take refuge in the Noble Avalokiteshvara, Supreme Bodhisattva, Great Enlightened Being, embodiment of Infinite Compassion. Oh! May this divine nectar purify karma, dissolve fear, cure all spiritual and physical illnesses and shower blessings of peace on all sentient beings.

oraciones.titulo: Green Tara Mantra – Release of the 8 Great Fears
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Tare Tuttare Ture Soha
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh! Reverences to the Noble Tara, the Swift Deliverer. With TARE you prostrate before the Cosmic Mother; With TUTTARE you are protected from the eight great fears and worldly dangers; With TURE you achieve liberation from internal afflictions and spiritual flourishing. SOHA! May my actions benefit all beings.

oraciones.titulo: Mantra of Tara Blanca – Health, Healing and Longevidad Espiritual
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Tare Tuttare Ture Mama Ayur Punye Jnana Pushtim Kuru Soha
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh! Noble White Tara, with seven compassionate eyes that see the pain of all worlds. Pour upon us the gift of long life, spiritual merit, perfect health and pure wisdom. May the life force be restored so that we may fulfill the path of compassion and peace.

oraciones.titulo: Manjushri Mantra – Awakening of Intelligence and Transcendent Wisdom
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om A Ra Pa Tsa Na Dhih
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh! With the flaming sword of truth, Bodhisattva Manjushri cuts ignorance, confusion and doubt in the bud. By intoning the sacred syllable DHIH, lucid memory, pure eloquence, deep understanding of spiritual teachings and mental clarity are awakened.

oraciones.titulo: Nembutsu (南無阿弥陀仏) – Prayer of the Tierra Pura a Amitabha
oraciones.textoOriginal: 南無阿弥陀仏 (なむ あみだ ぶつ)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Namu Amida Butsu
oraciones.textoTraducido: I take refuge in Buddha Amitabha, Infinite Light and Eternal Life. Fully trusting in His compassionate vow, I commend my heart to His infinite grace, attaining present serenity and blissful rebirth in the Pure Land of Peace and Wisdom.

oraciones.titulo: Maha Mangala Sutta – The Sutra of Highest Blessings
oraciones.textoOriginal: बहु देवा मनुस्सा च मङ्गलानि अचिन्तयुं। आकङ्खमाना सोत्थानं ब्रूहि मङ्गलमुत्तमं॥ असेवना च बालानं पण्डितानञ्च सेवना। पूजा च पूजनेय्यानं एतं मङ्गलमुत्तमं॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Bahu deva manussa ca mangalani acintayum | Akangkhamana sotthanam bruhi mangalamuttamam || Asevana ca balanam panditananca sevana | Puja ca pujaneyyanam etam mangalamuttamam ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Many gods and humans have pondered what constitutes true blessing in life. The Enlightened One taught: Do not associate with fools, associate with the wise and honor those worthy of reverence: this is the highest blessing. Living in a harmonious environment, having moral rectitude, cultivating self-control, supporting the family and maintaining an undisturbed mind in the face of the vagaries of life: these are the supreme blessings.

oraciones.titulo: Ratana Sutta – The Spiritual Jewel of Protection and Universal Peace
oraciones.textoOriginal: यानीध भूतानि समागतानि भुम्मानि वा यानि व अन्तलिक्खे। सब्बेव भूता सुमना भवन्तु अथोपि सक्कच्च सुणन्तु भासितं॥ यंकिञ्चि वित्तं इध वा हुरं वा सग्गेसु वा यं रतनं पणीतं। न नो समं अत्थि तथागतेन इदमपि बुद्धे रतनं पणीतं एतेन सच्चेन सुवत्थि होतु॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Yanidha bhutani samagatani bhummani va yani va antalikkhe | Sabbeva bhuta sumana bhavantu athopi sakkacca sunantu bhasitam || Yamkinci vittam idha va huram va saggesu va yam ratanam panitam | Na no samam atthi tathagatena idamapi buddhe ratanam panitam etena saccena suvatthi hotu ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Whatever beings are gathered here, terrestrial or celestial, may you all enjoy a happy heart and listen carefully to these words! Whatever treasure exists here or in the hereafter, there is nothing comparable to the Enlightened One. In the Buddha resides this precious jewel of truth. By the power of this truth, may there be well-being and peace for all!

oraciones.titulo: Bojjhanga Paritta – Canto Sagrado for the Curación and the Health
oraciones.textoOriginal: सत्त बोझ्झङ्गा धम्मस्स विचयो विरियं तथा। पीति पस्सद्धि बोझ्झङ्गा समाधुपेक्खा सत्तमे॥ एते सत्त बोझ्झङ्गे मुनिना सम्मदक्खाते। भाविता बहुलीकता संवत्तन्ति अभिञ्ञाय निब्बानाय च बोधिया। एतेन सच्चवज्जेन सोत्थि ते होतु सब्बदा॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Satta bojjhanga dhammassavicayo viriyam tatha | Piti passaddhi bojjhanga samadhupekkha sattame || Ete satta bojjhange munina sammadakkhate | Bhavita bahulikata samvattanti abhinnaya nibbanaya ca bodhiya | Etena saccavajjena sotthi te hotu sabbada ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Bojjhanga Paritta. May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Al-Asmaul Husna: Ar-Rahman (The Most Merciful)
oraciones.textoOriginal: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۞ يَا رَحْمَٰنُ ارْحَمْنَا وَتَوَلَّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim | Ya Rahmanu-rhamna wa tawallana bi-rahmatikal-lati wasi'at kulla shay'
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful. O Ar-Rahman (The Most Merciful)! You whose infinite mercy encompasses everything, pour out Your compassion on my soul, heal my inner wounds and guide me under the protection of Your infinite love.

oraciones.titulo: Al-Asmaul Husna: Ar-Rahim (The Especially Merciful)
oraciones.textoOriginal: يَا رَحِيمُ يَا غَفُورُ، اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Rahimu Ya Ghafur, ighfir li dhunubi wa yassir li amri waj'alni min 'ibadikas-salihin
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Ar-Rahim (The Ever-Merciful to the believers)! Forgive my faults, lighten my burdens, facilitate my righteous affairs, and let me number you among Your righteous and peaceful servants.

oraciones.titulo: Al-Asmaul Husna: Al-Malik (The Sovereign King of the Universe)
oraciones.textoOriginal: يَا مَلِكُ يَا قُدُّوسُ، لَكَ المُلْكُ وَلَكَ الحَمْدُ، طَهِّرْ قَلْبِي مِنَ الشَّكِّ وَالشِّرْكِ وَامْلَأْهُ بِالسَّكِينَةِ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Maliku Ya Quddus, lakal-mulku wa lakal-hamd, tahhir qalbi minash-shakki wash-shirk wamla'hu bis-sakinah
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Al-Malik (The Absolute Sovereign)! Yours is the creation, Yours is the Kingdom and Yours is all praise. Purify my heart of all doubt, pride and vanity, and fill it with stillness and serene submission to Your divine will.

oraciones.titulo: Al-Asmaul Husna: Al-Quddus (The Most Holy and Pure)
oraciones.textoOriginal: سُبُّوحٌ قُدُّوسٌ رَبُّ المَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ، اللَّهُمَّ طَهِّرْ سَرَائِرَنَا وَظَوَاهِرَنَا مِنْ كُلِّ عَيْبٍ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Subbuhun Quddusun Rabbul-Mala'ikati war-Ruh, Allahumma tahhir sara'irana wa zawahirana min kulli 'ayb
oraciones.textoTraducido: Glorified and Most Pure is the Lord of the Angels and the Spirit! O Al-Quddus! Purify our secret intentions and our public actions from all errors, stains or resentments, making us instruments of Your peace.

oraciones.titulo: Al-Asmaul Husna: As-Salam (The Supreme Source of Peace)
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الجَلَالِ وَالإِكْرَامِ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Allahumma Antas-Salamu wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh our God! You are Absolute Peace (As-Salam) and all peace emanates from You. Blessed are you for all eternity, oh Owner of Majesty and Honor!

oraciones.titulo: Al-Asmaul Husna: Al-Mu'min (The Giver of Security and Faith)
oraciones.textoOriginal: يَا مُؤْمِنُ آمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي وَاحْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Mu'minu aamin raw'ati wahfazni min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi wa 'an yamini wa 'an shimali
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Al-Mu'min (The Guarantor of Safety and Faith)! Calm my fears, secure my soul in moments of turbulence and keep me in front, behind, to my right and to my left from all harm or danger.

oraciones.titulo: Al-Asmaul Husna: Al-Aziz (The Unconquerable Almighty)
oraciones.textoOriginal: يَا عَزِيزُ يَا قَوِيُّ، أَعِزَّنِي بِطَاعَتِكَ وَلَا تُذِلَّنِي بِمَعْصِيَتِكَ، وَانْصُرْنِي عَلَى هَوَايَ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya 'Azizu Ya Qawiyyu, a'izzani bi-ta'atika wa la tudhillani bi-ma'siyatika, wansurni 'ala haway
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Al-Aziz (The Powerful and Majestic)! Strengthen me in the fulfillment of what is noble and right, do not allow me to fall into the baseness of my selfish impulses, and grant me spiritual victory over my own weaknesses.

oraciones.titulo: Al-Asmaul Husna: Al-Khaliq (The Supreme Creator)
oraciones.textoOriginal: يَا خَالِقَ الكَوْنِ وَيَا بَارِئَ النُّفُوسِ، اخْلُقْ فِي قَلْبِي نُوراً وَفِي لِسَانِي نُوراً وَفِي سَمْعِي نُوراً وَفِي بَصَرِي نُوراً
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Khaliqal-kawni wa ya Bari'an-nufus, ikhluq fi qalbi nuran wa fi lisani nuran wa fi sam'i nuran wa fi basari nura
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Al-Khaliq (The Creator of all things)! Create a radiant light in my heart, put light in my words, light in my ears and light in my eyes to recognize Your glory in every corner of creation.

oraciones.titulo: Al-Asmaul Husna: Al-Fattah (The Opener of Paths and Deliverer)
oraciones.textoOriginal: يَا فَتَّاحُ افْتَحْ لَنَا أَبْوَابَ الخَيْرِ وَالرَّحْمَةِ، وَافْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالحَقِّ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الفَاتِحِينَ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Fattahu iftah lana abwabal-khayri war-rahmah, waftah baynana wa bayna qawmina bil-haqqi wa Anta khayrul-fatihin
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Al-Fattah (The Great Opener of Doors and Paths)! Open for us the doors of worthy provision, understanding and mercy, and resolve our difficulties with justice and righteousness, for You are the Supreme Opener.

oraciones.titulo: Al-Asmaul Husna: Ash-Shafi (The Infallible Healer)
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، أَذْهِبِ البَأْسَ، اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَماً
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Allahumma Rabban-nas, adhhibil-ba's, ishfi Antash-Shafi, la shifa'a illa shifa'uk, shifa'an la yughadiru saqama
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh God, Lord of all humanity! Take away pain and suffering. Heal the bodies and the souls, for You are Ash-Shafi (The Only True Healer). There is no healing but Your divine healing, a complete cure that leaves no trace of illness.

oraciones.titulo: Qasida al-Burda – Devotional Poem of the Sacred Robe
oraciones.textoOriginal: مَوْلَايَ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ دَائِمًا أَبَدًا ۞ عَلَى حَبِيبِكَ خَيْرِ الخَلْقِ كُلِّهِمِ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ سَيِّدُ الكَوْنَيْنِ وَالثَّقَلَيْنِ ۞ وَالفَرِيقَيْنِ مِنْ عُرْبٍ وَمِنْ عَجَمِ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Mawlaya salli wa sallim da'iman abada | 'Ala Habibika khayril-khalqi kullihimi | Muhammadun sayyidul-kawnayni wath-thaqalayn | Wal-fariqayni min 'urbin wa min 'ajami
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh my Lord and Creator! Send Your continued and eternal blessings and peace upon Your beloved and guide of humanity, the best of all creation. Source of wisdom, mercy for all worlds and example of compassion, righteousness and peace for all peoples.

oraciones.titulo: Du'a Kumayl – Súplica Sublime of Humility and Shelter & Refuge Divino
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ، وَبِقُوَّتِكَ الَّتِي قَهَرْتَ بِهَا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ، وَخَضَعَ لَهَا كُلُّ شَيْءٍ، وَذَلَّ لَهَا كُلُّ شَيْءٍ، وَبِعَظَمَتِكَ الَّتِي مَلَأَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Allahumma inni as'aluka bi-rahmatikal-lati wasi'at kulla shay', wa bi-quwwatikal-lati qaharta biha kulla shay', wa khada'a laha kullu shay', wa dhalla laha kullu shay', wa bi-'azamatikal-lati mala'at kulla shay'...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh my God! I implore You for Your mercy that embraces and sustains all things; by Your supreme power before which the entire universe bows in reverence; for Your greatness that fills every corner of creation. Forgive me those errors that extinguish hope, purify my soul of all pride and grant me the joy of remembering Your presence in every breath.

oraciones.titulo: Du'a before Distress and Heavy Burdens (Hisn al-Muslim)
oraciones.textoOriginal: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ العَظِيمُ الحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ العَرْشِ العَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ العَرْشِ الكَرِيمِ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: La ilaha illallahul-'Azimul-Halim, la ilaha illallahu Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azim, la ilaha illallahu Rabbus-samawati wa Rabbul-ardi wa Rabbul-'Arshil-Karim
oraciones.textoTraducido: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, the Immeasurable, the Compassionate and the Patient. There is no God but Allah, Sovereign of the Sublime Throne. There is no God but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth and Lord of the Noble Throne of Grace.

oraciones.titulo: Morning Supplication for Protection and Daily Light (Hisn al-Muslim)
oraciones.textoOriginal: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ المُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَٰذَا اليَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah, wal-hamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in Qadir. Rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadhal-yawmi wa khayra ma ba'dah
oraciones.textoTraducido: We enter in the morning and the whole kingdom belongs to God. All praise is for God. There is no divinity but Allah, Unique and without associates. His is the sovereignty and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. Oh my Lord! I ask You for the good of this day and the good that follows, and I take refuge in You from all laziness, evil and tribulation.

oraciones.titulo: Lord of the Wonders of Puebla – Prayer in the face of Trials and Tribulations
oraciones.textoOriginal: Señor de las Maravillas, Jesús caído por nuestras culpas, te contemplo postrado bajo el madero de la cruz.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Señor de las Maravillas, Jesús caído por nuestras culpas...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Dearest Lord of Wonders! Patient and compassionate Jesus, who three times fell under the weight of the cross to redeem our faults: prostrate before your sacred and venerated image, I present to you my pains, anxieties and deepest needs. You who work wonders and pour out wonders of grace on those who come to you with sincere faith, extend your blessed hand, lift me up from my falls, comfort my family and grant me the grace that I fervently beg of you today. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Virgin of Zapopan (The Generala and Pacificadora) – Protection and Peace in the Home
oraciones.textoOriginal: Virgen de Zapopan, Madre protectora y reina de la paz, cobíjanos bajo tu manto de maternal misericordia.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Virgen de Zapopan, Madre protectora...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Sweet Virgin of Zapopan, dear Peacemaker and Patroness of ours! With filial devotion we come to your maternal presence to ask you to reign in our homes and remove all discord, danger and storm from our lives. Just as you protected the people in difficult times, take care of our path today, spread harmony in our families and obtain for us from your Divine Son the grace to always live in his love and peace. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Rafael Guízar and Valencia – Prayer for the Sick and Helpless
oraciones.textoOriginal: San Rafael Guízar, pastor infatigable de los pobres y consuelo de los enfermos, ruega por nosotros.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: San Rafael Guízar y Valencia, pastor de Cristo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Glorious Saint Rafael Guízar y Valencia, holy and charitable bishop who with courage and tenderness helped the wounded, orphans and afflicted in the midst of persecutions and epidemics: look with mercy on our ailments of body and soul. Intercede before the Heart of Jesus so that we achieve healing, strength in suffering and a generous heart to help those most in need. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Beato Miguel Agustín Pro – Prayer of Valentía and Gozo in the Fe
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Viva Cristo Rey y la Virgen de Guadalupe! Señor, en tus manos encomiendo mi vida con alegría.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Viva Cristo Rey y Santa María de Guadalupe...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord our God, who granted Blessed Michael Augustine Pro a burning zeal and unwavering joy to serve you even in the midst of danger and persecution: grant us to imitate his courage, keep hope alive in times of trial and proclaim with our works the reign of love, justice and truth of Jesus Christ. Long live Christ the King! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Toribio Romo – Heavenly Protector and Guide of Migrants and Travelers
oraciones.textoOriginal: San Toribio Romo, mártir de Cristo y amigo del caminante, acompáñame en mi travesía.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: San Toribio Romo, mártir y custodio del migrante...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy martyr Toribio Romo, who in your earthly life helped the stranger and gave faithful testimony to the faith: I commend to your intercession all the men and women who leave their land in search of a worthy future. Guide them in the desert, protect them from violence and injustice, open the hearts of those who receive them and protect them so that they reach their destination safely. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Nossa Senhora of Nazaré (Círio of Nazaré) – Blessing of Families and Life
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ó Senhora de Nazaré, Rainha da Amazônia e Mãe de misericórdia, abençoai o nosso caminhar.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O Senhora de Nazare, Rainha da Amazonia...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Loving Our Lady of Nazaré, Mother of God and our Mother! In the great pilgrimage of faith we entrust you with our lives, our families and our purest desires. Deliver us from all evil, renew in our hearts the fervor of charity and make the sacred rope of your love keep us united to Christ Jesus, Savior of the world. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Dulce dos Pobres (The Ángel Bueno of Bahía) – Prayer of Caridad and Health
oraciones.textoOriginal: Santa Dulce dos Pobres, anjo bom da caridade, rogai por nós e pelos enfermos.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Santa Dulce dos Pobres, anjo bom da caridade...
oraciones.textoTraducido: God of infinite mercy, who made Saint Dulce of the Poor a tireless instrument of compassion and relief for the most vulnerable and sick: grant us, through your holy intercession, the health we need and a humble and compassionate heart to see in each brother in need the suffering face of Jesus. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Anthony of Santana Galvão (Frei Galvão) – Prayer and Devotion of the Pills
oraciones.textoOriginal: Post partum, Virgo, inviolata permansisti: Dei Genitrix, intercede pro nobis.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Post partum, Virgo, inviolata permansisti: Dei Genitrix, intercede pro nobis.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Blessed Virgin Mary, who after childbirth remained an Immaculate Virgin! Through the intercession of your faithful devotee Saint Frei Galvão, pour out your maternal grace on us. It relieves the pain of childbirth to pregnant mothers, grants health to the seriously ill and guides our souls along the path of holiness, peace and Christian charity. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Lord of the Miracles of Buga – Plea for Healing and Peace
oraciones.textoOriginal: Señor de los Milagros de Buga, Cristo crucificado que renuevas las almas, ten piedad de mí.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Señor de los Milagros de Buga, Cristo de amor...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Most Loving Lord of the Miracles of Buga! With a contrite heart I come to your sacred feet to thank you for your benefits and implore your mercy.
