Heal my ailments, renew my spirit, remove hatred from our society and bless my home with the gift of harmony and dignified work. I trust in you, Lord. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Our Lady of the Rosary of Chiquinquirá – Patroness of Colombia
oraciones.textoOriginal: Virgen de Chiquinquirá, Reina y Patrona, renueva nuestra fe como renovaste tu sagrado lienzo.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Virgen de Chiquinquira, Reina y Patrona...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Sovereign Queen of the Rosary of Chiquinquirá! Just as your blessed image miraculously shone on the humble canvas, renew in our souls the light of faith, grace and purity. Intercede for the peace of our country, take care of our youth and make justice and brotherhood flourish in all corners of the world. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Lord of the Miracles of the Nazarenes (Cristo Moreno of Lima)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Señor de los Milagros, a Ti venimos en procesión tus fieles devotos a implorar tu bendición.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Señor de los Milagros, Cristo de Pachacamilla...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Lord of Miracles, Purple Christ of infinite goodness! You who stood erect on the sacred wall before earthquakes and storms: be our immovable bulwark against the trials of life. Forgive our sins, bless our families, heal our sick and pour out your holy blessing on the people of the entire world. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Martin of Porres – Prayer of Humility, Health and Fraternal Charity
oraciones.textoOriginal: San Martín de Porres, hermano humilde de la escoba y el crucifijo, ruega por nosotros.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: San Martin de Porres, siervo humilde del Señor...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh holy and charitable Fray Martín de Porres! A distinguished example of humility, love of neighbor and piety towards all of God's creatures: obtain for us from the Lord a clean and helpful heart, the physical and spiritual health that we so need, and the grace to live in harmony and fraternity without distinction of race or conditions. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Our Lady of Luján · Patroness of Argentina and Mother of the Southern Cone
oraciones.textoOriginal: Sancta Maria de Lujan, Patrona Argentinae et Tutela Coni Australis, ora pro nobis.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Virgencita de Luján, Patrona de la Argentina, cuida a tu pueblo]
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Most Holy Virgin Mary, as Our Lady of Luján, Patroness of Argentina and loving Mother of the Southern Cone! You who chose to remain by the Luján River as a sign of Your perpetual love, look upon Your children with tenderness. Guard our families, comfort the sick and sorrowful, and preserve peace and harmony in our homeland. Mother of Luján, obtain from Your Divine Son health, protection, and the grace we humbly ask today. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Cajetan of Thiene – Advocate of Providence, Peace, Bread and Work
oraciones.textoOriginal: San Cayetano, padre de providencia, no nos falte paz, pan ni trabajo en nuestro hogar.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: San Cayetano, padre de la divina providencia...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Glorious Saint Cajetan of Thiene! Loving Father of the helpless and faithful servant of Divine Providence: we trust in your powerful intercession so that our homes never lack peace of soul, daily bread on the table and dignified and honest work. Help us to live with detachment, justice and full trust in the Heavenly Father. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Niño of Cebú – Protector and Supreme Blessing of Homes
oraciones.textoOriginal: Pit Señor! Santo Niño de Cebú, Señor y Salvador en tu santa infancia, bendícenos.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Pit Senyor Santo Nino de Cebu...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Divine Holy Child of Cebu, Heavenly King and Lord of history! With infinite tenderness we prostrate ourselves before your venerable majesty to consecrate our homes, our children and our projects to you. Protect us from calamities, grant peace to the people and ensure that we always preserve the purity and simplicity of heart that open the doors of the Kingdom of Heaven. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Our Father Jesus Nazarene of Quiapo (The Black Nazarene) – Prayer of Resilience
oraciones.textoOriginal: Jesús Nazareno de Quiapo, Señor sufriente que cargas el madero, danos tu fortaleza.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Nuestro Padre Jesus Nazareno...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Beloved Lord Jesus of the Nazarene! Moved by the immense weight of the cross that you carry on your shoulders for our love: we ask you for strength in hours of weakness, consolation in pain and forgiveness for our offenses. May as we contemplate your bloody and compassionate face we find the courage to overcome the difficulties of life and follow you to eternal resurrection. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Pio of Pietrelcina – Prayer of Total Surrender 'Stay with Me, Lord'
oraciones.textoOriginal: Resta con me, Signore, perché è necessario averti presente per non dimenticarti...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Resta con me, Signore, perche e necessario averti presente per non dimenticarti...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Stay with me, Lord! Because it is necessary to keep you present so as not to forget you; You know how easily I abandon you. Stay with me, Lord, because I am weak and I need your strength to not fall so many times. Stay with me, because you are my life, my light and my salvation. Make me recognize you as your disciples when breaking bread, and may my soul be for you a haven of peace and a home of your love. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Francis of Assisi – Instrument of your Peace (Canticle of Fraternity)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Signore, fa di me uno strumento della tua pace: dove è odio, ch'io porti l'amore...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Signore, fa di me uno strumento della tua pace...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord, make me an instrument of your peace! Where there is hate, may I sow love; where there is offense, forgiveness; where there is discord, union; where there is doubt, faith; where there is error, truth; where there is despair, hope; where there is darkness, light; where there is sadness, joy. Oh divine Master! Make me not so much seek to be consoled as to console, to be understood as to understand, to be loved as to love. Because it is by giving as one receives, by forgiving as one is forgiven, and by dying as one is resurrected to eternal life. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Teresa of Jesus – Nothing Disturbs You, Nothing Frightens You
oraciones.textoOriginal: Nada te turbe, nada te espante, todo se pasa, Dios no se muda; la paciencia todo lo alcanza; quien a Dios tiene nada le falta: Sólo Dios basta.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Nada te turbe, nada te espante...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Nothing disturbs you, nothing frightens you; everything passes, God does not change. Patience achieves everything; He who has nothing lacks God: Only God is enough! Raise your thoughts, go up to heaven, don't worry about anything, don't worry about anything. Follow Jesus Christ with a big chest, and whatever comes, nothing scares you. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Faustina Kowalska – Hour of Mercy Prayer (3:00 PM)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Expirasti, Iesu, sed fons vitae scaturivit pro animabus, et oceanus misericordiae apertus est pro toto mundo.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Expirasti, Iesu, sed fons vitae scaturivit pro animabus...
oraciones.textoTraducido: You expired, Jesus, but the fountain of life gushed forth impetuously for the souls and the ocean of mercy opened for the entire world. Oh Source of Life, unfathomable Divine Mercy, encompass the entire world and pour out on us! Oh Blood and Water that flowed from the Heart of Jesus as a source of mercy for us: I trust in You! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Veni Creator Spiritus – Solemn Hymn of Invocation to the Holy Spirit
oraciones.textoOriginal: Veni, Creator Spiritus, mentes tuorum visita, imple superna gratia quae tu creasti pectora. Qui diceris Paraclitus, donum Dei altissimi, fons vivus, ignis, caritas, et spiritalis unctio.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Veni Creator Spiritus, mentes tuorum visita...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Come, Creator Spirit, visit the souls of your faithful and fill the hearts that you yourself created with your heavenly grace! You are called the Comforter, gift of the Most High God, living fountain, sacred fire, burning charity and spiritual anointing. Enlighten our senses, infuse your love into our hearts and strengthen the weakness of our body with your continued virtue. Glory to the Father, to the Son and to the Holy Spirit forever and ever. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Anima Christi (Soul of Christ) – Eucharistic Supplication for Purification and Union
oraciones.textoOriginal: Anima Christi, sanctifica me. Corpus Christi, salva me. Sanguis Christi, inebria me. Aqua lateris Christi, lava me. Passio Christi, conforta me. O bone Iesu, exaudi me. Intra tua vulnera absconde me.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Anima Christi sanctifica me, Corpus Christi salva me...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Soul of Christ, sanctify me. Body of Christ, save me. Blood of Christ, intoxicate me with love. Water from the side of Christ, wash me. Passion of Christ, comfort me. Oh good Jesus, hear me! Inside your wounds, hide me. Don't let me separate from You. From the evil enemy, defend me. At the hour of my death, call me and command me to come to You, so that with Your saints I may praise You forever and ever. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Chico Xavier (Emmanuel) · Prayer for Peace and Harmony in the Home
oraciones.textoOriginal: Senhor Jesus, entra em nosso lar e derrama Tua bênção de luz e harmonia sobre cada coração.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Senhor Jesus, entra em nosso lar...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Father of Infinite Goodness, Wisdom, and Mercy! In deep spiritual elevation, we lift our prayer for Chico Xavier (Emmanuel) · Prayer for Peace and Harmony in the Home. We pray to the good spirits and our guardian angel to assist us with their beneficent light, dispel all turmoil from the soul, and grant us patience, resignation, and love to progress along the path of goodness. May the peace of God rest upon us. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Chico Xavier – Praise for Serenity and Patience in the Face of Suffering
oraciones.textoOriginal: Senhor, ensina-me a calar diante da ofensa e a esperar com paciência a vitória do bem.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Senhor, ensina-me a calar...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord, teach me to be silent in the face of offense, to understand those who stumble and to serve without expecting worldly reward. When pain knocks at my door, remind me that the trials of Earth are lessons of growth for the eternal spirit. May I never lose faith, may my hand always be ready to help and may my heart rest in the certainty of your infinite justice. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Spiritist Prayer for the Fluidification and Blessing of Healing Water
oraciones.textoOriginal: Pedimos aos mensageiros de Deus que depositem nesta água os fluidos benfazejos da saúde e do refazimento físico e espiritual.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Pedimos aos mensageiros de Deus...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Father of infinite goodness! We ask the good spirits and doctors of space to impregnate this water with the life-giving fluids of health, calm and organic and spiritual rebalancing. May it be drunk with sincere faith, bringing relief for our ailments, balm for our afflictions, and strength for our body and mind. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Salutación a Oxalá (Epa Babá) – Pureza, Wisdom and Peace Universal
oraciones.textoOriginal: Epa Babá! Salve o Senhor da Paz e da Criação, manto sagrado de luz branca que tudo envolve.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Epa Baba! Salve Oxala...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Hey Baba! Hail Oxalá, Divine Manifestation of Peace, Purity and Love of the Creator. We ask you to cover our thoughts with your white mantle of serenity, remove pride and confusion from our paths, and grant us the wisdom necessary to sow harmony and concord wherever we go. Hail Oxalá!

oraciones.titulo: Invocation to Xangô (Kaô Kabecilê) – Firmeza, Justice Divina and Verdad
oraciones.textoOriginal: Kaô Kabecilê! Salve o Senhor da Justiça, do trovão sagrado e da balança da retidão.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Kao Kabecile! Salve Xango...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Kaô Kabecilê! Hail Xangô, custodian of supreme justice and the scales of truth. Enlighten our decisions with righteousness, protect us from the slander and injustices of the world and make us firm in the defense of the common good, always remembering that each person is responsible according to their works before the Divine Law. Hail Xangô!

oraciones.titulo: Invocation to Iansã (Eparrey) – Force of the Winds and Transformation
oraciones.textoOriginal: Eparrey Iansã! Salve a Senhora dos Ventos, das tempestades que limpam a atmosfera espiritual.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Eparrey Iansa! Salve Iansa...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Eparrey Iansã! Hail the Lady of the Winds and the transformation of souls. With your sword of light and the impetuous force of your sacred winds, sweep away all stagnant energy, negativity and discouragement from our lives. Give us courage to face life's changes and renew our destiny in the joy and victory of the spirit. Hail Iansã!

oraciones.titulo: Invocation to Oxóssi (Okê Arô) – Wisdom of the Bushes and Worthy Abundance
oraciones.textoOriginal: Okê Arô Oxóssi! Salve o Caçador de uma flecha só, Senhor do conhecimento e da fartura.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Oke Aro Oxossi! Salve Oxossi...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Okê Arô Oxóssi! Hail the Great Hunter of knowledge and Lord of the sacred forests. May your accurate arrow guide us towards noble goals, may we never lack decent sustenance in our homes or the medicine that heals the body in blessed nature. Teach us to care for creation and to live with righteousness and perseverance. Hail Oxóssi!

oraciones.titulo: Supplication to the Pretos Velhos (Adorei as Almas) – Humility, Paciencia and Forgiveness
oraciones.textoOriginal: Adorei as Almas! Salve os queridos vovôs e vovós, fontes de paciência, perdão e caridade pura.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Adorei as Almas! Salve os Pretos Velhos...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I adore the Souls! Hail the blessed spirits of the Pretos Velhos, grandparents of infinite goodness who with their sweet words teach us the value of humility, noble resignation and sincere forgiveness. Bless our heads with your wisdom, dry our tears and pour upon our souls the peace that comforts the wounded heart. Hail the blessed Souls!

oraciones.titulo: Invocation to the Caboclos Line – Strength of the Jungle and Spiritual Healing
oraciones.textoOriginal: Salve os Caboclos das Matas, mensageiros de cura, força e vigor espiritual.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Salve os Caboclos da Mata...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Save the spiritual strength of the noble Caboclos of the sacred jungles. With the herbs of the earth and the fluids of pure nature, strengthen our health, dissolve all physical and spiritual ailments and awaken in our being the firmness of the warrior of light who walks with sure steps towards the truth. Save the Caboclos!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Saint Ephrem the Syrian · Prayer of Great Lent
oraciones.textoOriginal: Κύριε καὶ Δέσποτα τῆς ζωῆς μου, πνεῦμα ἀργίας, περιεργίας, φιλαρχίας καὶ ἀργολογίας μή μοι δῷς. Πνεῦμα δὲ σωφροσύνης, ταπεινοφροσύνης, ὑπομονῆς καὶ ἀγάπης χάρισαί μοι τῷ σῷ δούλῳ...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Kyrie kai Despota tes zoes mou, pneuma argias, periergias, philarchias kai argologias me moi dos. Pneuma de sophrosynes, tapeinophrosynes, hypomones kai agapes charisai moi to so doulo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord and Sovereign of my life! Remove from me the spirit of laziness, despondency, ambition for dominion and vain words. Grant instead to this servant of yours the spirit of purity, humility, patience and brotherly love. Oh Lord and King! Grant me to see my own faults and not judge my brother, for blessed are you forever and ever. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Siluan of Mount Athos – Prayer of Love for Enemies and World Peace
oraciones.textoOriginal: Господи Милостивый, Духом Твоим Святым научи нас любить врагов и молиться за весь мир...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Gospodi Milostivyj, Dukhom Tvoim Svyatym nauchi nas lyubit' vragov i molit'sya za ves' mir...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Merciful Lord! By your Holy Spirit teach us to love our fellow human beings, even those who offend us, and to pray with compassion for the entire world so that all people know your love and live in holy peace. Keep our minds humble and never despair of your infinite mercy. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer before the Holy Icon of the Mother of God of Kazan – Protection of Homes
oraciones.textoOriginal: О Пресвятая Госпоже Владычице Богородице! Со страхом, верою и любовию припадающе пред честною иконою Твоею...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O Presvyataya Gospozhe Vladychitse Bogoroditse! So strakhom, veroyu i lyuboviyu pripadayushche pred chestnoyu ikonoyu Tvoyeyu...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Most Holy Lady, Sovereign Mother of God! With reverence, ardent faith and filial love we prostrate ourselves before your venerable Kazan Icon. Deliver us from falls into sin, from family discord, from tribulations and from sudden death without repentance. Be our protective shield and guide us towards the Kingdom of your Son and our God. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Paschal Troparion of the Resurrection (Christos Anesti / Khristos Voskrese)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Χριστὸς ἀνέστη ἐκ νεκρῶν, θανάτῳ θάνατον πατήσας, καὶ τοῖς ἐν τοῖς μνήμασι, ζωὴν χαρισάμενος!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Christos anesti ek nekron, thanato thanaton patesas, kai tois en tois mnemasi, zoen charisamenos!
oraciones.textoTraducido: Christ has risen from the dead, with his death he has conquered death, and he has granted Eternal Life to those who lay in the tombs! Glorious light that illuminates the entire cosmos!

oraciones.titulo: Egyptian Coptic Trisage – Immortal Hymn of Praise to the Holy Trinity
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ⲁⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲟ Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ, Ⲁⲅⲓⲟⲥ Ⲓⲥⲭⲩⲣⲟⲥ, Ⲁⲅⲓⲟⲥ Ⲁⲑⲁⲛⲁⲧⲟⲥ, ⲟ ⲉⲕ ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲩ ⲅⲉⲛⲛⲏⲑⲓⲥ: ⲉⲗⲉⲏⲥⲟⲛ ⲩⲙⲁⲥ.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Agios O Theos, Agios Ischyros, Agios Athanatos, o ek parthenou gennithis: eleison ymas.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the Living God! Through the intercession of the Most Holy Theotokos and the blessed memory and help of Egyptian Coptic Trisage, pour out Your Holy Spirit upon our life. Purify our mind in the stillness of prayer, grant us health, patience and forgiveness of sins, and guide us to the eternal peace of Your heavenly Kingdom. Amen!

oraciones.titulo: The Prayer of Jabez (1 Chronicles 4:10) – Enlargement of Territory and Blessing
oraciones.textoOriginal: «¡Oh, si me dieras bendición, y ensancharas mi territorio, y si tu mano estuviera conmigo, y me libraras de mal, para que no me dañe!» (1 Crónicas 4:10)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Oh si me dieras bendición y ensancharas mi territorio...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy and Almighty Father! In the supreme name of Jesus Christ, we come before Thy glorious presence, proclaiming the power and victory of Thy living Word over The Prayer of Jabez (1 Chronicles 4:10). Release Thy anointing and the fire of Thy Holy Spirit upon our life, tear down every obstacle, heal every infirmity, and fill us with supernatural strength and joy. To Thee be all the glory, honor, and power forever! Amen and amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Jehoshaphat before the Great Battle (2 Chronicles 20) – Victory belongs to the Lord
oraciones.textoOriginal: «¡Oh Señor Dios de nuestros padres! ¿No eres tú Dios en los cielos? En tu mano está la fuerza y el poder; en nosotros no hay fuerza contra tan grande multitud, ni sabemos qué hacer, y a ti volvemos nuestros ojos.»
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Oh Señor Dios de nuestros padres...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy and Almighty Father! In the supreme name of Jesus Christ, we come before Thy glorious presence, proclaiming the power and victory of Thy living Word over Prayer of Jehoshaphat before the Great Battle (2 Chronicles 20). Release Thy anointing and the fire of Thy Holy Spirit upon our life, tear down every obstacle, heal every infirmity, and fill us with supernatural strength and joy. To Thee be all the glory, honor, and power forever! Amen and amen.

oraciones.titulo: Cry for Breaking Chains and Coverage in the Blood of Christ
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Por la sangre del Cordero y por la palabra de su testimonio vencieron.» (Apocalipsis 12:11)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Por la sangre del Cordero proclamamos libertad...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, in the Name of Jesus and by the power of His precious blood shed on the cross of Calvary, we break every chain of oppression, illness, fear, scarcity or spiritual bondage over our lives and families. We cancel every decree of darkness and proclaim freedom, divine health, ineffable joy and integral restoration in the Holy Spirit. Whom the Son sets free will be truly free! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: John Wesley – Solemn Prayer of the Covenant and Total Consecration
oraciones.textoOriginal: I am no longer my own, but thine. Put me to what thou wilt, rank me with whom thou wilt...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: I am no longer my own, but thine...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I no longer belong to myself, but to You, Lord. Employ me for whatever you want, place me with whoever you want; make me do, make me suffer; let me be employed by You or set aside by You; Whether I be exalted by You or humbled by You; let me be full, let me be empty; let me have all things, let me have nothing. I freely and wholeheartedly put all things at your disposal. And You, oh glorious and blessed Father, Son and Holy Spirit, be my God, and may I be your servant forever. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Charles Spurgeon – Morning Prayer of Faith and Refuge in Divine Grace
oraciones.textoOriginal: Lord, help me this day to walk worthy of the vocation wherewith I am called, looking unto Jesus...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Lord help me this day to walk worthy...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus, grant me the grace this day to walk worthy of the holy calling with which I have been called, with my eyes fixed on You, the Author and Finisher of faith. Water my thirsty soul with the dew of your grace, keep my lips from murmuring, strengthen my hands for every good work and make your light shine through my life for the comfort of the afflicted. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Decreto of the Llama Violeta (Saint Germain) – Transmutación, Libertad and Forgiveness
oraciones.textoOriginal: YO SOY un ser de fuego violeta, YO SOY la pureza que Dios desea.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: YO SOY un ser de fuego violeta...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the luminous presence of the Universal Source and the Creator of all life, we align our hearts with Decreto of the Llama Violeta (Saint Germain). May the light of truth, the power of unconditional love, and profound peace flood our being, guiding our thoughts and actions toward harmony, serenity, and unity with all creation. So it is and so it shall be. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Decree of the Blue Ray of Archangel Michael – Mantle of Protection and Divine Will
oraciones.textoOriginal: San Miguel Arcángel, con tu espada de luz azul, corta y libera toda atadura de limitación y temor.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: San Miguel Arcángel, con tu espada de luz azul...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the luminous presence of the Universal Source and the Creator of all life, we align our hearts with Decree of the Blue Ray of Archangel Michael. May the light of truth, the power of unconditional love, and profound peace flood our being, guiding our thoughts and actions toward harmony, serenity, and unity with all creation. So it is and so it shall be. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Decree of the Green Ray of Archangel Raphael – Truth, Consecration and Perfect Health
oraciones.textoOriginal: Amado Arcángel Rafael, Médico de Dios, sella mi cuerpo y mente en la llama verde esmeralda de salud divina.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Amado Arcángel Rafael, Medico de Dios...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the luminous presence of the Universal Source and the Creator of all life, we align our hearts with Decree of the Green Ray of Archangel Raphael. May the light of truth, the power of unconditional love, and profound peace flood our being, guiding our thoughts and actions toward harmony, serenity, and unity with all creation. So it is and so it shall be. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Sacred Account of the First Vision (Joseph Smith - History 1:17) – Search for Light
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Vi una columna de luz, más brillante que el sol, directamente arriba de mi cabeza... Y vi a dos Personajes, cuyo brillo y gloria no admiten descripción.»
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Vi una columna de luz más brillante que el sol...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Heavenly Father, we come before Thee in the sacred and reverent name of Thy Son, Jesus Christ. We present our humble petition and gratitude for Sacred Account of the First Vision (Joseph Smith. We pray that Thou wilt pour out Thy Holy Spirit upon our home, strengthen our testimony, bless our daily labors, and guide us in righteousness along the covenant path. In the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Enos' Prayer for His Soul (Enos 1:4) – The Fight of the Spirit and the Joy of Forgiveness
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Y mi alma tuvo hambre; y me arrodillé ante mi Hacedor, y clamé a él con ferviente oración y súplica por mi propia alma.» (Enós 1:4)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Y mi alma tuvo hambre y me arrodille ante mi Hacedor...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Heavenly Father, we come before Thee in the sacred and reverent name of Thy Son, Jesus Christ. We present our humble petition and gratitude for Enos' Prayer for His Soul (Enos 1:4). We pray that Thou wilt pour out Thy Holy Spirit upon our home, strengthen our testimony, bless our daily labors, and guide us in righteousness along the covenant path. In the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Welcome to Holy Saturday – Rest, Creation and Peace in Christ
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Acuérdate del día del sábado para santificarlo... porque en seis días hizo Jehová los cielos y la tierra.» (Éxodo 20:8-11)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Acuérdate del día de reposo para santificarlo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Loving Heavenly Father, as the sun sets and we welcome the Holy Saturday that you created and blessed as a memorial of your love, we leave aside the labors and concerns of the earthly world. We thank you for the gift of rest, family communion and spiritual renewal in Jesus Christ, Lord of the Sabbath. May your Holy Spirit reign in our minds and may we enjoy the heavenly rest that you have prepared for your people. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of the Bendita Esperanza – Anhelo of the Segunda Venida of Cristo (Tito 2:13)
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Aguardando la esperanza bienaventurada y la manifestación gloriosa de nuestro gran Dios y Salvador Jesucristo.» (Tito 2:13)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Aguardando la bendita esperanza...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Heavenly Father, we come with confidence before the throne of Thy grace, anchored in the promises of Thy Holy Word and in the blessed hope of Christ's soon return. We present this earnest prayer for Prayer of the Bendita Esperanza: guard our lives, establish our steps in Thy holy commandments, and fill us with Thy heavenly peace. Through the merits of Jesus Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Al-Asmaul Husna (11/99): Al-Mutakabbir – The Supreme in Majesty and Greatness
oraciones.textoOriginal: يَا المُتَكَبِّرُ، نَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ العَظِيمِ أَنْ تَمُنَّ عَلَيْنَا بِفَضْلِكَ وَتَهْدِيَ قُلُوبَنَا
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Al-Mutakabbir, nas'aluka bi-ismikal-'Azim an tamunna 'alayna bi-fadlika wa tahdiya qulubana
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Al-Mutakabbir (The Supreme in Majesty and Greatness)! We invoke You by this Sacred Name and by Your infinite divine perfection. Purify our soul, grant peace to our hearts, bless our families with your grace and always guide us along the path of love, truth and righteousness. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Al-Asmaul Husna (12/99): Al-Bari' – The Creator Who Gives Perfect Form
oraciones.textoOriginal: يَا البَارِئُ، نَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ العَظِيمِ أَنْ تَمُنَّ عَلَيْنَا بِفَضْلِكَ وَتَهْدِيَ قُلُوبَنَا
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Al-Bari', nas'aluka bi-ismikal-'Azim an tamunna 'alayna bi-fadlika wa tahdiya qulubana
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Al-Bari' (The Creator Who Gives Perfect Form)! We invoke You by this Sacred Name and by Your infinite divine perfection. Purify our soul, grant peace to our hearts, bless our families with your grace and always guide us along the path of love, truth and righteousness. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Al-Asmaul Husna (13/99): Al-Musawwir – The Shaper of All Forms
oraciones.textoOriginal: يَا المُصَوِّرُ، نَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ العَظِيمِ أَنْ تَمُنَّ عَلَيْنَا بِفَضْلِكَ وَتَهْدِيَ قُلُوبَنَا
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Al-Musawwir, nas'aluka bi-ismikal-'Azim an tamunna 'alayna bi-fadlika wa tahdiya qulubana
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Al-Musawwir (The Shaper of All Forms)! We invoke You by this Sacred Name and by Your infinite divine perfection. Purify our soul, grant peace to our hearts, bless our families with your grace and always guide us along the path of love, truth and righteousness. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Al-Asmaul Husna (14/99): Al-Ghaffar – The Ever Forgiver and Eraser of Faults
oraciones.textoOriginal: يَا الغَفَّارُ، نَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ العَظِيمِ أَنْ تَمُنَّ عَلَيْنَا بِفَضْلِكَ وَتَهْدِيَ قُلُوبَنَا
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Al-Ghaffar, nas'aluka bi-ismikal-'Azim an tamunna 'alayna bi-fadlika wa tahdiya qulubana
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Al-Ghaffar (The Ever Forgiving and Eraser of Faults)! We invoke You by this Sacred Name and by Your infinite divine perfection. Purify our soul, grant peace to our hearts, bless our families with your grace and always guide us along the path of love, truth and righteousness. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Al-Asmaul Husna (15/99): Al-Qahhar – The Subjugator and Victorious over All
oraciones.textoOriginal: يَا القَهَّارُ، نَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ العَظِيمِ أَنْ تَمُنَّ عَلَيْنَا بِفَضْلِكَ وَتَهْدِيَ قُلُوبَنَا
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Al-Qahhar, nas'aluka bi-ismikal-'Azim an tamunna 'alayna bi-fadlika wa tahdiya qulubana
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Al-Qahhar (The Subjugator and Victorious Over All)! We invoke You by this Sacred Name and by Your infinite divine perfection. Purify our soul, grant peace to our hearts, bless our families with your grace and always guide us along the path of love, truth and righteousness. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Al-Asmaul Husna (16/99): Al-Wahhab – The Generous and Unconditional Giver
oraciones.textoOriginal: يَا الوَهَّابُ، نَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ العَظِيمِ أَنْ تَمُنَّ عَلَيْنَا بِفَضْلِكَ وَتَهْدِيَ قُلُوبَنَا
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Al-Wahhab, nas'aluka bi-ismikal-'Azim an tamunna 'alayna bi-fadlika wa tahdiya qulubana
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Al-Wahhab (The Generous and Unconditional Giver)! We invoke You by this Sacred Name and by Your infinite divine perfection. Purify our soul, grant peace to our hearts, bless our families with your grace and always guide us along the path of love, truth and righteousness. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Al-Asmaul Husna (17/99): Ar-Razzaq – The Provider and Sustainer of All Creation
oraciones.textoOriginal: يَا الرَّزَّاقُ، نَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ العَظِيمِ أَنْ تَمُنَّ عَلَيْنَا بِفَضْلِكَ وَتَهْدِيَ قُلُوبَنَا
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Ar-Razzaq, nas'aluka bi-ismikal-'Azim an tamunna 'alayna bi-fadlika wa tahdiya qulubana
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Ar-Razzaq (The Provider and Sustainer of All Creation)! We invoke You by this Sacred Name and by Your infinite divine perfection. Purify our soul, grant peace to our hearts, bless our families with your grace and always guide us along the path of love, truth and righteousness. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Al-Asmaul Husna (18/99): Al-'Alim – The All-Knowing Omniscient
oraciones.textoOriginal: يَا العَلِيمُ، نَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ العَظِيمِ أَنْ تَمُنَّ عَلَيْنَا بِفَضْلِكَ وَتَهْدِيَ قُلُوبَنَا
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Al-'Alim, nas'aluka bi-ismikal-'Azim an tamunna 'alayna bi-fadlika wa tahdiya qulubana

oraciones.titulo: The 21 Taras (01/21): Tara Nyurma Pamo – Tara the Swift and Courageous – Victory over Fear
oraciones.textoOriginal: ཨོཾ་ཏཱ་རེ་ཏུཏྟཱ་རེ་ཏུ་རེ་སྭཱ་ཧཱ། ཕྱག་འཚལ་སྒྲོལ་མ་མྱུར་མ་དཔའ་མོ།
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Tare Tuttare Ture Soha | Chagtsal Drolma Nyurma Pamo
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of The 21 Taras (01/21): Tara Nyurma Pamo. May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!
