oraciones.guiaFonetica: Kyrie eleison, Christe eleison...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord, have mercy on us. Christ, have mercy on us. Holy Mary, Holy Mother of God, Holy Virgin of Virgins, Mother of Christ, Mother of the Church, Mother of divine grace, Most Pure Mother, Most Chaste Mother, Kind Mother, Admirable Mother, Mother of Good Counsel, Mirror of Justice, Throne of Wisdom, Cause of our Joy, Spiritual Vessel of Devotion, Mystical Rose, Tower of David, Ivory Tower, House of Gold, Ark of the Covenant, Gate of Heaven, Morning Star, Health of the Sick, Refuge of the Sick sinners, Comfort of the afflicted, Help of Christians, Queen of angels, Queen of peace: Pray for us. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Litany to Saint Joseph – Terror of Demons and Guardian of Families
oraciones.textoOriginal: Sancte Ioseph, ora pro nobis. Custos Virginis, ora pro nobis. Familias columen, ora pro nobis. Terror daemonum, ora pro nobis...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Sancte Ioseph ora pro nobis...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord, have mercy. Christ, have mercy. Saint Joseph, distinguished descendant of David, light of the patriarchs, husband of the Mother of God, chaste custodian of the Virgin, nurturing father of the Son of God, zealous defender of Christ, head of the Holy Family, most just Joseph, most prudent Joseph, most faithful Joseph, mirror of patience, lover of poverty, model of workers, glory of domestic life, custodian of virgins, supporter of families, consolation of the unfortunate, hope of the sick, patron of the dying, terror of evil spirits, protector of the Holy Church: Pray for us. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Litany of the Sacred Heart of Jesus – Ocean of Love and Mercy
oraciones.textoOriginal: Cor Iesu, amore nostri vulneratum, miserere nobis. Cor Iesu, fons totius consolationis, miserere nobis...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Cor Iesu miserere nobis...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord, have mercy on us. Heart of Jesus, formed by the Holy Spirit in the womb of the Virgin Mother, substantially united to the Word of God, of infinite majesty, holy temple of God, tabernacle of the Most High, house of God and gate of heaven, burning bonfire of charity, sanctuary of justice and love, full of goodness and love, abyss of all virtues, most worthy of all praise, King and center of all hearts, in whom are all the treasures of wisdom and science, of whose fullness we have all received, patient and of great mercy, source of life and holiness: Have mercy on us and make our hearts like yours. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Salat al-Istikhara – Prayer of the Consulta and Guía Divina in Decisiones Trascendentes
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ العَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الغُيُوبِ...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi-'ilmika, wa astaadiruka bi-qudratika, wa as'aluka min fadlikal-'azim, fa-innaka taqdiru wa la aqdir, wa ta'lamu wa la a'lam, wa Anta 'Allamul-ghuyub...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh my God! I ask You to guide me through Your infinite wisdom, and I seek Your help through Your omnipotence, and I implore Your immense favor. Because You have the power and I lack it; You know everything and I know nothing, and You are the Knower of the Hidden. Oh God! If You know that this matter is good for me in my faith, in my present life and in the outcome of my existence, appreciate it for me, facilitate it and bless it. And if You know that it is harmful to my faith and my well-being, remove it from me, distance me from it and destine good for me wherever it is found, making me feel at peace and pleased with Your decision. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Salat al-Janazah – Funeral Liturgical Supplication for the Rest and Forgiveness of the Soul
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا، وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا، وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا. اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الإِسْلَامِ، وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الإِيمَانِ...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Allahummagh-fir li-hayyina wa mayyitina, wa shahidina wa gha'ibina, wa saghirina wa kabirina, wa dhakarina wa unthana. Allahumma man ahyaytahu minna fa-ahyihi 'alal-Islam, wa man tawaffaytahu minna fa-tawaffahu 'alal-Iman...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh our God! Forgive our living and our dead, our present and our absent, our young and our old, our men and our women. Oh God! Whoever you grant life among us, make him live in the righteousness and peace of Islam, and whoever you call from among us, welcome him into the fullness of sincere faith. Oh God! Forgive this departed soul, purify it with water, snow and dew of heavenly forgiveness, enlarge its eternal home and fill its tomb with light and rest. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Salat al-Hajah – Prayer of Súplica in the Necesidad Apremiante
oraciones.textoOriginal: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الحَلِيمُ الكَرِيمُ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ العَرْشِ العَظِيمِ، الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ. أَسْأَلُكَ مُوجِبَاتِ رَحْمَتِكَ، وَعَزَائِمَ مَغْفِرَتِكَ، وَالغَنِيمَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ بِرٍّ، وَالسَّلَامَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ إِثْمٍ...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: La ilaha illallahul-Halimul-Karim, Subhanallahi Rabbil-'Arshil-'Azim, Alhamdu lillahi Rabbil-'Alamin. As'aluka mujibati rahmatik, wa 'aza'ima maghfiratik, wal-ghanimata min kulli birr, was-salamata min kulli ithm...
oraciones.textoTraducido: There is no God but Allah, the Gracious, the Noble and Generous. Glorified be God, Lord of the Majestic Throne. Praise God, Lord of the Universe. I ask You for the causes of Your mercy and the effective means of Your forgiveness; the fruit of every good work and protection against all sin. Leave me no guilt unforgiven, no affliction or anguish unrelieved, no just need that pleases You without You satisfying it by Your infinite goodness, O You, the Most Merciful among the merciful! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Du'a Khatm al-Quran – Solemn Supplication for the Completion of the Holy Quran
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْنِي بِالقُرْآنِ، وَاجْعَلْهُ لِي إِمَاماً وَنُوراً وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً. اللَّهُمَّ ذَكِّرْنِي مِنْهُ مَا نَسِيتُ، وَعَلِّمْنِي مِنْهُ مَا جَهِلْتُ، وَارْزُقْنِي تِلَاوَتَهُ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَأَطْرَافَ النَّهَارِ...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Allahummar-hamni bil-Qur'an, waj'alhu li imaman wa nuran wa hudan wa rahmah. Allahumma dhakkirni minhu ma nasit, wa 'allimni minhu ma jahilt, warzuqni tilawatahu ana'al-layli wa atrafan-nahar...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh our God! Have mercy on me through the Holy Quran, and make it for me a luminous guide, a light in the darkness, a straight path and an inexhaustible source of blessing. Oh God! Remind me of him what I have forgotten, teach me of him what I do not know, grant me the gift of meditating on it night and day, and make it an argument in my favor on the Day of Judgment, O Lord of the Universe! Enlighten our lives with the wisdom of Your sacred words. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Du'a of the Night of Destiny (Laylat al-Qadr) – Supplication for Total Forgiveness
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ كَرِيمٌ تُحِبُّ العَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Allahumma innaka 'Afuwwun Karimun tuhibbul-'afwa fa'fu 'anni
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh our God! Certainly You are the Forgiver par excellence, Generous and Noble, you love to forgive and erase faults: forgive my sins, cleanse my heart and renew my destiny with Your grace.

oraciones.titulo: Arafat Day Du'a – The Supreme Supplication of the Pilgrimage (Hajj)
oraciones.textoOriginal: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in Qadir
oraciones.textoTraducido: There is no divinity worthy of worship except Allah, Unique and without associates. His is the supreme sovereignty and His is all praise, and He has absolute power over all things in heaven and earth.

oraciones.titulo: Du'a al-Iftaar – Supplication of Gratitude al Romper el Ayuno Diario
oraciones.textoOriginal: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ العُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Dhahabadh-dhama'u wabtallatil-'uruq, wa thabatal-ajru in sha'Allah
oraciones.textoTraducido: The thirst has been quenched, the veins have been hydrated and refreshed, and the spiritual reward has been confirmed with the grace of God.

oraciones.titulo: Tashahhud and Salawat Ibrahimiya – The Devotional Center of Daily Prayer (Salah)
oraciones.textoOriginal: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ. أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: At-tahiyyatu lillahi was-salawatu wat-tayyibat, as-salamu 'alayka ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh, as-salamu 'alayna wa 'ala 'ibadillahis-salihin. Ash-hadu alla ilaha illallah wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa Rasuluh...
oraciones.textoTraducido: All blessed greetings, sincere prayers and good deeds belong to God. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of God and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon all the just and upright servants of God. I bear witness that there is no God but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger. Oh God! Bless Muhammad and his family, as You blessed Abraham and his family, and pour out Your peace on all believing people.

oraciones.titulo: Durood Taj (درود تاج) – Crowned Blessing of Protection and Prophetic Love
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ، صَاحِبِ التَّاجِ وَالمِعْرَاجِ وَالبُرَاقِ وَالعَلَمِ، دَافِعِ البَلَاءِ وَالوَبَاءِ وَالقَحْطِ وَالمَرَضِ وَالأَلَمِ...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Allahumma salli 'ala sayyidina wa mawlana Muhammad, Sahibit-Taji wal-Mi'raji wal-Buraqi wal-'Alam, Dafi'il-bala'i wal-waba'i wal-qahti wal-maradi wal-alam...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh our God! Send Your blessings upon our teacher and guide Muhammad, bearer of the spiritual crown, of the heavenly ascension (Mi'raj), of the heavenly mount and of the banner of truth. He by whose intercession and example calamities, epidemics, scarcity, pain and affliction are dissipated. His name is engraved in the heavens with honor, his heart is pure compassion and his guidance is a beacon of peace for all humanity. Pour peace on his soul and on the lovers of justice!

oraciones.titulo: Durood Tanjeena (درود تنجینا) – Prayer for Rescue and Deliverance from All Tribulation
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تُنْجِينَا بِهَا مِنْ جَمِيعِ الأَهْوَالِ وَالآفَاتِ، وَتَقْضِي لَنَا بِهَا جَمِيعَ الحَاجَاتِ، وَتُطَهِّرُنَا بِهَا مِنْ جَمِيعِ السَّيِّئَاتِ...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Allahumma salli 'ala sayyidina Muhammadin salatan tunjina biha min jami'il-ahwali wal-afat, wa taqdi lana biha jami'al-hajat, wa tutahhiruna biha min jami'is-sayyi'at...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh our God! Send blessings upon our master Muhammad, a blessing by which he delivers us from all dangers, distresses and calamities; by which you satisfy all our lawful needs; by which you purify us from all moral faults and stains; and by which you elevate our souls to the highest ranks of peace and dignity in this life and in eternity.

oraciones.titulo: Durood Shifa / Tibb al-Quloob – Divine Balm for the Health of the Body and Soul
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ طِبِّ القُلُوبِ وَدَوَائِهَا، وَعَافِيَةِ الأَبْدَانِ وَشِفَائِهَا، وَنُورِ الأَبْصَارِ وَضِيَائِهَا، وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Allahumma salli 'ala sayyidina Muhammadin tibbil-qulubi wa dawa'iha, wa 'afiyatil-abdani wa shifa'iha, wa nuril-absari wa diya'iha, wa 'ala alihi wa sahbihi wa sallim
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh our God! Bless our master Muhammad, medicine and balm of hearts, vigor and healing of bodies, light and radiance of looks, and pour out Your peace and well-being on his family and all his followers.

oraciones.titulo: The Manzil Sagrado (منزل) – Versos of Protection Diaria and Manto Espiritual
oraciones.textoOriginal: قُلْ لَنْ يُصِيبَنَا إِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَنَا هُوَ مَوْلَانَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ المُؤْمِنُونَ ۞ وَإِنْ يَمْسَسْكَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُ إِلَّا هُوَ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Qul lay yusibana illa ma kataballahu lana Huwa mawlana wa 'alallahi falyatawakkalil-mu'minun | Wa iy yamsaskallahu bi-durrin fala kashifa lahu illa Huwa...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Say: 'Nothing will ever happen to us except what God has decreed for us; He is our Supreme Protector and all believers must trust in God.' If God tests you with a difficulty, no one but He can take it back; and if He decrees good for you, no one can prevent His grace. We take shelter under the shield of the Word of God against all evil, resentment or hidden disturbance.

oraciones.titulo: Munajat by Kazi Nazrul Islam (National Poet of Bangladesh) – Supplication for Love and Mercy
oraciones.textoOriginal: হে আল্লাহ! তুমি ক্ষমাশীল, তুমি মেহেরবান, তোমার দয়ার সাগরে ডুবিয়ে দাও আমার পাপের বোঝা...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Hey Allah! Tumi khomashil, tumi meherban, tomar doyar sagore dubiye dao amar paper bojha...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Almighty God! You are the Forgiver and the infinite Source of love and compassion. Submerge the heavy burden of my errors in the ocean of Your divine mercy. Heal the afflicted of this land, grant bread to the hungry, freedom to the oppressed, and fill the hearts of humanity with the light of universal brotherhood and unbreakable justice. Hear the humble cry of this servant thirsty for Your light!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Allama Iqbal (Lab Pe Aati Hai Dua) ​​– Prayer of the Soul for Light, Goodness and Science
oraciones.textoOriginal:
لب پہ آتی ہے دعا بن کے تمنا میری
زندگی شمع کی صورت ہو خدایا میری!
دور دنیا کا مرے دم سے اندھیرا ہو جائے!
ہر جگہ میرے چمکنے سے اجالا ہو جائے!
ہو مرا کام غریبوں کی حمایت کرنا
دردمندوں سے ضعیفوں سے محبت کرنا
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Lab pe aati hai dua ban ke tamanna meri / Zindagi shama ki soorat ho Khudaya meri! / Door duniya ka mere dam se andhera ho jaye! / Har jagah mere chamakne se ujala ho jaye! / Ho mera kaam gharibon ki himayat karna / Dardmandhon se zaeefon se mohabbat karna...
oraciones.textoTraducido: This plea reaches my lips like the purest desire of my being: Make my life, oh my God, like a lit candle! May the darkness of the world dissipate through my existence and the light of knowledge and goodness shine in every place where I am. May my mission be to protect the helpless, to tenderly love the elderly and afflicted, and to keep my soul in righteousness and in the love of truth.

oraciones.titulo: The Armor of God: The Belt of Truth (Ephesians 6:14)
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Estad, pues, firmes, ceñidos vuestros lomos con la verdad.» (Efesios 6:14)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Estad firmes cenidos vuestros lomos con la verdad...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, in the Name of Jesus, I gird my thoughts, emotions, and decisions today with the Belt of Divine Truth. I renounce all lies, deception, doubts or accusations of the enemy. I declare that Your Word is immutable truth that sustains my life and aligns my steps with Your perfect justice and righteousness. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: The Armor of God: The Breastplate of Righteousness (Ephesians 6:14)
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Y vestidos con la coraza de justicia.» (Efesios 6:14)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Y vestidos con la coraza de justicia...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus, today I cover my chest and heart with the Breastplate of Your Justice. I do not trust in my own merits, but in Your redeeming sacrifice on the cross. Protect my feelings from resentment, guilt and condemnation, and guard my heart so that life and purity flow from it at all times. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: The Armor of God: The Footwear of the Gospel of Peace (Ephesians 6:15)
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Y calzados los pies con el apresto del evangelio de la paz.» (Efesios 6:15)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Y calzados los pies con el apresto del evangelio de la paz...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord, today I put my feet on my feet with the ready disposition to bring the Gospel of Peace. Wherever I walk on this day I will be a bearer of concord, reconciliation and hope. Affirm my steps on the Rock that is Christ so that I never slip before the provocations of the world. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: The Armor of God: The Shield of Faith (Ephesians 6:16)
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Sobre todo, tomad el escudo de la fe, con que podáis apagar todos los dardos de fuego del maligno.» (Efesios 6:16)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Sobre todo tomad el escudo de la fe...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the Name of Jesus, I boldly raise the Shield of Faith. With it I extinguish and disintegrate every burning dart of fear, disbelief, illness, scarcity or discouragement that the enemy sends against my life or my home. My faith is unshakably anchored in the Almighty God who never fails. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: The Armor of God: The Helmet of Salvation (Ephesians 6:17)
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Y tomad el yelmo de la salvación.» (Efesios 6:17)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Y tomad el yelmo de la salvacion...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy Father, I place on my head the Helmet of Salvation. Protect my mind from thoughts of defeat, anxiety, confusion and depression. I fill my thoughts with what is true, noble, just, pure, lovely and praiseworthy. I have the mind of Christ and I walk in victory. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: The Armor of God: The Sword of the Spirit (Ephesians 6:17)
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Y la espada del Espíritu, que es la palabra de Dios.» (Efesios 6:17)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Y la espada del Espiritu que es la palabra de Dios...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Today I take in my mouth the Sword of the Spirit, which is the living and effective Word of God. I proclaim His promises in the face of every giant and obstacle. As it is written: 'Greater is he who is in us than he who is in the world.' No weapon formed against my life, my family or my ministry will prosper. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Spiritual Authority: Binding and Loosing in the Name of Jesus (Matthew 18:18)
oraciones.textoOriginal: «De cierto os digo que todo lo que atéis en la tierra, será atado en el cielo; y todo lo que desatéis en la tierra, será desatado en el cielo.» (Mateo 18:18)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Todo lo que ateis en la tierra sera atado en el cielo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the glorious Name of Jesus Christ, using the authority delegated to His Church, I bind every force of division, ruin, disease and confusion that operates against my environment. And I release upon my home, my work and my community the open heavens: spirit of peace, love, wisdom, supernatural provision and divine reconciliation. What God blesses, no one can curse! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Break Down Hidden Strongholds and Arguments (2 Corinthians 10:4-5)
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Porque las armas de nuestra milicia no son carnales, sino poderosas en Dios para la destrucción de fortalezas.» (2 Corintios 10:4)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Las armas de nuestra milicia son poderosas en Dios...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, we come with spiritual weapons of prayer, fasting and praise to tear down every stronghold of mind, every wall of bitterness and every haughty argument that rises up against the knowledge of God. We take every thought captive to obedience to Christ and proclaim full freedom in the Holy Spirit. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Total Restoration in the Valley of Dry Bones (Ezekiel 37)
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Profetiza sobre estos huesos, y diles: Huesos secos, oíd palabra de Jehová... He aquí, yo hago entrar espíritu en vosotros, y viviréis.» (Ezequiel 37:4-5)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Profetiza sobre estos huesos y diles huesos secos oid palabra de Jehova...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy and Almighty Father! In the supreme name of Jesus Christ, we come before Thy glorious presence, proclaiming the power and victory of Thy living Word over Prayer of Total Restoration in the Valley of Dry Bones (Ezekiel 37). Release Thy anointing and the fire of Thy Holy Spirit upon our life, tear down every obstacle, heal every infirmity, and fill us with supernatural strength and joy. To Thee be all the glory, honor, and power forever! Amen and amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Restitution for the Devoured Years (Joel 2:25)
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Y os restituiré los años que comió la oruga, el saltón, el revoltón y la langosta.» (Joel 2:25)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Y os restituire los anos que comio la oruga...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy and Almighty Father! In the supreme name of Jesus Christ, we come before Thy glorious presence, proclaiming the power and victory of Thy living Word over Prayer of Restitution for the Devoured Years (Joel 2:25). Release Thy anointing and the fire of Thy Holy Spirit upon our life, tear down every obstacle, heal every infirmity, and fill us with supernatural strength and joy. To Thee be all the glory, honor, and power forever! Amen and amen.

oraciones.titulo: Midnight Cry for Deliverance from Prisons and Chains (Acts 16:25)
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Pero a medianoche, orando Pablo y Silas, cantaban himnos a Dios; y los presos los oían. Entonces sobrevino de repente un gran terremoto... y al instante se abrieron todas las puertas.»
oraciones.guiaFonetica: A medianoche orando y cantando himnos...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord, even in the darkest hour of trial, we raise songs of praise and sincere adoration. May Your presence shake the foundations of all oppression, may the doors that were closed with iron bolts open and may the chains of all spiritual and emotional captivity fall. Our worship breaks prisons in the Name of Jesus! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Anointing with Oil for Comprehensive Healing (James 5:14-15)
oraciones.textoOriginal: «¿Está alguno enfermo entre vosotros? Llame a los ancianos de la iglesia, y oren por él, ungiéndole con aceite en el nombre del Señor. Y la oración de fe salvará al enfermo.»
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Y la oracion de fe salvara al enfermo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy and Almighty Father! In the supreme name of Jesus Christ, we come before Thy glorious presence, proclaiming the power and victory of Thy living Word over Prayer of Anointing with Oil for Comprehensive Healing (James 5:14. Release Thy anointing and the fire of Thy Holy Spirit upon our life, tear down every obstacle, heal every infirmity, and fill us with supernatural strength and joy. To Thee be all the glory, honor, and power forever! Amen and amen.

oraciones.titulo: The Aaronic Priestly Blessing (Numbers 6:24-26)
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Jehová te bendiga, y te guarde; Jehová haga resplandecer su rostro sobre ti, y tenga de ti misericordia; Jehová alce sobre ti su rostro, y ponga en ti paz.» (Números 6:24-26)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Yevarejeja Adonai veyishmereja...
oraciones.textoTraducido: May the Lord bless you abundantly and keep you from all evil under His heavenly protection. May the Lord make the light of His face shine on you and pour out His infinite grace and mercy on your life. May the Lord lift up His loving gaze upon you and place in your heart His perfect peace that surpasses all understanding. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of the Pacto Familyr: Yo and mi Casa Serviremos al Señor (Josué 24:15)
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Pero yo y mi casa serviremos a Jehová.» (Josué 24:15)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Pero yo y mi casa serviremos al Senor...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, today I consecrate my spouse, my children, my parents and all my descendants before Your altar. We establish a fence of angelic protection around our home. May love, mutual respect, fidelity to Your Word and unity in the Holy Spirit always reign in our house. Our family belongs to Christ for generations! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Early Morning Prayer (새벽기도 - Saet-byeol Gido) – Firstfruits of the Day before God
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Dios, Dios mío eres tú; de madrugada te buscaré; mi alma tiene sed de ti, mi carne te anhela en tierra seca y árida.» (Salmo 63:1)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: De madrugada te buscare mi alma tiene sed de ti...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord, before dawn I give you the first heartbeats and thoughts of my day. Water my thirsty soul with the cool dew of Your Holy Spirit. Give me wisdom to speak, discernment to decide and strength to overcome. I entrust all my plans to You and consecrate my hands to Your service. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: A.W. Tozer – Prayer of the Thirsty Soul for the Divine Presence
oraciones.textoOriginal: O God, I have tasted Thy goodness, and it has both satisfied me and made me thirsty for more...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O God I have tasted Thy goodness...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O God, I have tasted Your goodness, and it has satisfied me and at the same time left me with an infinite thirst for more of You. Deliver me from the pride of material things and from the selfishness that blinds the soul. Purify my heart so that I can see You, teach me to walk in Your holy presence and make my life a continuous praise to Your infinite glory. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Billy Graham – Prayer of Salvation and Surrender of the Heart to Jesus Christ
oraciones.textoOriginal: Dear Lord Jesus, I know that I am a sinner, and I ask for Your forgiveness. I believe You died for my sins and rose from the dead...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Dear Lord Jesus I know that I am a sinner...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy and Almighty Father! In the supreme name of Jesus Christ, we come before Thy glorious presence, proclaiming the power and victory of Thy living Word over Billy Graham. Release Thy anointing and the fire of Thy Holy Spirit upon our life, tear down every obstacle, heal every infirmity, and fill us with supernatural strength and joy. To Thee be all the glory, honor, and power forever! Amen and amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Favor Sobrenatural and Puertas Abiertas (Psalm 5:12)
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Porque tú, oh Jehová, bendecirás al justo; como con un escudo lo rodearás de tu favor.» (Salmo 5:12)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Como con un escudo lo rodearas de tu favor...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, I declare that Your supernatural favor surrounds my life, my profession, and my finances like an impenetrable shield. It opens doors of opportunity, grace and blessing that no man can close. May I find grace wherever I go in the eyes of God and men for the fulfillment of Your holy purpose. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint John Chrysostom – The 24 Petitions for Day and Night
oraciones.textoOriginal: Κύριε, μὴ στερήσῃς με τῶν ἐπουρανίων σου ἀγαθῶν. Κύριε, λύτρωσαί με τῶν αἰωνίων βασάνων. Κύριε, εἴτε λόγῳ εἴτε ἔργῳ ἥμαρτον, συγχώρησόν μοι...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Kyrie, me stereses me ton epouranion sou agathon. Kyrie, lytrosai me ton aionion basanon...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Mister! Do not deprive me of your heavenly goods. Deliver me from eternal tribulations. If I have sinned in words, thoughts or deeds, forgive me with kindness. Lord, grant me tears of sincere repentance, memory of eternity and compassion towards my brothers. Place in my heart holy fear and ardent love of Your Name. Guard my soul in the hour of temptation and receive me into Your Kingdom of light. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to the Holy Trinity (Presvyataya Troitse) – Beginning of the Orthodox Day
oraciones.textoOriginal: Пресвятая Троице, помилуй нас; Господи, очисти грехи наша; Владыко, прости беззакония наша; Святый, посети и исцели немощи наша, имене Твоего ради.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Presvyataya Troitse, pomiluy nas; Gospodi, ochisti grekhi nasha; Vladyko, prosti bezzakoniya nasha; Svyatyy, poseti i istseli nemoshchi nasha, imene Tvoyego radi.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy Trinity, have mercy on us! Lord, cleanse our sins! Sovereign, forgive our transgressions! Holy One, visit and heal our weaknesses and illnesses, for the glory of Your Holy Name! Lord have mercy (Kyrie Eleison)! Glory to the Father, to the Son and to the Holy Spirit, now and always, forever and ever! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Orthodox Prayer to the Holy Guardian Angel – Custodian of the Soul and Body
oraciones.textoOriginal: Святый Ангеле, предстояй окаянной моей души и страстной моей жизни, не остави мене грешнаго, ниже отступи от мене за невоздержание мое...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Svyatyy Angele, predstoyay okayannoy moyey dushi i strastnoy moyey zhizni, ne ostavi mene greshnago...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy Angel of God, custodian and protector of my soul and my body! Do not forsake me in the midst of my weaknesses nor turn away from me. Do not give room to the evil spirit to dominate my earthly being. Take my weak hand and guide me firmly along the path of salvation, righteousness and purity. Defend me on this day from all danger and pray for me before the Throne of the Creator. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Matrona of Moscow – Prayer for Help in Impossible Situations and Comfort
oraciones.textoOriginal: О блаженная мати Матроно, душею на небеси пред Престолом Божиим предстоящи, телом же на земли почивающи...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O blazhennaya mati Matrono, dusheyu na nebesi pred Prestolom Bozhiim predstoyashchi...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh blessed Mother Matrona! You who are in heaven before the Throne of God and on earth you tenderly welcome the cry of the afflicted: look with mercy on those of us who turn to you in the midst of our sorrows and ailments. Heal the sick, comfort broken hearts, help solve the most difficult problems in family life, and ask the Lord to grant us patience to carry the cross with faith and hope. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Lucas of Crimea (The Cirujano Santo) – Prayer of Healing Quirúrgica and Médica
oraciones.textoOriginal: О всесвятый святителю, отче наш Луко, великий угодниче Христов, врачу благодатный...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O vsesvyatyy svyatitelyu, otche nash Luko, velikiy ugodniche Khristov, vrachu blagodatnyy...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Holy Hierarch and our Father Saint Luke, admirable doctor of bodies and souls who endured prisons and exiles for the love of Christ!: guide the hands of the surgeons and doctors who care for us, relieve acute pain, restore health to the seriously ill and grant them spiritual strength to trust in the providence of God. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Xenia of Saint Petersburg – Protector of Work, Marriages and Home
oraciones.textoOriginal: О святая всеблаженная мати Ксение! Под кровом Всевышняго жившая, ведома и укрепляема Богоматерию...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O svyataya vseblazhennaya mati Kseniye! Pod krovom Vsevyshnyago zhivshaya...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Holy and blessed Mother Xenia! That for the love of Christ you chose poverty and sacred folly to intercede for others: accept our supplications for dignified sustenance, honest employment, peace in marriage and the well-being of children. Protect us from despair and lead us along the path of Christian charity and true love. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Icon of the Mother of God 'The Inexhaustible Chalice' (Neupivaemaya Chasha) – Liberation from Vices
oraciones.textoOriginal: О Премилосердная Владычице! К Твоему заступлению ныне прибегаем, молений наших не презри...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O Premiloserdnaya Vladychitse! K Tvoyemu zastupleniyu nyne pribegayem...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Merciful Sovereign, Mother of God of the Inexhaustible Chalice! We come to You imploring healing for those who suffer from the bonds of alcoholism, addictions and destructive passions. Quench the insatiable thirst of vices with the living water of the grace of Your Son. It returns lucidity to minds, peace to families and salvation to broken souls. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Himno Akathistos al Archistratego Miguel and Huestes Angélicas – Victory Espiritual
oraciones.textoOriginal: Избранный Воеводо Небесных Сил и заступниче рода человеческаго, сие тебе благодарственное похвальное пение приносим...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Izbrannyy Voyevodo Nebesnykh Sil i zastupniche roda chelovecheskago...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh invincible Leader of the Heavenly Hosts, Archangel Michael! As one who stands before the Throne of Glory with a flaming sword of justice: defend us in combat against the powers of darkness, dissolve the intrigues of evil, protect the nations from fratricidal war and guide us towards eternal bliss. Rejoice, great Captain of God, invincible defender of the faithful!

oraciones.titulo: Saint Nektarios of Aegina – Great Wonderworker of the Serious and Oncological Sick
oraciones.textoOriginal: Σηλυβρίας τὸν γόνον καὶ Αἰγίνης τὸν ἔφορον, τὸν ἐσχάτοις χρόνοις φανέντα ἀρετῆς φίλον γνήσιον, Νεκτάριον τιμήσωμεν πιστοί...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Selyvrias ton gonon kai Aigines ton ephoron...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Saint Nektarios of Aegina, luminary of patience, forgiveness and holiness in contemporary times! You who suffered slander with silent meekness and to whom God granted the miraculous gift of healing tumors and serious illnesses: hear our humble prayer, relieve the bodily ailments of the sick and obtain for us complete healing and peace of soul. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Paisios of the Monte Athos – Prayer for the Concordia Familyr and the Juventud
oraciones.textoOriginal: Господи Иисусе Христе, Сыне Божий, помилуй мир Твой и укрепи семьи в любви и верности...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Gospodi Iisuse Khriste, Syne Bozhiy, pomiluy mir Tvoy i ukrepi sem'i v lyubvi i vernosti...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God! Through the prayers of Saint Paisios of Mount Athos, pour out Your peace on divided homes and on young people disoriented by the vanities of the world. Infuse their hearts with the sweetness of Your love, free them from confusion and hopelessness, and grant them to find in You the true meaning of life and eternal joy. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Anthony the Great (Father of Monasticism) – Firmness in the Spiritual Desert
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Yo ya no temo a Dios, sino que lo amo; porque el amor perfecto echa fuera el temor.»
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Yo ya no temo a Dios sino que lo amo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Holy Father Anthony, patriarch of the hermits and conqueror of the illusions of the enemy in the desert! Teach us holy inner vigilance (spiritual sobriety / nepsis), help us to overcome the temptations of the flesh and selfishness, and grant us to persevere in continuous prayer until we reach perfect love that knows no fear. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Agpeya Copto: Prayer of the Primera Hora (Bakar) – The Luz Verdadera of Cristo
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ⲧⲉⲛϯϩⲟ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲕ ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲉⲛϭⲟⲓⲥ Ⲓⲏⲥⲟⲩⲥ Ⲡⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ: Ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁⲫⲙⲏⲓ, ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲉⲑⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Tentiho erok O Penchois Isos Pikristos: Pi-ouoini n-tafmeyi, phete-erouoini e-romi niven ethneyou e-pikismos...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Lord Jesus Christ, True Light that illuminates every human being who comes into this world! As the new day dawns, may the light of Your face shine upon us, purify our souls and guide our steps along the path of peace and Your holy commandments. Bless you forever! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Agpeya Copto: Prayer of the Hora Undécima (Ghoroub) – Gratitude al Ocaso of the Sol
oraciones.textoOriginal: Alabado sea el Señor que nos ha preservado a lo largo de este día y nos ha traído en paz hasta la caída de la tarde.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Alabado sea el Senor que nos ha preservado...
oraciones.textoTraducido: We thank you, benevolent and compassionate King, because you have kept us throughout this day and have led us safely until the hour of sunset. Forgive us for the faults committed on this day and grant us a night full of stillness, purity and rest in Your divine grace. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Sergius of Radonezh – Blessing on Work, Study and Community Peace
oraciones.textoOriginal: О священная главо, преподобне и богоносне отче наш Сергие! Молитвою твоею и верою, яже к Богу...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O svyashchennaya glavo, prepodobne i bogonosne otche nash Sergiye!...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the Living God! Through the intercession of the Most Holy Theotokos and the blessed memory and help of Saint Sergius of Radonezh, pour out Your Holy Spirit upon our life. Purify our mind in the stillness of prayer, grant us health, patience and forgiveness of sins, and guide us to the eternal peace of Your heavenly Kingdom. Amen!

oraciones.titulo: Nossa Senhora Aparecida (Padroeira do Brasil) – Official Oração of Consagração
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ó Maria Santíssima, pelos merecimentos de vosso Filho Jesus, em vossa querida imagem de Aparecida, espalhais inúmeros benefícios sobre todo o Brasil.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O Maria Santissima, pelos merecimentos de vosso Filho Jesus...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Most Holy Mary, who through the merits of your Divine Son you spread countless benefits over all the people in your sacred image of Aparecida! I, your unworthy servant, prostrate myself at your feet and solemnly consecrate to you my mind, my eyes, my ears, my mouth, my heart and my entire being. Receive me, pious Mother, as your faithful son. Protect me in all spiritual and temporal needs, defend my family from all evil and protect us in the hour of our earthly departure. Our Lady of Aparecida, pray for us! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: São Jorge Guerreiro – Prayer of the Cloak and Armor of Absolute Protection
oraciones.textoOriginal: Eu andarei vestido e armado com as armas de São Jorge para que meus inimigos, tendo pés não me alcancem, tendo mãos não me peguem, tendo olhos não me vejam, e nem em pensamentos eles possam me fazer mal.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Eu andarei vestido e armado com as armas de Sao Jorge...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I will walk dressed and protected with the weapons of Saint George, so that my adversaries, having feet, do not reach me, having hands do not catch me, having eyes do not see me, and not even in their thoughts can cause me harm. Firearms will not reach my body, knives and spears will break without hurting me, ropes and chains will break without binding me. Jesus will defend me with the power of His grace and the Virgin Mary will cover me with her sacred mantle. Saint George victorious, be my shield and my defender. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Nossa Senhora Desatadora dos Nós – Prayer to Release Impossible Difficulties
oraciones.textoOriginal: Virgem Maria, Mãe do belo amor, Mãe que nunca recusa acudir a um filho que clama por ajuda, desata os nós que sufocam a minha vida.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Virgem Maria, Mae do belo amor...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Virgin Mary, Mother of beautiful love and untier of knots! You whose kind hands never cease to help your afflicted children: look with mercy on the tangle of difficulties, debts, discord and anguish that bind my life and prevent me from moving forward. I place in your virginal hands this very difficult knot that causes me suffering. Through your powerful intercession before Jesus Christ, release me with sweetness, fill me with peace and open my paths to the light and blessing of God. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: São Judas Tadeu – Patron of Desperate Causes and Affects in Brazil
oraciones.textoOriginal: São Judas Tadeu, glorioso apóstolo e fiel servo de Jesus, rogai por mim que me encontro em tão grande aflição.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Sao Judas Tadeu, glorioso apostolo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Glorious Apostle Saint Jude Thaddeus, close relative of Jesus and Mary! The Church universally honors you as the patron of difficult and desperate cases. Come to my aid in this great need that overwhelms me. I promise you, blessed Saint Jude, to always be grateful for this favor, to honor you with devotion and to encourage your veneration among the afflicted for the glory of God the Father. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Holy Expedito – Holy of Just and Urgent Causes
oraciones.textoOriginal: Meu Santo Expedito das causas justas e urgentes, intercedei por mim junto a Nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Meu Santo Expedito das causas justas e urgentes...
oraciones.textoTraducido: My Holy Expedite of just and urgent causes! Help me in this hour of affliction and despair. You who are the holy warrior, you who are the protector of the troubled, you who are the saint of cases that do not admit delay: help me to overcome this difficult situation, protect me from all evil and obtain for me from Christ the grace that I urgently implore. Forever and ever! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: São Benedito o Negro – Protector of Pão, da Cozinha and dos Humildes
oraciones.textoOriginal: São Benedito, exemplo de humildade e de amor aos pobres, abençoai o alimento e a paz do nosso lar.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Sao Benedito, exemplo de humildade...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Glorious Saint Benedict of Palermo (São Benedito)! Admirable model of humility, purity and fraternal charity: bless our table so that our families and those most in need never lack daily bread. Remove scarcity from our homes, fill our kitchens with love and make us ready to share with our neighbors with generosity and joy in the Lord. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Rita of Cássia – Madrinha dos Impossíveis no Sertão Brasileiro
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ó Santa Rita dos Impossíveis, advogada dos casos desesperados, atendei à minha prece angustiada.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O Santa Rita dos Impossíveis...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Saint Rita of Casia, Mother of the afflicted and patron of impossible causes! You who carried the thorn of Christ's suffering on your forehead and turned resentment into reconciling forgiveness: look with tenderness at my tribulations. Console me in pain, restore peace in my marriage and family, and obtain for us from the Lord the miracle of love and health that we so implore. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Father Cícero do Juazeiro – Bênção do Patriarca do Nordeste and dos Romeiros
oraciones.textoOriginal: Meu Padim Ciço, protetor dos sertanejos e dos romeiros da fé, estendei a vossa mão bendita sobre nós.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Meu Padim Cico, protetor dos sertanejos...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Blessed Father Cícero Romão Batista, beloved Padim Ciço of the Northeast and consolation of the humble pilgrims! You who taught the people to work the land honestly, to pray without ceasing and to blindly trust in the Mother of Sorrows: bless our crops, take care of our livestock, protect our home from spiritual and material drought, and give us health and strength to walk firm in faith. Amen!

oraciones.titulo: Oração das Mães of Joelhos, Filhos of Pé – Cobertura Espiritual da Juventude
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Mães de joelhos, filhos de pé: o clamor de uma mãe move a mão de Deus e quebra as correntes do inimigo.»
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Maes de joelhos, filhos de pe...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus, as a mother and father who cries out with tears at the altar, I get down on my knees so that my children may always stand victorious. I establish a fiery fence of the Holy Spirit around your lives. I break every bond of bad friendships, vices, depression or deception that tries to divert you from the path of truth. I declare that my children are a blessed inheritance from the Lord and will serve God with excellence all the days of their lives! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Morning Clamor of Power (03:00 AM) – Spiritual Breaking Vigil
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Perto está o Senhor dos que têm o coração quebrantado... Na calada da noite Teu Espírito se move com poder.»
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Perto esta o Senhor dos que tem o coracao quebrantado...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Almighty God, in the silence of this morning of vigil and clamor, I appear before Your Throne of Grace. I come to break all opposition of darkness in my family, health and finances. I unleash the anointing of miracles on my bed, on my ceiling and on my projects. I declare that tonight the angel of the Lord encamps around us and that the dawn will come crowned with victory, health and good news. In the Name of Jesus, Amen!

oraciones.titulo: Clamor no Monte Sinai and Portas Abertas – Conquista of Fé and Prosperitye
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Eis que pus diante de ti uma porta aberta, a qual ninguém pode fechar.» (Apocalipse 3:8)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Eis que pus diante de ti uma porta aberta...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy and Almighty Father! In the supreme name of Jesus Christ, we come before Thy glorious presence, proclaiming the power and victory of Thy living Word over Clamor no Monte Sinai and Portas Abertas. Release Thy anointing and the fire of Thy Holy Spirit upon our life, tear down every obstacle, heal every infirmity, and fill us with supernatural strength and joy. To Thee be all the glory, honor, and power forever! Amen and amen.

oraciones.titulo: Oração of Quebra of Feitiçarias, Inveja and Maldições Hereditarias
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Nenhuma arma forjada contra ti prosperará... Porque o Sangue de Jesus nos purifica de todo pecado e quebra toda opressão.»
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Nenhuma arma forjada contra ti prosperara...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, in the mighty Name of Jesus Christ and covered with His precious blood, I nullify and destroy every word of curse, every envy, every work of witchcraft, every evil eye and every altar of darkness raised against my life, my spouse, my children and my property. They are undone by the fire of the Holy Spirit. I proclaim blessing, holiness, life in abundance and the peace that no one can take away from us. Amen and amen!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Saint Ceia and Restorative Alliance with Christ
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Isto é o meu corpo que é partido por vós... Este cálice é a nova aliança no meu sangue.» (1 Coríntios 11:24-25)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Isto e o meu corpo que e partido por vos...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus, as I partake of Your holy table, with the bread that represents Your broken body and the chalice that represents Your shed blood, I renew my covenant of faithfulness with You. May by eating and drinking with faith, all illness be eradicated from my body and all sadness be removed from my soul. We are one body in Christ, sealed with eternal life and redeemed forever. Glory to Your Holy Name! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: A Complete Praise of Cáritas – A More Amada Oração do Espiritismo no Brasil
oraciones.textoOriginal: Deus, nosso Pai, que sois todo poder e bondade, dai a força àquele que passa pela provação, dai a luz àquele que procura a verdade, ponde no coração do homem a compaixão e a caridade...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Deus, nosso Pai, que sois todo poder e bondade...
oraciones.textoTraducido: God, our Father, who are all power and goodness! Give strength to the one who goes through the test, give light to the one who seeks the truth, put compassion and charity in the heart of man. God! Give the traveler the guiding star; to the afflicted, consolation; to the sick, rest. Father! Give the guilty repentance; to the spirit, the truth; to the child, the guide; to the orphan, the father. Mister! May your goodness extend over all that you created. Mercy, Lord, for those who do not know you; hope for those who suffer. A single spark of your love can set the Earth on fire! Thank you, my goodness!

oraciones.titulo: Dr. Bezerra of Menezes – Praise for Desobsessão, Spiritual Peace and Healing
oraciones.textoOriginal: Nós Vos rogamos, Pai de Infinita Bondade e Justiça, a graça de enviar aos nossos lares os Mensageiros da Paz e da Cura...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Nos Vos rogamos, Pai de Infinita Bondade e Justica...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Father of Infinite Goodness and Justice! We beg the grace to send the blessed Space Doctors and emissaries of the Christ Light to our homes. May the balsamizing fluids of health penetrate sick bodies; May minds troubled by obsessions and lower spiritual influences be enveloped in rays of forgiveness and evangelical enlightenment. May peace reign in our souls and may brotherly love dissolve every shadow of hatred and pain. So be it!

oraciones.titulo: André Luiz (Chico Xavier) – Prece da Manhã of Luz and Trabalho Renovado
oraciones.textoOriginal: Senhor, abençoa as minhas horas de trabalho e ajuda-me a ser útil a todos os que cruzarem o meu caminho hoje.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Senhor, abencoa as minhas horas de trabalho...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Father of Infinite Goodness, Wisdom, and Mercy! In deep spiritual elevation, we lift our prayer for André Luiz (Chico Xavier). We pray to the good spirits and our guardian angel to assist us with their beneficent light, dispel all turmoil from the soul, and grant us patience, resignation, and love to progress along the path of goodness. May the peace of God rest upon us. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Iemanjá (Rainha do Mar - Odoyá) – Purification, Family and Peace
oraciones.textoOriginal: Odoyá, minha Mãe Iemanjá! Rainha das Águas Sagradas, vós que limpais com vossas ondas todas as dores e tristezas do mundo...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Odoya, minha Mae Iemanja! Rainha das Aguas Sagradas...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Father of Infinite Goodness, Wisdom, and Mercy! In deep spiritual elevation, we lift our prayer for Iemanjá (Rainha do Mar. May the peace of God rest upon us. Amen.

oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ogunhe, meu Pai Ogum! Vencedor de demandas...

oraciones.textoOriginal: Ora Yê Yê Ô, Mamãe Oxum! Senhora das águas doces e límpidas, fonte do amor puro e da prosperidade...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ora Ye Ye O, Mamae Oxum! Senhora das aguas doces...

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Erês (Cosme, Damião and Doum - Oni Ibejada) – Alegria and Proteção Infantil
oraciones.textoOriginal: Oni Ibejada! Salve as Crianças de Luz, fontes de pureza, riso sincero e cura espontânea...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Oni Ibejada! Salve as Criancas de Luz...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oni Ibejada! Hail the blessed spirits of the Erês, Saint Cosme, Saint Damian and Doum. With your flowers, sweets and pure laughter, cleanse our house of all sadness, bitterness or spiritual heaviness. Protect all the children in our family from any danger or illness, awaken innocence and optimism in our adult hearts, and bless our days with health and inexhaustible joy. Hail the Erês Falange!

oraciones.titulo: Farewell Prayer for Holy Saturday (Saturday Sunset) – Grace for the Week
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Jehová guardará tu salida y tu entrada desde ahora y para siempre.» (Salmo 121:8)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Jehova guardara tu salida y tu entrada...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Heavenly Father, we come with confidence before the throne of Thy grace, anchored in the promises of Thy Holy Word and in the blessed hope of Christ's soon return. We present this earnest prayer for Farewell Prayer for Holy Saturday (Saturday Sunset): guard our lives, establish our steps in Thy holy commandments, and fill us with Thy heavenly peace. Through the merits of Jesus Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Sabbath School Prayer – Illumination of the Holy Spirit for Bible Study
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Abre mis ojos, y miraré las maravillas de tu ley.» (Salmo 119:18)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Abre mis ojos y mirare las maravillas de tu ley...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord God Almighty and Supreme Teacher, as we gather in Your holy temple as a family of faith to search the Holy Scriptures in Sabbath School, we ask You for the anointing of the Holy Spirit. Open our understanding, remove every veil of prejudice from our minds and let Your living Word transform our character into the likeness of Christ Jesus. Bless the teachers, the classes and every heart thirsty for truth. In the name of Jesus, Amen.

oraciones.guiaFonetica: Jehova esta en su santo templo calle delante de el toda la tierra...

oraciones.guiaFonetica: Pues si yo el Senor y el Maestro he lavado vuestros pies...

oraciones.titulo: Adventist Holy Communion Prayer – Memorial of the Cross and Hope of the Kingdom
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Porque todas las veces que comiereis este pan, y bebiereis esta copa, la muerte del Señor anunciáis hasta que él venga.» (1 Corintios 11:26)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Porque todas las veces que comiereis este pan...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, we bless this unleavened bread that represents the immaculate body of Your Son broken for our sins, and this pure fruit of the vine that represents His redeeming blood shed on the cross of Calvary for the remission of our sins. By participating in holy communion, we renew our covenant of fidelity with you and joyfully proclaim the blessed hope: Jesus is coming soon to seek us to celebrate the Marriage of the Lamb in eternity! Amen.

oraciones.guiaFonetica: La tierra fue alumbrada con su gloria...

oraciones.guiaFonetica: Hasta que hayamos sellado en sus frentes a los siervos de nuestro Dios...

oraciones.titulo: The Song of Moses and the Lamb (Revelation 15:2-4) – Hymn of Victory Final
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Grandes y maravillosas son tus obras, Señor Dios Todopoderoso; justos y verdaderos son tus caminos, Rey de los santos.» (Apocalipsis 15:3)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Grandes y maravillosas son tus obras Senor Dios Todopoderoso...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Great and wonderful are your works, Lord God Almighty! Just and true are your ways, King of saints! Who will not fear you, O Lord, and glorify your name? For only you are holy; therefore all nations will come and worship you, because your judgments have been revealed. Praise the Lamb who redeemed us with His blood and granted us victory over sin and death. Alleluia! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Elena G. of White – Prayer of Consagración Total Matutina (The Camino a Cristo, Cap. 8)
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Conságrate a Dios todas las mañanas; haz de esto tu primer trabajo. Sea tu oración: Tómame, ¡oh Señor!, como enteramente tuyo...»
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Tomame oh Senor como enteramente tuyo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Take me, O Lord, as entirely yours! I put all my plans at your feet. Use me today in your service. Dwell in me and have all my work done in you. I renounce my own will to do yours. Let this be my daily exercise: every morning I consecrate myself to God for that day, submitting all my plans to Him so that they may be fulfilled or abandoned as His wise providence indicates. Thus I will put my life in the hands of God and it will be molded more and more into the likeness of Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer for Comprehensive Health and Temple of the Holy Spirit (1 Corinthians 6:19-20; 3 John 1:2)
oraciones.textoOriginal: «¿O ignoráis que vuestro cuerpo es templo del Espíritu Santo, el cual está en vosotros... glorificad, pues, a Dios en vuestro cuerpo?» (1 Corintios 6:19-20)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Vuestro cuerpo es templo del Espiritu Santo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Heavenly Father, we come with confidence before the throne of Thy grace, anchored in the promises of Thy Holy Word and in the blessed hope of Christ's soon return. oraciones.textoOriginal: «Por la gracia de Dios, seré puro, bondadoso y leal; guardaré la ley del Conquistador, seré siervo de Dios y amigo de la humanidad.»
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Por la gracia de Dios sere puro bondadoso y leal...

oraciones.guiaFonetica: Pedid a Jehova lluvia en la estacion tardia...

oraciones.guiaFonetica: Traed todos los diezmos al alfoli...

oraciones.guiaFonetica: No te dejare si no me bendices...

oraciones.textoOriginal: «Por la mañana hazme oír tu misericordia, porque en ti he confiado; hazme saber el camino por donde ande, porque a ti he elevado mi alma.» (Salmo 143:8)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Por la manana hazme oir tu misericordia...

oraciones.textoOriginal: «¡Cuán hermosos son sobre los montes los pies del que trae alegres nuevas, del que anuncia la paz, del que trae nuevas del bien!» (Isaías 52:7)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Cuan hermosos son sobre los montes los pies del que trae alegres nuevas...
