We present this earnest prayer for Present Truth Colporteurs and Publications: guard our lives, establish our steps in Thy holy commandments, and fill us with Thy heavenly peace. Through the merits of Jesus Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Akheri Munajat of the Bishwa Ijtema (Tongi, Bangladesh) – Massive Cry for World Peace
oraciones.textoOriginal: হে আল্লাহ! আমাদের সমস্ত গোনাহ মাফ করে দাও। সারা বিশ্বের মুসলিম ও মানবজাতির উপর শান্তি, নিরাপত্তা ও হেদায়েত দান করো...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Hey Allah! Amader shomosto gonah maf kore dao. Shara bissher Muslim o manobjatir upor shanti, niropotta o hedayet dan koro...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Allah, Lord and Creator of the Universe! In this immense assembly of repentant hearts, we beg you with tears in our eyes: forgive all our faults and sins, public and secret. Pour out peace, security, harmony and right guidance on all the peoples of the Earth. Heal our sick, satisfy the hunger of the dispossessed, free the world from violence, wars and catastrophes, and grant us to live in righteousness and die in the fullness of faith. O Lord of Majesty, accept our supplication! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Munajat of Shab-e-Barat (The Night of Forgiveness and Record of Destiny)
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ العَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنَّا ۞ হে দয়াময় আল্লাহ! এই বরকতময় রাতে আমাদের ভাগ্যকে কল্যাণে পূর্ণ করে দাও।
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Allahumma innaka 'Afuwwun tuhibbul-'afwa fa'fu 'anna | Hey Doyamoy Allah! Ei borokotmoy raate amader bhagyoke kollyane purno kore dao...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Merciful God! On this blessed night of forgiveness and dispensation of destinies, prostrate before Your presence we implore Your infinite compassion. Erase our past mistakes, prescribe for us and our families a year full of honest sustenance, unbreakable health, protection from all danger and closeness to Your holy light. Guide our steps along the straight path and make us instruments of blessing for our neighbors. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Milad Mehfil & Qiyam – Salutación Solemne al Profeta of the Mercy
oraciones.textoOriginal: يَا نَبِي سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكَ ۞ يَا رَسُول سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكَ ۞ يَا حَبِيب سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكَ ۞ صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكَ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Nabi Salam 'Alayka | Ya Rasul Salam 'Alayka | Ya Habib Salam 'Alayka | Salawatullah 'Alayka
oraciones.textoTraducido: Peace be upon you, O Prophet! Peace be upon you, O Messenger of God! Peace be upon you, oh Beloved of the Creator! God's continued blessings be upon you. Source of light that dispels the darkness of ignorance, teacher of compassion and tenderness for all worlds. May divine peace flood our homes and may we follow your steps of justice, forgiveness and universal brotherhood.

oraciones.titulo: Súplica Espiritual of Hazrat Shah Jalal of Sylhet – Shelter & Refuge and Road Opening
oraciones.textoOriginal: হে রাব্বুল আলামিন! তোমার ওলিদের মহব্বতের উসিলায় আমাদের দিলকে অন্ধকার মুক্ত করো এবং আমাদের বিপদ-আপদ দূর করে দাও।
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Hey Rabbul Alamin! Tomar olider mohobboter usilay amader dilke ondho-kar mukto koro ebong amader bipod-apod door kore dao...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Lord of the Worlds! For the sincere love of those righteous and holy servants who brought the light of the Gospel of Peace to the lands of Bengal: purify our hearts from envy and discouragement. Dissolve the obstacles that block our righteous paths, protect us from all tyranny and injustice, and grant us the firmness of spirit to sow love and truth in the midst of adversity. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Fakir Lalon Shah – Mystical Prayer of Human Unity and Divine Search
oraciones.textoOriginal: সব লোকে কয় লালন কি জাত সংসারে... যার যার ধর্ম সে সে পালন করে, কিন্তু মানুষের আসল ধর্ম হলো প্রেম ও সত্যের সাধনা।
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Shob loke koy Lalon ki jaat shongshare... Manusher ashol dhormo holo prem o shotter shadhona...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Everyone asks what caste or creed the traveler has... But in the eyes of the One Creator, the soul has no human divisions or earthly boundaries. The true religion of the heart is unconditional love, the search for Truth and compassionate service to others. Oh divine Creator who lives in the secret temple of the soul! Awaken in us the lucidity to see Your reflection in each human being. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Kazi Nazrul Islam – Chant of Ramadan and Sharing with the Poor (O Mon Romzaner)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ও মন রমজানের ওই রোজার শেষে এলো খুশির ঈদ! তুই আপনাকে আজ বিলিয়ে দে, শোন আসমানী তগিদ...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O mon Romzaner oi rozar sheshe elo khushir Eid! Tui apnake aaj biliye de, shon ashmani togib...
oraciones.textoTraducido: At the end of the sacred days of fasting, the bliss of divine joy flourishes. Give your being and your goods to those in need today; listen to the heavenly call to generosity! Open your hands to the orphan, share your bread with the hungry and cleanse your soul from selfishness. May this day of holy celebration renew in us the spirit of social justice, pure charity and sincere brotherhood. Glory to God!

oraciones.titulo: Mahalaya Invocation (Ya Devi Sarvabhuteshu) – The Awakening of the Divine Mother
oraciones.textoOriginal:
या देवी सर्वभूतेषु शक्ति-रूपेण संस्थिता। नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः॥
या देवी सर्वभूतेषु मातृ-रूपेण संस्थिता। नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Devi Sarvabhuteshu Shakti-Rupena Samsthita | Namastasyai Namastasyai Namastasyai Namo Namah || Ya Devi Sarvabhuteshu Matri-Rupena Samsthita | Namastasyai Namastasyai Namastasyai Namo Namah ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om Tat Sat! We invoke the supreme divine light and grace in this sacred contemplation of Mahalaya Invocation (Ya Devi Sarvabhuteshu). May transcendent wisdom and pure knowledge dispel all darkness and ignorance from our mind, filling our life with inner peace, equanimity, discernment, and spiritual elevation. Om Shanti, Shanti, Shanti.

oraciones.titulo: Durga Dhyana Mantra – Meditation on the Resplendent Ten-Armed Mother
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ जटाजूटसमायुक्तामर्धেন্দुकृतशेखराम्। लोचनत्रयसंयुक्तां पूर्णेन्दुसदृशाननाम्॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Jatajuta Samayuktam Ardhendu Krita Shekharam | Lochana Traya Samyuktam Purnendu Sadrishananam ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: I meditate on Mother Durga, adorned with the crescent moon on Her forehead, with three compassionate eyes that see past, present and future, and Her face resplendent like the full moon. Carrying in Her ten hands the sacred weapons granted by the gods for the protection of the Dharma, riding on the victorious lion and destroying all forces of ignorance and evil. Protective Mother, grant us Your eternal refuge!

oraciones.titulo: Durga Pushpanjali Mantra (Ashtami) – Sacred Flower Offering to Ma Durga
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ महिषघ्नि महामाये चामुण्डे मुण्डमालिनि। आयुरारोग्यमैश्वर्यं देहि देवि नमोऽस्तु ते॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Mahishaghni Mahamaye Chamunde Mundamalini | Ayur Arogyam Aishwaryam Dehi Devi Namo'stu Te ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om Tat Sat! We invoke the supreme divine light and grace in this sacred contemplation of Durga Pushpanjali Mantra (Ashtami). May transcendent wisdom and pure knowledge dispel all darkness and ignorance from our mind, filling our life with inner peace, equanimity, discernment, and spiritual elevation. Om Shanti, Shanti, Shanti.

oraciones.titulo: Durga Pranam Mantra – Sarva Mangala Mangalye (Supreme Auspicious Blessing)
oraciones.textoOriginal: सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्ये शिवे सर्वार्थसाधिके। शरण्ये त्र्यम्बके गौरि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Sarva Mangala Mangalye Shive Sarvartha Sadhike | Sharanye Tryambake Gauri Narayani Namo'stu Te ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: O You, most auspicious of all that is auspicious, kind, fulfiller of all the noble purposes of the soul! Supreme refuge of all beings, with three divine eyes, Divine Mother Narayani: we prostrate our minds and hearts before You with eternal reverence and gratitude!

oraciones.titulo: Bijoya Dashami & Aparajita Mantra – Prayer of Triunfo, Reconciliación and Peace
oraciones.textoOriginal: इमां पूजां मया देवि यथाशक्त्या निवेदिताम्। रक्षार्थं त्वं समादाय व्रज स्थानमनुत्तमम्॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Imam Pujam Maya Devi Yatha-Shaktya Niveditam | Rakshartham Tvam Samadaya Vraja Sthanam Anuttamam ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Dearest Mother! Accept this adoration that we have offered you with love and sincere devotion. Take away our afflictions, leave us Your blessing of peace, unite families in the fraternal embrace of Bijoya (victory) and protect us always until Your glorious return. Shubho Bijoya!

oraciones.titulo: Shyama Kali Pranam Mantra – Dissolution of Fear of Death and Transformation
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ जयन्ती मङ्गला काली भद्रकाली कपालिनी। दुर्गा शिवा क्षमा धात्री स्वाहा स्वधा नमोऽस्तु ते॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Jayanti Mangala Kali Bhadrakali Kapalini | Durga Shiva Kshama Dhatri Swaha Swadha Namo'stu Te ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh! Victory to the Transcendent Kali, Bearer of Good Fortune, Immortal Protector who dissolves the illusions of time. You are the Strength, the Infinite Patience, the Nurturer of the Cosmos and the Supreme Forgiver. We pay obeisance to Your sacred feet to drive away fear and grant us spiritual liberation!

oraciones.titulo: Ramprasad Sen – Prayer of the Hijo a the Madre Kali (Ma Tumi Kemon Kore Thako)
oraciones.textoOriginal: মা আমায় ঘুরাবি কত? যেমন কলুর চোখ-ঢাকা বলদ, তেম্নি ভবে ঘুরাবি কত...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ma amay ghurabi koto? Jemon kolur chokh-dhaka bolod, temni bhobe ghurabi koto...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh my mother! How long will you make this son of yours turn on the wheel of the world like a blindfolded ox? Remove the blindfold of ignorance from me, take me in Your loving arms and grant me the unchanging peace of Your lotus feet. I know that even if You rebuke me, in Your heart there is only infinite tenderness for those who surrender to You.

oraciones.titulo: Saraswati Pranam Mantra – Wisdom, Artes and Claridad Escolar
oraciones.textoOriginal: सरस्वति महाभागे विद्ये कमललोचने। विद्यारूपे विशालाक्षि विद्यां देहि नमोऽस्तु ते॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Saraswati Mahabhage Vidye Kamala Lochane | Vidya-Rupe Vishalakshi Vidyam Dehi Namo'stu Te ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Great and Noble Goddess Saraswati, with eyes similar to lotus petals, living personification of knowledge and enlightenment! Grant us pure wisdom, lucid memory, the eloquence of truth and success in our studies and intellectual labors. Reverences to You!

oraciones.titulo: Kojagari Lakshmi Puja Vrata – Prayer of Abundance on the Night of the Full Moon
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ नमस्ते सर्वदेवानां वरदासि हरिप्रिये। या गतिस्त्वत्प्रपन्नानां सा मे भूयात्त्वदर्चनात्॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Namaste Sarva Devanam Varadasi Haripriye | Ya Gatistvat Prapannanam Sa Me Bhuyat Tvad Archanat ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh! Salutations to You, Mother Lakshmi, divine consort of Vishnu and bestower of blessings to all beings. On this sacred night of Kojagari, when you visit the homes that remain awake in prayer, bless our house with decent sustenance, family peace, health and a selfless and generous heart. Amen!

oraciones.titulo: Shri Shikshashtakam (Verse 1) – The Purification of the Mirror of the Heart
oraciones.textoOriginal:
चेतोदर्पणमार्जनं भवमहादावाग्नि-निर्वापणं श्रेयःकैरवचन्द्रिकावितरणं विद्यावधूजीवनम्।
आनन्दाम्बुधिवर्धनं प्रतिपदं पूर्णामृतास्वादनं सर्वात्मस्नपनं परं विजयते श्रीकृष्णसङ्कीर्तनम्॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ceto-darpana-marjanam bhava-maha-davagni-nirvapanam | Shreyah-kairava-chandrika-vitaranam vidya-vadhu-jivanam | Anandambudhi-vardhanam prati-padam purnamritasvadanam | Sarvatma-snapanam param vijayate shri-krishna-sankirtanam ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Supreme glory to the congregational singing of the holy Names of God! This song cleanses the mirror of the heart of the dust accumulated for years; extinguishes the burning fire of worldly sufferings; spreads the beneficial rays of the moon of bliss; It is the very life of transcendent knowledge; expands the ocean of spiritual bliss; It grants the nectar of immortality at every step and bathes the entire soul in divine purity.

oraciones.titulo: Shri Shikshashtakam (Verse 3) – The Humility of the Blade of Grass and the Patience of the Tree
oraciones.textoOriginal: तृणादपि सुनीचेन तरोरपि सहिष्णुना। अमानिना मानदेन कीर्तनीयः सदा हरिः॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Trinad api sunicena taror api sahishnuna | Amanina manadena kirtaniyah sada harih ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: One should chant the holy Names of the Lord in a humble state of mind, feeling more humble than a blade of grass trodden on the road; more tolerant and patient than a generous tree that gives shade even to those who cut it; devoid of all desire for earthly vainglory and always ready to honor others. In such a state of purity, God can be remembered continually.

oraciones.titulo: Shri Shikshashtakam (Verso 4) – Renuncia a the Ambición and Pure Love a Dios
oraciones.textoOriginal: न धनं न जनं न सुन्दरीं कवितां वा जगदीश कामये। मम जन्मनि जन्मनीश्वरे भवताद्भक्तिरहैतुकी त्वयि॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Na dhanam na janam na sundarim kavitam va jagad-isha kamaye | Mama janmani janmanishvare bhavatad bhaktir ahaituki tvayi ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Lord of the Universe! I do not desire material riches, nor crowds of followers, nor earthly beauty, nor passing honors of poetry. The only thing I long for, life after life, is to possess pure, selfless and unconditional devotion to Your sacred feet.

oraciones.titulo: Pancha Tattva Mantra of Bengala – Invocation to Chaitanya and Sus Compañeros Santos
oraciones.textoOriginal: जय श्रीकृष्णचैतन्य प्रभु नित्यानन्द। श्रीअद्वैत गदाधर श्रीवासादि गौरभक्तवृन्द॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Jaya Sri Krishna Chaitanya Prabhu Nityananda | Sri Advaita Gadadhara Srivasadi Gaura Bhakta Vrinda ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Glory to Sri Krishna Chaitanya Mahaprabhu (the embodiment of divine love in Bengal), the compassionate Lord Nityananda, Sri Advaita Acharya, Gadadhara Pandita and Srivasa Thakura along with all the saintly devotees! May his infinite mercy pour out the grace of forgiveness and blessedness in all hearts.

oraciones.titulo: Maha Mantra of the Deliverance Espiritual – Hare Krishna Hare Rama
oraciones.textoOriginal: हरे कृष्ण हरे कृष्ण कृष्ण कृष्ण हरे हरे। हरे राम हरे राम राम राम हरे हरे॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Hare Krishna Hare Krishna Krishna Krishna Hare Hare | Hare Rama Hare Rama Rama Rama Hare Hare ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Supreme Divine Energy (Hara/Radha), O Supreme Attractor of all souls (Krishna), O Source of all Infinite Joy (Rama)! We humbly beg You: please engage us in Your loving service and purify our lives of all illusion and pain. Peace and love for all beings!

oraciones.titulo: Dasha Avatara Stotram (Jayadeva of Bengal - Gita Govinda) – Redemptive Invocation
oraciones.textoOriginal: प्रलयपयोधिजले धृतवानसि वेदं विहितवहित्रचरित्रमखेदम्। केशव धृतमीनशरीर जय जगदीश हरे॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Pralaya Payodhi Jale Dhritavanasi Vedam | Vihita Vahitra Charitram Akhedam | Keshava Dhrita Mina Sharira Jaya Jagadisha Hare ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Lord Keshava! You who in the midst of the turbulent waters of cosmic dissolution manifested yourself to save sacred wisdom and sustain the creatures of the world: Glory to You, Sovereign of the Universe! May you descend with love in every era to eradicate suffering and restore peace and justice.

oraciones.titulo: Damodarashtakam – Song of Love and Intimate Devotion to God
oraciones.textoOriginal: नमामीश्वरं सच्चिदानन्दरूपं लसत्कुण्डलं गोकुले भ्राजमानम्। यশোदाभियोलूखलाद्धावमानं परामृष्टमत्यन्ततो द्रुत्य गोप्या॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Namamishvaram Sac-Cid-Ananda-Rupam | Lasat-Kundalam Gokule Bhrajamanam | Yashoda-Bhiyolukhalad Dhavamanam | Paramrishtam Atyantato Drutya Gopya ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: I prostrate myself with infinite reverence before the Supreme Lord, whose form is Eternal Existence, Full Consciousness and Absolute Bliss (Sat-Chit-Ananda). To Him who, being the Sovereign of the Cosmos, allows Himself to be bound only by the ropes of the pure and selfless love of His devotees. Pour out Your grace on us and free us from material bonds!

oraciones.titulo: The Serenity Prayer (Reinhold Niebuhr) – Prayer Completa of the Serenidad, Valor and Wisdom
oraciones.textoOriginal: God, grant me the serenity to accept the things I cannot change, courage to change the things I can, and wisdom to know the difference. Living one day at a time, enjoying one moment at a time, accepting hardship as a pathway to peace...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: God grant me the serenity to accept the things I cannot change...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Dear God, grant me the serenity to accept the things I cannot change, the courage to change the things I can, and the wisdom to know the difference. Living one day at a time, enjoying one moment at a time, accepting difficulties as a path to peace; taking, as Jesus did, this sinful world as it is, and not as I would like it to be; trusting that You will make all things go well if I surrender to Your holy will, so that I may be reasonably happy in this life and supremely happy with You forever in eternity. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: George Washington (1783) – Solemn Prayer for the Peace, Union and Justice of the Nation
oraciones.textoOriginal: Almighty God, we make our earnest prayer that Thou wilt keep the United States in Thy holy protection; that Thou wilt incline the hearts of the citizens to cultivate a spirit of subordination and obedience to government...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Almighty God, we make our earnest prayer...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy and Almighty Father! In the supreme name of Jesus Christ, we come before Thy glorious presence, proclaiming the power and victory of Thy living Word over George Washington (1783). Release Thy anointing and the fire of Thy Holy Spirit upon our life, tear down every obstacle, heal every infirmity, and fill us with supernatural strength and joy. To Thee be all the glory, honor, and power forever! Amen and amen.

oraciones.titulo: Abraham Lincoln (1863) – National Cry for Humility, Consolation and Reconciliation
oraciones.textoOriginal: It has seemed to me fit and proper that the gracious gifts of the Most High God should be solemnly, reverently, and gratefully acknowledged as with one heart and one voice by the whole American people...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: It has seemed to me fit and proper...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy and Almighty Father! In the supreme name of Jesus Christ, we come before Thy glorious presence, proclaiming the power and victory of Thy living Word over Abraham Lincoln (1863). Release Thy anointing and the fire of Thy Holy Spirit upon our life, tear down every obstacle, heal every infirmity, and fill us with supernatural strength and joy. To Thee be all the glory, honor, and power forever! Amen and amen.

oraciones.titulo: Martin Luther King Jr. – Prayer for Peace, Human Dignity and the Triumph of Love
oraciones.textoOriginal: O God, our gracious Heavenly Father, help us to see that we are made to live together in a brotherhood of love. Grant that we will remove all bitterness, prejudice, and hatred from our hearts...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O God, our gracious Heavenly Father...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh God, Heavenly Father and Creator of all human beings! Help us understand that we were created to live together as brothers in a community of love and respect. Grant us the courage to uproot all bitterness, prejudice and hatred from our hearts. Give us the strength of unconditional love (*Agape*) to respond to resentment with compassion and oppression with unwavering justice. May Your Kingdom of justice, peace and brotherhood be established in every nation and in every heart. In the name of Jesus, Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Amazing Grace (John Newton) – Devotional Song of Infinite Grace and Redemption
oraciones.textoOriginal: Amazing grace! How sweet the sound that saved a wretch like me! I once was lost, but now am found; was blind, but now I see...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Amazing grace! How sweet the sound...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Sublime grace of the Lord, how sweet is his song! He saved a lost soul like me; I was blind and today I can see, I was lost and I was found. Grace taught me to fear and dispelled my fears; how precious was that grace in the hour when I believed! Through many dangers, toils, and snares I have passed; Grace has brought me safely here and grace will guide me to my eternal home. When we have been there ten thousand years shining like the sun, we will have no fewer days to sing the praises of God than when we first started. Glory to God!

oraciones.titulo: It Is Well With My Soul (Horatio Spafford) – Unshakeable Peace in the Midst of Pain
oraciones.textoOriginal: When peace like a river attendeth my way, when sorrows like sea billows roll; whatever my lot, Thou hast taught me to say: It is well, it is well with my soul...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: When peace like a river attendeth my way...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy and Almighty Father! In the supreme name of Jesus Christ, we come before Thy glorious presence, proclaiming the power and victory of Thy living Word over It Is Well With My Soul (Horatio Spafford). Release Thy anointing and the fire of Thy Holy Spirit upon our life, tear down every obstacle, heal every infirmity, and fill us with supernatural strength and joy. To Thee be all the glory, honor, and power forever! Amen and amen.

oraciones.titulo: Book of Common Prayer (BCP USA) – General Thanksgiving for Creation and Life
oraciones.textoOriginal: Almighty God, Father of all mercies, we, thine unworthy servants, do give thee most humble and hearty thanks for all thy goodness and loving-kindness to us, and to all men...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Almighty God, Father of all mercies...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy and Almighty Father! In the supreme name of Jesus Christ, we come before Thy glorious presence, proclaiming the power and victory of Thy living Word over Book of Common Prayer (BCP USA). Release Thy anointing and the fire of Thy Holy Spirit upon our life, tear down every obstacle, heal every infirmity, and fill us with supernatural strength and joy. To Thee be all the glory, honor, and power forever! Amen and amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Frances Xavier Cabrini (Mother Cabrini) – Patroness of Immigrants and Hospitals
oraciones.textoOriginal: Fortify me with the grace of Your Holy Spirit and give Your peace to my soul, that I may be free from all needless anxiety and worry.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Fortify me with the grace of Your Holy Spirit...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Saint Francis Xavier Cabrini, dear Mother Cabrini! First citizen of the United States to be elevated to the altars: you who crossed seas and founded schools, orphanages and hospitals with an ardent love that nothing could stop: be the protection of migrants, of families seeking a dignified future and of the helpless sick. Strengthen us with the grace of the Holy Spirit, remove all useless anxiety from our minds and grant us a generous and brave heart to serve Christ in the most vulnerable neighbor. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Elizabeth Ann Seton – First Saint Born in the USA (Abandonment in Divine Providence)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Hazard yet forward! The first end I propose in our daily work is to do the will of God, to do it in the manner He wills it, and to do it because it is His will.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Hazard yet forward! The first end I propose...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Saint Elizabeth Ann Seton, exemplary mother, educator of youth and faithful servant of Christ! You who, faced with the loss of your husband, the misunderstanding and the hardest trials, abandoned yourself with total confidence in the arms of Divine Providence: teach us to seek above all the will of God, to fulfill it with love and patience, and to see in each cross an opportunity for spiritual growth and fraternal charity. Pray for our families and for the education of our children. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Kateri Tekakwitha (The Lily of the Mohawks) – Patroness of Indigenous Peoples and Creation
oraciones.textoOriginal: I am not my own; I have given myself to Jesus. He must be my only love. The rain that falls from heaven, the birds that sing in the woods, all speak of His goodness.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: I am not my own; I have given myself to Jesus...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Saint Kateri Tekakwitha, Pure Lily of the Mohawks and resplendent flower of the native peoples of America! You whose heart burned with virginal love for Jesus Christ and found in nature the living reflection of the beauty of the Creator: inspire us to care for the Earth with reverence, to live with simplicity and purity, and to remain faithful to the Catholic faith even in the midst of trials and loneliness. Lead our souls towards the peace of the Great Celestial Spirit. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint John Neumann (Bishop of Philadelphia) – Patron of Children and Catholic Education
oraciones.textoOriginal: Merciful Father, You gave Saint John Neumann a heart of zeal and love for the flock, especially for the young and the immigrant.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Merciful Father, You gave Saint John Neumann...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Father of Mercy, who granted Saint John Neumann tireless pastoral zeal to proclaim the Gospel to the humble, educate children in the truth and promote perpetual adoration before the Blessed Sacrament: bless our schools, protect our children from moral danger and awaken in our parishes an ardent love for the Eucharist, an inexhaustible source of holiness and Christian charity. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Katharine Drexel – Patrona of the Justice Racial and the Reconciliación
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ever loving God, You called Saint Katharine Drexel to guide the neglected and build communities of love and dignity.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ever loving God, You called Saint Katharine Drexel...
oraciones.textoTraducido: God of infinite love, who called Saint Katharine Drexel to renounce immense earthly riches to consecrate her life and property to the service of Native American peoples and African-American communities: grant us a spirit free from all prejudice or vanity, a courageous commitment to justice and the dignity of each person, and the grace to see in the Holy Eucharist the sacred bond that unites us as one human family in Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Damien of Molokai – Hero of Charity for the Sick and Outcast (Hawaii)
oraciones.textoOriginal: My greatest happiness is to serve the Lord in His poor and sick children, banished from the world.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: My greatest happiness is to serve the Lord...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Saint Damian of Molokai, heroic apostle of lepers at the ends of the ocean! You who voluntarily chose exile and contagion to bring the consolation of the sacraments, the dignity and the love of God to the most despised in the world: grant us a compassionate heart that does not flee from the pain of others, strength to care for our sick and the grace to give ourselves without reservation to the service of our suffering neighbors. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Consecration of the Estados Unidos a the Inmaculada Concepción (Patrona Nacional)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Most Holy Trinity, our Father in Heaven, we place our country in the loving hands of Mary Immaculate, our Patroness.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Most Holy Trinity, our Father in Heaven...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy Trinity, God our Creator! We entrust the destiny of our country in the maternal hands of Mary Immaculate, Heavenly Patroness of the United States of America. Blessed Mother: Protect our families, guard our youth in purity and faith, inspire our leaders with wisdom and justice, and make this land a beacon of freedom, peace, welcoming the stranger, and inviolable respect for the sacred gift of life. Our Lady of the Immaculate Conception, pray for us! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Venerable Fulton J. Sheen – Prayer of the Hora Saint ante the Santísimo Sacramento
oraciones.textoOriginal: My Lord and my God, in this Holy Hour I place myself in Your Divine Presence. Teach me to pray, teach me to love, teach me to listen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: My Lord and my God, in this Holy Hour...
oraciones.textoTraducido: My Lord and my God! In this Holy Hour of silence and adoration I prostrate before Your Real Presence in the Blessed Sacrament of the Altar. Like the apostles in Gethsemane, I want to watch with you for an hour. Purify my soul in the fire of Your divine love, teach me to listen to Your voice in the stillness of my heart, heal my interior wounds and make me, upon leaving this Eucharistic encounter, be a luminous witness of Your truth, Your joy and Your infinite mercy. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Blessed Michael McGivney (Knights of Columbus) – Protector of Families and Workers
oraciones.textoOriginal: God, our Father, protector of the poor and defender of the widow and orphan, You called Father Michael McGivney to lead Christian families in fraternal charity.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: God, our Father, protector of the poor...
oraciones.textoTraducido: God, our Father, protector of the humble and defender of families: you inspired Blessed Father Michael McGivney to found the Knights of Columbus to help widows, protect orphans, and unite men in faith, honest patriotism, and fraternal charity. Help us to defend the sanctity of marriage, to work honestly to support our homes, and to be faithful guardians of the Catholic faith in our society. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Jinapanjara Gatha (The Armor of the Victorious) – Thailand's Most Famous Protection Prayer
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: जयसनाकता बुद्धा चेत्वा मारं सवाहनं। चतुसच्चासमं रसं ये पिविंसु नरासभा॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Jayasanakata Buddha chetva Maram savahanam | Chatu-saccasabham rasam ye pivimsu narasabha...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Having triumphed over the deception of Mara and his hosts, the Enlightened Buddhas drank the nectar of the Four Noble Truths. May the presence and protection of all the Buddhas past, present and future, together with the Holy Arhats and the Holy Dhamma, form around my body and mind an impenetrable diamond armor against all danger, curse, illness or misfortune. Victory and peace at all times!

oraciones.titulo: Itipiso Gatha – Chant of the Nine Sacred Qualities of the Buddha
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: इतिपि सो भगवा अरहं सम्मासम्बुद्धो विज्जाचरणसम्पन्नो सुगतो लोकविदू अनुत्तरो पुरिसदम्मसारथी सत्था देवमनुस्सानं बुद्धो भगवाति॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Iti pi so Bhagava Araham Samma-Sambuddho Vijja-Charana-Sampanno Sugato Lokavidu Anuttaro Purisa-Damma-Sarathi Sattha Deva-Manussanam Buddho Bhagava'ti.
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Itipiso Gatha. May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Svakkhato Gatha – Chant of the Six Qualities of the Holy Dhamma
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: स्वाक्खातो भगवता धम्मो सन्दिट्ठिको अकालिको एहिपस्सिको ओपनेय्यिको पच्चत्तं वेदितब्बो विञ्ञूहीति॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Svakkhato Bhagavata Dhammo Sanditthiko Akaliko Ehipassiko Opanayiko Paccattam Veditabbo Vinnuhi'ti.
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Svakkhato Gatha. May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Supatipanno Gatha – Song of Praise to the Noble Sangha
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: सुपटिपन्नो भगवतो सावकसङ्घो उजुपटिपन्नो भगवतो सावकसङ्घो ञायपटिपन्नो भगवतो सावकसङ्घो सामीचिपटिपन्नो भगवतो सावकसङ्घो...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Supatipanno Bhagavato Savaka-Sangho Uju-Patipanno Bhagavato Savaka-Sangho Naya-Patipanno Bhagavato Savaka-Sangho...
oraciones.textoTraducido: The community of disciples of the Blessed One is of upright and noble conduct; of upright, wise conduct and worthy of reverence. They are worthy of offerings, worthy of hospitality, worthy of respectful gifts, and worthy of reverent salutation with joined palms: the supreme field of spiritual merit for the world.

oraciones.titulo: Maha Jayamangala Gatha – Chant of the Eight Great Victories of the Buddha
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: बाहुं सहस्समभिनिम्मितसावुधन्तं गिरिमेखलं उदितघोरससेनमारं। दानादिधम्मविधिना जितवा मुनिन्दो तं तेजसा भवतु ते जयमङ्गलानि॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Bahum sahassam abhinimmita savudhantam Girimekhalam udita ghora sasenamaram | Danadi-dhamma-vidhina jitava munindo Tam tejasa bhavatu te jayamangalani ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Creating a thousand armed arms on the fierce elephant Girimekhala, Mara advanced with his terrible armies. The King of the Wise defeated him through generosity and spiritual virtues. By the radiant power of this victory, may there be supreme blessing, triumph and well-being for you throughout your life!

oraciones.titulo: Angulimala Paritta – Chant of Protection for the Parto and the Maternidad Segura
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: यतोहं भगिनि अरियाय जातिया जातो नाभिजानामि सञ्चिच्च पाणं जीविता वोरोपेता। तेन सच्चेन सोत्थि ते होतु सोत्थि गब्भस्स॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Yatoham bhagini ariyaya jatiya jato nabhijanami sancicca panam jivita voropeta | Tena saccena sotthi te hotu sotthi gabbhassa ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: From the moment I was spiritually born into the noble family of the Enlightened One, oh sister, I do not remember having intentionally taken the life of any creature. By the sacred truth of this purity, may there be perfect health and safety for you and for the blessed life in your womb!

oraciones.titulo: Abhaya Paritta – Song to Dispel Bad Dreams and Omens
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: यन्दुन्निमित्तं अवमङ्गलञ्च यो चामनापो सकुणस्स सद्दो। पापग्गहो दुस्सपिनं अकन्तं बुद्धानुभावेन विनासमेन्तु॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Yan-dunnimittam ava-mangalanca Yo camanapo sakunassa saddo | Papaggaho dussapinam akantam Buddhanubhavena vinasamentu ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Any bad omen, inauspicious omen, disturbing sound, adverse planetary influence or disturbing nightmare: may all of these be completely dissolved and transformed into peace by the power of the Buddha, by the power of the Dhamma and by the power of the Sangha!

oraciones.titulo: Dhajagga Paritta – The Estandarte of the Protection against the Miedo and the Pánico
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: अरञ्ञे रुक्खमूले वा सुञ्ञागारेव भिक्खवो। अनुस्सरेथ सम्बुद्धं भयं तुम्हाक नो सिया॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Aranne rukkhamule va sunnagareva bhikkhavo | Anussaretha sambuddham bhayam tumhaka no siya ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Dhajagga Paritta. May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Anumodana Gatha – Sacred Blessing and Dedication of Merits
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: सब्बीतियो विवज्जन्तु सब्बरोगो विनस्सतु। मा ते भवत्वन्तरायो सुखी दीघायुको भव॥ अभिवादनसीलिस्स निच्चं वुड्ढापचायिनो। चत्तारो धम्मा वड्ढन्ति आयु वण्णो सुखं बलं॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Sabbitiyo vivajjantu sabba-rogo vinassatu | Ma te bhavatvantarayo sukhi dighayuko bhava || Abhivadana-silissa niccam vuddhapacayino | Cattaro dhamma vaddhanti ayu vanno sukham balam ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: May all misfortunes be removed; May all diseases be cured; May no danger hinder your path. May you enjoy long life, happiness and peace. For those who cultivate respect and constant devotion, four divine blessings flourish: longevity, beauty of spirit, happiness and inner strength.

oraciones.titulo: Pattidana Gatha – Transfer of Merits to Departed Loved Ones
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: इदं मे ञातीनं होतु सुखिता होन्तु ञातयो। उण्णमे उदकं वट्टं यथा निन्नं पपवत्तति। एवमेव इतो दिन्नं पेतानं उपकप्पति॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Idam me natinam hotu sukhita hontu natayo | Unname udakam vattam yatha ninnam pavattati | Evam eva ito dinnam petanam upakappati ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: May this spiritual merit reach our ancestors and relatives who have departed this world; May you enjoy joy, peace and light in your destiny! Just as the waters from the mountains descend to fill the valleys, may the blessing of this love and these prayers reach directly to your spirits for your eternal comfort.

oraciones.titulo: Shurangama Mantra (Lengyan Zhou / 楞嚴咒) – The Gran Mantra of Protection Mental
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: 南無楞嚴會上佛菩薩 (三稱) ۞ 唵。阿那隸。毗舍提。鞞囉跋闍囉陀唎。盤陀盤陀你。跋闍囉謗尼泮。虎𤙖都嚧甖泮。莎婆訶。
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Nanmo Lengyan Huishang Fo Pusa | Om Anale Visada Vaira Vajradhari Bandha Bandhani Vajrapani Phat Hum Bhrum Phat Svaha
oraciones.textoTraducido: I take refuge in the sacred assembly of the Shurangama. Oh! Great Protective Diamond, dissolves mental illusions, overcomes all interference from dark attachments and passions, and seals the mind in the diamond concentration of Supreme Illumination. Swaha!

oraciones.titulo: Wang Sheng Zhou (往生咒) – Mantra of Rebirth in the Pure Land of Amitabha
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: 南無阿彌多婆夜。哆他伽多夜。哆地夜他。阿彌利都婆毗。阿彌利哆。悉耽婆毗。阿彌利哆。毗迦蘭帝。阿彌利哆。毗迦蘭多。伽彌膩。伽伽那。枳多迦隸。莎婆訶。
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Namo Amitabhaya Tathagataya Tadyatha Amritodbhave Amrita Sambhave Amrita Vikrante Amrita Vikranta Gamini Gagana Kirti Kare Svaha
oraciones.textoTraducido: Salutations to Buddha Amitabha, the Transcendent of Infinite Light. May the immortal nectar of His wisdom and pure love purify all roots of negative karma, grant present peace and ensure blissful awakening in the Pure Land of Eternal Peace! Swaha!

oraciones.titulo: The 10 Great Vows of Samantabhadra (Puxian Shi Da Yuan / 普賢菩薩十大願王)
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: 一者禮敬諸佛。二者稱讚如來。三者廣修供養。四者懺悔業障。五者隨喜功德。六者請轉法輪。七者請佛住世。八者常隨佛學。九者恒順眾生。十者普皆迴向。
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Yi zhe li jing zhu Fo | Er zhe cheng zan Ru Lai | San zhe guang xiu gong yang | Si zhe chan hui ye zhang | Wu zhe sui xi gong de | Liu zhe qing zhuan Fa lun | Qi zhe qing Fo zhu shi | Ba zhe chang sui Fo xue | Jiu zhe heng shun zhong sheng | Shi zhe pu jie hui xiang
oraciones.textoTraducido: 1. Revere all the Buddhas. 2. Praise the Enlightened Ones. 3. Make abundant offerings. 4. Regret past mistakes. 5. Rejoice in the merits of others. 6. Ask for the teaching of the Dharma. 7. Beg teachers to remain in the world. 8. Always follow the teachings of the Buddha. 9. Serve all living beings with kindness. 10. Dedicate all merits to the universal awakening of humanity.

oraciones.titulo: Dizang Pusa (Ksitigarbha / 地藏菩薩) – Dissolution of Fixed Karmas and Grief Assistance
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: 唵。鉢囉末鄰陀寧。娑婆訶。(Om Pramardane Svaha) ۞ 南無地藏王菩薩摩訶薩。
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Pramardane Svaha | Nanmo Dizang Wang Pusa Mahasattva
oraciones.textoTraducido: I take refuge in the Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha (Dizang), compassionate protector of troubled souls and savior in states of greatest suffering. Om Pramardane Svaha! May deep-rooted guilt be dissolved by the power of this mantra and paths of comfort, light and redemption open for all beings.

oraciones.titulo: Diamond Sutra (Vajracchedika) – The Four Verses of Transcendent Wisdom
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: 一切有為法，如夢幻泡影，如露亦如電，應作如是觀。
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Yi qie you wei fa, ru meng huan pao ying, ru lu yi ru dian, ying zuo ru shi guan.
oraciones.textoTraducido: All the composite and transitory phenomena of this world are similar to a dream, an illusion, a bubble in water, a fleeting shadow; similar to the dew of dawn or the flash of lightning: this is how they must be contemplated to achieve immutable peace.

oraciones.titulo: Mantra of Cosmic Light (Guangming Zhenyan / 光明真言) – Universal Radiance
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: 唵。阿謨伽。尾盧左曩。摩賀母捺囉。摩抳。鉢納摩。入嚩攞。鉢囉靺哆野。吽。
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Amogha Vairochana Mahamudra Mani Padma Jvala Pravarttaya Hum
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh! We invoke Vairochana, the Buddha of Immeasurable Radiance. May the jewel and lotus of Compassion radiate its purifying fire over our lives, dissolving all spiritual darkness and igniting the light of awakening in every heart. Hmm!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Arrepentimiento of Liang Huang (Liang Huang Bao Chan / 梁皇寶懺)
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: 往昔所造諸惡業，皆由無始貪瞋癡，從身語意之所生，一切我今皆懺悔。
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Wang xi suo zao zhu e ye, jie you wu shi tan chen chi, cong shen yu yi zhi suo sheng, yi qie wo jin jie chan hui.
oraciones.textoTraducido: All the wrong actions committed in the past, born of greed, resentment and mental confusion since beginningless times, originating in the body, the word or the thought: before the Noble Enlightened Ones today I recognize them and I sincerely repent of all of them to walk in purity.

oraciones.titulo: Hannya Shingyo (般若心経) – Heart Sutra in Japanese Zen Tradition
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: 観自在菩薩。行深般若波羅蜜多時。照見五蘊皆空。度一切苦厄。色不異空。空不異色。色即是空。空即是色...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Kanji zai bosa gyo jin hannya hara mita ji sho ken go on kai ku do issai ku yaku. Shiki fu i ku. Ku fu i shiki. Shiki soku ze ku. Ku soku ze shiki...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara, practicing profound Transcendent Wisdom, clearly perceived that the five aggregates are void of inherent existence, thus overcoming all suffering. Form is not different from emptiness, emptiness is not different from form; Form is emptiness, emptiness is form. Gate Gate Paragate Parasamgate Bodhi Svaha!

oraciones.titulo: Nichiren Daimoku (南無妙法蓮華経) – Devotion to the Mystical Law of the Lotus
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: 南無妙法蓮華経 (なむ みょうほう れんげ きょう)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Namu Myoho Renge Kyo
oraciones.textoTraducido: I consecrate my life to the Mystical Law of Cause and Effect expressed in the Lotus Sutra. I awaken the state of Buddhahood inherent in my own heart, transforming any poison into medicine, any obstacle into strength, and manifesting courage, inexhaustible wisdom, and universal compassion.

oraciones.titulo: Fudo Myo-o (Acala / 不動明王) – Mantra of Immovable Fire that Destroys Obstacles
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: ノウマク サマンダ バザラダン センダ マカロシャナ ソワタヤ ウン タラタ カンマン
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Nōmaku samanda bazaradan senda makaroshana sowataya un tarata kanman
oraciones.textoTraducido: Reverences to the Victorious Diamantines. Oh Fudo Myo-o, Immovable Protector of flaming sword and lasso of compassion! Burn all illusory attachments with your sacred fire, conquer hidden fears, bind negative forces and lead us with indestructible firmness to enlightenment.

oraciones.titulo: Yakushi Nyorai (薬師如来) – Japanese Medicine Buddha Mantra
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: オン コロコロ センダリ マトウギ ソワカ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: On korokoro sendari matōgi sowaka
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh! Praise be to the Master Buddha of Medicine and Healing, who makes twelve great vows to eradicate diseases of the body and soul. May His divine balm restore perfect health, vitality and peace to all the sick.

oraciones.titulo: Zazen Wasan (Hakuin Ekaku / 白隠禅師坐禅和讃) – Chant of Zazen Meditation
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: 衆生本来仏なり。水と氷の如くにて、水を離れて氷なく、衆生の外に仏なし...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Shujo honrai Hotoke nari. Mizu to kori no gotoku nite, mizu o hanarete kori naku, shujo no hoka ni Hotoke nashi...
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Zazen Wasan (Hakuin Ekaku / 白隠禅師坐禅和讃). May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Vajrasattva Mantra of 100 Syllables – The Supreme Purification of Karma
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Vajrasattva Samayam Anupalaya | Vajrasattva Tvenopatishtha | Dridho Me Bhava | Sutoshyo Me Bhava | Suposhyo Me Bhava | Anurakto Me Bhava | Sarva Siddhim Me Prayaccha...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om Vajrasattva! Keep my spiritual commitment. It remains firmly in my heart. Grant me deep satisfaction. Make me grow in purity. Pour out Your compassionate love. Grants all spiritual attainments. Purify all my actions and thoughts. Hahaha haho Bhagavan! You who embody the diamond wisdom of all the Buddhas: do not abandon me, make me pure and inseparable from You! Hum Phat!

oraciones.titulo: Padmasambhava Mantra (Guru Rinpoche) – Transformation of Difficult Times
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Ah Hung Vajra Guru Pema Siddhi Hung
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Padmasambhava Mantra (Guru Rinpoche). May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Seven Lines Prayer to Guru Rinpoche – Spontaneous Blessing Supplication
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: ཧཱུྃ༔ ཨོ་རྒྱན་ཡུལ་གྱི་ནུབ་བྱང་མཚམས༔ པདྨ་གེ་སར་སྡོང་པོ་ལ༔ ཡ་མཚན་མཆོག་གི་དངོས་གྲུབ་བརྙེས༔ པདྨ་འབྱུང་གནས་ཞེས་སུ་གྲགས༔...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Hung! Orgyen yul gyi nubjang tsam | Pema gesar dongpo la | Yatsen chok gi ngodrup nye | Pema Jungne zhe su drak | Khor du khandro mangpo kor | Kye kyi je su dak drup kyi | Jin gyi lob chir shek su sol | Guru Pema Siddhi Hung
oraciones.textoTraducido: Hung! On the north-western frontier of the country of Oddiyana, in the calyx of a lotus flower, you were born endowed with wonderful and supreme attainments, known as the Lotus-Born (Padmasambhava). Surrounded by an assembly of awakened beings: following your steps we practice the Dharma. We beg you: come and grant us your blessings. Guru Pema Siddhi Hung!

oraciones.titulo: Mantra of Amitayus (Buddha of Long Life and Wisdom)
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Amarani Jivantaye Soha
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh! Salutations to the Buddha of Immortal Life and Radiant Wisdom. May this divine nectar extend the years of fruitful life for the practice of good, strengthen the physical body and restore the vital energy of all beings. Soha!

oraciones.titulo: Mantra of Dzambala Amarillo – Prosperity Espiritual and Material Generosa
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Dzambala Dzalen Draye Soha
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh! We invoke the Noble Dzambala, protector of generosity and dissolver of poverty. May he shower upon us worthy abundance of resources and wisdom, so that free from scarcity and material distress we may practice charity and benefit all those in need. Soha!

oraciones.titulo: The Four Immeasurable Thoughts (Brahmaviharas)
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: སེམས་ཅན་ཐམས་ཅད་བདེ་བ་དང་བདེ་བའི་རྒྱུ་དང་ལྡན་པར་གྱུར་ཅིག སེམས་ཅན་ཐམས་ཅད་སྡུག་བསྔལ་དང་སྡུག་བསྔལ་གྱི་རྒྱུ་དང་བྲལ་བར་གྱུར་ཅིག...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Semchen thamched dewa dang dewei gyu dang denpar gyur chik | Semchen thamched duk-ngal dang duk-ngal gyi gyu dang drelwar gyur chik...
oraciones.textoTraducido: May all sentient beings have happiness and the causes of happiness (Unconditional Love - Metta)! May all beings be free from suffering and the causes of suffering (Compassion - Karuna)! May all beings never be separated from the sacred joy devoid of pain (Empathic Joy - Mudita)! May all beings remain in great equanimity, free from attachment and aversion (Upekkha)!

oraciones.titulo: Kurukulla Mantra (Red Tara) – Spiritual Magnetism and Harmony in Relationships
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Kurukulle Hrih Soha
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Kurukulla Mantra (Red Tara). May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Short Namgyalma Mantra (Ushnishavijaya) – Longevity and Radiant Purification
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Bhrum Soha | Om Amrita Ayur Dade Soha
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om Bhrum Soha! From the crown of the Enlightened One emanates radiant victory over unfavorable rebirths and premature death. May the nectar of longevity and total purification illuminate the present life of all beings.

oraciones.titulo: Cheonsugyeong (천수경 – Thousand Hands Sutra) – Daily Liturgy of South Korea
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: 정구업진언: 수리수리 마하수리 수수리 사바하 (淨口業眞言) ۞ 개경게: 무상심심미묘법 백천만겁난조우...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Suri suri maha-suri susu-ri sabaha | Mu-sang sim-sim mi-myo-beop baek-cheon-man-geop nan-jo-u...
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Cheonsugyeong (천수경. May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Sám Hối Hồng Danh (Prayer of Repentance and Salutation to the Buddhas of Vietnam)
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: Đệ tử chúng con từ vô thỉ đến nay, tạo nhiều nghiệp chướng... Nay đối trước mười phương Chư Phật, chí tâm sám hối.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: De tu chung con tu vo thi den nay, tao nhieu nghiep chuong... Nay doi truoc muoi phuong Chu Phat, chi tam sam hoi...
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Sám Hối Hồng Danh (Prayer of Repentance and Salutation to the Buddhas of Vietnam). May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Cundi Bodhisattva Mantra (Chuẩn Đề / 準提咒) – Granting of Noble Wishes
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Pali / Sanskrit / Chinese / Tibetano / Japanese / Coreano
oraciones.textoOriginal: Khể thủ quy y Tô-tất-đế, đầu diện đảnh lễ Thất Câu Chi... ۞ Án, chiết lệ chủ lệ chuẩn đề ta bà ha.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Nam mo tat da nam, tam mieu tam bo da, cau chi nam, dat dien tha: Om Cale Cule Cundi Svaha
oraciones.textoTraducido: I prostrate my head in reverence before the Great Mother Cundi of eighteen arms, protector of the noble vows. Om Cale Cule Cundi Svaha! Grant success in virtuous deeds, dissolve obstacles, and shower blessings of peace on all families.

oraciones.titulo: Mantra of Buddha Sakyamuni – The Sage of the Sakyas Clan
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Tadyatha Om Muni Muni Maha Muni Shakyamuniye Soha
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh! Wise, wise, great sage, victorious Sakyamuni. Awaken in my mind the perfect serenity, discernment and compassionate detachment that dissolve all confusion. Soha!

oraciones.titulo: Ushnisha Sitatapatra (The Goddess of the White Umbrella) – Invincible Mantle of Protection
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Sarva Tathagatoshnisha Sitatapatre Hum Phat | Hum Mama Hum Ni Soha
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Ushnisha Sitatapatra (The Goddess of the White Umbrella). May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Vajrapani Mantra – Indestructible Strength and Dissolution of Hidden Fears
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Vajrapani Hum
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Vajrapani Mantra. May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Prajñaparamita Mantra – The Great Mantra of Transcendent Wisdom
oraciones.textoOriginal: गते गते पारगते पारसंगते बोधि स्वाहा॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Gate Gate Paragate Parasamgate Bodhi Svaha
oraciones.textoTraducido: Gone, gone, gone beyond, gone completely to the other shore of awakening! Glory to the Supreme Illumination that frees us from all attachment and illusion! Swaha!

oraciones.titulo: Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva (Da Shi Zhi Pusa / 大勢至菩薩) – Direct Light of Wisdom
oraciones.textoOriginal: 南無大勢至菩薩摩訶薩 (Nanmo Da Shi Zhi Pusa Mahasattva)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Nanmo Da Shi Zhi Pusa Mahasattva
oraciones.textoTraducido: I take refuge in the Bodhisattva Mahasthamaprapta, personification of spiritual strength and the light of understanding. May His wisdom illuminate my path to distance myself from error and achieve blissful communion with the Pure Land.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Bardo Thodol (The Tibetan Book of the Dead) – Guide in Transition
oraciones.textoOriginal: ཀྱེ་མ་བདག་ལ་སྲིད་པ་བར་དོ་འཆར་དུས་འདིར། བློ་རྩེ་གཅིག་ཏུ་སྨོན་ལམ་འདེབས་པར་བྱེད...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Kye ma dak la sipa bardo char dui dir | Lo tse chik tu monlam debpar je...
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Prayer of Bardo Thodol (The Tibetan Book of the Dead). May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Aspiration to the 48 Great Vows of Amitabha
oraciones.textoOriginal: 設我得佛，十方眾生，至心信樂，欲生我國，乃至十念，若不生者，不取正覺。
oraciones.guiaFonetica: She wo de Fo, shi fang zhong sheng, zhi xin xin le, yu sheng wo guo, nai zhi shi nian, ruo bu sheng zhe, bu qu zheng jue.
oraciones.textoTraducido: If upon attaining Buddhahood, the beings of the ten directions who trust with sincere faith and long to be reborn in my Pure Land of Peace were not received even after ten invocations of the heart: I will not achieve supreme enlightenment. Fully trusting in Your compassionate vote, Namu Amida Butsu!

oraciones.titulo: Metta Bhavana – Cultivation of Universal Benevolent Love
oraciones.textoOriginal: अहं सुखितो होमि, निद्दुक्खो होमि, अवेरो होमि, अब्यापज्झो होमि, अनीघो होमि, सुखी अत्तानं परिहरामि॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Aham sukhito homi, niddukkho homi, avero homi, abyapajjho homi, anigho homi, sukhi attanam pariharami...
oraciones.textoTraducido: May I be free from enmities and dangers; may he be free from mental and physical affliction; May he be full of peace and take care of me with well-being. And just as I wish for myself, that all beings: friends, strangers and those who have offended me, are free of resentment, enjoy health and achieve perfect peace.

oraciones.titulo: Karaniya Metta Sutta – The Sacred Practice of Boundless Benevolence
oraciones.textoOriginal: करणीयमत्थकुसलेन यन्तं सन्तं पदं अभिसमेच्च। सक्को उजू च सूजू च सुवचो चस्स मुदु अनतिमानी॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Karaniyam-attha-kusalena yantam santam padam abhisamecca | Sakko uju ca suju ca suvaco c'assa mudu anatimanī ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Karaniya Metta Sutta. May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Ti-Sarana – The Sacred Taking of Refuge in the Three Jewels
oraciones.textoOriginal: बुद्धं सरणं गच्छामि। धम्मं सरणं गच्छामि। सङ्घं सरणं गच्छामि॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Buddham saranam gacchami | Dhammam saranam gacchami | Sangham saranam gacchami ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: I take refuge in the Buddha (the Awakened and Guiding One). I take refuge in the Dhamma (Truth and the Path). I take refuge in the Sangha (the Noble Community of Practitioners). For the second and third time, I take refuge in the Three Sacred Jewels.

oraciones.titulo: Panca Sila – The Five Sacred Precepts of Moral Conduct
oraciones.textoOriginal: पाणातिपाता वेरमणी सिक्खापदं समादियामि। अदिन्नादाना वेरमणी सिक्खापदं समादियामि। कामेसुमिच्छाचारा वेरमणी सिक्खापदं समादियामि। मुसावादा वेरमणी सिक्खापदं समादियामि। सुरामेरयमज्जपमादट्ठाना वेरमणी सिक्खापदं समादियामि॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Panatipata veramani sikkhapadam samadiyami | Adinnadana veramani sikkhapadam samadiyami | Kamesu micchacara veramani sikkhapadam samadiyami | Musavada veramani sikkhapadam samadiyami | Sura-meraya-majja-pamadatthana veramani sikkhapadam samadiyami ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: I assume the precept of refraining from harming life; I assume the precept of not taking what does not belong to me; I assume the precept of ethical and respectful sexual conduct; I assume the precept of abstaining from false or hurtful words; I assume the precept of abstaining from intoxicating substances that cloud the mind and cause carelessness. May this moral purity bring peace to my being and to the world!

oraciones.titulo: Long Mantra of the Medicine Buddha (Bhaishajyaguru Dharani)
oraciones.textoOriginal: नमो भगवते भैषज्यगुरुवैडूर्यप्रभराजाय तथागतायार्हते सम्यक्सम्बुद्धाय। तद्यथा: ॐ भैषज्ये भैषज्ये महाभैषज्ये भैषज्यसमुद्गते स्वाहा॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Namo Bhagavate Bhaishajyaguru Vaidurya Prabha Rajaya Tathagatayarhate Samyaksambuddhaya | Tadyatha: Om Bhaishajye Bhaishajye Maha-Bhaishajye Bhaishajya Samudgate Svaha ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Reverences to the Blessed Master of Medicine, King of the Light of Lapis Lazuli, the Supreme Enlightened One. Oh! Medicine, medicine, great medicine, may the supreme medicine of wisdom and perfect health arise in all bodies and minds. Swaha!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to White Tara from the Seven Eyes of Compassion
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Tare Tuttare Ture Mama Ayur Jnana Pushtim Kuru Soha
oraciones.textoTraducido: Mother Tara Blanca!, with seven eyes of wisdom and compassion with which you watch over beings in the six realms of suffering. It increases the length of our life, the clarity of our understanding and the virtuous merit to benefit the world. Soha!

oraciones.titulo: Root Praise to Manjushri – The Clear Mind of the Enlightened Ones (Gang Gi Lo Dro)
oraciones.textoOriginal: གང་གི་བློ་གྲོས་སྒྲིབ་གཉིས་སྤྲིན་བྲལ་ཉི་ལྟར་རྣམ་དག་རབ་གསལ་བས...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Gang gi lo dro drip nyi trin drel nyi tar nam dak rab sal we...
oraciones.textoTraducido: He whose intelligence is pure and radiant as the sun free from the clouds of deception; who holds close to his heart the sacred text of Transcendent Wisdom and wields the flaming sword that nips suffering in the bud: homage to Manjushri, the Lord of Supreme Wisdom!

oraciones.titulo: Invocation to Chenrezig (Avalokiteshvara) – Océano of Compasión Viviente
oraciones.textoOriginal: ཇོ་བོ་སྐྱོན་གྱིས་མ་གོས་སྐུ་དོག་དཀར། རྫོགས་སངས་རྒྱས་ཀྱིས་དབུ་ལ་བརྒྱན། ཐུགས་རྗེའི་སྤྱན་གྱིས་འགྲོ་ལ་གཟིགས། སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ལ་ཕྱག་འཚལ་ལོ།
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Jowo kyon gyi ma go ku dok kar | Dzok sangye kyi u la gyen | Thukje chen gyi dro la zik | Chenrezik la chak tsal lo
oraciones.textoTraducido: Immaculate and pure, with a radiant and white body; crowned by the light of Amitabha Buddha; looking upon all beings with eyes of infinite compassion: I prostrate myself before You, Noble Avalokiteshvara! Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Mantra of Hayagriva – Protection Intensa against Obstáculos Internos and Externos
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Hrih Padmantakrita Vajra Krodha Hayagriva Hum Phat
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Mantra of Hayagriva. May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Night Aspiration to the Light of Sukhavati (Dewachen)
oraciones.textoOriginal: 愿生西方净土中，九品莲花为父母。花开见佛悟无生，不退菩萨为伴侣。
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Yuan sheng xi fang jing tu zhong, jiu pin lian hua wei fu mu. Hua kai jian Fo wu wu sheng, bu tui pu sa wei ban lu.
oraciones.textoTraducido: I vow to be reborn in the Pure Land of the West, having the nine-degree lotus flower as my cradle. When the flower opens, I will contemplate the Buddha and realize the unborn truth, having as inseparable companions the Bodhisattvas who never retreat. Namu Amida Butsu!

oraciones.titulo: Moyugba Completes Lucumí – Solemn Permission to Olodumare, Eggun and Orishas
oraciones.textoOriginal: Moyugba Olofin, Moyugba Olorun, Moyugba Olodumare. Olorun Alabosudayé, Olorun Alabosunifé. Olorun Alayé, Olorun Elemí. Moyugba Ashedá, Moyugba Akodá...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Moyugba Olofin, Moyugba Olorun, Moyugba Olodumare...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I pay homage and ask permission to the Supreme God (Olofin, Olorun, Olodumare), Creator of heaven and earth, Giver of life and breath. I pay tribute to the wise spirits of creation, to all the elder ancestors who rest in the light (Eggun), to my spiritual godfathers and godmothers, and to all the Orisha saints of the pantheon. May God's blessing and Ashé open my words, cleanse my path of negativity and bring health, peace and prosperity to my life. Ashe!

oraciones.titulo: Oriki Olodumare – Praise to the Sovereign Creator of the Universe
oraciones.textoOriginal: Olodumare, Oba Aterere Kaye. Olorun Eledumare, Alaye, Eleti Gbaroye. A dupe lowo Re...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Olodumare, Oba Aterere Kaye...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Olodumare, Almighty King who spreads His mantle of grace over the entire universe! Owner of life, possessor of the infinite Ashé, You who listen to the cry of the needy and guide the destinies of the world: we thank you for the gift of air, the sun and existence. Bless our families, give us understanding and remove all evil from us. Olodumare was going!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Olorun al Amanecer – Salutación al Sol and the Fuerza of the Vida
oraciones.textoOriginal: Olorun Kokoibere, Olorun Mo dupe fun ojo oni. Gba mi, wo mi, dabobo mi...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Olorun Kokoibere, Olorun Mo dupe fun ojo oni...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Olorun, Heavenly Source of the sun and living energy! As I see the glow of this new day, I thank you for allowing me to wake up healthy and clear. Awaken vitality within me, dissolve laziness and the shadows of the night, and make my actions today worthy and blessed under Your sacred light.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Olofin – Supplication of Blessing Suprema and Manto Protector
oraciones.textoOriginal: Olofin Orun, Iba Re o. Fun mi ni Alafia, fun mi ni Ilera, fun mi ni Iwa Pele...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Olofin Orun, Iba Re o...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Supreme Olofin! I prostrate my heart before Your infinite majesty. Grant me Alafia (perfect peace), Ilera (unbreakable health) and Iwa Pele (good character and moral uprightness). May Your mantle cover my head and may no witchcraft or evil tongue be able to overthrow the blessing that You have decreed for my life. Ashe!

oraciones.titulo: Oriki Ori – Prayer and Praise to the Spiritual Head and Destiny
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ori mi, gbe mi o. Ori mi, la mi o. Ori lo nda eni, kosi orisa ti da ni lehin Ori...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ori mi, gbe mi o. Ori mi, la mi o...
oraciones.textoTraducido: My own Ori (my divine head), lift me up and guide me to success! My Ori, bless me with wisdom and prosperity. It is Ori who forges the person's destiny; No Orisha blesses a human being without the consent of his own Ori. My head, do not allow me to make wrong decisions; Align my thoughts with the light and lead me to the fullness of my mission on Earth. Ashé Ori mi!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Rogación of Cabeza (Kofibori Eleda) – Purificación and Frescura Mental
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ori Eleda e, Ori Alafia. Omi tutu, Ona tutu, Ile tutu, Eleda tutu. Ori Ofo kosi, Ori Arun kosi, Ori Iku kosi...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ori Eleda e, Ori Alafia. Omi tutu...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Creative head, head blessed with peace and freshness! With this pure water and these sacred elements I refresh my mind and my spirit. May there be freshness in my path, freshness in my home and freshness in my thoughts. Let loss go away (Ofo), let illness go away (Arun), let premature death go away (Iku) and let tranquility and well-being reign. Ashe!

oraciones.titulo: I pray to Elegguá for the Immediate Opening of Roads and Prosperity
oraciones.textoOriginal: Elegguá, Laroye Asukere Bi Koko, Eshu Alawana, nikan gba gbogbo nlo. Fun mi ni ire owo, ire oma, ire arikú babawa...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Eleggua, Laroye Asukere Bi Koko...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Elegguá, Laroye, owner of the corners and opener of all the doors of the universe! With your guava doodle, remove the stones, the stumbling blocks and the obstacles from my path. Open for me the doors of honest employment, blessed money, lucid intelligence and lasting health. Do not allow evil to reach me nor let anyone close what you open for me. Hey Laroye, Ashe!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Eshu Laroye – Protection Feroz against Traiciones and Envidias
oraciones.textoOriginal: Eshu Laroye, kosi iku, kosi arun, kosi ofo, kosi eyo. Gbogbo osogbo unlo...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Eshu Laroye, kosi iku, kosi arun...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Eshu Laroye, tireless guardian of the entrance to my house! Keep sudden death, contagious disease, material loss and discord with neighbors far from my door. Disrupt the traps that my hidden enemies lay behind my back and return with justice every bad intention turned into a blessing for my home. Hey, I give you coconut and tobacco with respect!

oraciones.titulo: I pray to Elegguá Alagbana – The Lonely Wanderer of the Crossroads
oraciones.textoOriginal: Eshu Alagbana, oba kaye, olorun awo, baba mi ma se mi o...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Eshu Alagbana, oba kaye...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Elegguá Alagbana, lord of lonely paths and difficult decisions! When I find myself at a crossroads and don't know where to go, show me the safe path of victory and peace. Keep me from the trap at night and accompany me on every journey. Ashe!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Oggún – Firmeza, Empleo Digno and Fuerza for the Work and Employment Duro
oraciones.textoOriginal: Oggún Kobú Kobú, Oggún Arere, Alagbede Orun. Baba Oggún, fun mi ni agbara lati sise, fun mi ni ise owo...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Oggun Kobu Kobu, Oggun Arere...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oggún, great blacksmith of the sky and invincible warrior of the mountain! You who make your way through the thick jungle with your steel machete: cut unemployment, laziness and scarcity from my life. Give me strength in my arms to work honestly, bless the tools of my trade and defend my family with your iron armor. Ogunhê, Oggún Arere!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Oggún – Protection against Accidentes, Cirugías and Armas of Fuego
oraciones.textoOriginal: Oggún Onile, wo mi san, ma je ki nri ejo, ma je ki nri ewu irin...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Oggun Onile, wo mi san...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Powerful Oggún, owner of all metals and protector of iron roads! I beg you to spare me from crashes, falls, cut wounds and firearms. Guide the hands of the surgeons if I have to undergo surgery, heal my bones and joints, and make metal an instrument of health for me and never of harm. Ashé Oggún!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Ochosi – Flecha Certera for the Justice Divina and Asuntos Legales
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ochosi Ode Mata, Baba Onibebe, agbaniyan. Ta ofa Re si gbogbo awon ti nfe ibi mi...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ochosi Ode Mata, Baba Onibebe...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Ochosi, accurate hunter who never misses his shot with his bow and arrow! Great warrior of divine justice and protector of the innocent: launch your arrow of light on my legal issues, exams and difficult procedures. May the truth shine in the courts, may every false accusation be destroyed, and may I achieve my goals with precision and honesty. Ochosi Odde Mata!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Osun – Bastón Firme of the Vida, the Health and the Firmeza
oraciones.textoOriginal: Osun Duro Gangan, Ma Dubule. Duro ti mi, gbe mi leke gbogbo arun ati ewu...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Osun Duro Gangan, Ma Dubule...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Osun, upright guardian who always stands watching over my head! Do not allow my health to fail, do not allow my emotional stability to collapse or my house to falter before the winds of adversity. Keep my crown firm and my life in perfect spiritual balance. Ashe Osun!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Obatalá – Manto of Wisdom, Pureza and Sosiego Mental
oraciones.textoOriginal: Obatalá, Oba Tasa, Baba Arayé, Alabalashe. Fun mi ni Alafia, fun mi ni Oye, pa gbogbo wahala da si alafia...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Obatala, Oba Tasa, Baba Araye...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Obatalá, King of the White Mantle, loving Father of humanity and owner of all heads! You who are the personification of peace, serenity and spotless justice: calm the nerves of my mind, dissolve anger and resentment, and fill my home with the perfume of harmony and respect. Cover me with your snowy mantle so that my thoughts are pure and luminous. Jekua Baba!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Obatalá Ayáguna – The Guerrero Joven of the Verdad and the Rectitud
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ayáguna, Baba Elejigbo, jagunjagun alafia. Ba mi ja ija emi mi...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ayaguna, Baba Elejigbo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Obatalá Ayáguna, brave warrior of the heights and defender of righteousness! With your silver sword and your white steed, help me overcome my own weaknesses, indecision and cowardice. Give me strength to defend the innocent and keep me invincible in the line of duty. Ashé Ayáguna!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Changó – Rayo Purificador and Victory over the Falsedad
oraciones.textoOriginal: Changó, Oba Koso, Alafin de Oyo, Ina Loju. Kawo Kabiosile! Gba mi lowo awon ota mi, bukun mi pelu agbara ati ola...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Chango, Oba Koso, Alafin de Oyo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Changó, King of Kings, Lord of thunder, lightning and the sacred drum! Kawo Kabiosile! You whose voice shakes the hypocrites and whose fiery sword consumes lies: arise in my defense. Disrupt slander, attract charisma and respect to me, and grant me the strength and dignity of a true winner. Kawo Kabiosile Changó!

oraciones.titulo: I pray to Changó with 6 Apples – Attraction of Abundance and Passion
oraciones.textoOriginal: Baba Changó, eleduwa ina, mo mu eso didun wa fun O. Fun mi ni ire aje, ire ife, ire ogo...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Baba Chango, eleduwa ina...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Dear Father Changó! With respect and joy I offer you the sweetness of red fruits and the light of candles. Light in my life the fire of economic prosperity, the passionate vigor to undertake my projects and sincere and reciprocated love. May your blessing fill my pockets with abundance and my heart with joy. Ashe!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Ochún with Honey – Attraction of Money, Wealth and Sweetness in Life
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ochún Yeyé Kari, Yalode, Iyalode Ibu Akuaro, Ofe Owo, Ofe Ire. Ba mi se o, Oloyeye mi...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ochun Yeye Kari, Yalode...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Ochún, most beautiful and merciful Mother, Queen of the River and Lady of Resplendent Gold! With the honey of your waters, sweeten my destiny, drive away the bitterness of scarcity and attract prosperity, well-earned money and good fortune to my hands. Make my life shine with your charm and may my home never lack food, joy or love. Yalodde Yeye Ochún!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Ochún – Blessing of the Love of a Couple, Fertility and Motherhood
oraciones.textoOriginal: Iya mi Ochún, Alade Ogo, fun mi ni omo, fun mi ni ife gidi, dabobo awon omo mi...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Iya mi Ochun, Alade Ogo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Sweet Mother Ochún, protector of wombs and newborns! Pour out your blessing on pregnant mothers, heal the reproductive organs and grant the miracle of fertility to those who long to be parents. Unite couples in sincere love, loyalty and tenderness, and care for children under your mantle of golden waterfalls. Pray Yê Yê Ô!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Ochún Ibú Kolé – The Messenger who Saves the People from Catastrophe
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ochún Ibu Kole, Akalamagbo, Iya ti nfi ebo ranse si Olorun. Gba wa lowo ogbele ati osi...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ochun Ibu Kole, Akalamagbo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Ochún Ibú Kolé, humble and wise Lady who, in the form of a tingy aura, flew to the heavens to carry the prayers of humanity and save the world from drought! Hear my humble request, raise my prayers before Olofin and transmute my scarcity into sustenance, health and miraculous victory. Ashe!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Yemayá – Purification of Pain, Healing and Mantle of Living Waters
oraciones.textoOriginal: Yemayá Asesu, Omio Yemayá! Iya mi Olokun, Iya gbogbo aye. Fo gbogbo ibi mi ninu omi okun re...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Yemaya Asesu, Omio Yemaya!...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Yemayá, Mother of the World, Lady of the seven seas and the protective waves! Omio Yemayá! I come to your sacred waters to deliver my tears, my sadness and my illnesses. Wash away with your beneficent foam all the pain in my heart, heal my physical and mental body, and embrace me with the maternal tenderness that renews life. Omio Yemayá!

oraciones.titulo: I pray to Yemayá Okute – The Unconquerable Warrior of the Coasts and Reefs
oraciones.textoOriginal: Yemayá Okute, Iya jagunjagun, iyawo Oggun, alagbara omi. Dabobo mi lowo gbogbo aburu...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Yemaya Okute, Iya jagunjagun...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Yemayá Okute, brave mother and warrior of the rocky coasts! With your silver machete and the contained fury of your tides, defend me from the attacks of evil, break the spells and return peace to my spirit with your indomitable strength. Ashé Yemayá Okute!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Oyá – The Force of the Spark that Breaks the Darkness and Opens New Directions
oraciones.textoOriginal: Oyá Yansa, Jekua Hey! Iya mesan orun, iya afefe, iya ina. Gba mi lowo awon aje ati oso...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Oya Yansa, Jekua Hey!...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oyá Yansá, Mother of the nine winds and owner of the spark! Jekua Hey Oyá! With your sacred iruke, sweep away all stagnant energy, witchcraft, evil eye or spiritual disturbance from my aura. Give me the courage of the warrior to face the transcendent changes of life and make my way towards a renewed and victorious destiny. Jekua Hey!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Babalú Ayé (Saint Lázaro / Asojano) – Supplication of Milagro of Health
oraciones.textoOriginal: Babalú Ayé, Asojano, Baba mi Alawana, Olode. Wo mi san, gba mi lowo arun ati iponju...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Babalu Aye, Asojano, Baba mi Alawana...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Babalú Ayé, dear Asojano, pious doctor of the wounded and comforter of the incurably sick! Prostrated before you with profound humility, I beg you to extend your blessing over my suffering body and over all the sick people in my family. Keeps away pests, chronic pain and serious illnesses; grant us health and teach us to live with patience, charity and gratitude. Jekua Babalú Ayé!

oraciones.titulo: I pray to Orunmila (Ifá) – Witness of Creation and Guide to Destiny
oraciones.textoOriginal: Orunmila Iború, Orunmila Iboya, Orunmila Ibosheshé. Baba Ifá, Eleri Ipin, Ibikeji Olodumare. Ko mi si ona ire...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Orunmila Iboru, Orunmila Iboya, Orunmila Ibosheshe...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Orunmila, Eleri Ipin (Witness of Human Destiny and Second after God)! I pay tribute to your infinite wisdom. You who know the beginning and the end of all beings: guide me along the path of Ire (blessing), free me from Osogbo (misfortune) and grant me the prudence and intelligence to make the best decisions in my earthly life. Iboru, Iboya, Ibosheshe!

oraciones.titulo: Ifá Odu 1: Eji Ogbe (Baba Ejiogbe) – The Gran Despertar of the Luz and the Doble Victory
oraciones.textoOriginal: Baba Eji Ogbe, Alafia ni ire owo, ire omo, ire arikú. Orunmila ni ki a gbe ire de...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Baba Eji Ogbe, Alafia ni ire owo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Olofin and the Holy Orishas, we lift our devotion and prayer for Ifá Odu 1: Eji Ogbe (Baba Ejiogbe). We come with reverence before the blessed spiritual powers to remove all negativity, disturbance and heavy burdens, firmly opening the pathways to health, peace, progress and abundance in our home. Ashé to iban Eshu! Amen.

oraciones.textoOriginal: Oyeku Meyi, Baba ti npa Iku da si emi gigun. Kosi iku, kosi arun...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Oyeku Meyi, Baba ti npa Iku da...
