oraciones.textoOriginal: Ofun Meyi, Baba ti nmu ire wa lehin iponju. Afeefe rere...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ofun Meyi, Baba ti nmu ire wa...

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Inle (Erinle) – Healer of Diseases and Protector of Physicians
oraciones.textoOriginal: Inle Abata, Oloogun Orun, Onisegun alaafin. Wo mi san pelu ewe ati omi re...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Inle Abata, Oloogun Orun...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Inle, celestial doctor of radiant beauty and lord of the waters where the river and the sea meet! Guide diagnoses, heal ailments, and bless healthcare professionals. Ashe Inle!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Ozain (Osanyin) – Blessing of the Hierbas Sagradas (Ewe) and the Omiero
oraciones.textoOriginal: Kurin Kurin Kurin Ewe, Ozain Ewe Owo, Ewe Omo, Ewe Arikú Babawa...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Kurin Kurin Kurin Ewe...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Ozain, owner of all the leaves, roots and healing secrets of the mountain! Awaken the medicinal Ashé of each plant to cleanse our auras, cure our illnesses and ward off all negativity. Ateko Ozain!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to the Ibejis (Taewo and Kainde) – Alegría Infantil, Protection and Buena Fortuna
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ibeji Oro, Omo Kekere, fun mi ni ayo, fun mi ni orire...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ibeji Oro, Omo Kekere...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Sacred jimaguas, divine children of happiness and quick luck! With your sweets and holy pranks, drive away sadness from our home and bring laughter and good fortune to our lives. Ashé Ibejis!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Olokun – Firmeza Inamovible, Health and Secretos of the Océano Profundo
oraciones.textoOriginal: Olokun, Oba nla ti ngbe isale okun, Olugbe rere. Fun mi ni ilera ati ipo to duro...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Olokun, Oba nla ti ngbe isale okun...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Olokun, immeasurable ruler of the deep sea! Grant me the immovable stability of the abysses of the sea, iron health and protection against the storms of the world. Ashé Olokun!

oraciones.titulo: Oriki Eggun – Invocation and Honor the Spirits of the Ancestors
oraciones.textoOriginal: Aumba wa ori, Aumba wa ori, awa osun, awa oma, leri oya, Eggun lelekun...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Aumba wa ori, Aumba wa ori...
oraciones.textoTraducido: We honor all the spirits of our ancestors who preceded us on the path of life! We send them light, fresh water and prayers. May their wisdom guide us, may their blessings protect us and may they rest in the peace of Olofin. Ibae Bayen Tonu Eggun!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to the Corte Africana (Espiritismo of María Lionza / Venezuela) – Fuerza and Rompimiento
oraciones.textoOriginal: En el nombre del Gran Dios Todopoderoso y de la Reina María Lionza, invoco a la Poderosa Corte Africana...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: En el nombre del Gran Dios Todopoderoso...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Olofin and the Holy Orishas, we lift our devotion and prayer for the Corte Africana (Espiritismo of María Lionza / Venezuela). We come with reverence before the blessed spiritual powers to remove all negativity, disturbance and heavy burdens, firmly opening the pathways to health, peace, progress and abundance in our home. Ashé to iban Eshu! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Gran Invocation to the Siete Potencias Africanas (Cuba and Puerto Rico) – Shelter & Refuge Universal
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Oh Siete Potencias Africanas! Siete rayos de luz que iluminan los caminos de la humanidad: Elegguá, Oggún, Ochosi, Obatalá, Changó, Yemayá y Ochún...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Oh Siete Potencias Africanas...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Seven African Powers, blessed messengers of God! I prostrate myself before his presence to implore his protection. Elegguá, open the doors of fortune for me. Oggún, defend me from the enemy. Ochosi, straighten my path. Obatalá, cover me with your mantle of peace. Changó, give me strength in the face of injustice. Yemayá, purify me with your holy waters. Ochún, sweeten my life with love and prosperity. Amen, Ashe!

oraciones.titulo: Eshu Bi – The Guardian Child Who Protects Children from Danger
oraciones.textoOriginal: Iba Eshu Bi – El Niño Guardián que Protege a los Hijos del Peligro, Awa se ebo fun Alafia ati Ire Gbogbo. Ashé Olodumare!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Iba Eshu Bi – El Niño Guardián que Protege a los Hijos del Peligro, Awa se ebo fun Alafia...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Praise and veneration to Eshu Bi – The Guardian Child Who Protects Children from Danger! We offer you our sincere respect to achieve inner peace, perfect health and prosperity on our path. May your sacred Ashé remove all obstacles, grant us firmness and protect our families from all evil. Ashé, Ashé, Ashé!

oraciones.titulo: Eshu Afrá – The Guardian of the Hospital that Keeps Epidemics Away

oraciones.guiaFonetica: Iba Eshu Afrá – El Guardián del Hospital que Aleja las Epidemias, Awa se ebo fun Alafia...

oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Olofin and the Holy Orishas, we lift our devotion and prayer for Ofun Trupo. We come with reverence before the blessed spiritual powers to remove all negativity, disturbance and heavy burdens, firmly opening the pathways to health, peace, progress and abundance in our home. Ashé to iban Eshu! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Ofun Tura – The Light of True Devotion to Olofin
oraciones.textoOriginal: Omí tutu, oná tutu, ilé tutu, owó tutu, omó tutu, ariku babawa. Ashé gbogbo kaleno osha, modupué Olofin, modupué Orisha. Ashé!

oraciones.titulo: Salat al-Fatih (The Prayer of the Opener) – Supreme Supplication of the Tijaniyya Order in Nigeria
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الفَاتِحِ لِمَا أُغْلِقَ، وَالخَاتِمِ لِمَا سَبَقَ، نَاصِرِ الحَقِّ بِالحَقِّ، وَالهَادِي إِلَى صِرَاطِكَ المُسْتَقِيمِ...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Allahumma salli 'ala sayyidina Muhammadinil-Fatihi lima ughliqa, wal-khatimi lima sabaqa, Nasiril-haqqi bil-haqq, wal-Hadi ila siratikal-mustaqim...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh our God! Send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Opener of what was closed, the Seal of the former prophets, the Defender of Truth through Truth, and the Guide to Your straight path; and pour out Your peace on his family to the extent of his immense worth and dignity before You. Open for us the doors of good, wisdom and spiritual prosperity. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Jawharat al-Kamal (The Pearl of Perfection) – Mystical Supplication of Friday Dhikr
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى عَيْنِ الرَّحْمَةِ الرَّبَّانِيَّةِ، وَاليَاقُوتَةِ المُتَحَقِّقَةِ، الحَائِطَةِ بِمَرْكَزِ الفُهُومِ وَالمَعَانِي...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Allahumma salli wa sallim 'ala 'aynir-rahmatir-rabbaniyyati, wal-yaqutatil-mutahaqqiqati, al-ha'itati bi-markazil-fuhumi wal-ma'ani...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh our God! Send blessings and peace upon the Source of Divine Mercy, the Ruby of Pure Truth that encompasses the center of all spiritual understanding and knowledge; the Light of the Cosmos that illuminates all the paths of existence. Fill me with Your grace, purify my mind and make me walk in the serenity of Your love.

oraciones.titulo: Hizb al-Bahr (The Letanía of the Mar) – Protection against Peligros, Tempestades and Travesías
oraciones.textoOriginal: يَا عَلِيُّ يَا عَظِيمُ، يَا حَلِيمُ يَا عَلِيمُ، أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَعِلْمُكَ حَسْبِي، فَنِعْمَ الرَّبُّ رَبِّي، وَنِعْمَ الحَسْبُ حَسْبِي...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya 'Aliyyu Ya 'Azim, Ya Halimu Ya 'Alim, Anta Rabbi wa 'ilmuka hasbi, fa-ni'mar-Rabbu Rabbi, wa ni'mal-hasbu hasbi...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Most High, oh Great One, oh Patient, oh Omniscient! You are my Lord and Your knowledge is enough for me; how excellent Lord is my Lord, and how perfect Protector is my Protector! Grant us victory in our affairs, calm the storms of our lives, protect us from oppressors and facilitate our travels by land, sea and air.

oraciones.titulo: Supplication of Sheikh Usman dan Fodio – Prayer for Peace Social, Rectitud and Justice
oraciones.textoOriginal: رَبَّنَا أَصْلِحْ وُلَاةَ أُمُورِنَا، وَانْشُرِ العَدْلَ وَالأَمْنَ فِي بِلَادِنَا، وَارْزُقْنَا العِلْمَ النَّافِعَ وَالعَمَلَ الصَّالِحَ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Rabbana aslih wulata umurina, wanshuril-'adla wal-amna fi biladina, warzuqnal-'ilman-nafi'a wal-'amalas-salih
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh our Lord! Correct and inspire our rulers and leaders with wisdom; extends justice, security and peace throughout our land; grant us useful knowledge and righteous deeds, and free our society from discord, poverty and ignorance.

oraciones.titulo: Munajat of Nana Asma'u of Sokoto – Plea for Consolation for Mothers, Orphans and the Sick
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَؤُوفُ بِالعِبَادِ، اشْفِ مَرْضَانَا، وَارْحَمْ ضُعَفَاءَنَا، وَبَارِكْ فِي أُمَّهَاتِنَا وَأَطْفَالِنَا
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Allahumma Ya Ra'ufu bil-'ibad, ishfi mardana, warham du'afa'ana, wa barik fi ummahatina wa atfalina
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh God, Full of Pity and Tenderness for Your servants! Heal our sick, help the orphans and the helpless, bless mothers in their sacrifices and care for our children so that they grow in righteousness, knowledge and brotherly love.

oraciones.titulo: Addu'ar Neman Tsari (Hausa) – Supplication of Protection against the Mal of Ojo and the Envidia
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ya Allah! Ka tsare mu daga sharrin mahassada, da sharrin mugun ido, da sharrin asiri, ka bamu kariya dare da rana.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Allah! Ka tsare mu daga sharrin mahassada...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Almighty Allah! Protect us from the evil of the envious when he envies, from the damage of the evil eye and from any hidden trap. Be our defending shield night and day, and fill our house with tranquility and divine security.

oraciones.titulo: Addu'ar Zaman Lafiya da Arziki (Hausa) – Peace Comunitaria and Prosperity Digna
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ya Ubangiji! Ka kawo mana zaman lafiya a kasar mu, ka albarkaci kasuwancin mu da gonakin mu, ka bamu abinci na halal.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Ubangiji! Ka kawo mana zaman lafiya...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Lord and our Creator! Spread peace in our communities and families; bless our businesses, farms and crops with abundance; Give us dignified and honest sustenance, and free us from scarcity and overwhelming debts.

oraciones.titulo: Addu'ar Neman Waraka da Lafiya (Hausa) – Prayer of Healing Corporal and Espiritual
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ya Allah, Mai warkarwa! Ka yaye mana wannan rashin lafiya, ka baiwa jikin mu lafiya da karfi.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Allah, Mai warkarwa! Ka yaye mana...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh God, the Supreme Healer! Remove all illness from us, relieve body pain, restore the vitality of our forces and grant us prolonged health to serve you with joy and devotion.

oraciones.titulo: Adua Asiri Bibo (Yoruba Musulmán) – Supplication of Provision Secreta and Dignidad Financiera
oraciones.textoOriginal: Olohun Oba, bo asiri wa o. Ma je ki a ri itiju l'aye ati l'orun. Fun wa ni ounje ati oro to dara.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Olohun Oba, bo asiri wa o...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Allah, Sovereign King! Cover our needs with Your secret blessing and do not allow us to suffer shame or financial humiliation in this world or the hereafter. Open the fountains of abundant provision and bless our hands.

oraciones.titulo: Adua fun Idabobo Ile ati Omo (Yoruba Muslim) – Home and Children Protection Fence
oraciones.textoOriginal: Olohun Oludabobo, dabobo ile wa, dabobo awon omo wa lowo ewu ati aburu gbogbo. Je ki alafia joba ninu ile wa.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Olohun Oludabobo, dabobo ile wa...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Protector God! Keep our house and our children from all danger, illness and bad company. May peace, harmony and mutual love reign permanently in our home.

oraciones.titulo: Nigerian Islamic Supplication for Faith and Light (01/18) – Community Devotion
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَعَافِنَا وَارْزُقْنَا وَاهْدِنَا صِرَاطَكَ المُسْتَقِيمَ (1)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Allahummagh-fir lana warhamna wa 'afina warzuqna...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh our God! Forgive us our faults, have mercy on us, grant us perfect health, grant us worthy sustenance and always guide us along Your straight path. Bless our people with peace and brotherhood. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Mountain of Fire (MFM - Dr. D.K. Olukoya) – Prayer of the Fuego Saint against Altares Malignos
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Holy Ghost Fire, consume every evil altar speaking against my family, health and progress, in the mighty Name of Jesus!»
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Holy Ghost Fire consume every evil altar...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Fire of the Holy Spirit, descend and consume every evil altar, ancestral sorcery or decree of darkness raised against my life, my marriage, my health and my financial advancement! In the glorious Name of Jesus Christ, I break every chain of oppression and claim my total freedom and spiritual victory. Amen!

oraciones.titulo: MFM: My Destiny, Reject Satanic Manipulation – Prayer Against Procrastination and Stagnation
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Every power of delay and backwardness assigned against my divine breakthrough: die by fire, in the Name of Jesus!»
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Every power of delay and backwardness...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the Name of Jesus, I decree that my destiny rejects all satanic manipulation, stagnation and delay. Where they tried to put up barriers of frustration, the Lord unleashes divine acceleration, open doors and fulfillment of His holy purpose. I advance with power and without restraint in Christ! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: MFM: Prayer of Deliverance of Ataques and Pesadillas Nocturnas
oraciones.textoOriginal: «I cancel every negative dream and demonic pollution with the Blood of Jesus, and I reclaim my peace and sound sleep.»
oraciones.guiaFonetica: I cancel every negative dream...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I cancel with the precious Blood of Jesus every nightmare, nocturnal spiritual contamination or attack in sleep. My rest is consecrated to the Lord and the angels of God guard my bed. I go to bed in peace and rise in victory and vigor. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Redeemed Christian Church of God (RCCG - Pastor Adeboye) – Let There Be Light
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Father, in the mighty Name of Jesus: let there be light in my home, let there be light in my health, let there be light in my career!»
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Father in the mighty Name of Jesus let there be light...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy and Almighty Father! In the supreme name of Jesus Christ, we come before Thy glorious presence, proclaiming the power and victory of Thy living Word over Redeemed Christian Church of God (RCCG. Release Thy anointing and the fire of Thy Holy Spirit upon our life, tear down every obstacle, heal every infirmity, and fill us with supernatural strength and joy. To Thee be all the glory, honor, and power forever! Amen and amen.

oraciones.titulo: RCCG: Double Portion of Grace and Supernatural Elevation
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Lord, grant me a double portion of Thy Holy Spirit anointing, that I may excel and glorify Thy Name in all I do.»
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Lord grant me a double portion...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy and Almighty Father! In the supreme name of Jesus Christ, we come before Thy glorious presence, proclaiming the power and victory of Thy living Word over RCCG: Double Portion of Grace and Supernatural Elevation. Release Thy anointing and the fire of Thy Holy Spirit upon our life, tear down every obstacle, heal every infirmity, and fill us with supernatural strength and joy. To Thee be all the glory, honor, and power forever! Amen and amen.

oraciones.titulo: Winners Chapel (Bishop David Oyedepo) – Financial Breakthrough and Success Pact
oraciones.textoOriginal: «By the covenant of Abraham, I enter into my season of supernatural breakthrough, exemption from economic hardship and unprecedented favor!»
oraciones.guiaFonetica: By the covenant of Abraham...
oraciones.textoTraducido: By the eternal covenant of Abraham in Christ Jesus, I enter my season of supernatural breakthrough! I am exempt from the crisis and shortage. The windows of heaven are open on my finances, my mind is blessed with creative ideas and my hands are prosperous in everything they undertake. In the Name of Jesus, Amen!

oraciones.titulo: Winners Chapel (Shiloh): Prayer for the Milagro of the Concepción and Fertilidad
oraciones.textoOriginal: «None shall be barren in the land, saith the Lord. I receive my miracle children in faith, to the glory of God!»
oraciones.guiaFonetica: None shall be barren in the land...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy and Almighty Father! In the supreme name of Jesus Christ, we come before Thy glorious presence, proclaiming the power and victory of Thy living Word over Winners Chapel (Shiloh): Prayer for the Milagro of the Concepción and Fertilidad. Release Thy anointing and the fire of Thy Holy Spirit upon our life, tear down every obstacle, heal every infirmity, and fill us with supernatural strength and joy. To Thee be all the glory, honor, and power forever! Amen and amen.

oraciones.titulo: Ekpere Maka Udo na Ngozi n'Ezi na Ulo (Igbo) – Prayer for Peace and the Blessing of the Home
oraciones.textoOriginal: Chukwu Okike, biko wunye udo na ngozi n'ezinulo anyi. Chekwaa umu anyi, mee ka anyi nwee oganiru.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Chukwu Okike, biko wunye udo na ngozi...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Creator God (Chukwu Okike)! Pour out Your holy peace and Your inexhaustible blessing upon our family. Keep our children from all danger, grant us honest prosperity and keep us united in love and Christian harmony. Amen!

oraciones.titulo: Ekpere Nchekwube na Chukwu (Igbo) – Declaration of Complete Trust in the Most High God
oraciones.textoOriginal: N'ime Chukwu ka m tukwasiri obi m dum. O dighi ihe kariri gi ime, Onye Nwe m.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: N'ime Chukwu ka m tukwasiri obi m dum...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In You, Lord God Most High, I place all my trust. There is nothing impossible for Your power. Although difficulties arise, I know that You fight my battles and crown me with grace and victory.

oraciones.titulo: Adua Aseyori ati Isegun (Yoruba Cristiano) – Prayer of Éxito and Victory Rotunda
oraciones.textoOriginal: Jesu Kristi, Olori Ogun wa, fun mi ni isegun lori gbogbo idiwon aye mi. Je ki nse aseyori ninu gbogbo ona mi.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Jesu Kristi, Olori Ogun wa...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus Christ, Captain of our salvation! Give me victory over every giant and obstacle in my life. May my path be crowned with worthy success, health and blessing as a testimony of Your power.

oraciones.titulo: Nigerian Cry for Faith, Revival and Healing (01/18)
oraciones.textoOriginal: «By the stripes of Jesus I am healed, by His blood I am redeemed, and by His Spirit I walk in total victory.» (1)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: By the stripes of Jesus I am healed...
oraciones.textoTraducido: By the stripes of Jesus I have been healed, by His blood I have been redeemed and by His Holy Spirit I walk in total victory. No affliction will prevail against my life or against my family. In the Name of Jesus, Amen!

oraciones.titulo: Saint Basil the Great – Morning Prayer upon Awakening (Molitvoslov)
oraciones.textoOriginal: От сна востав, благодарю Тя, Святая Троице, яко многия ради Твоея благости и долготерпения не прогневался еси на мя...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ot sna vostav, blagodaryu Tya, Svyataya Troitse, yako mnogiya radi Tvoyeya blagosti...
oraciones.textoTraducido: As I rise from sleep I thank you, oh Holy Trinity!, because by your infinite goodness and patience you have not been angry against this weak servant, but have awakened me to glorify Your power in this new day. Open the eyes of my mind to meditate on Your commandments, and open my lips to praise You from the heart and worship the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Seraphim of Sarov – Prayer to Acquire the Spirit of Inner Peace
oraciones.textoOriginal: Господи Иисусе Христе, Сыне Божий, даруй мне дух мира и тишины сердечной...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Gospodi Iisuse Khriste, Syne Bozhiy, daruy mne dukh mira i tishiny serdechnoy...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God! Grant us to acquire the Holy Spirit of Peace in the depths of our hearts. As Saint Seraphim taught: 'Acquire inner peace and thousands around you will find salvation.' Dissolve anger, remove corrosive sadness and make my soul a home full of Your Easter light and perpetual joy. Christ is risen, my joy! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of the Holy Elders of Optina (Optina Pustyn) – Daily Serenity
oraciones.textoOriginal: Господи, дай мне с душевным спокойствием встретить все, что принесет мне наступающий день. Дай мне всецело предаться воле Твоей святой...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Gospodi, day mne s dushevnym spokoystviyem vstretit' vse, chto prineset mne nastupayushchiy den'...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Mister! Allow me to receive with peace of mind everything that this day that begins brings me. Grant me to surrender completely to Your holy will. In every hour of this day instruct me and guide me. Whatever news I receive throughout the day, teach me to accept it with peace of heart and the firm conviction that Your holy will is manifested in everything. Direct my thoughts and feelings in all my words and actions. In unforeseen events, do not allow me to forget that everything is sent by You. Teach me to act righteously and sensibly with each member of my family! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to the Honorable and Vivificante Cruz (Da voskresnet Bog) – Escudo against the Mal
oraciones.textoOriginal: Да воскреснет Бог, и расточатся врази Его, и да бежат от лица Его ненавидящии Его. Яко исчезает дым, да исчезнут...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Da voskresnet Bog, i rastochatsya vrazi Yego, i da bezhat ot litsa Yego nenavidyashchii Yego...
oraciones.textoTraducido: May God arise and His enemies be dispersed, and all who hate Him may flee from His presence! As smoke vanishes, so may they vanish; As wax melts before fire, so may the forces of evil perish before those who love God and cross themselves with the sign of the Holy Cross, saying with joy: Rejoice, Most Precious and Life-giving Cross of the Lord, who drives away all adversity by the power of our crucified and resurrected Lord Jesus Christ! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint John of Kronstadt – Prayer of Living Faith and Healing of Souls and Bodies
oraciones.textoOriginal: Господи, Имя Тебе Любовь: не отвержи мене заблуждающагося. Имя Тебе Сила: укрепи мене изнемогающаго...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Gospodi, Imya Tebe Lyubov': ne otverzhi mene zabluzhdayushchagosya. Imya Tebe Sila...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the Living God! Through the intercession of the Most Holy Theotokos and the blessed memory and help of Saint John of Kronstadt, pour out Your Holy Spirit upon our life. Purify our mind in the stillness of prayer, grant us health, patience and forgiveness of sins, and guide us to the eternal peace of Your heavenly Kingdom. Amen!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer before the Holy Icon of the Mother of God of Vladimir – Protector of Peoples
oraciones.textoOriginal: О Всемилостивая Госпоже Богородице, Небесная Царице, Всемощная Заступнице! К Тебе прибегаем с верою и любовию...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O Vsemilostivaya Gospozhe Bogoroditse, Nebesnaya Tsaritse...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Most Gracious Sovereign Mother of God, Heavenly Queen and powerful intercessor of our lands! Before your venerated Icon of Vladimir we prostrate ourselves with filial love. Preserve our families from discord, defend the helpless, protect nations from war and calamity, and guide us to reconciliation and holiness in Christ Jesus. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Icon of the Mother of God 'Consolation in Sorrows' (Utole moya pechali) – Relief of Distress
oraciones.textoOriginal: Утоли болезни многовздыхающия души моея, утолившая всякую слезу от лица земли...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Utoli bolezni mnogovzdykhayushchiya dushi moyeya...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Mother of God, who wipes away every tear from afflicted faces! Relieve the sorrows and anguish of my troubled soul; dissolves the depression, loneliness and anguish that weigh on my chest; renew my hope and fill my heart with the heavenly comfort that only comes from God. Amen!

oraciones.titulo: Saint Alexander Nevsky – Prayer for Peace, Moral Courage and Defense of the Weak
oraciones.textoOriginal: «Не в силе Бог, а в правде!» Святый благоверный княже Александре, моли Бога о нас...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ne v sile Bog, a v pravde! Svyatyy blagovernyy knyazhe Aleksandre...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the Living God! Through the intercession of the Most Holy Theotokos and the blessed memory and help of Saint Alexander Nevsky, pour out Your Holy Spirit upon our life. Purify our mind in the stillness of prayer, grant us health, patience and forgiveness of sins, and guide us to the eternal peace of Your heavenly Kingdom. Amen!

oraciones.titulo: Saint Macarius the Great of Egypt and Russia – Morning Purification Supplication
oraciones.textoOriginal: Боже, очисти мя грешнаго, яко николиже сотворих благое пред Тобою; но избави мя от лукаваго...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Bozhe, ochisti mya greshnago, yako nikolizhe sotvorikh blagoye pred Toboyu...
oraciones.textoTraducido: My God! Purify me, for I have never done anything truly good in Your eyes without Your divine grace; Deliver me from the evil one and make Your holy will be fulfilled in me, so that without condemnation I open my lips today to exalt Your Holy Name: Father, Son and Holy Spirit. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint John Damascene – Evening Prayer before Sleep (Vladyko Chelovekoliubche)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Владыко Человеколюбче, неужели мне одр сей гроб будет? Или еще окаянную мою душу просветиши днем?...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Vladyko Chelovekoliubche, neuzheli mne odr sey grob budet?...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Sovereign and Friend of humanity! I entrust my body and my soul into Your merciful hands during the rest of the night. Deliver me from the dark sleep of sin and from every impure disturbance. Send Your holy Guardian Angel to guard my bed, drive away nightmares and grant me to wake up full of vigor and gratitude to serve You in a new dawn. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Russian Orthodox Prayer of the Molitvoslov (01/18) – Devotion of the Saints
oraciones.textoOriginal: Господи помилуй, Господи помилуй, Господи помилуй. Слава Отцу и Сыну и Святому Духу (1)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Gospodi pomiluy, Gospodi pomiluy, Gospodi pomiluy...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord, have mercy (Góspodi Pomíluy)! Fill my life with Your sanctifying grace, comfort my family, forgive our faults and grant us eternal bliss in Your heavenly Kingdom. Amen.

oraciones.textoOriginal: Господи помилуй, Господи помилуй, Господи помилуй. Слава Отцу и Сыну и Святому Духу (12)

oraciones.titulo: Öy häm Ash Duası (Өй һәм аш догасы - Tatar) – Blessing of the Home and Table in Tatarstan
oraciones.textoOriginal: Йә Раббым! Бу йортка бәрәкәт, тынычлык һәм татулык бир. Ризыкларыбызны хәләл һәм мул ит, гаиләбезне бәла-казалардан сакла.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ye Rabbym! Bu yortka bereket, tynychlyk hem tatulyk bir...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Lord and our Creator! Pour into this home Your blessing, peace and mutual harmony. Make our food lawful, pure and abundant; Protect our family from all calamity and discord, and fill our hearts with gratitude and sincere hospitality. Amen!

oraciones.titulo: Safarda Bulganda Ukıla Torgan Doga (Tártaro) – Protection of the Viajero and Familys Ausentes
oraciones.textoOriginal: И Раббыбыз! Юлыбызны уң, сәфәребезне имин кыл. Безне һәм калган гаиләбезне Үз рәхмәтең белән сакла.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: I Rabbybyz! Yulybyzny ung, seferebezne imin kyl...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh our Lord! Make our path auspicious and our journey safe. Protect us from the dangers of the journey, take care of the loved ones we leave at home and allow us to return in peace and well to the bosom of our families.

oraciones.titulo: Täwbä häm Sawlık Dogası (Tatar) – Sincere Repentance and Health for the Elderly
oraciones.textoOriginal: Йә Аллаһ! Гөнаһларыбызны гафу ит, тәнебезгә һәм җаныбызга сәламәтлек бир, өлкәннәребезгә хәерле озын гомер насыйп ит.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ye Allah! Gonahlarybyzny gafu it, tenebezge hem janybyzga selametlek bir...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Merciful Allah! Forgive our faults and errors; grants health and well-being to our body and soul; Bless our elders and parents with a long dignified life, and keep us firm on the path of righteousness and charity.

oraciones.titulo: Salawat-i Sharif of the Kul Sharif Mosque (Kazan) – Blessed Salutation to the Prophet
oraciones.textoOriginal: Аллаһүммә салли галә сәййидинә Мөхәммәдин вә галә әлиһи вә сәхбиһи вә сәллим. Йә Раббым, безгә Үзеңнең рәхмәтеңне иңдер.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Allahumme salli gale seyyidine Mehemmedin ve gale elihi ve sehbihi ve sellim...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh our God! Send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, his family and his companions. Pour out on our land of Tatarstan and on the entire world Your mercy, brotherly understanding between peoples and peace in hearts.

oraciones.titulo: Sheikh Kunta-Haji Kishiev (Chechenia) – Prayer for Peace, the No-Violencia and the Fraternidad
oraciones.textoOriginal: Делера салам хуьлда! Дала машар а, беррт а лойла вайна, тIом а, девнеш а дIадойла вайн лаьтта тIера.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Delera salam khuylda! Dala mashar a, berrt a loyla vayna...
oraciones.textoTraducido: The peace of God be with all! We pray to the Creator to spread peace, concord and understanding between us; May wars, grudges and violence be extinguished from our mountainous land, and may we live as brothers in mutual love and compassion towards all creatures.

oraciones.titulo: Dhikr Naqshbandi of Dagestan – Plea for Sacred Silence and Stillness of the Heart
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ مَقْصُودِي وَرِضَاكَ مَطْلُوبِي، أَعْطِنِي مَحَبَّتَكَ وَمَعْرِفَتَكَ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Allahumma Anta maqsudi wa ridaka matlubi, a'tini mahabbataka wa ma'rifatak
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh my God! You are my only supreme purpose and Your divine pleasure is my only pursuit. Grant me the joy of Your unconditional love and the intimate knowledge of Your truth that fills the heart with unchanging stillness.

oraciones.titulo: Du'a of Protection and Justice of the Caucasus – Firmness in the Face of Difficulty
oraciones.textoOriginal: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْراً وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى القَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Rabbana afrigh 'alayna sabran wa thabbit aqdamana wansurna 'alal-qawmiz-zalimin
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh our Lord! Pour upon us unbreakable patience, establish our steps in righteousness, and grant us the peaceful victory of justice over all oppression and iniquity.

oraciones.titulo: Bashkir Supplication for Prosperity and Harmony with Nature (Baskortostan)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Йә Раббым! Илебезгә бәрәкәт бир, урман-һыуҙарыбыҙҙы һаҡла, күңелдәребеҙгә иман нуры сәс.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ye Rabbym! Ilebezge bereket bir, urman-hyuzyarybyzzy haqla...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Supreme Lord! Grant blessing to our land; protect our rivers, forests and nature; and sow in our souls the radiant light of faith, solidarity and lasting peace.

oraciones.titulo: Islamic Supplication from Tatarstan and Caucasus (01/20) – Peace and Faith
oraciones.textoOriginal: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ (1)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanah...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh our Lord! Grant us the good and noble in this earthly life, the best in eternal life, and protect us from all suffering. Bless our communities with peace, health and brotherly love. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Aditya Hridaya Stotram – The Himno al Sol for the Victory, Health and Coraje Supremo
oraciones.textoOriginal: ततो युद्धपरिश्रान्तं समरे चिन्तया स्थितम्। रावणं चाग्रतो दृष्ट्वा युद्धाय समुपस्थितम्॥ दैवतैश्च समागम्य द्रष्टुमभ्यागतो रणम्। उपगम्याब्रवीद्राममगस्त्यो भगवानृषिः॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Tato yuddha-parishrantam samare chintaya sthitam | Ravanam chagranto drishta yuddhaya samupasthitam || Daivataish cha samagamya drashtum abhyagato ranam | Upagamyabravid Ramam Agastyo bhagavan rishih ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om Tat Sat! We invoke the supreme divine light and grace in this sacred contemplation of Aditya Hridaya Stotram. May transcendent wisdom and pure knowledge dispel all darkness and ignorance from our mind, filling our life with inner peace, equanimity, discernment, and spiritual elevation. Om Shanti, Shanti, Shanti.

oraciones.titulo: Brahma Samhita – Govindam Adi-Purusham (The Chant of Praise of the Creador)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ईश्वरः परमः कृष्णः सच्चिदानन्दविग्रहः। अनादिरादिर्गोविन्दः सर्वकारणकारणम्॥ गोविन्दमादिपुरुषं तमहं भजामि॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ishvarah Paramah Krishnah Sac-Cid-Ananda-Vigrahah | Anadir Adir Govindah Sarva-Karana-Karanam || Govindam Adi-Purusham Tam Aham Bhajami ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Krishna, known as Govinda, is the Supreme Personality of Godhead. It possesses an eternal form of Absolute Bliss and Infinite Knowledge (Sat-Chit-Ananda). He has no beginning; It is the Primordial Origin of all things and the Cause of all causes. I prostrate and worship that Original Lord, Govinda, whose sacred flute fills the cosmos with divine love.

oraciones.titulo: Madhurashtakam (Vallabhacharya) – The Infinite Sweetness of Lord Krishna
oraciones.textoOriginal: अधरं मधुरं वदनं मधुरं नयनं मधुरं हसितं मधुरम्। हृदयं मधुरं गमनं मधुरं मधुराधिपतेरखिलं मधुरम्॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Adharam madhuram vadanam madhuram nayanam madhuram hasitam madhuram | Hridayam madhuram gamanam madhuram madhuradhipater akhilam madhuram ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om Tat Sat! We invoke the supreme divine light and grace in this sacred contemplation of Madhurashtakam (Vallabhacharya). May transcendent wisdom and pure knowledge dispel all darkness and ignorance from our mind, filling our life with inner peace, equanimity, discernment, and spiritual elevation. Om Shanti, Shanti, Shanti.

oraciones.titulo: Purusha Suktam (Rigveda) – The Transcendent Unity of the Cosmic Being
oraciones.textoOriginal: सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषः सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात्। स भूमिं विश्वतो वृत्वात्यतिष्ठद्दशाङ्गुलम्॥ पुरुष एवेदं सर्वं यद्भूतं यच्च भव्यम्...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Sahasra-shirsha Purushah Sahasrakshah Sahasra-pat | Sa bhumim vishvato vritva-atyatishthad dashangulam || Purusha evedam sarvam yad bhutam yac cha bhavyam...
oraciones.textoTraducido: The Supreme Cosmic Being has a thousand heads, a thousand eyes and a thousand feet; It encompasses the entire universe and at the same time transcends all measurement. Certainly the Supreme Being is everything that has existed in the past, everything that exists in the present and everything that will exist in the future. In Him all living beings form a single sacred and inseparable family.

oraciones.titulo: Kanakadhara Stotram (Adi Shankaracharya) – Lakshmi's Shower of Abundance and Gold
oraciones.textoOriginal: अङ्कं हरेः पुलकभूषणमाश्रयन्ती भृङ्गाङ्गनेव मुकुलाभरणं तमालम्। अङ्गीकृताखिलविभूतिरपाङ्गलीला माङ्गल्यदास्तु मम मङ्गलदेवतायाः॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Angam Hareh pulaka-bhushanam ashrayanti Bhringanganeva mukulabharanam tamalam | Angikritakhila-vibhutir apanga-lila Mangalyadastu mama mangala-devatayah ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: May the compassionate and gracious gaze of Supreme Mother Lakshmi, abode of all divine blessing and beauty, descend upon my life. Just as the lotus blooms with the sun and the rain fertilizes the dry land: may His kind gaze dissolve all poverty, scarcity or debt, showering a golden shower of dignified prosperity, health and family peace.

oraciones.titulo: Shiva Lingashtakam – Himno Universal of AdPrayer to the Sagrado Shiva Lingam
oraciones.textoOriginal: ब्रह्ममुरारिसुरार्चितलिङ्गं निर्मलभासितशोभितलिङ्गम्। जन्मजदुःखविनाशकलिङ्गं तत् प्रणमामि सदाशिवलिङ्गम्॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Brahma-Murari-Surarchita-Lingam Nirmala-Bhasita-Shobhita-Lingam | Janmaja-Dukha-Vinashaka-Lingam Tat Pranamaami Sadashiva-Lingam ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Revered by Brahma, Vishnu and all celestial beings; resplendent in His immaculate purity; destroyer of the sufferings accumulated in the cycles of existence: before that Sacred Lingam of the Eternal Lord Shiva (Sadashiva) I prostrate with infinite reverence and devotion! Grant purity to my mind and peace to my spirit.

oraciones.titulo: Sri Narasimha Kavacha – The Invincible Protective Armor of Lord Narasimha
oraciones.textoOriginal: नृसिंहकवचं वक्ष्ये प्रह्लादेनोदितं पुरा। सर्वरक्षाकरं पुण्यं सर्वोपद्रवनाशनम्॥ उग्रं वीरं महाविष्णुं ज्वलन्तं सर्वतोमुखम्। नृसिंहं भीषणं भद्रं मृत्युमृत्युं नमाम्यहम्॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Nrisimha-kavacham vakshye Prahladanoditam pura | Sarva-raksha-karam punyam sarvopadrava-nashanam || Ugram viram maha-vishnum jvalantam sarvato-mukham | Nrisimham bhishanam bhadram mrityu-mrityum namammyaham ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om Tat Sat! We invoke the supreme divine light and grace in this sacred contemplation of Sri Narasimha Kavacha. May transcendent wisdom and pure knowledge dispel all darkness and ignorance from our mind, filling our life with inner peace, equanimity, discernment, and spiritual elevation. Om Shanti, Shanti, Shanti.

oraciones.titulo: Dhanvantari Maha Mantra – Invocation to the Divine Physician of Ayurveda for Total Healing
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ नमो भगवते महासुदर्शनाय वासुदेवाय धन्वन्तरये। अमृतकलशहस्ताय सर्वभयविनाशाय सर्वरोगनिवारणाय। त्रैलोक्यपतये त्रैलोक्यनिधये श्रीमहाविष्णुस्वरूपाय श्रीधन्वन्तरिस्वरूपाय नमः॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Namo Bhagavate Maha-Sudarshanaya Vasudevaya Dhanvantaraye | Amrita-Kalasha-Hastaya Sarva-Bhaya-Vinashaya Sarva-Roga-Nivaranaya | Trailokya-Pataye Trailokya-Nidhaye Sri Maha-Vishnu-Swarupaya Sri Dhanvantari-Swarupaya Namah ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh! Salutations to the Blessed Lord Dhanvantari, the incarnation of Vishnu who holds in His hands the jug of the nectar of immortality (Amrita). Dissolver of all fears, infallible healer of all diseases of the body and mind, Lord of the three worlds: pour upon us Your divine medicine, restore perfect cellular health and give us unbreakable vitality.

oraciones.titulo: Annapurna Stotram (Adi Shankaracharya) – Lady of Sacred Food and Nutrition
oraciones.textoOriginal: नित्यानन्दकरी वराभयकरी सौन्दर्यरत्नाकरी निर्धूताखिलघोरपावनकरी प्रत्यक्षमाहेश्वरी। प्रालेयाचलवंशपावनकरी काशीपुराधीश्वरी भिक्षां देहि कृपावलम्बनकरी मातान्नपूर्णेश्वरी॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Nityanandakari Varabhayakari Saundarya-Ratnakari Nirdhutakhila-Ghora-Pavanakari Pratyaksha-Maheshwari | Praleyachala-Vamsha-Pavanakari Kashi-Puradhishwari Bhiksham Dehi Kripavalambanakari Mata Annapurneshwari ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Mother Annapurna, Queen of the sacred city of Kashi (Benares)! Bestower of perpetual joy, protector against fear, ocean of beauty and purity: grant us the sacred alms of Your grace, daily sustenance for our table and spiritual wisdom that nourishes the soul for eternity. May bread and love never be lacking in any home!

oraciones.titulo: Karpura Gauram Karunavataram – Universal Hymn of Praise and Worship
oraciones.textoOriginal: कर्पूरगौरं करुणावतारं संसारसारं भुजगेन्द्रहारम्। सदा वसन्तं हृदयारविन्दे भवं भवानीसहितं नमामि॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Karpura-Gauram Karunavataram Samsara-Saram Bhujagendra-Haram | Sada Vasantam Hridaya-Ravinde Bhavam Bhavani-Sahitam Namami ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: White and pure as camphor, living embodiment of infinite divine compassion, supreme essence of existence, adorned with the garland of wisdom: You who dwell eternally in the secret lotus of my heart, O Lord Shiva along with Divine Mother Bhavani, I prostrate before You with eternal love and gratitude!

oraciones.titulo: Tvam Eva Mata Cha Pita Tvam Eva – Prayer of Surrender and Filial Refuge in God
oraciones.textoOriginal: त्वमेव माता च पिता त्वमेव। त्वमेव बन्धुश्च सखा त्वमेव। त्वमेव विद्या द्रविणं त्वमेव। त्वमेव सर्वं मम देवदेव॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Tvam Eva Mata Cha Pita Tvam Eva | Tvam Eva Bandhush Cha Sakha Tvam Eva | Tvam Eva Vidya Dravinam Tvam Eva | Tvam Eva Sarvam Mama Deva Deva ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: You are my Mother and You are my Father; You are my Family and my most intimate Friend; You are my Wisdom and my True Wealth; You are my Everything, oh God of my heart and Lord of lords!

oraciones.titulo: Brahmarpanam (Bhagavad Gita 4:24) – Sacred Consecration of Food
oraciones.textoOriginal: ब्रह्मार्पणं ब्रह्म हविर्ब्रह्माग्नौ ब्रह्मणा हुतम्। ब्रह्मैव तेन गन्तव्यं ब्रह्मकर्मसमाधिना॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Brahmarpanam Brahma Havir Brahmagnau Brahmana Hutam | Brahmaiva Tena Gantavyam Brahma-Karma-Samadhina ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: The act of offering is God; the food offered is God; the fire of digestion is God; and it is God who makes the offering. Whoever contemplates God in all his actions certainly achieves illumination and supreme peace.

oraciones.titulo: Deepa Jyoti Param Brahma – Prayer to the Encender the Lámpara Sagrada (Diya)
oraciones.textoOriginal: दीपज्योतिः परं ब्रह्म दीपज्योतिर्जनार्दनः। दीपो हरतु मे पापं दीपज्योतिर्नमोऽस्तु ते॥ शुभं करोति कल्याणमारोग्यं धनसम्पदः। शत्रुबुद्धिविनाशाय दीपज्योतिर्नमोऽस्तु ते॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Deepa-Jyotih Param Brahma Deepa-Jyotir Janardanah | Deepo Haratu Me Papam Deepa-Jyotir Namo'stu Te || Shubham Karoti Kalyanam Arogyam Dhana-Sampadah | Shatru-Buddhi-Vinashaya Deepa-Jyotir Namo'stu Te ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: The flame of the lamp is the Supreme Divine Reality; The light of the lamp dissolves darkness and errors. May this holy light bring auspiciousness, perfect health, dignified prosperity and dissolve all ignorance and hostility in our minds. Reverences to the Holy Light!

oraciones.titulo: Sankat Mochan Hanuman Ashtak (Tulsidas) – Deliverance Inmediata of Crisis and Dolores
oraciones.textoOriginal: बाल समय रबि भक्षि लियो तब तीनहुँ लोक भयो अँधियारो। ताहि सों त्रास भयो जग को यह संकट काहु सों जात न टारो...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Bala samaya rabi bhakshi liyo taba tinahu loka bhayo andhiyaro...
oraciones.textoTraducido: When you were a child you jumped towards the sun believing it was a sweet fruit, demonstrating your incomparable power. What pain or crisis exists in this world that you, O compassionate Hanuman, cannot dissolve with your grace? Destroyer of afflictions, relieve my present distresses and fill me with Your protective blessing.

oraciones.titulo: Bajrang Baan – Hanuman's Indestructible Arrow Against All Evil
oraciones.textoOriginal: निश्चय प्रेम प्रतीति ते, बिनय करैं सनमान। तेहि के कारज सकल शुभ, सिद्ध करैं हनुमान॥ ॐ हं हनुमते रुद्रात्मकाय हुं फट्॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Nischaya prema pratiti te, binaya karain sanman | Tehi ke karaja sakala shubha, siddha karain Hanuman || Om Ham Hanumate Rudratmakaye Hum Phat ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Whoever invokes Hanuman with sincere love, certainty and respect sees all his noble tasks fulfilled and freed from obstacles. Om Ham Hanumate Hum Phat! Diamond arrow that cuts all sorcery, fear and nightmare, establishing the victory of peace.

oraciones.titulo: Bilvashtakam – The Sacred Offering of the Three-Pointed Bilva Leaf to Shiva
oraciones.textoOriginal: त्रिदलं त्रिगुणाकारं त्रिनेत्रं च त्रियायुधम्। त्रिजन्मपापसंहारं एकबिल्वं शिवार्पणम्॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Tridalam Trigunakaram Trinetram Cha Triyayudham | Trijanma-Papa-Samharam Eka-Bilvam Shivapanam ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: With three leaves symbolizing the three divine eyes, the three qualities of nature and the destruction of errors of three lives - I lovingly offer this sacred Bilva leaf at the feet of Lord Shiva. Om Namah Shivaya!

oraciones.titulo: Radha Kripa Kataksha Stotram – Supplication for the Mirada Compasiva of Sri Radha
oraciones.textoOriginal: मुनीन्द्रवृन्दवन्दिते त्रिलोकशोकहारिणी प्रसन्नवक्त्रपङ्कजे निकुञ्जभूविलासिनी। व्रजेन्द्रभानुनन्दिनी व्रजेन्द्रसूनुसङ्गते कदा करिष्यसीह मां कृपाकटाक्षभाजनम्॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Munindra-vrinda-vandite triloka-shoka-harini prasanna-vaktra-pankaje nikunja-bhu-vilasini | Vrajendra-bhanu-nandini vrajendra-sunu-sangate kada karishyasiha mam kripa-kataksha-bhajanam ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Queen of Vrindavan, revered by the most exalted sages, who dissipates the suffering of the three worlds with Your sweet lotus face! When will You shed on this humble servant a single glimpse of Your compassionate gaze that purifies the soul and awakens the supreme love for God? Radhe Radhe!

oraciones.titulo: Jagannathashtakam (Adi Shankaracharya) – Prayer to the Lord of the Universe in Puri
oraciones.textoOriginal: कदाचित् कालिन्दीतटविपिनसङ्गीततरलो मुदाभीरीहारीवदनकमलास्वादमधुपः। रमाशम्भुब्रह्मामरपतिगणेशार्चितपदो जगन्नाथः स्वामी नयनपथगामी भवतु मे॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Kadachit Kalindi-tata-vipina-sangita-taralo muda bhiri-hari-vadana-kamalaswada-madhupah | Rama-Shambhu-Brahmamara-pati-Ganesharchita-pado Jagannathah Swami Nayana-Patha-Gami Bhavatu Me ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: He whose lotus feet are worshiped by Lakshmi, Shiva, Brahma and Ganesha; the Lord of the Universe who walks among the crowd with all-embracing compassionate eyes: may that Lord Jagannatha always be the supreme object of my vision and the eternal refuge of my heart! Jai Jagannath!

oraciones.titulo: Shiva Manasa Puja (Adi Shankaracharya) – Inner Mental Worship in the Temple of the Heart
oraciones.textoOriginal: रत्नैः कल्पितमासनं हिमजलैः स्नानं च दिव्याम्बरं नानारत्नविभूषितं मृगमदामोदाङ्कितं चन्दनम्। जातीचम्पकबिल्वपत्ररचितं पुष्पं च धूपं तथा दीपं देव दयानिधे पशुपते हृत्कल्पितं गृह्यताम्॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ratnaih kalpitam asanam hima-jalaih snanam cha divyambaram | Nana-ratna-vibhushitam mrigamada-modankitam chandanam || Jati-champaka-bilva-patra-rachitam pushpam cha dhupam tatha | Deepam Deva Dayanidhe Pashupate Hrit-Kalpitam Grihyatam ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the secret temple of my mind I offer you a jeweled throne, a bath of pure Himalayan waters, heavenly garments, perfumed sandalwood, jasmine flowers and bilva leaves, incense and the radiant light of devotion. O Ocean of Compassion, Lord Shiva, accept this worship born from the silence of my soul!

oraciones.titulo: Pashupatinath & Guhyeshwari (Nepal) – Protection of the Himalayan Heights
oraciones.textoOriginal: नमस्ते पशुपतये महादेवाय शम्भवे। गुह्येश्वर्यै नमस्तुभ्यं नेपालरक्षणप्रिये॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Namaste Pashupataye Mahadevaya Sambhave | Guhyeshwaryai Namastubhyam Nepala-Rakshana-Priye ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Salutations to Lord Pashupatinath, protector of all living souls and lord of the Himalayas, and Mother Guhyeshwari, custodian of the sacred mysteries and peace of the mountains. Pour health, harmony and protection against all earthly and spiritual danger into our homes.

oraciones.titulo: Gayatri Mantra to the Sun Savitur – Awakening of Higher Intelligence
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय। सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्ये शिवे सर्वार्थसाधिके। शरण्ये त्र्यम्बके गौरि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥ ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Om Na-mo Bha-ga-va-te Va-su-de-va-ya. Sar-va-man-ga-la-man-gal-ye Shi-ve Sar-var-tha-sa-dhi-ke. Sha-ran-ye Try-am-ba-ke Gau-ri Na-ra-ya-ni Na-mas-tu Te. Om Shan-ti, Shan-ti, Shan-ti]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om Tat Sat! We invoke the supreme divine light and grace in this sacred contemplation of Gayatri Mantra to the Sun Savitur. May transcendent wisdom and pure knowledge dispel all darkness and ignorance from our mind, filling our life with inner peace, equanimity, discernment, and spiritual elevation. Om Shanti, Shanti, Shanti.

oraciones.titulo: Maha Mrityunjaya Mantra – Deliverance of the Muerte Prematura and Healing
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय। सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्ये शिवे सर्वार्थसाधिके। शरण्ये त्र्यम्बके गौरि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥ ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Om Na-mo Bha-ga-va-te Va-su-de-va-ya. Sar-va-man-ga-la-man-gal-ye Shi-ve Sar-var-tha-sa-dhi-ke. Sha-ran-ye Try-am-ba-ke Gau-ri Na-ra-ya-ni Na-mas-tu Te. Om Shan-ti, Shan-ti, Shan-ti]

May transcendent wisdom and pure knowledge dispel all darkness and ignorance from our mind, filling our life with inner peace, equanimity, discernment, and spiritual elevation. Om Shanti, Shanti, Shanti.

oraciones.titulo: Shiva Shadakshara Stotram – Meditation on the 6 Syllables of Om Namah Shivaya
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय। सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्ये शिवे सर्वार्थसाधिके। शरण्ये त्र्यम्बके गौरि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥ ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः॥

Om Shanti, Shanti, Shanti.

oraciones.titulo: Durga Argala Stotram – Concesión of Victory, Belleza and Fama Espiritual
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय। सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्ये शिवे सर्वार्थसाधिके। शरण्ये त्र्यम्बके गौरि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥ ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः॥

Om Shanti, Shanti, Shanti.

oraciones.titulo: Durga Keelaka Stotram – The Sacred Key that Unlocks the Grace of Chandi
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय। सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्ये शिवे सर्वार्थसाधिके। शरण्ये त्र्यम्बके गौरि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥ ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः॥
