oraciones.titulo: Maha Mangala Sutta (Pali) – The 38 Supreme Blessings of Life
oraciones.textoOriginal: एवं मे सुतं। एकं समयं भगवा सावत्थियं विहरति जेतवने अनाथपिण्डिकस्स आरामे... बहु देवा मनुस्सा च मङ्गलानि अचिन्तयुं। आकङ्खमाना सोत्थानं ब्रूहि मङ्गलमुत्तमं॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Evam me sutam: Ekam samayam Bhagava Savatthiyam viharati Jetavane Anathapindikassa arame... Bahu deva manussa ca mangalani acintayum | Akankhamana sotthanam bruhi mangalamuttamam || Asevana ca balanam panditanan ca sevana | Puja ca pujaniyanam etam mangalamuttamam ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Maha Mangala Sutta (Pali). May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Ratana Sutta (Pali) – The Protective Hymn of the Three Jewels against Dangers and Pests
oraciones.textoOriginal: यानीध भूतानि समागतानि भुम्मानि वा यानि व अन्तलिक्खे। सब्बेव भूता सुमना भवन्तु अथोपि सक्कच्च सुणन्तु भासितं... यंकिञ्चि वित्तं इध वा हुरं वा सग्गेसु वा यं रतनं पणीतं। न नो समं अत्थि तथागतेन इदमपि बुद्धे रतनं पणीतं एतेन सच्चेन सुवत्थि होतु॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Yanidha bhutani samagatani bhummani va yani va antalikkhe | Sabbeva bhuta sumana bhavantu athopi sakkacca sunantu bhasitam... Yam kinci vittam idha va huram va saggesu va yam ratanam panitam | Na no samam atthi Tathagatena idampi Buddhe ratanam panitam etena saccena suvatthi hotu ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: May all beings gathered here, both on earth and in space, have their minds filled with peace and listen with reverence to the truth. There is no treasure in all the worlds comparable to the Enlightened One, to the Holy Dharma of liberation, or to the Noble Sangha of the virtuous. By the immense power of this sacred truth: may there be well-being, health, protection from all pestilence and peace for all beings!

oraciones.titulo: Karaniya Metta Sutta (Pali) – The Song of Universal and Unlimited Benevolent Love
oraciones.textoOriginal: करणीयमत्थकुसलेन यन्तं सन्तं पदं अभिसमेच्च। सक्को उजू च सूजू च सुवचो चस्स मुदु अनतिमानी... माता यथा नियं पुत्तं आयुसा एकपुत्तमनुरक्खे। एवम्पि सब्बभूतेसु मानसं भावये अपरमाणं॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Karaniyam-attha-kusalena yantam santam padam abhisamecca | Sakko uju ca su-uju ca suvaco c'assa mudu anatimanI... Mata yatha niyam puttam ayusa ekaputtam-anurakkhe | Evampi sabba-bhutesu manasam bhavaye aparimanam ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Karaniya Metta Sutta (Pali). May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Bojjhanga Paritta (Pali) – The Seven Factors of Enlightenment for Healing
oraciones.textoOriginal: संसारे संसरन्तानं सब्बदुक्खविनासनं। सत्त धम्मे च बोज्झङ्गे मारसेनप्पमद्दनं... बोज्झङ्गो सतिसङ्खातो धम्मानं विचयो तथा। विरियं पीतिपस्सद्धि बोज्झङ्गा च तथोपरे। समाधुपेक्खा बोज्झङ्गा... एतेन सच्चवज्जेन सोत्थि ते होतु सब्बदा॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Bojjhango satisankhato dhammanam vicayo tatha | Viriyam piti-passaddhi bojjhanga ca tathopare | Samadh-upekkha bojjhanga... Etena sacca-vajjena sotthi te hotu sabbada ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Bojjhanga Paritta (Pali). May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Mora Paritta (Pali) – The Song of the Sacred Peacock for Daily Sun Protection
oraciones.textoOriginal: उदेतयं चक्खुमा एकराजा हरिसवण्णो पठविप्पभासो। तं तं नमस्सामि हरिसवण्णं पठविप्पभासं तयज्झ गुत्ता विहरेमु दिवसं... नमो बुद्धानं नमो बोधिया नमो विमुत्तानं नमो विमुत्तिया॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Udetayam cakkhuma ekaraja harissavanno pathavippabhaso | Tam tam namassami harissavannam pathavippabhasam tayajja gutta viharemu divasam... Namo Buddhanam namo Bodhiya namo Vimuttanam namo Vimuttiya ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Mora Paritta (Pali). May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Dhajagga Sutta (Pali) – The Victorious Teaching to Dissolve Fear and Panic
oraciones.textoOriginal: इतिपि सो भगवा अरहं सम्मासम्बुद्धो विज्जाचरणसम्पन्नो सुगतो लोकविदू अनुत्तरो पुरिसदम्मसारथि सत्था देवमनुस्सानं बुद्धो भगवाति...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Itipi so Bhagava Araham Samma-sambuddho Vijja-carana-sampanno Sugato Lokavidu Anuttaro Purisa-damma-sarathi Sattha Deva-manussanam Buddho Bhagava ti...
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Dhajagga Sutta (Pali). May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Angulimala Paritta (Pali) – Sacred Blessing for Childbirth and Maternal Protection
oraciones.textoOriginal: यतोहं भगिनि अरियाय जातिया जातो नाभिजानामि संचिच्च पाणं जीविता वोरोपेता। तेन सच्चेन सोत्थि ते होतु सोत्थि गब्भस्स॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Yato'ham bhagini ariyaya jatiya jato nabhijanami sancicca panam jivita voropeta | Tena saccena sotthi te hotu sotthi gabbhassa ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Since I have been born in the noble spiritual birth of the awakened, sister, I have no memory of having intentionally deprived any living being of life. By the immense power of this truth and purity: may there be blessing, peace and perfect health for you, and may the birth in your womb be safe, blissful and protected!

oraciones.titulo: Girimananda Sutta (Pali) – The Ten Sacred Visions for the Transcendence of Suffering
oraciones.textoOriginal: दसिमा आनन्द सञ्ञाओ... अनिच्चसञ्ञा, अनत्तसञ्ञा, असुभसञ्ञा, आदीनवसञ्ञा, पहानसञ्ञा, विरागसञ्ञा, निरोधसञ्ञा, सब्बलोके अनभिरतिसञ्ञा, सब्बसङ्खारेसु अनिच्चसञ्ञा, आनापानसति...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Das'ima Ananda sanna... Anicca-sanna, Anatta-sanna, Asubha-sanna, Adinava-sanna, Pahana-sanna, Viraga-sanna, Nirodha-sanna, Sabbaloke anabhirati-sanna, Sabba-sankharesu anicca-sanna, Anapanasati...
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Girimananda Sutta (Pali). May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Buddha Jayamangala Gatha (Pali) – The Eight Great Triumphs of the Buddha over Darkness
oraciones.textoOriginal: बाहुं सहस्स अभिनिम्मित सायुधन्तं गिरिमेखलं उदिसघोर ससेनमारं। दानादिधम्मविधिना जितवा मुनिन्दो तं तेजसा भवतु ते जयमङ्गलानि॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Bahum sahassam abhinimmita sayudhantam Girimekhalam uditaghora sasenamaram | Danadi-dhamma-vidhina jitava munindo tam tejasa bhavatu te jayamangalani ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Mara the tempter appeared with a thousand armed arms mounted on his roaring elephant; but the Lord of the Wise defeated him with the invincible shield of generosity and love. In the same way he defeated the fury of the wild elephant Nalagiri, the cruelty of Angulimala and the pride of the ignorant. By the radiance of these eight victories: may auspicious triumph, prosperity and peace crown your path!

oraciones.titulo: Sri Dalada Vandanawa (Sri Lanka) – Prayer before the Sacred Tooth Relic of Buddha in Kandy
oraciones.textoOriginal: एकदाठो वसित्वा तु कलिङ्गेसु पुरे तदा... ततो दन्तालयं गन्त्वा वन्दामि मुनिधम्मकं॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ekadatho vasitva tu kalingesu pure tada... Tato dantalayam gantva vandami munidhammakam || Lokanathassa pujitam sirasa dharayamyaham ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Before the sacred relic of the Tooth of the Enlightened One lovingly preserved in the Kandy Temple, I prostrate with a heart filled with gratitude. May the living memory of the Buddha's compassion and wisdom be the indestructible beacon that guides our nations, protects our families, and keeps the flame of world peace burning.

oraciones.titulo: Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi Vandanawa (Anuradhapura - Sri Lanka) – Under the Awakening Tree
oraciones.textoOriginal: यस्स मूले निसिन्नोव सब्बारिविजयं अका। पत्तो सब्बञ्ञुतं सत्था वन्दे तं बोधिपादपं॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Yassa mule nisinnova sabbarivijayam aka | Patto sabbanjutam Sattha vande tam Bodhi-padapam ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Under whose sacred branches the Master sat motionless until he defeated all the illusions of the ego and achieved Supreme Omniscience: I venerate with devotion that sacred Bodhi tree, eternal witness of Enlightenment. May his beneficent shadow bring unbreakable patience to my mind and flourishing to my projects.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer in Seven Lines to Guru Rinpoche Padmasambhava (Dorje Tsik Dunkhang)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ཧཱུྃ༔ ཨོ་རྒྱན་ཡུལ་གྱི་ནུབ་བྱང་མཚམས༔ པདྨ་གེ་སར་སྡོང་པོ་ལ༔ ཡ་མཚན་མཆོག་གི་དངོས་གྲུབ་བརྙེས༔ པདྨ་འབྱུང་གནས་ཞེས་སུ་གྲགས༔ འཁོར་དུ་མཁའ་འགྲོ་མང་པོས་བསྐོར༔ ཁྱེད་ཀྱི་རྗེས་སུ་བདག་བསྒྲུབ་ཀྱིས༔ བྱིན་གྱིས་བརླབ་ཕྱིར་གཤེགས་སུ་གསོལ༔ གུ་རུ་པདྨ་སིདྡྷི་ཧཱུྃ༔
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Hung | Orgyen yul gyi nub jang tsam | Pema gesar dongpo la | Yatsen chog gi ngodrup nye | Pema Jungney zhey su drag | Khor du khandro mangpo kor | Khyed kyi jesu dag drub kyi | Jin gyi lab chir sheg su sol | Guru Pema Siddhi Hung ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: HUNG! In the northwestern reaches of the land of Oddiyana, upon the chalice of a blossoming lotus flower, you were born possessing the supreme and miraculous attainment, universally known as the Lotus Born (Padmasambhava), surrounded by an assembly of celestial dakinis. Following your steps I practice with fervor: come, Supreme Master, and shower upon us your blessings and protection! OM AH HUNG VAJRA GURU PEMA SIDDHI HUNG.

oraciones.titulo: Sampa Lhundrupma – Prayer for the Spontaneous Fulfillment of Wishes
oraciones.textoOriginal: ཨེ་མ་ཧོ༔ མཚོ་དབུས་གེ་སར་པདྨའི་སྡོང་པོ་ལ༔ སྐུ་ལྔ་ཡེ་ཤེས་ལྷུན་གྱིས་གྲུབ་པའི་ལྷ༔ རང་བྱུང་ཆེན་པོ་པདྨ་ཧེ་རུ་ཀ༔ གསོལ་བ་འདེབས་སོ་གུ་རུ་རིན་པོ་ཆེ༔ བསམ་པ་ལྷུན་གྱིས་འགྲུབ་པར་བྱིན་གྱིས་རློབས༔
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Emaho | Tso u gesar pemey dongpo la | Ku nga yeshe lhun gyi drubpey lha | Rangjung chenpo Pema Heruka | Solwa deb so Guru Rinpoche | Sampa lhun gyi drubpar jin gyi lob ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Emmaho! In the center of the lake, on the stem of a lotus, dwells the spontaneously perfect deity of the five bodies of primordial wisdom. We beseech you with unconditional devotion, oh Guru Rinpoche, Precious Master!: bless us so that all noble wishes and desires for enlightenment and well-being for beings are fulfilled spontaneously and effortlessly.

oraciones.titulo: Barchey Lamsel – The Great Prayer to Dispel Obstacles from the Path
oraciones.textoOriginal: ཨོཾ་ཨཱཿཧཱུྃ་བཛྲ་གུ་རུ་པདྨ་ཐོད་ཕྲེང་རྩལ་བཛྲ་ས་མ་ཡ་ཛཱཿ སིདྡྷི་ཕ་ལ་ཧཱུྃ་ཨཱཿ བདུད་དང་བགེགས་ཀྱི་བར་ཆད་ཞི་བ་དང་༔ ཆོས་མཐུན་བསམ་པ་འགྲུབ་པར་བྱིན་གྱིས་རློབས༔
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Ah Hung Vajra Guru Padma Thotreng Tsal Vajra Samaya Dza | Siddhi Phala Hung Ah | Dud dang geg kyi barched zhiwa dang | Cho thun sampa drubpar jin gyi lob ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: We invoke the invincible power of Guru Padma Thodtreng Tsal. In the face of any danger from fire, water, wind, attackers, evil diseases or the demons of inner doubt: may all external and internal obstacles be pacified by the light of primordial compassion, and we be guided to absolute peace!

oraciones.titulo: Supplication of Larga Vida and Health a Tara Blanca (Drolkar Yishin Khorlo)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ཨོཾ་ཏཱ་རེ་ཏུཏྟཱ་རེ་ཏུ་རེ་མཱ་མ་ཨཱ་ཡུཿཔུཎྱེ་ཛྙཱ་ན་པུཥྚིཾ་ཀུ་རུ་སྭཱ་ཧཱ༔ འཆི་མེད་ཚེ་ཡི་དངོས་གྲུབ་མ་ལུས་པ༔ བདག་དང་སེམས་ཅན་ཐམས་ཅད་ལ་སྩོལ་ཅིག༔
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Tare Tuttare Ture Mama Ayuh Punya Jnana Pushtim Kuru Svaha | Chimey tse yi ngodrub malupa | Dag dang semchen thamched la tsol cig ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: OM TARE TUTTARE TURE MAMA AYUR PUNYE JNANA PUSHTIM KURU SVAHA! Noble Mother White Tara, life-fulfilling wheel of desires, who with your seven eyes of compassion contemplate all suffering beings: grant the nectar of longevity, health without disease, fruitful merit and radiant wisdom to serve the good of the world.

oraciones.titulo: Dharani of the Medicine Buddha (Bhaisajyaguru Sangye Menla)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Tadyatha: Om Bhaishajye Bhaishajye Maha Bhaishajye Bhaishajya-Samudgate Svaha | Sangye Men gyi Lha Baidurya Od kyi Gyalpo la Chagtsal Lo ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: I prostrate before the Lapis Lazuli Radiance King, the Supreme Healer and Medicine Buddha. May the blue radiance of His compassion penetrate the four elements of our physical body, cleanse the poisons of ignorance, attachment and aversion, and restore perfect health, serenity and peace to all the sick.

oraciones.titulo: Gangloma – Praise to the Sublime Intelligence of the Noble Manjushri
oraciones.textoOriginal: གང་གི་བློ་གྲོས་སྒྲིབ་གཉིས་སྤྲིན་བྲལ་ཉི་ལྟར་རྣམ་དག་རབ་གསལ་བས༔ ཇི་སྙེད་དོན་ཀུན་ཇི་བཞིན་གཟིགས་ཕྱིར་ཉིད་ཀྱི་ཐུགས་ཀར་གླེགས་བམ་འཛིན༔ ཨོཾ་ཨ་ར་པ་ཙ་ན་དྷཱིཿ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Gang gi lodro drib nyi trindral nyi tar namdag rab sal we | Jinye don kun jibzhin zig chir nyid kyi thugkar legbam dzin | Om A Ra Pa Tsa Na Dhih ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: He whose diamond mind is free from the clouds of error, bright and pure as the midday sun; who holds in his heart the sacred text of Transcendent Wisdom and in his hand the flaming sword that cuts ignorance at its roots: OM A RA PA TSA NA DHIH! Grant clarity to my memory, lucidity in study and truthful eloquence.

oraciones.titulo: Migtsema – Prayer of Invocation of the Wisdom, Compasión and Poder Trascendente
oraciones.textoOriginal: མིག་མེད་བརྩེ་བའི་གཏེར་ཆེན་སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས༔ དྲི་མེད་མཁྱེན་པའི་དབང་པོ་འཇམ་པའི་དབྱངས༔ བདུད་དཔུང་མ་ལུས་འཇོམས་མཛད་གསང་བའི་བདག༔ གངས་ཅན་མཁས་པའི་གཙུག་རྒྱན་ཙོང་ཁ་པ༔ བློ་བཟང་གྲགས་པའི་ཞབས་ལ་གསོལ་བ་འདེབས༔
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Migmey tsewey terchen Chenrezig | Drimey khyenpey wangpo Jampelyang | Dudpung malup jomdzey Sangwey Dag | Gangchen khepey tsuggyan Tsongkhapa | Lobzang Dragpey zhab la solwa deb ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Inexhaustible treasure of boundless compassion, Avalokiteshvara (Chenrezig); supreme teacher of immaculate knowledge, Manjushri; victorious conqueror of all the dark hosts, Lord of the Vajrapani Secrets; supreme jewel among the sages of the snows: at your sacred feet we beseech you to bless our minds with purity, kindness and perseverance.

oraciones.titulo: Monlam of Samantabhadra (Kuntuzangpo) – The Great Dzogchen Aspiration
oraciones.textoOriginal: ཧོ༔ སྣང་སྲིད་འཁོར་འདས་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀུན༔ གཞི་གཅིག་ལམ་གཉིས་འབྲས་བུ་གཉིས༔ རིག་དང་མ་རིག་ཆོ་འཕྲུལ་ཏེ༔ ཀུན་ཏུ་བཟང་པོའི་སྨོན་ལམ་གྱིས༔ ཐམས་ཅད་ཆོས་དབྱིངས་ཕོ་བྲང་དུ༔ མངོན་པར་རྫོགས་ཏེ་སངས་རྒྱས་ཤོག༔
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ho | Nang si khor de thamched kun | Zhi cig lam nyi drebu nyi | Rig dang marig chotrul te | Kuntuzangpoy monlam gyi | Thamched Choying phodrang du | Ngonpar dzog te sangye shog ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Monlam of Samantabhadra (Kuntuzangpo). May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: The Eight Verses of Mental Training (Lojong of Geshe Langri Tangpa)
oraciones.textoOriginal: བདག་ནི་སེམས་ཅན་ཐམས་ཅད་ལ༔ ཡིད་བཞིན་ནོར་བུ་ལས་ལྷག་པའི༔ དོན་མཆོག་སྒྲུབ་པའི་བསམ་པ་ཡིས༔ རྟག་ཏུ་གཅེས་པར་འཛིན་པར་ཤོག༔
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Dag ni semchen thamched la | Yidzhin norbu ley lhagpey | Don chog drubpey sampa yi | Tagtu chepar dzinpar shog ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Considering all sentient beings more valuable than a wish-fulfilling jewel, may you always cherish them with deep tenderness. When meeting anyone, let them recognize me as the most humble and honor them deep in my heart. When receiving harm or slander, let him offer victory to his neighbor and assume the loss with serenity and perfect patience.

oraciones.titulo: The Song of Joy in the Cave of Jetsun Milarepa – The Bliss of Detachment
oraciones.textoOriginal: བདག་ནི་རི་ཁྲོད་འགྲིམ་པའི་རྣལ་འབྱོར་པ༔ ཟས་ལ་ཞེན་པ་མེད་པའི་བདེ་བ་ཡོད༔ གོས་ལ་ཞེན་པ་མེད་པའི་བདེ་བ་ཡོད༔ གནས་ལ་ཞེན་པ་མེད་པའི་བདེ་བ་ཡོད༔
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Dag ni ritrod drimpey naljorpa | Zey la zhenpa meypey dewa yod | Goy la zhenpa meypey dewa yod | Ney la zhenpa meypey dewa yod ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of The Song of Joy in the Cave of Jetsun Milarepa. May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Kalachakra Mantra for World Peace and Cosmic Protection
oraciones.textoOriginal: ཨོཾ་ཨཱཿཧཱུྃ་ཧོ་ཧཾ་ཀྵ་མ་ལ་ཝ་ར་ཡ་ཧཱུྃ་ཕཊ༔ ཞི་བདེ་ཆེན་པོའི་དུས་ཀྱི་འཁོར་ལོ་ཡིས༔ འཛམ་གླིང་ཡོངས་ལ་ཞི་བདེ་སྩོལ་ཅིག༔
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Ah Hum Ho Ham Ksha Ma La Wa Ra Ya Hum Phat | Zhi de chenpoy Duki Khorlo yi | Dzamling yong la zhide tsol cig ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: OM AH HUM HO HAM KSHA MA LA VA RA YA HUM PHAT! Sacred wheel of time that harmonizes the elements of the cosmos and dissolves wars, grudges and natural disasters: may the kingdom of inner peace and universal brotherhood flourish in every corner of the earth.

oraciones.titulo: Maka Hannya Haramita Shingyo (Japan) – The Heart Sutra in Japanese Phonetics
oraciones.textoOriginal: 観自在菩薩 行深般若波羅蜜多時 照見五蘊皆空 度一切苦厄 舎利子 色不異空 空不異色 色即是空 空即是色... 羯諦 羯諦 波羅羯諦 波羅僧羯諦 菩提薩婆訶
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Kan-ji-zai bo-satsu gyo jin han-nya ha-ra-mi-ta ji sho-ken go-un kai ku do is-sai ku-yaku. Sha-ri-shi shiki fu i ku ku fu i shiki shiki soku ze ku ku soku ze shiki... Gya-tei gya-tei ha-ra-gya-tei hara-so-gya-tei bo-ji sowa-ka ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: When Bodhisattva Kannon deeply contemplated Transcendent Wisdom, he clearly perceived that the five aggregates of existence are void of an independent self, and he transcended all suffering. Form is emptiness, emptiness is form. Go, go, go beyond, go to the other shore of awakening! Glory to Enlightenment!

oraciones.titulo: Shoshinge (Shinran Shonin) – Hymn of True Faith in the Name of Amida Buddha
oraciones.textoOriginal: 帰命無量寿如来 南無不可思議光 法蔵菩薩因位時 在世自在王仏所 覩見諸仏浄土因 国土人天之善悪 建立無上殊勝願 超発希有大弘誓...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ki-myo Mu-ryo-ju Nyo-rai | Na-mu Fu-ka-shi-gi-ko | Ho-zo bo-satsu in-ni-ji | Zai Se-ji-zai-o-butsu-sho | To-ken sho-butsu jo-do-in | Koku-do nin-den no zen-aku | Kon-ryu mu-jo shu-sho-gan | Cho-hotsu ke-u dai-gu-zei ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: I take refuge with a grateful heart in the Tathagata of Infinite Life and bow before the Inconceivable Light. Fully trusting in the Great Vow of Amida Buddha that embraces all beings without ever abandoning any, we devoutly pronounce: Namu Amida Butsu, finding unconditional serenity in this life and blissful rebirth in the Pure Land.

oraciones.titulo: Odaimoku Namu Myoho Renge Kyo (Nichiren Daishonin) – Invocation to the Lotus Sutra
oraciones.textoOriginal: 南無妙法蓮華經 妙法蓮華經は一切諸仏の生処、一切菩薩の法母なり。唱え奉る処、即ち仏界顕現す。
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Na-mu Myo-ho Ren-ge Kyo | Namu Myoho Renge Kyo | Namu Myoho Renge Kyo ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Devotion to the Mystical Law of Cause and Effect through the Lotus Sutra! By chanting this sacred title with firm faith, we dispel inner suffering, awaken the inherent Buddhahood in our hearts, and manifest courage, wisdom, and victorious harmony in our daily lives.

oraciones.titulo: Komyo Shingon (Shingon Light Mantra - Kobo Daishi)
oraciones.textoOriginal: オン アボキャ ベイロシャノウ マカボダラ マニ ハンドマ ジンバラ ハラバリタヤ ウン
oraciones.guiaFonetica: On Abokya Beiroshanou Makabodara Mani Handoma Jinbara Harabaritaya Un ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: OM! May the purifying light of the Great Cosmic Buddha Dainichi Nyorai (Mahavairocana), the precious jewel, the sacred lotus and the inextinguishable radiation of compassion, penetrate our lives, dissolve all heavy karma and shower peace on the living and the dead.

oraciones.titulo: Fudo Myoo Shingon (Acala) – The Immovable Protector Who Conquers Passions and Fears
oraciones.textoOriginal: ノウマク サンマンダ バザラダン センダ マカロシャダ ソワタヤ ウンタラタ カンマン
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Nohmaku Samanda Bazaradan Senda Makaroshada Sowataya Untarata Kanman ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Salutations to the Immovable Lord Fudo Myoo, whose penetrating gaze and sword of wisdom cut all the bonds of deception, fear and anger, protecting practitioners with his fire of total purification.

oraciones.titulo: Gokan-no-ge (Zen) – The Cinco Recordatorios and Gratitude ante the Alimento
oraciones.textoOriginal: 一つには功の多少を計り彼の来処を量る。二つには己が徳行の全欠を忖って供に応ず。三つには心を防ぎ過を離るることは貪等を宗とす。四つには正に良薬を事とするは形枯を療ぜんが為なり。五つには成道の為の故に今此の食を受く。
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Hitotsu ni wa ko no tasho o hakari kano raisho o hakaru. Futatsu ni wa onore ga tokugyo no zenketsu o hakatte ku ni ozu. Mitsu ni wa shin o fusegi toga o hanaruru koto wa tonto o shu to su. Yotsu ni wa masa ni ryoyaku o koto to suru wa gyoko o ryozen ga tame nari. Itsutsu ni wa jodo no tame no yue ni ima kono jiki o uku.
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Gokan. May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Fueko (Zen and Pure Land) – Universal Dedication of Merits for Peace
oraciones.textoOriginal: 願わくは此の功徳を以て 普く一切に及ぼし 我等と衆生と 皆共に仏道を成ぜんことを
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Negawakuwa kono kudoku o motte amaneku issai ni oyoboshi, warera to shujo to mina tomo ni butsudo o jozen koto o ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: May the merits and blessings born from this practice extend everywhere to all beings without exception, and may together, in union and harmony, reach the supreme plenitude of Buddhahood and Universal Peace.

oraciones.titulo: Enmei Jizo Bosatsu Gatha – Prayer to the Protector of Children, Travelers and Homes
oraciones.textoOriginal: オン カカカ ビサンマエイ ソワカ 南無延命地蔵菩薩 大慈大悲にして衆生を済度し給う。
oraciones.guiaFonetica: On Kakaka Bisanmaei Sowaka | Namu Enmei Jizo Bosatsu ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: OM KA KA KA VISMAYE SVAHA! Reverence to Jizo Bosatsu, the kind protector of the staff and sacred jewel who cares for children, guides travelers, dissolves the sorrows of the home and accompanies souls with infinite tenderness at all times.

oraciones.titulo: Da Bei Zhou (Chinese) – The Great Dharani of Guanyin's Infinite Compassion
oraciones.textoOriginal: 南無喝囉怛那哆囉夜耶 南無阿唎耶 婆盧羯帝爍鉢囉耶 菩提薩埵婆耶 摩訶薩埵婆耶 摩訶迦盧尼迦耶 唵 薩皤囉罰曳 數怛那怛寫... 娑婆訶
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Namo Heladanna Duolayaye | Namo Aliye Polojiedi Shuobolaye | Putisaduobaye Mohesaduobaye Mohe Jialunijiaye | Om Sabolafaye Shudannadaxie... Suopohe ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Prostration to the Three Jewels and the Noble Avalokiteshvara (Guanyin Bodhisattva), living embodiment of the Great Infinite Compassion. Whoever recites this sacred Dharani with pure faith is freed from the fifteen types of fateful deaths, dissolves insurmountable karmas, obtains the protection of all celestial beings and attains perfect health and peace.

oraciones.titulo: Shurangama Mantra (Xin Zhou) – The Heart Mantra for Supreme Protection
oraciones.textoOriginal: 唵 阿難隸 毗舍提 鞞囉跋闍囉 陀唎 盤陀盤陀你 跋闍囉謗尼泮 吽 都嚧甕泮 娑婆訶
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Anale Visada Vaira Vajra Dhare Bandha Bandhani Vajrapani Phat Hum Dhrum Phat Svaha ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Shurangama Mantra (Xin Zhou). May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Wang Sheng Zhou – Dharani for Rebirth in the Pure Land of Sukhavati
oraciones.textoOriginal: 南無阿彌多婆夜 哆他伽哆夜 哆地夜他 阿彌利都婆毗 阿彌利哆 悉耽婆毗 阿彌利哆 毗迦蘭帝 阿彌利哆 毗迦蘭哆 伽彌膩 伽伽那 枳多迦隸 娑婆訶
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Namo Amituobaye Duotajiatuoye Duodiyetad Amilidubapi Amiliduo Xidanpapi Amiliduo Pijialandi Amiliduo Pijialanduo Jiamini Jiajiana Zhiduojiali Suopohe ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Salutations to Amitabha Buddha of Infinite Light. May the sweet nectar of the Pure Land purify our past faults, grant calm and serene rest to the soul, and ensure eternal bliss.

oraciones.titulo: Zhunti Shen Zhou – Dharani of the Mother of Seventy Million Buddhas (Cundhi)
oraciones.textoOriginal: 稽首皈依蘇悉帝 頭面頂禮七俱胝 我今稱讚大準提 唯願慈悲垂加護。南無颯哆喃 三藐三菩陀 俱胝喃 怛姪他 唵 折隸 主隸 準提 娑婆訶
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Jishou guiyi Suxidi | Toumian dingli Qi Ju Zhi | Wojin chengzan Da Zhunti | Weiyuan cibei chui jiahu | Namo Saduonan Sanmiaosanputuo Juzhinan Dazhituo: Om Zheli Zhuli Zhunti Suopohe ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: I prostrate and bow before Mother Cundhi, surrounded by seventy million Buddhas. Through your immense compassion and your eighteen arms of salvation, may you protect our children, grant wisdom in exams and work, and bless our home with prosperity and peace.

oraciones.titulo: Jin Gang Jing (The Gatha of the Four Lines of the Diamond Sutra)
oraciones.textoOriginal: 一切有為法 如夢幻泡影 如露亦如電 應作如是觀
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Yiqie youwei fa | Ru menghuan paoying | Ru lu yi ru dian | Ying zuo rushi guan ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: All composite things in this world are similar to a dream, an illusion, a soap bubble or a fleeting shadow; They are like a drop of dew or a lightning bolt in the storm: this is how reality must be contemplated with wisdom to live free of attachment and anguish.

oraciones.titulo: Pu Xian Shi Da Yuan Wang – The Ten Great Vows of Bodhisattva Samantabhadra
oraciones.textoOriginal: 一者禮敬諸佛 二者稱讚如來 三者廣修供養 四者懺悔業障 五者隨喜功德 六者請轉法輪 七者請佛住世 八者常隨佛學 九者恒順眾生 十者普皆迴向
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Yizhe Lijing Zhufo | Erzhe Chengzan Rulai | Sanzhe Guangxiu Gongyang | Sizhe Chanhui Yezhang | Wuzhe Suixi Gongde | Liuzhe Qingzhuan Falun | Qizhe Qingfo Zhushi | Bazhe Changsui Foxue | Jiuzhe Hengshun Zhongsheng | Shizhe Pujie Huixiang ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Pu Xian Shi Da Yuan Wang. May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Guan Yin Pu Sa Shi Er Da Yuan – The Twelve Great Vows of Help of Guanyin
oraciones.textoOriginal: 南無大慈大悲救苦救難廣大靈感觀世音菩薩。願消三障諸煩惱 願得智慧真明了 普願罪障悉消除 世世常行菩薩道。
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Namo Daci Dabi Jiuku Jiunan Guangda Linggan Guanyin Pusa | Yuan xiao sanzhang zhu fannao | Yuan de zhihui zhen mingliao | Puyuan zuizhang xi xiaochu | Shishi changxing Pusa dao ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Salutations to Guanyin Bodhisattva, of Great Mercy, Great Compassion and Miraculous Answer who hears the cries of the world! May all afflictions and obstacles dissolve, may true wisdom shine in our souls and may we practice kindness and helpful love in every moment.

oraciones.titulo: Wei Tuo Zun Tian Pu Sa – Prayer to the General Celestial Skanda Protector of the Dharma
oraciones.textoOriginal: 韋馱天將 菩薩化身 擁護佛法誓弘深 寶杵鎮魔軍 功德難倫 祈保國泰民安。
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Wei Tuo Tianjiang | Pusa huashen | Yonghu fofa shi hongshen | Baochu zhen mojun | Gongde nanlun | Qibao guotai min'an ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Noble celestial protector Wei Tuo, manifestation of the Bodhisattva who wields the sacred scepter to safeguard temples and sincere practitioners: drive away discord, protect our places of study and prayer, and bless the community with peace and concord.

oraciones.titulo: Chú Đại Bi (Việt Nam) – Đại Bi Tâm Đà Ra Ni Quán Thế Âm Bồ Tát
oraciones.textoOriginal: Nam Mô Hắc Ra Đát Na Đa Ra Dạ Da. Nam Mô A Rị Da, Bà Lô Yết Đế, Thước Bát Ra Da, Bồ Đề Tát Đỏa Bà Da, Ma Ha Tát Đỏa Bà Da, Ma Ha Ca Lô Ni Ca Da... Án, Tất Điện Đô, Mạn Đa Ra, Bạt Đà Dạ, Ta Bà Ha.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Nam Mo Hac Ra Dat Na Da Ra Ya Da | Nam Mo A Ri Da, Ba Lo Yet De, Thuoc Bat Ra Da, Bo De Tat Doa Ba Da, Ma Ha Tat Doa Ba Da, Ma Ha Ca Lo Ni Ca Da... An, Tat Dien Do, Man Da Ra, Bat Da Da, Ta Ba Ha ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Con xin cung kinh đảnh lễ Tam Bảo và Bồ Tát Quán Thế Âm Đại Bi. May the great compassion that calms the suffering of the world descend upon our people and families, dispelling illnesses, calamities and sadness, and granting lasting peace and health.

oraciones.titulo: Sám Hối Hồng Danh (Việt Nam) – Lời Nguyện Sám Hối Thanh Lọc Tâm Ý
oraciones.textoOriginal: Đệ tử chúng con từ vô thỉ đến nay, do tham sân si, từ thân miệng ý, gây ra bao điều lầm lỗi. Nay đối trước mười phương chư Phật, chí tâm thành kính sám hối, nguyện từ nay dứt trừ điều ác, siêng làm việc lành.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: De tu chung con tu vo thi den nay, do tham san si, tu than mieng y, gay ra bao dieu lam loi. Nay doi truoc muoi phuong chu Phat, chi tam thanh kinh sam hoi, nguyen tu nay dut tru dieu ac, sieng lam viec lanh.
oraciones.textoTraducido: We, before the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas of the ten directions, sincerely repent of all mistakes committed through attachment, anger or ignorance in body, speech and thought. We promise to abandon harm, cultivate generosity, and sow seeds of peace and goodness each day.

oraciones.titulo: Bát Nhã Ba The Mật Đa Tâm Kinh (Việt Nam) – Kinh Trí Tuệ Siêu Việt
oraciones.textoOriginal: Khi Bồ Tát Quán Tự Tại hành sâu Bát Nhã Ba La Mật Đa, ngài soi thấy năm uẩn đều không, liền vượt qua mọi khổ ách... Yết đế, yết đế, ba la yết đế, ba la tăng yết đế, bồ đề tát bà ha.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Khi Bo Tat Quan Tu Tai hanh sau Bat Nha Ba La Mat Da, ngai soi thay nam uan deu khong, lien vuot qua moi kho ach... Yet de, yet de, ba la yet de, ba la tang yet de, bo de tat ba ha.
oraciones.textoTraducido: When Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara delved into Transcendent Wisdom, he realized that all phenomena are interdependent and empty of an isolated self, freeing himself from all distress. Awake, walk together to the bright shore of peace!

oraciones.titulo: Niệm Phật A Di Đà (Việt Nam) – Lời Cầu Nguyện Bình An Vãng Sanh Cực Lạc
oraciones.textoOriginal: Nam Mô A Di Đà Phật. Nguyện đem công đức này, hướng về khắp tất cả, đệ tử và chúng sanh, đều trọn thành Phật đạo.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Nam Mo A Di Da Phat | Nam Mo A Di Da Phat | Nam Mo A Di Da Phat ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Reverence to Buddha Amitabha of Infinite Life and Light. We trust in Your compassion that welcomes all souls; May tranquility, longevity and mutual love reign in our homes.

oraciones.titulo: Kinh Vu Lan Báo Hiếu (Việt Nam) – Nguyện Cầu Ân Đức Cha Mẹ và Tổ Tiên
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ơn cha lành cao như núi Thái, đức mẹ hiền sâu tựa biển khơi. Nguyện cầu mười phương Tam Bảo gia hộ cho cha mẹ hiện tiền tăng long phước thọ, tổ tiên quá vãng siêu sanh Tịnh Độ.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: On cha lanh cao nhu nui Thai, duc me hien sau tua bien khoi. Nguyen cau muoi phuong Tam Bao gia ho cho cha me hien tien tang long phuoc tho, to tien qua vang sieu sanh Tinh Do.
oraciones.textoTraducido: The grace of the father is as high as the highest mountain; Mother's love is as deep as the infinite ocean. May the blessings of the Three Jewels grant our living parents health and long blissful lives, and our ancestors peace and eternal rest in the Pure Land.

oraciones.titulo: Chú Tiêu Tai Cát Tường (Việt Nam) – Tiêu Trừ Nghiệp Chướng Đón Nhận Phúc Lành
oraciones.textoOriginal: Nẵng mồ tam mãn đa, một đà nẫm, a bát ra đề, hạ đa xá, ta nẵng nẫm, đát điệt tha: Án, khê khê, khê hế, khê hế, hồng hồng, nhập phạ ra, nhập phạ ra, bát ra nhập phạ ra, bát ra nhập phạ ra, đề sắc xá, đề sắc xá, sắc trí rị, sắc trí rị, ta phấn tra, ta phấn tra, phiến đề ca, thất rị duệ, ta phạ ha.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Nang mo tam man da, mot da nam, a bat ra de, ha da xa, ta nang nam, dat diet tha: An, khe khe, khe he, khe he, hong hong, nhap pha ra, nhap pha ra, bat ra nhap pha ra, bat ra nhap pha ra, de sac xa, de sac xa, sac tri ri, sac tri ri, ta phan tra, ta phan tra, phien de ca, that ri due, ta pha ha ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Dharani auspicious to dispel calamities, appease the difficulties of destiny and attract blessings of harmony, health and noble success to our home and workplace.

oraciones.titulo: Cheonsugyeong (Korea) – Thousand Hands and Thousand Eyes Sutra by Gwaneum Bosal
oraciones.textoOriginal: 정구업진언: 수리수리 마하수리 수수리 사바하. 신묘장구대다라니: 나모라 다나다라 야야 나막알약 바로기제 새바라야 모지사다바야 마하사다바야...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Jeong-gu-eop Jin-eon: Suri Suri Maha-Suri Su-Suri Sabaha | Shin-myo-jang-gu Dae-da-ra-ni: Namora Danadara Yaya Namak-aryak Barogije Saebaraya Mojisadabaya Mahasadabaya...
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Cheonsugyeong (Korea). May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Maha Banya Baramilda Shimgyeong (Korea) – The Heart Sutra in Korean Seon
oraciones.textoOriginal: 관자재보살 행심반야바라밀다시 조견오온개공 도일체고액. 사리자 색불이공 공불이색 색즉시공 공즉시색... 아제아제 바라아제 바라승아제 모지 사바하.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Gwan-ja-jae Bo-sal haeng-sim ban-ya-ba-ra-mil-da-si jo-gyeon o-on-gae-gong do-il-che-go-aek. Sa-ri-ja saek-bul-i-gong gong-bul-i-saek saek-jeuk-si-gong gong-jeuk-si-saek... A-je a-je ba-ra-a-je ba-ra-seung-a-je mo-ji sa-ba-ha ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: The venerable Gwanseeum Bosal saw with diamond clarity the luminous emptiness of all things and crossed the sea of ​​suffering. There is no birth or death, there is no stain or purity. Let's move forward to awakening full and serene!

oraciones.titulo: Gwaneum Bosal Jeong-geun (Korea) – Concentrated Invocation of Gwaneum's Compassion
oraciones.textoOriginal: 나무 보문시현 원력홍심 대자대비 구고구난 관세음보살... 관세음보살 관세음보살 관세음보살...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Namu Bomun-sihyeon Wonryeok-hongsim Daeja-daebi Gugo-gunan Gwanseeum Bosal | Gwanseeum Bosal Gwanseeum Bosal Gwanseeum Bosal ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Reverence to Gwanseeum Bosal, of immense vow and compassionate heart that rescues from pain and affliction. By continually chanting Your holy name, we find serenity of mind, safe refuge and peace for our family.

oraciones.titulo: Yaksayeoraebul Jeong-geun (Korea) – Invocation to the Medicine Healing Buddha
oraciones.textoOriginal: 나무 동방만월세계 십이대원 명행족 굴치병고 약사여래불... 약사여래불 약사여래불 약사여래불...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Namu Dongbang Manwol-segye Sib-i-daewon Myeong-haeng-jok Gulchi-byeonggo Yaksa-yeoraebul | Yaksa-yeoraebul Yaksa-yeoraebul ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Salutations to the Medicine Buddha of the Eastern Full Moon World, who fulfilled the twelve great vows to eradicate diseases and pain from living beings. Shed Your healing light on our body and mind!

oraciones.titulo: Jijang Bosal Jeong-geun (Korea) – Invocation to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva
oraciones.textoOriginal: 나무 남방화주 대원본존 지장보살... 옴 바라 마니 다니 사바하. 지장보살 지장보살 지장보살...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Namu Nambang Hwaju Daewon Bonjon Jijang Bosal | Om Bara Mani Dani Sabaha | Jijang Bosal Jijang Bosal ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Salutations to the Great Vow of Bodhisattva Jijang (Ksitigarbha), who promised not to enter Nirvana until the last suffering being is rescued. OM BARA MANI DANI SABAHA! Protection of the deceased and comfort for the afflicted.

oraciones.titulo: Balwonmun of Wonhyo Daesa (Corea) – The Gran Prayer of the Maestro Wonhyo
oraciones.textoOriginal: 시방삼세 제불보살님께 귀의하옵고 원하옵나니, 저의 이 마음 본래 맑고 밝아 걸림이 없사오니, 모든 중생과 더불어 한마음(一心)의 바다에 들게 하소서.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Sibang samse jebul bosalnim-kke gwi-ui ha-ob-go won-ha-om-nani, jeo-ui i maeum bonrae malk-go balk-a geollim-i eob-sa-oni, modeun jungsaeng-gwa deobuleo Han-maeum(Il-sim)-ui bada-e deulge hasoseo.
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Balwonmun of Wonhyo Daesa (Corea). May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Prajnaparamita Hridaya Sutram (Original Sanskrit) – The Essence of the Heart
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ नमो भगवत्यै आर्यप्रज्ञापारमितायै। आर्यव्यवलोकितेश्वरो बोधिसत्त्वो गम्भीरायां प्रज्ञापारमितायां चर्यां चरमाणो व्यवलोकयति स्म: पञ्चस्कन्धांस्तांश्च स्वभावशून्यान् पश्यति स्म...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Namo Bhagavatyai Arya-Prajnaparamitayai | Arya-Avalokiteshvaro bodhisattvo gambhirayam prajnaparamitayam caryam caramano vyavalokayati sma: panca-skandhams tamsh ca svabhava-shunyan pashyati sma... Gate gate paragate parasamgate bodhi svaha ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Reverence to the Sacred Transcendent Wisdom! Avalokiteshvara contemplated in the depth of meditation that the five components of existence have no fixed and independent entity. Form is emptiness, emptiness is form. Gate gate paragate parasamgate bodhi svaha!

oraciones.titulo: Vajracchedika Prajnaparamita (Diamond Sutra in Sanskrit) – The Final Gatha
oraciones.textoOriginal: तारका तिमिरं दीपो मायावश्यायकः कलः। स्वप्नं च विद्युदभ्रं च एवं द्रष्टव्य संस्कृतम्॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Taraka timiram dipo mayavashyayah kalah | Svapnam ca vidyud-abhram ca evam drashtavya samskritam ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Like a shooting star, a shadow in the pupil, the flame of a candle, an optical illusion, a drop of dew, a bubble in the river, a dream at night, a lightning bolt or a cloud in the sky: this is how the wise man contemplates all the conditioned experiences of this world.

oraciones.titulo: Karanavyuha Sutra (Om Mani Padme Hum) – The Jewel in the Heart of the Lotus
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ मणिपद्मे हूं। सर्वसत्त्वानां दुःखापनोदाय महाकरुणामूर्तये नमः।
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Mani Padme Hum | Sarva-sattvanam duhkhapanodaya maha-karuna-murtaye namah ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: OM MANI PADME HUM! Behold the immaculate jewel of compassion in the secret lotus of the heart. May this sacred mantra close the doors of suffering in the six realms of existence and awaken infinite love towards all living creatures.

oraciones.titulo: Maha Tara Mantra Universal (Om Tare Tuttare Ture Svaha) – Protection and Pronta Ayuda
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ तारे तुत्तारे तुरे स्वाहा। सर्वविघ्नान् प्रशमय स्वाहा। सर्वदुःखानि नाशय स्वाहा।
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Tare Tuttare Ture Svaha | Sarva-vighnan prashamaya svaha | Sarva-duhkhani nashaya svaha ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Maha Tara Mantra Universal (Om Tare Tuttare Ture Svaha). May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: The Four Immeasurable Attitudes (Brahmaviharas in Tibetan Tradition)
oraciones.textoOriginal: སེམས་ཅན་ཐམས་ཅད་བདེ་བ་དང་བདེ་བའི་རྒྱུ་དང་ལྡན་པར་གྱུར་ཅིག༔ སྡུག་བསྔལ་དང་སྡུག་བསྔལ་གྱི་རྒྱུ་དང་བྲལ་བར་གྱུར་ཅིག༔ སྡུག་བསྔལ་མེད་པའི་བདེ་བ་དང་མི་འབྲལ་བར་གྱུར་ཅིག༔ ཉེ་རིང་ཆགས་སྡང་གཉིས་དང་བྲལ་བའི་བཏང་སྙོམས་ལ་གནས་པར་གྱུར་ཅིག༔
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Semchen thamched dewa dang dewey gyu dang denpar gyur cig | Dugngal dang dugngal gyi gyu dang dralwar gyur cig | Dugngal meypey dewa dang mindralwar gyur cig | Nyering chag dang nyi dang dralwey tangnyom la neypar gyur cig ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: May all beings possess happiness and the causes of happiness (Love). May all beings be free from suffering and the causes of suffering (Compassion). May all beings never be separated from the sacred bliss free of affliction (Empathic Joy). May all beings dwell in great equanimity, free from attachment and rejection.

oraciones.titulo: Deche Monlam (Prayer of Aspiración a Sukhavati of Karma Chagme / Raga Asya)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ཨེ་མ་ཧོ༔ ངོ་མཚར་སངས་རྒྱས་སྣང་བ་མཐའ་ཡས་དང༔ གཡས་སུ་ཇོ་བོ་ཐུགས་རྗེ་ཆེན་པོ་དང༔ གཡོན་དུ་སེམས་དཔའ་མཐུ་ཆེན་ཐོབ་རྣམས་ལ༔ སངས་རྒྱས་བྱང་སེམས་དཔག་མེད་འཁོར་གྱིས་བསྐོར༔
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Emaho | Tsomo Sangye Nangwa Thayey dang | Yey su Jowo Thugje Chenpo dang | Yon du Sempa Thuchen Thob nam la | Sangye Changsem pagmey khor gyi kor ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Emmaho! In the western direction is the wonderful Pure Land of Sukhavati, where dwells the Buddha of Infinite Light Amitabha, accompanied on his right by the Great Compassionate Chenrezig and on his left by the Mighty Vajrapani. Upon leaving this body, may we be spontaneously reborn in the heart of a lotus flower in His presence!

oraciones.titulo: White Mahakala Mantra (Gonkar) – Spiritual Prosperity and Dissolution of Scarcity
oraciones.textoOriginal: གུ་རུ་མ་ཧཱ་ཀཱ་ལ་ཧ་རི་ནི་ས་སིདྡྷི་ཛཿ ཨོཾ་བཛྲ་ཙིཏྟ་ཧཱུྃ་ཕཊ༔ དཀར་པོ་མགོན་པོ་ཡིད་བཞིན་ནོར་བུ་ཡིས༔ དབུལ་ཕོངས་ཀུན་ཞི་དངོས་གྲུབ་སྩོལ་ཅིག༔
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Guru Mahakala Hari Nisa Siddhi Dza | Om Vajra Tsitta Hung Phat | Karpo Gonpo Yidzhin Norbu yi | Dbul phong kun zhi ngodrub tsol cig ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: We invoke White Mahakala, protector of sincere practitioners and jewel that fulfills noble desires. It dissolves all material and spiritual scarcity, protects the resources of the community and grants worthy abundance for generosity and the sustenance of the Dharma.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Saraswati / Yangchenma (Tibet) – Inspiration in Arts, Music and Poetry
oraciones.textoOriginal: ཨོཾ་པྲཛྙཱ་ཝརྡྷ་ནི་ཧྲཱིཿསྭཱ་ཧཱ༔ དབྱངས་ཅན་ལྷ་མོ་མཚོ་བྱུང་མ་ལ་ཕྱག་འཚལ་ལོ༔ བློ་གྲོས་སྤོབས་པའི་གཏེར་ཆེན་འགྲུབ་པར་ཤོག༔
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Prajna Vardhani Hrih Svaha | Yangchen Lhamo Tsojungma la chagtsal lo | Lodro pobpey terchen drubpar shog ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: OM PRAJNA VARDHANI HRIH SVAHA! We worship the Goddess of Sweet Melody, Yangchenma (Saraswati). Awaken in our minds the spark of pure inspiration, eloquence in words, talent in the arts and wisdom in knowledge.

oraciones.titulo: Usnisha Vijaya Long Mantra (Namgyalma) – Karmic Purification and Longevity
oraciones.textoOriginal: ཨོཾ་བྷྲཱུྃ་སྭཱ་ཧཱ༔ ཨོཾ་ཨ་མྲྀ་ཏ་ཨཱ་ཡུརྡ་དེ་སྭཱ་ཧཱ༔ གཙུག་གཏོར་རྣམ་པར་རྒྱལ་མའི་བྱིན་རླབས་ཀྱིས༔ ཚེ་དང་བསོད་ནམས་ཡེ་ཤེས་རྒྱས་གྱུར་ཅིག༔
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Bhrum Svaha | Om Amrita Ayur-Dade Svaha | Tsugtor Nampar Gyalmey jinlab kyi | Tse dang sonam yeshe gyey gyur cig ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: OM BHRUM SVAHA! Usnisha Vijaya, manifestation of the crown of the Enlightened One that purifies the darkest karmas and grants invulnerable health. May your light purify our subtle channels and fill us with vital energy, wisdom and peace.

oraciones.titulo: Maha Shakyamuni Buddha Mantra (Om Muni Muni Maha Munaye Svaha)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ཏདྱཐཱ༔ ཨོཾ་མུ་ནེ་མུ་ནེ་མ་ཧཱ་མུ་ན་ཡེ་སྭཱ་ཧཱ༔ སྟོན་པ་ཐུགས་རྗེ་ཅན་གྱི་ཞབས་ལ་ཕྱག་འཚལ་ལོ༔
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Tadyatha: Om Muni Muni Maha Munaye Svaha | Tonpa Thugjechen gyi zhab la chagtsal lo ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: OM MUNI MUNI MAHA MUNAYE SVAHA! We venerate the Sage of the Shakya, the Historical Enlightened One who showed the Middle Path between the extremes, teaching that peace is found in the awakened heart, free of greed and resentment.

oraciones.titulo: Sangye Cho Dang (Solemn Refuge and Generation of the Mind of Awakening - Bodhicitta)
oraciones.textoOriginal: སངས་རྒྱས་ཆོས་དང་ཚོགས་ཀྱི་མཆོག་རྣམས་ལ༔ བྱང་ཆུབ་བར་དུ་བདག་ནི་སྐྱབས་སུ་མཆི༔ བདག་གིས་སྦྱིན་སོགས་བགྱིས་པའི་བསོད་ནམས་ཀྱིས༔ འགྲོ་ལ་ཕན་ཕྱིར་སངས་རྒྱས་འགྲུབ་པར་ཤོག༔
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Sangye Cho dang Tsog kyi Chog nam la | Changchub bardu dag ni kyab su chi | Dag gi jin sog gyipey sonam kyi | Dro la phen chir Sangye drubpar shog ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the Buddha, in the Holy Dharma and in the Supreme Assembly of the Sangha, I take refuge until I reach Enlightenment. May by the merit of generosity and the other virtues that I practice, may I achieve Supreme Awakening to benefit all sentient beings.

oraciones.titulo: Aspiration in the Six Transcendent Perfections (Paramitas)
oraciones.textoOriginal: སྦྱིན་པ་ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས་བཟོད་པ་བརྩོན་འགྲུས་དང༔ བསམ་གཏན་ཤེས་རབ་ཕ་རོལ་ཕྱིན་དྲུག་པོ༔ ཉིན་མཚན་ཀུན་ཏུ་ཉམས་སུ་ལེན་པར་ཤོག༔
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Jinpa tsultrim zodpa tsondru dang | Samten sherab pharol chyin drugpo | Nyintsen kuntu nyamsu lenpar shog ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Aspiration in the Six Transcendent Perfections (Paramitas). May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

oraciones.titulo: Sacramental Bread Prayer (D&C 20:77 / Moroni 4:3)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Oh Dios, Padre Eterno, en el nombre de Jesucristo, tu Hijo, te pedimos que bendigas y santifiques este pan para las almas de todos los que participen de él...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Oh Dios, Padre Eterno, en el nombre de Jesucristo, tu Hijo, te pedimos que bendigas y santifiques este pan...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O God, Eternal Father, in the name of Jesus Christ, your Son, we ask you to bless and sanctify this bread for the souls of all who partake of it, that they may eat it in memory of the body of your Son, and testify before you, O God, Eternal Father, that they are willing to take upon themselves the name of your Son, and to always remember him, and to keep his commandments which he has given them, so that they may always have his Spirit with them. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Sacramental Water Prayer (D&C 20:79 / Moroni 5:2)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Oh Dios, Padre Eterno, en el nombre de Jesucristo, tu Hijo, te pedimos que bendigas y santifiques esta agua para las almas de todos los que la beban...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Oh Dios, Padre Eterno, en el nombre de Jesucristo, tu Hijo, te pedimos que bendigas y santifiques esta agua...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O God, Eternal Father, in the name of Jesus Christ, your Son, we ask you to bless and sanctify this water for the souls of all who drink it, so that they may do so in memory of the blood of your Son, which was shed for them; so that they may testify before you, O God, the Eternal Father, that they always remember him, so that they may have his Spirit with them. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Baptismal Prayer by Immersion (3 Nephi 11:25 / D&C 20:73)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Habiendo sido comisionado por Jesucristo, yo te bautizo en el nombre del Padre, y del Hijo, y del Espíritu Santo. Amén.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Habiendo sido comisionado por Jesucristo, yo te bautizo en el nombre del Padre, y del Hijo, y del Espíritu Santo. Amén.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Having been commissioned by Jesus Christ, I baptize you in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Confirmation Ordinance and Granting of the Gift of the Holy Spirit
oraciones.textoOriginal: Por la autoridad del Santo Sacerdocio de Melquisedec, te confirmamos miembro de La Iglesia de Jesucristo de los Santos de los Últimos Días, y te decimos: Recibe el Espíritu Santo...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Por la autoridad del Santo Sacerdocio de Melquisedec, te confirmamos miembro de La Iglesia de Jesucristo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Jesus Christ and by the authority of the Holy Priesthood of Melchizedek, we place our hands on your head and confirm you as a member of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, and we say to you: Receive the Holy Spirit. We bless you so that your heart may be a temple of light, your mind may be guided by the Comforter, and you may always feel the peace of the Savior.

oraciones.titulo: Consecration of Pure Olive Oil for the Healing of the Sick
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre Celestial, por la autoridad del Sacerdocio de Melquisedec, consagramos y apartamos este aceite de oliva puro para la unción y bendición de los enfermos y afligidos...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Padre Celestial, por la autoridad del Sacerdocio de Melquisedec, consagramos y apartamos este aceite...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, in the name of Jesus Christ and by the power of the Holy Priesthood of Melchizedek, we consecrate this pure olive oil for the anointing and blessing of the sick. We pray that it be sanctified to bring relief, healing and strength according to your holy will and the faith of your children.

oraciones.titulo: Priesthood Blessing of the Sick by Laying on of Hands
oraciones.textoOriginal: Hermano/a, por la autoridad del Santo Sacerdocio de Melquisedec y habiendo sido ungido con aceite consagrado, sellamos y confirmamos esta unción...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Hermano, por la autoridad del Santo Sacerdocio de Melquisedec...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Jesus Christ and by the power of the Melchizedek Priesthood, we seal and confirm the anointing performed on your head. We bless you with physical strength, cellular restoration and peace in your spirit. We rebuke the affliction and pray that the healing grace of the Redeemer fills your being so that you rise with renewed vigor.

oraciones.titulo: Dedication of the Home as a Sanctuary of Peace and Family Refuge
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre Celestial, por la autoridad del Sacerdocio de Melquisedec, dedicamos este hogar como un lugar santo, un refugio contra las tormentas del mundo...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Padre Celestial, por la autoridad del Sacerdocio de Melquisedec, dedicamos este hogar...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Dear Heavenly Father, in the name of Jesus Christ we dedicate this house and its foundations to be a sanctuary of peace, harmony and holiness. May your holy angels guard the doors and windows; May the Holy Spirit dwell in every room, and may those who live here grow in love, respect and mutual devotion.

oraciones.titulo: Parent Blessing Children at the Beginning of the School Year or Tests
oraciones.textoOriginal: Hijo/a mío/a, en el nombre de Jesucristo y por el poder del Santo Sacerdocio que poseo, pongo mis manos sobre tu cabeza para darte una bendición de padre...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Hijo mio, en el nombre de Jesucristo y por el poder del Santo Sacerdocio...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Dear child, in the name of Jesus Christ I bless you with mental clarity, spiritual discernment and protection against the temptations of the world. May you have confidence in your abilities, peace in your decisions and always feel the infinite love of God and your family.

oraciones.titulo: Dedication of the Grave for Peaceful Rest until the Resurrection
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre Celestial, por la autoridad del Santo Sacerdocio de Melquisedec, dedicamos y consagramos este sepulcro como el lugar de descanso...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Padre Celestial, por la autoridad del Santo Sacerdocio de Melquisedec, dedicamos este sepulcro...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Eternal Father, in the name of Jesus Christ we dedicate this resting place for the earthly body of our loved one, until the glorious morning of the Resurrection. Comfort the grieving hearts and fill us with the unshakeable certainty of eternal families and heavenly reunion.

oraciones.titulo: The Psalm of Nephi (2 Nephi 4:16-35) – Absolute Trust in the Rock of Salvation
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Oh, miserable hombre que soy! ¡Sí, mi corazón se aflige a causa de mi carne; mi alma se duele a causa de mis iniquidades!... No obstante, sé en quién he confiado...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: ¡Oh, miserable hombre que soy! ¡Si, mi corazon se aflige a causa de mi carne...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Heavenly Father, we come before Thee in the sacred and reverent name of Thy Son, Jesus Christ. We present our humble petition and gratitude for The Psalm of Nephi (2 Nephi 4:16. We pray that Thou wilt pour out Thy Holy Spirit upon our home, strengthen our testimony, bless our daily labors, and guide us in righteousness along the covenant path. In the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Enos' Prayer in the Forest (Enos 1:1-17) – The Soul's Struggle for Forgiveness
oraciones.textoOriginal: Y mi alma tuvo hambre; y me arrodillé ante mi Hacedor, y clamé a él con ferviente oración y súplica por mi propia alma...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Y mi alma tuvo hambre; y me arrodille ante mi Hacedor...
oraciones.textoTraducido: My soul hungered for righteousness; and I knelt in the forest before my Creator, and cried to Him with fervent prayer all day and night for my own soul. And a voice came to me saying: Enos, your sins are forgiven you, and you will be blessed because of your faith in Christ. And my guilt was erased. And I also prayed with all my heart for my brothers and for my enemies, that the Lord would preserve a sacred record.

oraciones.titulo: The Prayer and Sermon of King Benjamin (Mosiah 2:17-21) – Service to Others
oraciones.textoOriginal: Cuando os halláis en el servicio de vuestros semejantes, sólo os halláis en el servicio de vuestro Dios...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Cuando os hallais en el servicio de vuestros semejantes, solo os hallais en el servicio de vuestro Dios...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, we recognize that when we serve our fellow human beings we are only serving our God. We have nothing to boast about, for You created us from dust and give us breath moment by moment. Grant us a humble heart, generous hands to clothe the naked and feed the hungry, and unwavering joy in Christ.

oraciones.titulo: Alma's Prayer for the Humble Zoramites (Alma 31:26-38)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Oh Señor, hasta cuándo permitirás que esta iniquidad e infidelidad prevalezca entre este pueblo! ¡Oh Señor, dame fuerzas para sobrellevar mis aflicciones...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: ¡Oh Senor, hasta cuando permitiras que esta iniquidad...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Lord God, see how precious the souls of this people are, and many of them are our brothers! Therefore, give us, O Lord, power and wisdom that we may bring these our brothers back to you. Comfort our souls in Christ and grant us success in the preaching of your Gospel.

oraciones.titulo: The Chant of Triunfo and Gozo of Ammón (Alma 26:11-37)
oraciones.textoOriginal: No me jacto de mi propia fuerza ni de mi propia sabiduría; pero he aquí, mi gozo es completo, sí, mi corazón rebosa de gozo, y me regocijaré en mi Dios...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: No me jacto de mi propia fuerza ni de mi propia sabiduria...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I do not boast in my own strength, but my heart overflows with joy and I will rejoice in my God. Because with his strength I can do all things. How great are the mercies of the Lord toward those who repent! He is a compassionate and loving God who rescues those who were in darkness and fills them with the light of his truth.

oraciones.titulo: The Prayer of the Brother of Jared on Mount Shelem (Ether 3:1-5)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Oh Señor, has dicho que debemos ser rodeados por las olas! Ahora bien, oh Señor, no te enojes con tu siervo a causa de su debilidad delante de ti...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: ¡Oh Senor, has dicho que debemos ser rodeados por las olas!...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Lord, be merciful to me and look at these sixteen stones that I have cast from the rock. Touch these stones with your finger, O Lord, and prepare them to shine in the darkness of our ships, so that we may not cross the great waters in darkness. We know that you have all power to do this for us.

oraciones.titulo: The Intercessory Prayer of Jesus Christ in the Land of Plenty (3 Nephi 17 & 19)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Y nadie puede concebir el gozo que llenó nuestras almas al oírle orar por nosotros al Padre...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Y nadie puede concebir el gozo que lleno nuestras almas...
oraciones.textoTraducido: The Savior knelt on the earth and prayed to the Father with words so sublime and full of love that no human language can describe them. He healed the lame, blind and sick, took the little children one by one, blessed them and prayed for them with tears of heavenly tenderness. Glory to the Holy Messiah, Redeemer of the world!

oraciones.titulo: Moroni's Promise to Obtain Testimony by the Spirit (Moroni 10:3-5)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Y cuando recibáis estas cosas, quisiera exhortaros a que preguntéis a Dios el Eterno Padre, en el nombre de Cristo, si no son verdaderas estas cosas...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Y cuando recibais estas cosas, quisiera exhortaros...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Eternal Father, in the name of Jesus Christ I ask you with a sincere heart and with true faith to reveal to me the truth of the Book of Mormon by the power of the Holy Spirit. Open my understanding and confirm in my chest the certainty of your restored Gospel, knowing that You manifest the truth to those who seek You with devotion.

oraciones.titulo: The First Vision in the Sacred Grove (James 1:5 / Joseph Smith-History)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Vi una columna de luz, más brillante que el sol, directamente arriba de mi cabeza; y esta luz gradualmente descendió hasta descansar sobre mí...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Vi una columna de luz, mas brillante que el sol...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, just as young Joseph came to the Sacred Grove seeking wisdom and forgiveness, I come to you with simple faith. May your light dispel all spiritual darkness from my path, may I hear the voice of your beloved Son saying 'This is my Beloved Son: Listen to him!', and find safe direction for my life.

oraciones.titulo: Supplication at Liberty Jail (D&C 121:1-9 / D&C 122:7)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Oh Dios, ¿dónde estás? ¿Y dónde está el pabellón que cubre tu morada oculta?... Hijo mío, paz a tu alma; tu adversidad y tus aflicciones no serán más que por un breve momento...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: ¡Oh Dios, ¿donde estas? ¿Y donde esta el pabellon...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh God of our fathers! In times of pain, injustice or severe trial we cry out to you. We hear your tender response: 'My son, peace to your soul; your adversity will be but for a brief moment; and then, if you bear it well, God will exalt you; All these things will serve as your experience and will be for your good.' Grant unbreakable patience to my heart.

oraciones.titulo: Kirtland Temple Dedicatory Prayer (D&C 109)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Te damos gracias, oh Señor Dios de Israel... para que tu santo nombre sea honrado en esta casa que hemos edificado a tu nombre...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Te damos gracias, oh Senor Dios de Israel...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Heavenly Father, we come before Thee in the sacred and reverent name of Thy Son, Jesus Christ. We present our humble petition and gratitude for Kirtland Temple Dedicatory Prayer (D&C 109). We pray that Thou wilt pour out Thy Holy Spirit upon our home, strengthen our testimony, bless our daily labors, and guide us in righteousness along the covenant path. In the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of the Thirteen Articles of Faith (Joseph Smith)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Creemos en Dios el Eterno Padre, y en su Hijo Jesucristo, y en el Espíritu Santo...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Creemos en Dios el Eterno Padre, y en su Hijo Jesucristo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Eternal Father, we consecrate our faith in you, in the atonement of Jesus Christ and in the sacred ordinances of the Gospel. Give us courage to be honest, truthful, chaste, benevolent and virtuous, always seeking everything that is virtuous, beautiful or of good reputation.

oraciones.titulo: Relief Society Prayer – 'Charity Never Fails'
oraciones.textoOriginal: Amado Padre Celestial, une los corazones de las hermanas en amor puro y servicio compasivo...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Amado Padre Celestial, une los corazones de las hermanas...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, bless the women of Relief Society around the world. May the pure love of Christ (charity) guide your hands to help the needy, comfort the sad and strengthen families. May every home feel the warmth of your faith and devotion.

oraciones.titulo: Primary Prayer – 'I am a Son of God'
oraciones.textoOriginal: Soy un hijo de Dios y Él me envió aquí; me ha dado un hogar en la tierra con padres bondadosos...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Soy un hijo de Dios y El me envio aqui...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, thank you for reminding me that I am your child, that you love me and have a divine purpose for my life. Guide me, accompany me and teach me what I should do so that one day I can live with you again.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Consecration of the Manzana of the Templo (Salt Lake City - EE.UU.)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Our Father in Heaven, we consecrate our hearts to Thee as we behold the House of the Lord in the Salt Lake Valley...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Our Father in Heaven, we consecrate our hearts to Thee...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, we consecrate our lives as we contemplate the House of the Lord in the Salt Lake Valley. We honor the faith and sacrifice of the pioneers who crossed plains and mountains with handcarts. May that same flame of unwavering faith guide our families today.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Apertura of the Conferencia General (EE.UU. / Global)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre nuestro que estás en los cielos, nos reunimos en asamblea solemne para escuchar la voz de tus siervos...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Padre nuestro que estas en los cielos, nos reunimos en asamblea solemne...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, we come together as people around the world to listen to the counsel of your living prophet and the apostles. Open our hearts, soften our spirit, and grant us the strength to apply his teachings of love, repentance, and family unity.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Faith in the Mexico City Temple
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre Celestial, te damos gracias por el Santo Templo en la Ciudad de México y por el florecimiento de Sión en tierras mexicanas...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Padre Celestial, te damos gracias por el Santo Templo en la Ciudad de Mexico...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Father, bless the families of Mexico. We thank you for the temples erected in this noble nation. May peace reign in our cities, may young people remain firm in righteousness and may the Gospel continue to bring hope, decent work and unity to every Mexican home.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer for the Missionaries in the Sierras and Cities of Mexico
oraciones.textoOriginal: Señor Jesús, cuida a los élderes y hermanas que recorren México proclamando el mensaje de la Restauración...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Senor Jesus, cuida a los elderes y hermanas...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Almighty Lord, extend your protective hand over the missionaries throughout Mexico. Open the doors of sincere homes, protect them from dangers and allow them to find souls prepared to receive the peace of the eternal covenant.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Consecration of Families in the Temple of São Paulo (Brazil)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Pai Celestial, em nome de Jesus Cristo nós Te agradecemos pelo Santo Templo em São Paulo e pelo amor e fé dos santos brasileiros...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Pai Celestial, em nome de Jesus Cristo nos Te agradecemos...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, we thank you for the devotion and joy of the Saints in Brazil. Bless the families who travel from the Amazon to the south to be sealed for eternity in your Holy Temples. Pour peace and prosperity on the Brazilian land.

oraciones.titulo: Oração da Noite Familyr no Lar Brasileiro
oraciones.textoOriginal: Querido Pai Celestial, reunidos em nosso lar no Brasil, Te pedimos união, saúde e discernimento para nossos filhos...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Querido Pai Celestial, reunidos em nosso lar no Brasil...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Dear Heavenly Father, gathered as a family in our home, we ask you for harmony, health and protection for our children. Help us to keep the light of the Gospel burning, to forgive each other quickly, and to serve our neighbors generously.

oraciones.titulo: Panalangin ng Pananampalataya sa Templo ng Maynila (Philippines)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Amang Banal sa Langit, nagpapasalamat kami sa Iyong pag-ibig at sa Banal na Templo sa Maynila...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Amang Banal sa Langit, nagpapasalamat kami sa Iyong pag-ibig...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, bless the devout Saints of the Philippine Islands. In the midst of typhoons, storms and trials, grant us the firmness of faith to remain anchored in Jesus Christ. Protect our communities and bless the work of our hands.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Gratitude of the Saints in the Andes and Coasts of Peru
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre Celestial, te alabamos desde el Perú, tierra de nobleza y fe, por los Templos sagrados en Lima, Arequipa y Trujillo...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Padre Celestial, te alabamos desde el Peru...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, we thank you for the unwavering faith of the Saints in Peru. From the Andean peaks to the coast and the jungle, bless homes with honest work, young people with desires to improve, and the Church with spiritual growth and charity.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Resilience and Faith of the Saints in Chile
oraciones.textoOriginal: Señor Dios de Israel, bendice a nuestro amado Chile, tierra entre la cordillera y el mar...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Senor Dios de Israel, bendice a nuestro amado Chile...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord God of our fathers, bless the people of Chile. In times of earthquakes or trials, strengthen our hope in Christ. May the peace of the Temple of Santiago and Concepción be an immovable refuge of love, comfort and family strength.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Peace and Fraternity of Saints in Argentina
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre Celestial, elevamos nuestra súplica desde el Río de la Plata y las provincias de Argentina...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Padre Celestial, elevamos nuestra suplica desde el Rio de la Plata...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, pour out your Spirit on the families in Argentina. Give us wisdom to endure economic challenges with integrity and faith. May mutual love reign in our branches and stakes, and may we be an example of brotherhood and service in society.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Devotion of the Families of Guatemala and Central America
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre Eterno, te damos gracias por el Templo de la Ciudad de Guatemala y de Quetzaltenango...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Padre Eterno, te damos gracias por el Templo de Guatemala...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Eternal Father, bless the children of Lehi and all the families of Guatemala and Central America. May the light of the Gospel protect our children, strengthen marriages, and flourish in justice and peace in every village and city.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer for the Legado Histórico of the Misión Británica (Preston / Londres)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Heavenly Father, we remember the faith of the early British saints who heard the restored Gospel on the banks of the River Ribble...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Heavenly Father, we remember the faith of the early British saints...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, we remember with gratitude the first British Saints who received the restored message in the waters of the River Ribble at Preston. Renew your children's faith in the UK and Europe; fill youth with fervor and make the light of the Savior shine with renewed strength.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Gozo and Chant of the Saints of West Africa (Nigeria & Ghana)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Heavenly Father, our hearts sing with boundless joy for the Gospel of Jesus Christ in Africa...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Heavenly Father, our hearts sing with boundless joy...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, our hearts sing with immense joy for the Gospel in Africa. We thank you for the Holy Temples of Aba in Nigeria and Accra in Ghana. Bless our communities with peace, prosperity, and strong families founded on the Rock of Christ.

oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Heavenly Father, we come before Thee in the sacred and reverent name of Thy Son, Jesus Christ. We present our humble petition and gratitude for Peace and Spiritual Light of the Saints in India. We pray that Thou wilt pour out Thy Holy Spirit upon our home, strengthen our testimony, bless our daily labors, and guide us in righteousness along the covenant path. In the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
