oraciones.titulo: Cry for the Baptism in the Holy Spirit and Fire of Pentecost (Acts 2:1-4)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Señor Jesús, sumérgeme en el río de tu Espíritu Santo; que descienda el fuego purificador de Pentecostés sobre mi vida y se desaten lenguas de alabanza celestial...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Senor Jesus, sumergeme en el rio de tu Espiritu Santo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus, baptize me with your Holy Spirit and Fire! Just as on the day of Pentecost a roar like a mighty wind came from heaven and filled the entire house, today it fills my being completely. Burn away all impurity, unleash the heavenly gift of praise and pour a fresh anointing on my head to witness you with invincible power. In the name of Jesus, amen!

oraciones.titulo: Full Coverage Prayer for the Precious Blood of Jesus Christ (Revelation 12:11)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Aplico la Sangre del Cordero de Dios sobre mi mente, mi cuerpo, mis hijos, mi hogar y mis finanzas; ningún dardo del enemigo puede tocar lo que ha sido sellado con la Sangre...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Aplico la Sangre del Cordero de Dios sobre mi mente...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ, I apply the power of the precious Blood of the Lamb over my life, my family, my entrance and my exit! The Blood of Christ draws a line of fire and protection that no spirit of darkness can penetrate. Every accusation, illness or plan of the adversary is canceled, because through the Blood of Christ we are more than conquerors.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Ruptura of Maldiciones Generacionales and Ataduras Familyres (Gálatas 3:13)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Cristo nos redimió de la maldición de la ley, hecho por nosotros maldición. Rompo todo pacto ancestral de ruina, enfermedad y divorcio en el nombre de Jesús...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Cristo nos redimio de la maldicion de la ley...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Jesus Christ and by the power of the Cross of Calvary, I declare that Christ redeemed me from every curse! I renounce and cut off all spiritual inheritance of scarcity, chronic illness, alcoholism, pain and discord that has come from my ancestors. I establish the lineage of blessing, health and holiness upon my children and future generations.

oraciones.titulo: Fervent Cry for Divine Healing: 'By His Wounds We Were Healed' (Isaiah 53:5)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Él mismo llevó nuestras enfermedades y cargó con nuestros dolores. ¡Por la llaga de Cristo ordeno a todo cáncer, dolor y dolencia salir de este cuerpo!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: El mismo llevo nuestras enfermedades y cargo con nuestros dolores...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy Father, your Word declares that He certainly bore our illnesses and suffered our pains! In the supreme name of Jesus, I take possession of divine health. I speak life to my cells, organs, bones and immune system; I order every virus, bacteria, inflammation and spirit of illness to leave this temple of the Holy Spirit. I am healthy for the glory of God!

oraciones.titulo: Midnight Cry for the Breaking of Chains (Acts 16:25-26)
oraciones.textoOriginal: A la medianoche, orando y cantando himnos a Dios, sobrevino un gran terremoto celestial y se abrieron todas las puertas y las cadenas de todos se soltaron...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: A la medianoche, orando y cantando himnos a Dios...
oraciones.textoTraducido: At midnight I get up to praise you, Lord! Just as in the Philippian prison the praise of Paul and Silas unleashed a heavenly earthquake, today I release songs of victory in the midst of my difficulty. May the iron bars fall, the chains of captivity be broken and the doors of freedom and divine favor open wide in my life!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Resurrection and Breath of Life in the Valley of Dry Bones (Ezekiel 37)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Espíritu, ven de los cuatro vientos y sopla sobre estos muertos, y vivirán! ¡Huesos secos, oíd palabra de Jehová!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Espiritu, ven de los cuatro vientos y sopla sobre estos muertos...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I prophesy in the name of Jesus over every dry area of ​​my life! Blow, oh Wind of the Spirit, on my stopped projects, on my broken health and on the extinguished souls of my family. Dry bones, cover yourselves with flesh and vigor; Let a victorious army arise where before there was desolation!

oraciones.titulo: Cry of Intercession to Unleash Warrior Angels of Fire (Psalm 91:11 / Hebrews 1:14)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Pues a sus ángeles mandará acerca de ti, que te guarden en todos tus caminos. Salgan legiones celestiales a derribar potestades...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Pues a sus angeles mandara acerca de ti...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, I ask you in the name of Jesus to send your armies of ministering angels and warriors with drawn swords! May they camp around my house, clear the air of all oppression, neutralize the attacks of the evil one and guard my loved ones wherever they go.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Rebuke to the Devourer and Opening of the Financial Heavens (Malachi 3:10)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Traed todos los diezmos al alfolí... y probadme ahora en esto, dice Jehová de los ejércitos, si no os abriré las ventanas de los cielos...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Traed todos los diezmos al alfoli...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord of hosts, I bring my offering before your altar with gratitude and faithfulness! I rebuke in the name of Jesus the devouring spirit of my finances, my harvest and my work. I open the windows of heaven by faith; unleash rain of honest provision, creativity in business and wisdom to manage resources for the enlargement of your Kingdom.

oraciones.titulo: Morning Prayer and Clamor for Brazil (Assembleia of Deus / Belém do Pará)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Senhor Jesus, de madrugada Te busco; derrama Teu avivamento sobre as cidades e sertões do Brasil...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Senhor Jesus, de madrugada Te busco...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Senhor Deus de Elias, at dawn we prostrate ourselves before your throne. Pour the fire of Espírito Santo over the Brazilian lares; Heals families, frees young people from crime and drugs, restores work and the face of Brazil, a speed of missões for the whole world. Em nome de Jesus, amém!

oraciones.titulo: Oração do Cerco of Jericó – Derrubando as Muralhas da Impossibilidade (Brazil)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Caiam por terra as muralhas do desespero, da dívida e da doença pelo poder do brado de vitória em Cristo...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Caiam por terra as muralhas do desespero...
oraciones.textoTraducido: We march with faith and praise around every impossible problem! In the name of Jesus, the walls of Jericho that prevented our advance fall; The opposition collapses and we take possession of the blessing that the Lord has prepared for his people.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Restoration of the Azusa Street Fire (William J. Seymour - 1906 / USA)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Lord, send the Pentecostal Fire again as in Azusa Street! Melt down our pride and unite all races in love and Holy Ghost power...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Lord, send the Pentecostal Fire again as in Azusa Street...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord God Almighty, revive your work in the midst of time! Just as you poured out your Spirit in the Azusa Street revival, breaking down barriers of race, social status, and human pride, pour out today a fire of deep repentance, unity, and apostolic power upon our generation.

oraciones.titulo: Daily Prayer for the Full Armor of God (Ephesians 6:10-18 - USA)
oraciones.textoOriginal: I put on the whole armor of God: the belt of truth, the breastplate of righteousness, the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: I put on the whole armor of God...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I put on the full armor of God today! I gird my loins with truth, I cover myself with the breastplate of justice, I shod my feet with zeal for the gospel of peace, I take the shield of faith to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one, I put on the helmet of salvation and I take up the Sword of the Spirit which is the living Word of God.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Fuego of Medianoche (MFM Dr. D.K. Olukoya - 'Dangerous Prayers')
oraciones.textoOriginal: Every dark power assigned to swallow my destiny, die by fire in the name of Jesus! Holy Ghost, arise and let my stubborn enemies be scattered!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Every dark power assigned to swallow my destiny...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O God of consuming fire, arise and let my enemies be scattered! Every hidden conspiracy, every spirit of stagnation and every satanic bondage against my prophetic destiny is burned to ashes by the fire of the Holy Spirit. I advance with the strength of a lion towards victory in Christ Jesus!

oraciones.titulo: Holy Spirit Congress Blessing Prayer (RCCG Pastor E.A. Adeboye)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Let the wind of God blow away every mountain of sorrow and release a fresh overflow of divine glory and peace...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Let the wind of God blow away every mountain...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Merciful Father, may the wind of God blow upon my life! May every mountain of sadness and sterility be turned into a plain of joy. Release a double portion of anointing, unbreakable peace, and testimony of miracles upon my family so that the world will know that You are God.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Strength and Courage from the Clandestine Churches in China (Back to Jerusalem)
oraciones.textoOriginal: 主啊，赐给我们如铁的信心，在患难中坚守十字架的真理，让福音传回耶路撒冷...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Zhu a, ci gei women ru tie de xinxin, zai huannan zhong jianshou shizijia de zhenli...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus, grant us faith as unbreakable as steel! Even if we go through prisons, trials or persecution, fill our hearts with your invincible love and make the seed of the Gospel flourish in millions of souls to the ends of the earth.

oraciones.titulo: Doa Menara Doa 24 Jam (Indonesian Tower of Continuous Intercession - GBI)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Tuhan Yesus, kobarkan api doa di atas mezbah kami siang dan malam; biarlah kepulauan Indonesia dipenuhi kemuliaan-Mu...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Tuhan Yesus, kobarkan api doa di atas mezbah kami siang dan malam...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus, keep the fire burning on our prayer altar twenty-four hours a day! We cry out for the thousands of islands of Indonesia and the nations of Asia: may all idolatry and fear fall, and may the peace and salvation of Christ flood every home and city.

oraciones.titulo: Panalangin ng Tagumpay at Pagpapagaling ng Bansa (Jesus Is Lord - Philippines)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Panginoong Hesus, Ikaw ang Hari ng mga hari! Pagpalain Mo ang sambayanang Pilipino sa gitna ng unos at kahirapan...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Panginoong Hesus, Ikaw ang Hari ng mga hari...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus, You are the King of kings and Lord of lords! Bless and heal the Filipino nation; In the midst of storms and economic difficulties, lift up your people with dignity, fruitful work and miraculous power of healing in each community.

oraciones.titulo: Cry for the Latter Rain Revival in Latin America (Bogotá - Colombia)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Espíritu Santo, sopla sobre Colombia y toda Latinoamérica! ¡Que se abran los cielos y caiga la lluvia de tu presencia sanadora!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Espiritu Santo, sopla sobre Colombia y toda Latinoamerica...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Dear Holy Spirit, we long for your presence more than the air we breathe! Pour out rivers of living water over Colombia and the Spanish-speaking nations; May family altars be lit, marriages reconciled and millions of young people consecrate themselves to Jesus Christ with holy passion.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Fasting and Cry at the Summits of Guatemala and Central America
oraciones.textoOriginal: Desde los montes y valles de Guatemala elevamos este clamor con ayuno: ¡Señor, quebranta las fortalezas de violencia y desata tu paz!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Desde los montes y valles de Guatemala elevamos este clamor...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord of Glory, we humble ourselves in fasting and prayer before your holiness! Demolish the strongholds of evil, crime and pain in Central America; make our fields green, honest work prosper and fill the churches with songs of joy and brotherly love.

oraciones.titulo: Commanding the Morning and Strategic Prayer Warfare (Archbishop Duncan-Williams)
oraciones.textoOriginal: I take authority over the atmosphere of this day; I command the morning to yield its blessings and silence every voice of witchcraft!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: I take authority over the atmosphere of this day...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I take authority in the name of Jesus over the atmosphere of this new day! I command the morning to deliver its blessings of health, success and peace, and I silence every decree of witchcraft, envy or ruin. No weapon formed against me shall prosper!

oraciones.titulo: Tongsung Kido on the Prayer Mount (Yoido Full Gospel - David Yonggi Cho)
oraciones.textoOriginal: 주여! 주여! 주여! 성령의 불로 우리를 태우시고, 기도의 산에서 하늘의 능력을 부어 주옵소서...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Juyeo! Juyeo! Juyeo! Seongryeong-ui bullo urireul tae-usigo, gido-ui san-eseo haneul-ui neungryeok-eul bueo juopsoseo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy and Almighty Father! In the supreme name of Jesus Christ, we come before Thy glorious presence, proclaiming the power and victory of Thy living Word over Tongsung Kido on the Prayer Mount (Yoido Full Gospel. Release Thy anointing and the fire of Thy Holy Spirit upon our life, tear down every obstacle, heal every infirmity, and fill us with supernatural strength and joy. To Thee be all the glory, honor, and power forever! Amen and amen.

oraciones.titulo: The Anointing of the Holy One Who Teaches All Things (1 John 2:20-27)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre Celestial, en el nombre poderoso y sobre todo nombre de nuestro Señor Jesucristo venimos ante tu presencia.

May the chains of sin and pain fall, altars of continuous prayer be raised and the light of your Gospel shine with miracles, salvation and eternal joy. Amen!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Praise Explosiva and Despertar Juvenil (Australia)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre Celestial, en el nombre poderoso y sobre todo nombre de nuestro Señor Jesucristo venimos ante tu presencia.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Pá-dre San-to y To-do-po-de-ró-so, en el nóm-bre su-pré-mo de Je-su-krís-to nos pre-sen-tá-mos an-te tu pre-sén-cia... A-mén.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy and Almighty Father! In the supreme name of Jesus Christ, we come before Thy glorious presence, proclaiming the power and victory of Thy living Word over Prayer of Praise Explosiva and Despertar Juvenil (Australia). Release Thy anointing and the fire of Thy Holy Spirit upon our life, tear down every obstacle, heal every infirmity, and fill us with supernatural strength and joy. To Thee be all the glory, honor, and power forever! Amen and amen.

oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Pá-dre San-to y To-do-po-de-ró-so, en el nóm-bre su-pré-mo de Je-su-krís-to nos pre-sen-tá-mos an-te tu pre-sén-cia... A-mén.]

oraciones.titulo: Reception and Welcome from Holy Saturday to Sunset on Friday (Genesis 2:1-3 / Isaiah 58:13-14)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre Santo, al ocultarse el sol en este viernes, recibimos con gozo las horas sagradas de tu Santo Sábado, monumento eterno de la Creación y sello de tu amor...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Padre Santo, al ocultarse el sol en este viernes, recibimos con gozo las horas sagradas...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Dear Heavenly Father, as the sun sets on this Friday, we pause our secular tasks to welcome the holy hours of Saturday, the day blessed and sanctified by you from Eden. We thank you for this oasis of spiritual rest and family communion. Fill our home with your peace and join us in this time of worship to the Creator of heaven and earth. In the name of Jesus, amen.

oraciones.titulo: Farewell to the Holy Saturday and Consecration of the New Week (Genesis 1:5)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Señor Dios nuestro, al ponerse el sol del sábado, te damos gracias por el reposo recibido y consagramos en tus manos los días de trabajo de la nueva semana...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Senor Dios nuestro, al ponerse el sol del sabado...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Father, as we conclude the blessed hours of your Holy Saturday, we raise our gratitude for the rest, the brotherhood of the church, and the renewal of the soul. As we begin this new week of work, we ask that the light of Saturday shine in our actions, that we be upright at work and school, and that you keep our steps in holiness. In the name of Jesus, amen.

oraciones.titulo: Sabbath School Opening Prayer – Study of Holy Scripture
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre Celestial, al abrir la Guía de Estudio de la Biblia en nuestras clases de Escuela Sabática, derrama el Espíritu Santo sobre maestros y alumnos...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Padre Celestial, al abrir la Guia de Estudio de la Biblia...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Eternal Father, we gather in our Sabbath School classes with hearts longing for your truth. Send the Holy Spirit to illuminate the pages of your Holy Word, soften hearts, strengthen our missionary faith and enable us to share the blessed hope with our neighbors. In the name of Jesus, amen.

oraciones.titulo: Kneeling Intercessory Prayer in Divine Worship (1 Kings 8:22-23 / Ephesians 3:14)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Soberano Dios del Universo, nos postramos de rodillas ante tu santa presencia en este santuario terrenal para elevar nuestras peticiones y alabanzas...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Soberano Dios del Universo, nos postramos de rodillas ante tu santa presencia...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Sovereign God and kind Father! We kneel in reverence in your house of prayer. We praise you for your majesty and mercy. We pray for the sick in hospitals and homes, for the afflicted, for those suffering persecution and for our authorities. I anointed the lips of your servant who will proclaim the message; May your Word be heavenly bread that satisfies our souls and prepares us for the return of Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Consecration of Tithes and Offerings for the Preaching of the World Gospel (Malachi 3:8-10)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Señor, reconocemos que de ti es la tierra y su plenitud; te devolvemos fielmente el diezmo sagrado y presentamos nuestras ofrendas voluntarias...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Senor, reconocemos que de ti es la tierra y su plenitud...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, we recognize that everything we have comes from your generous hand. We joyfully and faithfully return to you the tithe that is holy to you, and we dedicate these offerings for the advancement of missionary work in local and distant fields. Multiply these resources so that the message of salvation reaches every corner of the planet. In the name of Jesus, amen.

oraciones.titulo: Ordinance of Humility: Footwashing and Holy Communion (John 13:1-17 / 1 Corinthians 11:23-26)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Señor Jesús, al ceñirte con la toalla y lavar los pies de tus discípulos nos diste ejemplo supremo de humildad y amor abnegado...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Senor Jesus, al cenirte con la toalla y lavar los pies...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Savior Jesus Christ, by participating in the ordinance of footwashing, we cleanse our hearts of all pride, resentment or vanity. And by eating the unleavened bread and drinking the pure fruit of the vine, we proclaim your atoning death on the Cross and renew our covenant of love until you come in glory to celebrate the heavenly banquet with your redeemed. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Consagración Bautismal for Inmersión (Romanos 6:3-5 / Mateo 28:19)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Señor Dios, sepultamos el hombre viejo en las aguas del bautismo para levantarnos a una vida nueva en Cristo...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Senor Dios, sepultamos el hombre viejo en las aguas del bautismo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy Father, bless these your children who descend to the baptismal waters in the name of the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit. That when they are immersed they die to sin and when they rise they walk in newness of life, sealed with the Holy Spirit for the day of final redemption. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: The First Angel's Message: 'Fear God and Give Him Glory' (Revelation 14:6-7)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Temed a Dios y dadle gloria, porque la hora de su juicio ha llegado; y adorad a aquel que hizo el cielo y la tierra, el mar y las fuentes de las aguas!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Temed a Dios y dadle gloria, porque la hora de su juicio ha llegado...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord God Almighty, Creator of the heavens, the earth, the seas and the fountains of waters! We recognize that the hour of your judgment has arrived. We give you glory in our decisions, in the care of our body and in the worship of Holy Saturday. We proclaim the Eternal Gospel to every nation, tribe, language and people with holy courage. In the name of Jesus, amen.

oraciones.titulo: The Second Angel's Message: 'Babylon is fallen' (Revelation 14:8 / Revelation 18:1-4)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ha caído, ha caído Babilonia, la gran ciudad, porque ha hecho beber a todas las naciones del vino del furor de su fornicación...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ha caido, ha caido Babilonia, la gran ciudad...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Heavenly Father, we come with confidence before the throne of Thy grace, anchored in the promises of Thy Holy Word and in the blessed hope of Christ's soon return. We present this earnest prayer for The Second Angel's Message: 'Babylon is fallen' (Revelation 14:8 / Revelation 18:1: guard our lives, establish our steps in Thy holy commandments, and fill us with Thy heavenly peace. Through the merits of Jesus Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: The Third Angel's Message: The Patience of the Saints and the Seal of God (Revelation 14:9-12)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Aquí está la paciencia de los santos, los que guardan los mandamientos de Dios y la fe de Jesús!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Aqui esta la paciencia de los santos, los que guardan los mandamientos...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus, engrave your holy Law on the tablets of our hearts! Grant us the faith of Jesus to remain firm in the hour of trial, rejecting all deception and receiving the Seal of the living God. May our lives testify to the love of God's Law and the saving grace of Calvary. In your blessed name, amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Faith in Christ Our High Priest in the Holy of Holies (Hebrews 4:14-16 / Daniel 8:14)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Acérquemonos, pues, confiadamente al trono de la gracia, para alcanzar misericordia y hallar gracia para el oportuno socorro...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Acerquemonos, pues, confiadamente al trono de la gracia...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus Christ, our heavenly High Priest! We look by faith to the Celestial Sanctuary where you intercede for us with your own atoning blood before the Ark of the Testimony. Purify our lives from all hidden sin, vindicate your holy name and cover us with your perfect mantle of righteousness. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Cry for the Blessed Hope of Christ's Return (Titus 2:13 / 1 Thessalonians 4:16-17)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Aguardando la esperanza bienaventurada y la manifestación gloriosa de nuestro gran Dios y Salvador Jesucristo...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Aguardando la esperanza bienaventurada y la manifestacion gloriosa...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Heavenly Father, we come with confidence before the throne of Thy grace, anchored in the promises of Thy Holy Word and in the blessed hope of Christ's soon return. We present this earnest prayer for Cry for the Blessed Hope of Christ's Return (Titus 2:13 / 1 Thessalonians 4:16: guard our lives, establish our steps in Thy holy commandments, and fill us with Thy heavenly peace. Through the merits of Jesus Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Consecration of the Body as a Sacred Temple and the 8 Natural Remedies (1 Corinthians 6:19-20)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¿O ignoráis que vuestro cuerpo es templo del Espíritu Santo?... Glorificad, pues, a Dios en vuestro cuerpo y en vuestro espíritu...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: ¿O ignorais que vuestro cuerpo es templo del Espiritu Santo?...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Heavenly Father, we come with confidence before the throne of Thy grace, anchored in the promises of Thy Holy Word and in the blessed hope of Christ's soon return. We present this earnest prayer for Consecration of the Body as a Sacred Temple and the 8 Natural Remedies (1 Corinthians 6:19: guard our lives, establish our steps in Thy holy commandments, and fill us with Thy heavenly peace. Through the merits of Jesus Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of the Médico and Enfermero Misionero Adventista (Loma Linda / Sanatorios)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Señor Jesús, el Gran Médico de almas y cuerpos, guía mis manos y mi mente al atender a los que sufren...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Senor Jesus, el Gran Medico de almas y cuerpos, guia mis manos...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Heavenly Father, we come with confidence before the throne of Thy grace, anchored in the promises of Thy Holy Word and in the blessed hope of Christ's soon return. We present this earnest prayer for Prayer of the Médico and Enfermero Misionero Adventista (Loma Linda / Sanatorios): guard our lives, establish our steps in Thy holy commandments, and fill us with Thy heavenly peace. Through the merits of Jesus Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer for Victory over Addictions and Total Temperance (1 Corinthians 10:31)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Si, pues, coméis o bebéis, o hacéis otra cosa, hacedlo todo para la gloria de Dios...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Si, pues, comeis o bebeis, o haceis otra cosa...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, break every chain of addiction, alcohol, tobacco, drugs or destructive habits. Grant those who fight willpower renewed by your grace to live in sobriety, self-control and purity of life, consecrating every breath for your glory. In the name of Jesus, amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Total Surrender to God (The Way to Christ - Ellen G. White)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Conságrate a Dios todas las mañanas; haz de esto tu primer trabajo. Sea tu oración: 'Tómame, ¡oh Señor! como enteramente tuyo'...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Consagrate a Dios todas las mananas; haz de esto tu primer trabajo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus, I consecrate myself to you this morning; make this my first and most sacred duty. Place on my lips the sincere prayer: 'Take me, O Lord, as entirely yours. I put all my plans at your feet. Use me today in your service. Dwell in me, and may all my works be done in you.' I surrender my will to your holy direction. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of the Club of Conquistadores (Desbravadores / Pathfinders) – Voto and Ley
oraciones.textoOriginal: Por la gracia de Dios, seré puro, bondadoso y leal; guardaré la Ley del Conquistador, seré siervo de Dios y amigo de la humanidad...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Por la gracia de Dios, sere puro, bondadoso y leal...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, bless the millions of children and young people of the Pathfinder Club around the world. Help us fulfill our sacred vow: to be pure in mind, kind to others, and loyal to God. May we love the nature you created and be ready to announce the message of advent to the whole world. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: 10 Days of Prayer Prayer – Revival and Latter Rain
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre Santo, nos unimos como pueblo mundial en estos diez días de oración pidiendo la unción de la Lluvia Tardía...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Padre Santo, nos unimos como pueblo mundial en estos diez dias de oracion...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Eternal Father, we cry out in unison like the early church in the upper room. Pour upon us the Latter Rain of your Holy Spirit; heal our homes, revive youth, dissolve the spiritual lukewarmness of Laodicea and fill us with holy fire to finish the mission. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Morning and Evening Prayer at the Family Altar (Ellen G. White)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre Celestial, reunidos alrededor del altar de nuestro hogar, ofrecemos el incienso de nuestra oración matutina y vespertina...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Padre Celestial, reunidos alrededor del altar de nuestro hogar...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Dear Heavenly Father, just as the continuous morning and evening incense burned in the ancient sanctuary, we light the fire of devotion in our home. We consecrate our children, our marriage and our roof to you. May your holy angels watch over our beds and the peace of Christ reign in our conversations. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of the Adventist Church in Brazil (DSA / UNASP / Rede Novo Tempo)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Pai Celestial, Te louvamos pela força e expansão da mensagem do advento no Brasil...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Pai Celestial, Te louvamos pela forca e expansao...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Pai Amado, support the thousands of Adventist families in Brazil. Abençoa a Rede Novo Tempo, the UNASP colleges and universities, and the missionary projects of evangelism. May Brazil continue to be a land of bold missionaries, raising the Bible and a message of the Three Angels to every city and countryside. In the name of Jesus, amém.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer for the Legacy of Adventist Pioneers and Universities (USA)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Heavenly Father, we thank Thee for the faith of early pioneers like Joseph Bates, James and Ellen White, and J.N. Andrews...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Heavenly Father, we thank Thee for the faith of early pioneers...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, we reverently remember the pioneers who founded this movement with sacrifice and tears. Bless our institutions in the United States and the world; keep Andrews University, Loma Linda, and every church firm in original biblical doctrine and missionary zeal. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Adventist Families in Mexico and the University of Montemorelos
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre Celestial, te alabamos desde México por el florecimiento de tu pueblo en las sierras, selvas y ciudades...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Padre Celestial, te alabamos desde Mexico...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Eternal Father, bless the Adventist youth and families in Mexico. We thank you for the University of Montemorelos and the thousands of missionary professionals who have left there to bless the world. May peace reign in our congregations and the message of Saturday be light in every corner of our country. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Gratitude of Adventists in Peru (UPeU ​​/ Andean Missions)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre Celestial, desde las costas, cumbres andinas y la selva del Perú elevamos este canto de gratitud...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Padre Celestial, desde las costas, cumbres andinas y la selva del Peru...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Father, bless the Adventist Church in Peru. We thank you for the Universidad Peruana Unión and for the pioneers like Stahl who brought education and health to the Altiplano. May our young people serve with nobility and may the hope of the advent strengthen each Peruvian family. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Panalangin ng mga Sabadista sa Pilipinas (Adventist University of the Philippines)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Amang Banal, pinupuri Ka namin sa mga isla ng Pilipinas sa bawat paglubog ng araw sa Sabado...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Amang Banal, pinupuri Ka namin sa mga isla ng Pilipinas...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, bless the Adventist believers in the Philippine Islands. In the midst of storms and difficulties, maintain firm fidelity to the Sabbath and your holy Law. Bless the Adventist University of the Philippines and multiply the peace workers throughout the archipelago. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Joy at the Great Kenyan Camp Assemblies (Baraton)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Heavenly Father, we lift our voices in the valleys and mountains of Kenya praising Thy Holy Name...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Heavenly Father, we lift our voices in the valleys and mountains...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, we praise you with songs of joy in our field conventions in Kenya and East Africa. Bless Baraton University and strengthen our churches with brotherly love, health and perseverance in biblical truth. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Hope from Adventists in Nigeria and Ghana (Babcock / Valley View)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Lord God of Heaven, bless the vibrant Advent message across West Africa...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Lord God of Heaven, bless the vibrant Advent message...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Eternal Father, bless the vigorous growth of your church in Nigeria, Ghana and all of West Africa. Prosper Babcock and Valley View Universities, care for our pastors, and shower our families with peace and dignified provision. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Faith in Southern Africa (Solusi University - Zimbabwe & Zambia)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Almighty Father, we praise Thee from the savannahs of Zimbabwe and Zambia where the light of the Sabbath shines...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Almighty Father, we praise Thee from the savannahs of Zimbabwe...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Almighty Father, we praise you from the savannahs of Zimbabwe and Zambia. We thank you for the historic Solusi University and the faithful witness of millions of believers who keep your commandments with sincere joy. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer for Peace and Spiritual Light in India (Spicer Adventist University - Pune)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Heavenly Father, we bring our prayers from India, honoring Thee as the Creator God on Thy holy Sabbath...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Heavenly Father, we bring our prayers from India...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, from the cities and villages of India we worship you as the only true Creator on your Holy Saturday. Bless Spicer University and Adventist schools; May your love dissolve all discord and shine in every community. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Gratitude in the South Pacific Islands and Papua New Guinea
oraciones.textoOriginal: Lord of the Isles, we praise Thee from Papua New Guinea and the South Pacific...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Lord of the Isles, we praise Thee from Papua New Guinea...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord of the islands, we praise you from the mountains and coasts of Papua New Guinea and the South Pacific! Thank you for the joy with which entire towns keep your Holy Saturday. Save Pacific Adventist University and bless our villages with peace and salvation. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Praise to the Creator of the World in Six Literal Days (Exodus 20:11)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Amado Padre Celestial, en el bendito nombre de Jesucristo consagramos nuestra vida a tu santa voluntad.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [A-má-do Pá-dre Ce-les-tiál, en el ben-dí-to nóm-bre de Je-su-krís-to con-sa-grá-mos nues-tra vi-da a tu san-ta vo-lun-tád... A-mén.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Heavenly Father, we come with confidence before the throne of Thy grace, anchored in the promises of Thy Holy Word and in the blessed hope of Christ's soon return. We present this earnest prayer for Prayer of Praise to the Creator of the World in Six Literal Days (Exodus 20:11): guard our lives, establish our steps in Thy holy commandments, and fill us with Thy heavenly peace. Through the merits of Jesus Christ. Amen.

oraciones.guiaFonetica: [A-má-do Pá-dre Ce-les-tiál, en el ben-dí-to nóm-bre de Je-su-krís-to con-sa-grá-mos nues-tra vi-da a tu san-ta vo-lun-tád... A-mén.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Heavenly Father, we come with confidence before the throne of Thy grace, anchored in the promises of Thy Holy Word and in the blessed hope of Christ's soon return. We present this earnest prayer for Prayer of Blessing in the Mass Distribution of the Book of the Year (Impacto Esperanza): guard our lives, establish our steps in Thy holy commandments, and fill us with Thy heavenly peace. Through the merits of Jesus Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: The Holy Prayer of Jesus (Hesychasm of Mount Athos with Chotki/Komboskini)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Κύριε Ἰησοῦ Χριστέ, Υἱὲ τοῦ Θεοῦ, ἐλέησόν με τὸν ἁμαρτωλόν.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Kyrie Iesou Christe, Yie tou Theou, eleison me ton hamartolon ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God, have mercy on me, a sinner! With each serene breath and in the secret of the heart, we invoke your most holy name so that the ineffable peace of Mount Tabor descends, turbulent thoughts dissipate and the uncreated light of your Spirit fills our soul with silence and joy.

oraciones.titulo: Agni Parthene (Saint Nectario of Egina) – Hymn to the Virgen Pura and Soberana Reina
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ἁγνὴ Παρθένε Δέσποινα, Ἄχραντε Θεοτόκε, Χαῖρε Νύμφη Ἀνύμφευτε. Παρθὲνε Μήτηρ Ἄνασσα, Πανένδροσε τε πόκε, Χαῖρε Νύμφη Ἀνύμφευτε...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Agni Parthene Despoina, Achrante Theotoke, Chaire Nymphe Anympheute | Parthene Meter Anassa, Panendrose te poke, Chaire Nymphe Anympheute...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Pure Virgin and Immaculate Lady, Sovereign Theotokos! Rejoice, Betrothed Wife! Virgin Mother and Queen of heaven, most pure dew of the heavenly dew: You who are more excellent than the Cherubs and more glorious than the Seraphim, extend your protective mantle over our souls and guide our steps towards your Son.

oraciones.titulo: Axion Estin (The Hymn Revealed by Archangel Gabriel on Mount Athos)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ἄξιόν ἐστιν ὡς ἀληθῶς μακαρίζειν σε τὴν Θεοτόκον, τὴν ἀειμακάριστον καὶ παναμώμητον καὶ μητέρα τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν. Τὴν τιμιωτέραν τῶν Χερουβεὶμ...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Axion estin hos alethos makarizein se ten Theotokon, ten aeimakariston kai panamometon kai metera tou Theou hemon...
oraciones.textoTraducido: It is truly worthy to bless you, oh Theotokos, ever blessed and most pure, and Mother of our God. To you, more venerable than the Cherubim and incomparably more glorious than the Seraphim, who without corruption gave birth to the Word of God: to you, true Mother of God, we magnify you!

oraciones.titulo: The Cherubic Hymn of the Divine Liturgy of Saint John Chrysostom (Cherubicon)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Οἱ τὰ Χερουβεὶμ μυστικῶς εἰκονίζοντες, καὶ τῇ ζωοποιῷ Τριάδι τὸν τρισάγιον ὕμνον προσᾴδοντες, πᾶσαν τὴν βιωτικὴν ἀποθώμεθα μέριμναν...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Oi ta Cheroubeim mystikos eikonizontes, kai te zoopoio Triadi ton trisagion hymnon prosadontes, pasan ten biotiken apothemetha merimnan...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the Living God! Through the intercession of the Most Holy Theotokos and the blessed memory and help of The Cherubic Hymn of the Divine Liturgy of Saint John Chrysostom (Cherubicon), pour out Your Holy Spirit upon our life. Purify our mind in the stillness of prayer, grant us health, patience and forgiveness of sins, and guide us to the eternal peace of Your heavenly Kingdom. Amen!

oraciones.titulo: Symbol of Faith (Nicene-Constantinopolitan Creed of the Orthodox Church)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Πιστεύω εἰς ἕνα Θεόν, Πατέρα, Παντοκράτορα, ποιητὴν οὐρανοῦ καὶ γῆς, ὁρατῶν τε πάντων καὶ ἀοράτων...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Pisteuo eis hena Theon, Patera Pantokratora, poieten ouranou kai ges...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I believe in one God, Almighty Father, Creator of heaven and earth, of all things visible and invisible. And in one Lord Jesus Christ, Only Begotten Son of God... Light from Light, true God from true God, begotten, not created, consubstantial with the Father... And in the Holy Spirit, Lord and giver of life, who proceeds from the Father... I confess one baptism for the forgiveness of sins. I await the resurrection of the dead and the life of the world to come. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer before Holy Communion (Saint John Chrysostom)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Πιστεύω, Κύριε, καὶ ὁμολογῶ, ὅτι σὺ εἶ ἀληθῶς ὁ Χριστός, ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ ζῶντος, ὁ ἐλθὼν εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἁμαρτωλοὺς σῶσαι, ὧν πρῶτός εἰμι ἐγώ...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Pisteuo, Kyrie, kai homologo, hoti sy ei alethos ho Christos, ho Yios tou Theou tou zontos...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I believe, Lord, and confess that You are truly the Christ, the Son of the living God, who came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the first. Make me a participant today in your Mystical Dinner, oh Son of God; For I will not reveal the secret to your enemies, nor will I give you a kiss like Judas, but like the thief I confess to you: Remember me, Lord, in your Kingdom!

oraciones.titulo: Morning Prayer of the Holy Elders of the Optina Pustyn Monastery (Russia)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Господи, дай мне с душевным спокойствием встретить всё, что принесёт мне наступающий день. Дай мне всецело предаться воле Твоей святой...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Gospodi, day mne s dushevnym spokoystviyem vstretit' vsyo, chto prinesyot mne nastupayushchiy den'...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord, grant me to receive with peace in my soul everything that this new day brings me! Grant me to surrender completely to your holy will. Guide me and instruct me every hour. Whatever news I receive, teach me to receive it with serenity and with the firm conviction that your holy will is manifested in everything. In all my words and actions guide my thoughts and feelings; In the event of unforeseen events, do not let him forget that everything is sent by you. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Saint Seraphim of Sarov – The Acquisition of the Holy Spirit and Easter Joy
oraciones.textoOriginal: Радость моя, Христос воскресе! Стяжи дух мирен, и тысячи вокруг тебя спасутся...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Radost' moya, Khristos voskrese! Styazhi dukh miren, i tysyachi vokrug tebya spasutsya...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord God and our Father, who gave your servant Saint Seraphim the gift of ardent love and perpetual Easter joy! Grant us the grace to acquire the Holy Spirit in our hearts: that by achieving deep inner peace, thousands of souls around us will find comfort and salvation in Christ. Christ is risen, my joy!

oraciones.titulo: Intercessory Plea to Saint Matrona of Moscow for Family Healing and Protection
oraciones.textoOriginal: О блаженная мати Матроно, душею на небеси пред Престолом Божиим предстоящи, телом же на земли почивающи...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O blazhennaya mati Matrono, dusheyu na nebesi pred Prestolom Bozhiim predstoyashchi...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh blessed Mother Matrona, who in spirit stand before the Throne of God and on earth hear the prayers of the afflicted! Look with your kind eyes on those of us who come to you for help. Heal the sick, protect our children, dissolve family tribulations and ask the Lord to grant us patience in trials and eternal salvation. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Troparion and Supplication to Saint Sergius of Radonezh (Trinity Saint Sergius Lavra)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Иже добродетелей подвижник, яко истинный воин Христа Бога, на страсти вельми подвизался еси в жизни временней...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Izhe dobrodeteley podvizhnik, yako istinny voin Khrista Boga...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy Father Sergius of Radonezh, zealous servant of the Holy Trinity and protector of the Slavic lands! You who in the dense forests achieved purity of heart and harmony with creation: pray to Christ God for the peace of our people, the end of hatred and the illumination of minds in the truth of the Gospel. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Saint Xenia of Saint Petersburg (Crazy for Christ and Protector of the Helpless)
oraciones.textoOriginal: О святая всеблаженная мати Ксение, под покровом Вышняго жившая, ведома и укрепляема Богоматерию...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O svyataya vseblazhennaya mati Kseniye, pod pokrovom Vyshnyago zhivshaya...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Holy and blessed Mother Xenia, who for love of Christ chose poverty and detachment from the world, helping the humble! Help those seeking honest employment, comfort marriages in crisis, shelter the helpless, and pray for our souls before the throne of the Redeemer. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Troparium before the Holy Icon of the Mother of God of Kazan
oraciones.textoOriginal: Заступнице усердная, Мати Господа Вышняго, за всех молиши Сына Твоего Христа Бога нашего...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Zastupnitse userdnaya, Mati Gospoda Vyshnyago, za vsekh molishi Syna Tvoyego Khrista Boga nashego...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Fervent intercessor, Mother of the Most High Lord! You pray for all to your Son, Christ our God, and you save all who take refuge in your powerful protection. Deliver us from all calamity, war and sadness, and save our souls, O Sovereign Mother of God of Kazan.

oraciones.titulo: Wudasie Maryam (Ethiopia - Saint Ephrem the Syrian) – Praise to the Virgin Mary in Ge'ez
oraciones.textoOriginal: ፈቀደ እግዚእ ያግዕዞ ለአዳም ሕዙነ ወትኩዘ መንፈስ... እግዝእትነ ቅድስት ድንግል ማርያም ወላዲተ አምላክ ውድስት አንቲ...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Feqede Egzi' yag'izo le-Adam hizune we-tikuze menfes... Egzietne Qidist Dingil Maryam Weladite Amlak wudist anti...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the Living God! Through the intercession of the Most Holy Theotokos and the blessed memory and help of Wudasie Maryam (Ethiopia, pour out Your Holy Spirit upon our life. Purify our mind in the stillness of prayer, grant us health, patience and forgiveness of sins, and guide us to the eternal peace of Your heavenly Kingdom. Amen!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Saint Tekle Haymanot – The Holy Hermit of Debre Libanos (Ethiopia)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ኦ ቅዱስ ተክለ ሃይማኖት ፀሐየ ጽድቅ ወብርሃነ ሃይማኖት... ጸልይ በእንቲአነ ቅድመ መንበረ ስላሴ...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O Qidus Tekle Haymanot tsehay tsidq we-birhane haymanot... Tseliy be'intiane qidme menbere Silassie...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Holy Tekle Haymanot, sun of justice and torch of the pure faith of Ethiopia! You who prayed motionless on one leg for years praising the Holy Trinity: intercede for us so that God grants us unbreakable patience, forgiveness of our faults, and physical and spiritual healing.

oraciones.titulo: Qeddase (Ethiopian Tewahedo Eucharistic Liturgy) – Anaphora of the Holy Apostles
oraciones.textoOriginal: ቅዱስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ጸባዖት፡ ፍጹም፡ ምሉዕ፡ ሰማያተ፡ ወምድረ፡ ቅድሳተ፡ ስብሐቲከ...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Qidus, Qidus, Qidus, Egziabher Tseba'ot fitsum milu' semayate we-midre qidstate sibhatike...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy, Holy, Holy is the Lord God of Hosts! The heavens and the earth are full of the majesty of your glory. We praise you, we bless you and we thank you, our Lord and Creator, who through the cross of your beloved Son gave life to the world.

oraciones.titulo: Acatistul Sfintei Cuvioase Parascheva of the Iași (Ocrotitoarea Moldovei și României)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Bucură-te, Sfântă Parascheva, mult folositoare! Întru tine, maică, cu osârdie s-a mântuit cel după chip...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Bucura-te, Sfanta Parascheva, mult folositoare!...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Rejoice, Saint Parascheva, most prompt help of the afflicted and protector of Moldova and Romania! You who from your youth embraced prayer and fasting: pray to Christ to dissolve the illnesses in our homes, bless the families and grant us peace and salvation.

oraciones.titulo: Acatistul Bunei Vestiri to Maicii Domnului (Romania)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Apărătoare Doamnă, pentru biruință mulțumiri, izbăvindu-ne din nevoi, aducem ție, Născătoare de Dumnezeu...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Aparatoare Doamna, pentru biruinta multumiri, izbavindu-ne din nevoi...
oraciones.textoTraducido: To you, Sovereign Protector and victorious Captain, we raise songs of gratitude for having freed us from all tribulation! You who possess invincible power, protect us from all danger so that we may cry out: Rejoice, Virgin and Immaculate Spouse!

oraciones.titulo: Molitva Svetom Vasiliju Ostroškom Čudotvorcu (Saint Basil of Ostrog - Montenegro/Serbia)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Свети Василије, велики угодниче Божији, помози свима па и мени. Велики браничу вере Православне, одбрани и нас...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Sveti Vasilije, veliki ugodnice Boziji, pomozi svima pa i meni...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Saint Basil of Ostrog, great miracle worker of God embedded in the rock of the monastery! Thousands come before your incorrupt relics seeking health: pour out healing grace on our weakened bodies, calm the anxieties of the mind and strengthen our faith in Christ.

oraciones.titulo: Troparion to Saint Sava, First Archbishop and Illuminator of Serbia
oraciones.textoOriginal: Пута вождја и светитеља и учитеља био јеси, светитељу Саво. Дошао јеси и просветио отачаство своје...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Puta vozhdja i svetitelja i ucitelja bio jesi, svetitelju Savo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: You were guide of the path, holy hierarch and distinguished teacher, oh Holy Sava. You came and illuminated your country with the light of Christ, planting the seeds of truth and harmony. Pray to Christ God for the peace of the entire world and the salvation of our souls.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Saint Nina (Nino) – Illuminator of Georgia with the Cross of Sarmientos
oraciones.textoOriginal: წმიდაო ნინო, ემსგავსე მოციქულთა და ქადაგე ქრისტეს სახარება საქართველოში...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Tsmidao Nino, emsgavse motsikultha da khadage Khristes sakhareba Sakartveloshi...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Holy Nina, equal to the Apostles, who holding the Cross made of vine shoots and tied with your own hair brought the light of the Gospel to Georgia! Light in our hearts the flame of living faith and unconditional love for Christ.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Saint Anthony the Great – Father of the Monks of the Egyptian Desert
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲁⲛⲧⲱⲛⲓ ⲡⲓⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲁⲥⲕⲏⲧⲏⲥ... Ⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲉ̀ϩⲢⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Peniot avva Antoni pi-nishti n-askites... Tobh ehrei ejon nte Phnouti kha nennobi nan ebol ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Holy Father Abba Anthony, great ascetic of the desert of Egypt! You who defeated all the temptations of the enemy in the solitude of the cave with fasting and constant prayer: teach us not to fear the illusions of the world and obtain for us the grace of inner purity.

oraciones.titulo: The Prayer of Cuaresma of Saint Ephrem the Syrian (Kýrie kai Déspota tes Zoes mou)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Κύριε καὶ Δέσποτα τῆς ζωῆς μου, πνεῦμα ἀργίας, περιεργίας, φιλαρχίας καὶ ἀργολογίας μή μοι δῷς...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Kyrie kai Despota tes zoes mou, pneuma argias, periergias, philarchias kai argologias me moi dos...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord and Sovereign of my life! Remove from me the spirit of laziness, despondency, ambition for dominion and vain words. Instead, grant this servant of yours a spirit of chastity, humility, patience and love. Yes, my Lord and King! Grant me to see my own faults and not judge my brother, because You are blessed forever and ever. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Saint Pantaleon – Saint Anárgyrus Physician for the Healing of the Sick
oraciones.textoOriginal: Господи Иисусе Христе, Сыне Божий, помилуй мя грешнаго. Молитвами Пречистыя Твоея Матере и всех святых Твоих, спаси и сохрани души наша. Аминь.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Gós-po-di I-i-sú-se Khris-té, Sý-ne Bó-zhiy, po-mí-luy mya gresh-na-go. Mo-lit-va-mi Pre-chis-ty-ya Tvo-ye-ya Ma-te-re i vsekh svya-tykh Tvo-ikh, spa-si i sokh-ra-ni du-shi na-sha. A-min.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the Living God! Through the intercession of the Most Holy Theotokos and the blessed memory and help of Saint Pantaleon, pour out Your Holy Spirit upon our life. Purify our mind in the stillness of prayer, grant us health, patience and forgiveness of sins, and guide us to the eternal peace of Your heavenly Kingdom. Amen!

oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Gós-po-di I-i-sú-se Khris-té, Sý-ne Bó-zhiy, po-mí-luy mya gresh-na-go. Mo-lit-va-mi Pre-chis-ty-ya Tvo-ye-ya Ma-te-re i vsekh svya-tykh Tvo-ikh, spa-si i sokh-ra-ni du-shi na-sha. A-min.]

Through the intercession of the Most Holy Theotokos and the blessed memory and help of Saint Charalambos (Caralampio) against Epidemics and Pests, pour out Your Holy Spirit upon our life. Purify our mind in the stillness of prayer, grant us health, patience and forgiveness of sins, and guide us to the eternal peace of Your heavenly Kingdom. Amen!

oraciones.titulo: Saint John Maximovich of Shanghai and San Francisco · Swift Aid and Healing of the Afflicted
oraciones.textoOriginal: О святителю отче Иоанне, пастырю добрый и чудотворче предивный Христов! Молися Христу Богу о спасении душ наших, исцели недуги телесныя и душевныя, и защити нас от всякаго зла. Аминь.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O svya-ti-té-lyu ót-che I-o-án-ne, pás-ty-ryu dób-ryi i chu-dot-vór-che pre-dív-nyi Khris-tóv! Mo-lí-sya Khris-tú Bó-gu...]
oraciones.textoTraducido: O holy hierarch Father John, good shepherd and wonderworker of Christ! You who traveled the world bringing solace to the sick, shelter to orphans, and swift aid to the afflicted, hear our humble prayer. You who in Shanghai, Europe, and San Francisco worked miracles of faith and healing through the power of the Holy Cross, intercede before the Throne of the Most High for our spiritual and physical needs. Deliver us from tribulations, heal our infirmities, grant us strength in trial, and guide our souls to eternal salvation through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen!

oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Gós-po-di I-i-sú-se Khris-té, Sý-ne Bó-zhiy, po-mí-luy mya gresh-na-go. Mo-lit-va-mi Pre-chis-ty-ya Tvo-ye-ya Ma-te-re i vsekh svya-tykh Tvo-ikh, spa-si i sokh-ra-ni du-shi na-sha. A-min.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the Living God! Through the intercession of the Most Holy Theotokos and the blessed memory and help of Troparion to the Apostle Saint Andrew, pour out Your Holy Spirit upon our life. Purify our mind in the stillness of prayer, grant us health, patience and forgiveness of sins, and guide us to the eternal peace of Your heavenly Kingdom. Amen!

oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Gós-po-di I-i-sú-se Khris-té, Sý-ne Bó-zhiy, po-mí-luy mya gresh-na-go. Mo-lit-va-mi Pre-chis-ty-ya Tvo-ye-ya Ma-te-re i vsekh svya-tykh Tvo-ikh, spa-si i sokh-ra-ni du-shi na-sha. A-min.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the Living God! Through the intercession of the Most Holy Theotokos and the blessed memory and help of Troparium of the Holy Protection of the Veil of the Theotokos (Pokrov / Saint Mary of Blachernae), pour out Your Holy Spirit upon our life. Purify our mind in the stillness of prayer, grant us health, patience and forgiveness of sins, and guide us to the eternal peace of Your heavenly Kingdom. Amen!

oraciones.titulo: Sri Venkateswara Suprabhatam (Tirupati Balaji - India) – Song of Divine Awakening
oraciones.textoOriginal: कौसल्या सुप्रजा राम पूर्वा संध्या प्रवर्तते। उत्तिष्ठ नरशार्दूल कर्तव्यं दैवं आह्निकम्॥ उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ गोविन्द उत्तिष्ठ गरुडध्वज। उत्तिष्ठ कमलाकान्त त्रैलोक्यं मङ्गलं कुरु॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Kausalya supraja Rama poorva sandhya pravartate | Uttishtha narashardoola kartavyam daivam ahnikam || Uttishthottishtha Govinda uttishtha garudadhwaja | Uttishtha kamalakanta trailokyam mangalam kuru ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: O beloved Rama, blessed son of Kausalya! Dawn breaks on the eastern horizon. Awake, Lord of men, to fulfill the sacred duties of the cosmos! Awake, O Govinda! Awake, Lord of the Garuda Badge! Wake up, beloved of Lakshmi, and shower blessing and prosperity on the three worlds!

oraciones.titulo: Sri Damodarashtakam (Satyavrata Muni) – The Sweet Lord Bound by the Ropes of Pure Love
oraciones.textoOriginal: नमामीश्वरं सच्चिदानन्दरूपं लसत्कुण्डलं गोकुले भ्राजमानम्। यशोदाभियोलूखलाद्धावमानं परामृष्टमत्यन्ततो द्रुत्य गोप्या॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Namamishvaram sach-cid-ananda-roopam lasat-kundalam gokule bhrajamanam | Yashoda-bhiyolukhalad-dhavamanam paramrishtam atyantato drutya gopya ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: I prostrate before the Supreme Controller, whose form is Eternity, Knowledge and Absolute Bliss (Sat-Chit-Ananda), whose golden earrings shine on Gokula as he runs fearing the rod of Mother Yashoda. I ask not for riches or liberation from the cycle of reincarnations, but for this sweet lotus face of Krishna to dwell eternally in my heart.

oraciones.titulo: Gita Govinda (Jayadeva Goswami) – Ashtapadi: The Beauty of the Groves of Vrindavan
oraciones.textoOriginal: ललितलवङ्गलतापरिशीलने कोमलमलयसमीरे। मधुकुरनिकरकरम्बितकोकिलकूजितकुञ्जकुटीरे। विहरति हरिरिह सरसवसन्ते नृत्यति युवतिजनेन समं सखि विरहिजनस्य दुरन्ते॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Lalita-lavanga-lata-parishilana komala-malaya-samire | Madhu-kara-nikara-karambita-kokila-koojita-kunja-kuteere || Viharati Harir iha sarasa-vasante nrityati yuvati-janena samam sakhi virahi-janasya durante ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: The gentle southern breeze caresses the fragrant vines of cloves and jasmine; The bumblebees buzz and the cuckoo sings among the flowering groves. In this beautiful spiritual spring, Lord Hari dances filling hearts with immaculate love and heavenly peace.

oraciones.titulo: Tiruppavai (Holy Andal - Alwar Tamil Tradition) – Awakening of the Soul before Ranganatha
oraciones.textoOriginal: மார்கழித் திங்கள் மதிநிறைந்த நன்னாளால்; நீராடப் போதுவீர்! போதுமினோ, நேரிழையீர்!... நாராயணனே, நமக்கே பறை தருவான், பாரோர் புகழப் படிந்தேலோர் எம்பாவாய்.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Margazhi thingal madhi nirainda nannalaal | Neeraada poduveer podumino nerizhaiyeer | Narayanane namakke parai tharuvaan | Paaror pugazha padindhelor embaavaai ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: On this beautiful morning of the full moon, let all consecrated souls go out to bathe in the river of divine grace. The Supreme Lord Narayana will grant us the supreme gift of his service and eternal love, dissolving all sadness and blessing our land.

oraciones.titulo: Narayana Suktam (Yajurveda) – The Transcendent Light at the Heart of the Cosmos
oraciones.textoOriginal: सहस्रशीर्षं देवं विश्वाक्षं विश्वशम्भुवम्। विश्वं नारायणं देवमक्षरं परमं पदम्॥ पद्मकोशप्रतीकाशं हृदयं चाप्यधोमुखम्। अधो निष्ट्या वितस्त्यान्ते नाभ्यामुपरि तिष्ठति...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Sahasra-shirsham devam vishvaksham vishva-shambhuvam | Vishvam Narayanam devam aksharam paramam padam || Padma-kosha-prateekasham hridayam chapy-adho-mukham...
oraciones.textoTraducido: The Divine Being Narayana has a thousand heads and a thousand eyes; It is the source of all cosmic well-being and the supreme rest of the worlds. In the center of the human heart a subtle and inextinguishable flame shines, like a bolt of golden light: there dwells the Supreme Divinity as a witness and eternal friend of our soul.

oraciones.titulo: Sri Suktam (Rigveda) – Invocation of the Gracia and Abundance of the Madre Lakshmi
oraciones.textoOriginal: हिरण्यवर्णां हरिणीं सुवर्णरजतस्रजाम्। चन्द्रां हिरण्मयीं लक्ष्मीं जातवेदो म आवह॥ तां म आवह जातवेदो लक्ष्मीमनपगामिनीम्। यस्यां हिरण्यं विन्देयं गामश्वं पुरुषानहम्॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Hiranya-varnam harineem suvarna-rajata-srajam | Chandram hiranmayeem lakshmeem jata-vedo ma aavaha || Taam ma aavaha jata-vedo lakshmeem anapagaamineem...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O divine fire, invoke for us the golden Mother Lakshmi, resplendent like the full moon, adorned with garlands of gold and silver! May your blessing never leave our home, filling our table with pure food, bringing health to our children and removing all scarcity and misery from our lives.

oraciones.titulo: Siddha Kunjika Stotram (Shiva to Parvati) – The Secret Key of Power of the Great Goddess
oraciones.textoOriginal: शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि कुञ्जिकास्तोत्रमुत्तमम्। येन मन्त्रप्रभावेण चण्डीजापः शुभो भवेत्॥ ॐ ऐं ह्रीं क्लीं चामुण्डायै विच्चे। ॐ ग्लौं हुं क्लीं जूं सः ज्वालय ज्वालय ज्वल ज्वल प्रज्वल प्रज्वल ऐं ह्रीं क्लीं चामुण्डायै विच्चे ज्वल हं सं लं क्षं फट् स्वाहा॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Shrinu devi pravakshyami Kunjika-stotram uttamam | Yena mantra-prabhavena chandi-japah shubho bhavet || Om Aim Hreem Kleem Chamundayai Vicche | Om Glaum Hum Kleem Joom Sah...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om Tat Sat! We invoke the supreme divine light and grace in this sacred contemplation of Siddha Kunjika Stotram (Shiva to Parvati). May transcendent wisdom and pure knowledge dispel all darkness and ignorance from our mind, filling our life with inner peace, equanimity, discernment, and spiritual elevation. Om Shanti, Shanti, Shanti.

oraciones.titulo: Panchamukhi Hanuman Kavacham – Shield of the Five Protective Faces of Hanuman
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ नमो भगवते पञ्चवदनाय पूर्वमुखाय वानराय महाबलाय। सकलशत्रुसंहारकाय स्वाहा। दक्षिणमुखाय करालवदनाय नारसिंहाय... पश्चिममुखाय गरुडाय... उत्तरमुखाय वराहाय... ऊर्ध्वमुखाय हयग्रीवाय...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Namo Bhagavate Pancha-vadanaya poorva-mukhaya vanaraya maha-balaya | Sakala-shatru-samharakaya svaha...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om Tat Sat! We invoke the supreme divine light and grace in this sacred contemplation of Panchamukhi Hanuman Kavacham. May transcendent wisdom and pure knowledge dispel all darkness and ignorance from our mind, filling our life with inner peace, equanimity, discernment, and spiritual elevation. Om Shanti, Shanti, Shanti.

oraciones.titulo: Abhang to Sri Vitthala of Pandharpur (Sant Tukaram - Maharashtra)
oraciones.textoOriginal: सुंदर ते ध्यान उभे विटेवरी । कर कटावरी ठेवोनिया ॥ तुळशीचे हार गळा कासे पीतांबर । आवडे निरंतर हेचि ध्यान ॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Sundara te dhyana ubhe vitevari | Kara katavari thevoniya || Tulasiche haara gala kaase peetambara | Aavade nirantara hechi dhyana ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: What a beautiful and gracious vision! Lord Vitthala standing on the sacred brick with his hands on his hips, adorned with the Tulasi garland and golden garments. As I contemplate Your sweet presence, O God of love and compassion, all the sorrows of the world fade into joy.

oraciones.titulo: Bhajan by Meera Bai – 'Mere To Giridhar Gopal Doosro Na Koi'
oraciones.textoOriginal: मेरो तो गिरधर गोपाल दूसरो न कोई। जाके सिर मोर मुकुट मेरो पति सोई। तात मात भ्रात बन्धु आपनो न कोई। छांड़ि दई कुल की कानि कहा करिहै कोई॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Mero to Giridhar Gopal doosro na koi | Jaake sir mor mukut mero pati soi | Taat maat bhraat bandhu aapno na koi | Chhandi dayi kul ki kaani kaha karihai koi ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: For me there is only the Lord who raised the hill of Govardhan (Giridhar Gopal), there is no one else in my heart. He who wears the crown of peacock feathers is my beloved and my supreme refuge. In his unconditional love I have found the true jewel that is never lost or worn out.

oraciones.titulo: Harivarasanam (Sabarimala - Kerala) – Lullaby to Lord Ayyappa
oraciones.textoOriginal: हरिवरासनं विश्वमोहनं हरिदधीश्वरं आराध्यपादुकम्। अरिविमर्दनं नित्यनर्तनं हरिकुमारकम अय्यपमाश्रये॥ शरणमय्यप्पा स्वामि शरणमय्यप्पा...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Harivarasanam vishva-mohanam haridadhishwaram aradhya-padukam | Ari-vimardanam nitya-nartanam hari-kumarakam Ayyapam ashraye || Sharanam Ayyappa Swami Sharanam Ayyappa ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Take refuge in Lord Ayyappa, blessed son of Shiva and Vishnu, whose presence calms the entire universe and whose lotus feet are worshiped by the sages. May peace descend upon the mountains of Sabarimala and upon all the pilgrims who cry: Swamiye Saranam Ayyappa!

oraciones.titulo: Kanda Sashti Kavasam (Tamil Nadu) – The Protective Armor of Lord Murugan
oraciones.textoOriginal: துதிப்போர்க்கு வல்வினைபோம் துன்பம்போம் நெஞ்சிற் பதிப்போர்க்குச் செல்வம் பலித்துக் கதித்தோங்கும்... சஷ்டியை நோக்கச் சரவணபவனார் சிஷ்டருக்குதவும் செங்கதிர்வேலோன்...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Thuthipporkku valvinaipom thunbampom nenjir | Padhipporkku selvam palithu kathithongum... Sashtiyai nokka saravanabavanaar | Sishtarukkuthavum sengkathir velon ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: For those who praise Lord Murugan, sorrows and difficult karmas dissolve; The mind is filled with light and prosperity flourishes. May the Holy Spear (Vel) of Murugan protect my body from all pain, drive away all shadows and guard my mind with divine courage!

oraciones.titulo: Balinese Puja to Sang Hyang Widhi Wasa (Pura Besakih - Bali, Indonesia)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Om Atma Tattwatma Suddha Mam Swaha. Om Sri Pasupataye Hum Phat. Om Sarwa Dewa Bhuta Pratistha Ya Namah Swaha.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Atma Tattwatma Suddha Mam Swaha | Om Sri Pasupataye Hum Phat...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh! May the Supreme Divine Reality Sang Hyang Widhi Wasa purify our soul and harmonize the three worlds (Tri Hita Karana): the relationship with God, with nature and with our fellow humans. May the blessing of the sacred volcano Agung and the temples of Bali bring fertility and unalterable peace.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Maha Shivaratri in Ganga Talao (Grand Bassin - Mauricio)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ नमः शिवाय। शम्भो महादेवा पावनजलधारिणे। मॉरीशसद्वीपवासिनां कल्याणं कुरु सर्वदा॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Namah Shivaya | Shambho Mahadeva pavana-jala-dharine | Mauritius-dweepa-vasinam kalyanam kuru sarvada ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om Namah Shivaya! Lord Shiva, who sustains the purifying waters of the sacred lake Ganga Talao on the island of Mauritius: protect our families, bless our ocean lands with harmony among all cultures, and grant us spiritual peace and perpetual health.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer before Sri Dhakeshwari Mata (Dhaka National Temple - Bangladesh)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ ढाकेश्वरी महामाये दुर्गा दुर्गतिनाशिनी। वरदे शुभदे देवि रक्ष मां शरणागतम्॥
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Dhakeshwari Mahamaye Durga durgati-nashini | Varade shubhade devi raksha mam sharanagatam ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Salutations to Mother Dhakeshwari, blessed manifestation of Durga who dissolves difficulties and suffering! Protect your people in Bangladesh, spread concord and well-being on the banks of the Padma and Meghna rivers, and keep our homes in peace and prosperity.

oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय। सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्ये शिवे सर्वार्थसाधिके। शरण्ये त्र्यम्बके गौरि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥ ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः॥

Om Shanti, Shanti, Shanti.

oraciones.titulo: Oriki Olodumare – Invocation to the Supreme Creator of the Universe and Giver of Life
oraciones.textoOriginal: Olódùmarè, Ọba Àjíkí, Ọba Àjìpè, Ẹlẹ́dàá gbogbo ayé. A dúpẹ́ lọ́wọ́ rẹ fún ẹ̀mí àti àlàáfíà...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Olodumare, Oba Ajiki, Oba Ajipe, Eledaa gbogbo aye. A dupe lowo re fun emi ati alaafia...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Olodumare, Supreme King whom we greet upon awakening, Creator of heaven and earth! We thank you for the breath of life (Emi), for health and peace. In your divine hands we place our destiny, asking that your blessing guide our steps in righteousness and harmony.

oraciones.titulo: Oriki Ori – Prayer and Offering to the Spiritual Head and Personal Destiny
oraciones.textoOriginal: Orí mi, gbe mí! Orí mi, l'à mi! Ẹni tó gbọ́n, orí ló ni. Orí ló ń dá ẹ̀dá sí...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ori mi, gbe mi! Ori mi, la mi! Eni to gbon, ori lo ni...
oraciones.textoTraducido: My Ori, my spiritual head, support me! My Ori, open the paths of success and wisdom for me! He who is prudent owes his fortune to the guidance of his Ori. May my head not wander into pride, may it make wise decisions and lead me to peace and prosperity.

oraciones.titulo: Oriki Eledá – Invocation to the Guardian Angel and Inner Protector
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ẹlẹ́dàá mi, mo júbà rẹ. Má jẹ́ kí n rìn nínú òkùnkùn, fún mi ní ìmọ́lẹ̀ àti àbò...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Eledaa mi, mo juba re. Ma je ki n rin ninu okunkun...
oraciones.textoTraducido: My Eledá, guardian and protective angel who walks with me from birth! I give you moforibale and respect. Don't let him stumble in the dark; Light my path, keep false friends away and keep my spirit firm in the face of any difficulty.

oraciones.titulo: Oriki Eshu Elegbara – Opening of Doors, Opportunities and Development
oraciones.textoOriginal: Èṣù Ẹlẹ́gbára, Ọba àwọn oríta, aṣọ̀tún aṣòsì láì nítìjú. Ṣí ọ̀nà ire fún mi, tì ọ̀nà ibi...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Eshu Elegbara, Oba awon orita, ashotun ashosi lai nitiju. Shi ona ire fun mi, ti ona ibi...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Olofin and the Holy Orishas, we lift our devotion and prayer for Oriki Eshu Elegbara. We come with reverence before the blessed spiritual powers to remove all negativity, disturbance and heavy burdens, firmly opening the pathways to health, peace, progress and abundance in our home. Ashé to iban Eshu! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Oriki Ogun Onire – Fuerza, Work and Employment Honrado and Victory over Obstáculos
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ògún Alákàayé, Ọba aṣọ irin, olómi nile fẹ̀jẹ̀ wẹ̀. Fún mi ní agbára àti iṣẹ́ rere...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ogun Alakaaye, Oba asho irin, olomi nile feje we. Fun mi ni agbara ati ishe rere...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Ogun Onire, lord of iron and patron of tireless work! Cut with your sacred machete all the difficulties, obstacles and curses that try to stop my progress. Grant strength to my hands to work, protect my path from accidents and give me the victory of perseverance. Ogun Ye!

oraciones.titulo: Oriki Ochosi Ode Mata – Cazador Certero, Justice Divina and Libertad
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ọ̀ṣọ́ọ̀sì Ọdẹ Mọta, a gbani là nígbà ìṣòro. Ọfà rẹ kì í tàsé. Gbè mí lọ́wọ́ àwọn ọ̀tá...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Oshosi Ode Mata, a gbani la nigba ishoro. Ofa re ki i tase. Gbe mi lowo awon ota...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Ochosi Ode Mata, accurate hunter whose divine arrow never misses the target! Defend me from unjust judgments, free me from prisons and bonds, and guide my steps with righteousness to pursue the blessings of knowledge and peace. Ochosi Odde Mata!

oraciones.titulo: Oriki Ozain Ewe – Lord of Healing Herbs and Secrets of the Mount
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ọ̀sanyìn Ewé gbogbo, Kò sí ewé kò sí Òrìṣà. Ewé tí ń wo àrùn, ewé tí ń mú àlàáfíà wá...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Osanyin Ewe gbogbo, Ko si ewe ko si Orisha. Ewe ti n wo arun...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Ozain, owner of all the sacred leaves and medicine of the mountain! Without grass there is no consecration or healing. May the healing power of plants and the dew of nature cleanse my body of diseases and restore my health and vitality. Ozain Kuelese Kan!

oraciones.titulo: Oriki Obatala Baba Aye – The White Mantle of Peace, Purity and Mental Clarity
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ọbàtálá, Ọba gbogbo ayé, Ọba aṣọ funfun. Fún mi ní sùúrù, ìmọ́lẹ̀ àti ìrònú rere...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Obatala, Oba gbogbo aye, Oba asho funfun. Fun mi ni suuru, imole ati ironu rere...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Olofin and the Holy Orishas, we lift our devotion and prayer for Oriki Obatala Baba Aye. We come with reverence before the blessed spiritual powers to remove all negativity, disturbance and heavy burdens, firmly opening the pathways to health, peace, progress and abundance in our home. Ashé to iban Eshu! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Oriki Yemaya Olokun – Universal Mother of Salt Waters and Maternal Protector
oraciones.textoOriginal: Yemọja, Ìyá gbogbo wa, Ọba odò àti òkun. Wẹ̀ mí mọ́ pẹ̀lú omi tútù rẹ, gba àwọn ọmọ mi...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Yemoja, Iya gbogbo wa, Oba odo ati okun. We mi mo pelu omi tutu re...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Yemaya, beloved Mother of all beings and lady of the waves of the sea! Wash my anguish and sadness with your sacred and refreshing waters. Embrace my children with your protective mantle, fill my home with fertility, peace and unconditional love. Omio Yemaya!

oraciones.titulo: Oriki Oshun Ibu Kole – Sacred Honey, Noble Wealth, Beauty and Fertility
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ọ̀ṣun Yèyé Kari, Ìyá olómi tútù, Ọba wúrà àti oyin. Fún mi ní ayọ̀, ìfẹ́ tòótọ́ àti ọrọ̀ rere...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Oshun Yeye Kari, Iya olomi tutu, Oba wura ati oyin. Fun mi ni ayo, ife tooto ati oro rere...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oshun Yeye Kari, mother of the sweet waters of the rivers, lady of gold and sacred honey! Sweeten my life with sincere joy, bless my womb and my family, bring worthy prosperity to my work and clothe me with spiritual beauty and peace. Yalodde Oshun!

oraciones.titulo: Oriki Shango Alafin of Oyo – The Fire of Thunder, Bravery and Royal Justice
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ṣàngó Ọba Kòso, Ọba tí ń bọ́ àrá, olómi iná. Gbèjà mi níwájú àwọn ọ̀tá, fún mi ní ìṣẹ́gun...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Shango Oba Koso, Oba ti n bo ara, olomi ina. Gbeja mi niwaju awon ota...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Shango, King of Oyo and lord of lightning and bata drums! Defend me from traitors and slanderers; May the thunder of truth overthrow all falsehood and grant me the courage, dignity and victory of just men. Kawiosile Shango!

oraciones.titulo: Oriki Oya Yansa – Wind of Transformation, Lady of Storms and Ancestors
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ọya Yànsán, Ìyá afẹ́fẹ́ àti mọ̀nàmọ́ná, a gbani là nínú ìjì. Ṣí ọ̀nà àwọn baba wa...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Oya Yansan, Iya afefe ati monamona, a gbani la ninu iji...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oya Yansa, lady of the winds, the sparks and the sacred doors! Drive away any bad streak, illness or stagnation with your impetuous breath. Make way for blessed transformations and guide the ancestors (Eguns) with light and peace. Jekua Hey Yansa!

oraciones.titulo: Oriki Babalu Aye / Sopona – Miraculous Healer of Illnesses and Protector of Health
oraciones.textoOriginal: Babá Lú Ayé, Asójano, Ọba tí ń wo àrùn gbogbo. Fi oore-ọ̀fẹ́ rẹ wò mí sàn, mú àìsàn kúrò...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Baba Lu Aye, Asojano, Oba ti n wo arun gbogbo. Fi oore-ofe re wo mi san...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Babalu Aye, humble Saint who understands the pain of the sick! Cover my body with your purifying sackcloth, drive away any pestilence, virus or incurable ailment, and pour out health, vitality and comfort on those who suffer in their beds. Jekua Babalu Aye!

oraciones.titulo: Bahia Candomblé – Oração a Oxalá (Epá Babá - Salvador da Bahia, Brazil)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Epá Babá! Senhor do pano branco, abençoai o povo de santo e todas as famílias da Bahia e do Brasil...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Epa Baba! Senhor do pano branco, abencoai o povo de santo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Olofin and the Holy Orishas, we lift our devotion and prayer for Bahia Candomblé. We come with reverence before the blessed spiritual powers to remove all negativity, disturbance and heavy burdens, firmly opening the pathways to health, peace, progress and abundance in our home. Ashé to iban Eshu! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Candomblé – Prayer from February 2 to Iemanjá (Rio Vermelho / Salvador da Bahia)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Odoyá, Rainha do Mar! No dia dois de fevereiro entregamos nossas flores e oferendas nas águas sagradas...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Odoya, Rainha do Mar! No dia dois de fevereiro...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Odoyá Iemanjá, Queen of the Sea! On the beaches of Rio Vermelho and in all the seas of the world we place our flowers and hopes. Protect fishermen and sailors, cleanse our hearts of bitterness and bless our families with health and togetherness.

oraciones.titulo: Umbanda – Oração aos Pretos Velhos (Adorei as Almas - Vovô and Vovó)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Adorei as Almas! Salve os Pretos Velhos, mensageiros de humildade, caridade e paciência...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Adorei as Almas! Salve os Pretos Velhos...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I adore the Souls! Hail the wise and kind Pretos Velhos who with their cachimbo and their herbs of blessing calm the afflictions of the soul, teach us the value of forgiveness and humility, and help us carry our crosses with patience and faith in God. Axé!

oraciones.titulo: Umbanda – Oração aos Caboclos das Matas (Okê Caboclo - Arrows of Healing)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Okê Caboclo! Salve a força dos guerreiros das matas virgens, das ervas medicinais e da justiça...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Oke Caboclo! Salve a forca dos guerreiros das matas virgens...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Ok Caboclo! Save the strength of the warrior spirits of the jungles and mountains. May its diamond arrows destroy all evil, may its crystalline waters cleanse our homes and may its courage inspire our daily lives with health and dignity. Axé!

oraciones.titulo: Oriki Inle and Abata – The Divine Physician of Waters and Health
oraciones.textoOriginal: Omí tutu, oná tutu, ilé tutu, owó tutu, omó tutu, ariku babawa. Ashé gbogbo kaleno osha, modupué Olofin, modupué Orisha. Ashé!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O-mí tu-tu, o-ná tu-tu, i-lé tu-tu, o-wó tu-tu, o-mó tu-tu, a-ri-ku ba-ba-wa. A-shé gbog-bo ka-le-no o-sha, mo-du-pué O-lo-fin, mo-du-pué O-ri-sha. A-shé!]
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Olofin and the Holy Orishas, we lift our devotion and prayer for Oriki Inle and Abata. We come with reverence before the blessed spiritual powers to remove all negativity, disturbance and heavy burdens, firmly opening the pathways to health, peace, progress and abundance in our home. Ashé to iban Eshu! Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Oriki Ibejis (Taiwo and Kehinde) – Children's Joy and Prosperity
oraciones.textoOriginal: Omí tutu, oná tutu, ilé tutu, owó tutu, omó tutu, ariku babawa. Ashé gbogbo kaleno osha, modupué Olofin, modupué Orisha. Ashé!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [O-mí tu-tu, o-ná tu-tu, i-lé tu-tu, o-wó tu-tu, o-mó tu-tu, a-ri-ku ba-ba-wa. A-shé gbog-bo ka-le-no o-sha, mo-du-pué O-lo-fin, mo-du-pué O-ri-sha. A-shé!]
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Olofin and the Holy Orishas, we lift our devotion and prayer for Oriki Ibejis (Taiwo and Kehinde).
