oraciones.titulo: Hymn and Prayer 'Oh, It's All Well!' (William Clayton / Come, Come, Ye Saints)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Oh, está todo bien! Santos, venid, no temáis ni dudéis; con gozo andad, aunque haya dolor...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Oh, esta todo bien! Santos, venid, no temais ni dudeis...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, as we remember the pioneers who sang through the snow and weariness, 'Oh, it's all right!', we ask you for that same serene faith. May no trial or earthly loss break our hope, knowing that in your arms of eternal love all will be well forever. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Gratitude 'We Give You, Lord, Our Thanks for Sending a Prophet'
oraciones.textoOriginal: Te damos, Señor, nuestras gracias que mandas un profeta hoy... Nos muestras la senda divina que guía al reino de Dios...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Te damos, Senor, nuestras gracias que mandas un profeta hoy...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Dear Heavenly Father, we thank you with a heart full of joy for sending prophets and apostles to guide us in these last days. Bless their families with health and strength, and give us the humility to listen to their advice and live according to your Holy Will. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer at the Missionary Training Center (MTC/MTC) – Preparation and Anointing
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre Celestial, en estos salones de preparación misional nos consagramos para enseñar el Evangelio...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Padre Celestial, en estos salones de preparacion misional...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Dear Father, bless the thousands of young people and older couples in Missionary Training Centers around the world. Open their minds to learn languages ​​with the gift of tongues, fill their souls with love for the people they will teach, and send them out clothed with the power of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Gratitude for the Reconstruction of the Nauvoo Temple along the Mississippi
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre Celestial, te alabamos por el Templo de Nauvoo que se levanta nuevamente como símbolo de fe invencible...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Padre Celestial, te alabamos por el Templo de Nauvoo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Eternal Father, we thank you for the Holy Temple of Nauvoo on the banks of the Mississippi River. We remember the devotion of the first saints who carved the stone with sacrifice; May that same love for your sacred covenants burn in our hearts forever. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Peace and Praise at the Laie Temple (Hawaii / Polynesia)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Heavenly Father, we praise Thee from the shores of Laie, Hawaii, uniting the islands in Thy temple covenants...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Heavenly Father, we praise Thee from the shores of Laie...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, we praise you from the shores of Laie in Hawaii. We thank you for the blessings of the Holy Temple that unite the islands of the Pacific in eternal covenants of salvation. Spread the spirit of Christian 'Aloha' into our families and communities. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Devotional Prayer at the Mesa Temple (Arizona) – Desert Oasis
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre Celestial, te agradecemos por el Templo de Mesa como un oasis de aguas vivas en el desierto...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Padre Celestial, te agradecemos por el Templo de Mesa...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Our Father, we thank you for the Mesa Arizona Temple. Just as this sanctuary flourished in the middle of the desert, make our lives flourish in righteousness, strengthen Hispanic and Anglo-American families in Christian unity and comfort those who thirst for justice. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Gratitude for the Historic Temple of Bern (Switzerland) and Faith in Europe
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre Celestial, recordamos con gratitud el Templo de Berna, primer templo erigido en Europa...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Padre Celestial, recordamos con gratitud el Templo de Berna...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, bless the members of the Church throughout Europe. May the peace of the Temple of Berne and of each European temple be an inextinguishable beacon of hope, reconciliation between nations and light of the Gospel for future generations. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Parents for the Return of a Wayward Son (Alma 36 / Parable of the Prodigal Son)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre Celestial, clamamos con lágrimas de amor por nuestro hijo; ablanda su corazón y tráelo de vuelta a tu redil...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Padre Celestial, clamamos con lagrimas de amor por nuestro hijo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, we come to you with the moved hearts of parents for our beloved child who has strayed from the path. Just as you heard Father Alma's prayer for his son and reached him with your infinite grace, send angels of kindness to touch his conscience, make him remember the love of home and bring him safe and sound to your arms of forgiveness. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer for the Healing and Renewal of Covenant Marriage
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre Celestial, renueva el amor, la paciencia y el perdón en nuestro matrimonio sellado en el Templo...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Padre Celestial, renueva el amor, la paciencia y el perdon...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Father, we come together before your presence to renew the sacred vows we made in your Holy Temple. Dissolve misunderstandings, heal the wounds of the heart and fill us with the pure love of Christ (charity) to listen to each other with patience, respect each other with nobility and walk hand in hand towards eternity. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Opening Prayer at Stake Conference – Unity and Local Revelation
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre Celestial, nos reunimos como estaca de Sión para ser instruidos por tus siervos...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Padre Celestial, nos reunimos como estaca de Sion...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Eternal Father, bless all wards and branches gathered in this Stake Conference. Inspires the Stake Presidency, High Council, and auxiliary leaders; strengthen the bonds of brotherhood and help us rise as one family in Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer for the Liahona Espiritual and the Dirección Personal Diaria
oraciones.textoOriginal: Amado Padre Celestial, en el sagrado nombre de Tu Hijo Jesucristo nos allegamos a Ti en humilde oración.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [A-má-do Pá-dre Ce-les-tiál, en el sa-grá-do nóm-bre de Tu Hí-jo Je-su-krís-to nos al-le-gá-mos a Ti en hu-míl-de o-ra-ción... A-mén.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Heavenly Father, we come before Thee in the sacred and reverent name of Thy Son, Jesus Christ. We present our humble petition and gratitude for the Liahona Espiritual and the Dirección Personal Diaria. We pray that Thou wilt pour out Thy Holy Spirit upon our home, strengthen our testimony, bless our daily labors, and guide us in righteousness along the covenant path. In the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.

oraciones.guiaFonetica: [A-má-do Pá-dre Ce-les-tiál, en el sa-grá-do nóm-bre de Tu Hí-jo Je-su-krís-to nos al-le-gá-mos a Ti en hu-míl-de o-ra-ción... A-mén.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Heavenly Father, we come before Thee in the sacred and reverent name of Thy Son, Jesus Christ. We present our humble petition and gratitude for Prayer of Firmeza and Devoción in Cochabamba (Bolivia). We pray that Thou wilt pour out Thy Holy Spirit upon our home, strengthen our testimony, bless our daily labors, and guide us in righteousness along the covenant path. In the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Peace and Serenity (Psychography of Chico Xavier - Emmanuel)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Senhor, faze de mim um instrumento de Tua paz. Onde houver ódio, que eu leve o amor; onde houver ofensa, que eu leve o perdão...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Senhor, faze de mim um instrumento de Tua paz...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord, grant me the grace to sow comfort where there is pain, understanding where there is discord, and light where there is darkness. May he not seek so much to be loved as to love, to be understood as to understand; because giving is how we receive, forgiving is how we are forgiven and by forgetting selfishness we awaken to eternal life.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Dr. Bezerra of Menezes – Doctor of the Poor and Healing Fluids
oraciones.textoOriginal: Nós Te rogamos, Pai de Infinita Bondade e Justiça, as graças de Jesus Cristo através de Bezerra de Menezes e suas legiões de companheiros...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Nos Te rogamos, Pai de Infinita Bondade e Justica...
oraciones.textoTraducido: We pray to you, Father of Infinite Goodness, that through Dr. Bezerra de Menezes and the medical spirits of space, salves and healthy fluids descend upon the sick and afflicted. May the fluidized waters heal bodies, cleanse minds and restore hope to suffering homes. In the name of Jesus, amen.

oraciones.titulo: Price of Gratidão and Spiritual Work (André Luiz - 'Nosso Lar')
oraciones.textoOriginal: Senhor Jesus, ajuda-nos a trabalhar no bem sem desfalecer. Ensina-nos a servir ao próximo como oportunidade sagrada de evolução...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Senhor Jesus, ajuda-nos a trabalhar no bem sem desfalecer...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus, grant us the joy of being useful in your vineyard. May we contemplate the realities of the spiritual world understand that life continues beyond the physical grave, that love is the eternal bond between souls and that selfless work is the key that opens the doors of moral elevation.

oraciones.titulo: Oração pelas Mães and pelas Crianças (Psychography of Chico Xavier - Meimei)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Jesus amigo, abençoa as criancinhas da Terra, protege os pequeninos nos seus passos e consola o coração das mães...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Jesus amigo, abencoa as criancinhas da Terra...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Father of Infinite Goodness, Wisdom, and Mercy! In deep spiritual elevation, we lift our prayer for Oração pelas Mães and pelas Crianças (Psychography of Chico Xavier. We pray to the good spirits and our guardian angel to assist us with their beneficent light, dispel all turmoil from the soul, and grant us patience, resignation, and love to progress along the path of goodness. May the peace of God rest upon us. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Price of Self-Healing and Interior Reconciliation (Divaldo Franco - Joanna of Ângelis)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Pai Amado, ilumina os refolhos da minha alma para que eu me reconcilie com meu passado e dissipe a culpa pelo autoamor...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Pai Amado, ilumina os refolhos da minha alma...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Father, illuminate the secret corners of my soul. Help me overcome fear, resentment, and guilt through self-discovery and compassionate love. I recognize that every experience lived is a lesson in growth and that in your infinite mercy there is always an opportunity to be reborn and flourish in holiness.

oraciones.titulo: Prece of Abertura do Evangelho no Lar (Allan Kardec / Paris)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Seigneur Dieu Tout-Puissant, que de bons Esprits soient attirés vers nous pour nous assister et nous éclairer...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Seigneur Dieu Tout-Puissant, que de bons Esprits soient attires vers nous...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord God Almighty, allow the good spirits to assist and instruct us in this moment of reading the Gospel at Home. May the light of Christ illuminate our family coexistence, dissolve the roughnesses and make our home a refuge of brotherhood and charity.

oraciones.titulo: Prière pour le Courage of l'Âme dans l'Épreuve (Léon Denis - 'Après the Mort')
oraciones.textoOriginal: Dieu de Justice et d'Amour, soutiens notre volonté dans les heures de labeur et d'épreuve...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Dieu de Justice et d'Amour, soutiens notre volonte...
oraciones.textoTraducido: God of Justice and Love, strengthen our will in hours of trial. May we understand the law of cause and effect not as a punishment, but as the wise crucible that purifies the gold of the spirit, making us more humble, compassionate and aware of our immortality.

oraciones.titulo: Prière of Contemplation of l'Infini Céleste (Camille Flammarion - Paris)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ô Grand Architecte de l'Univers, en contemplant les myriades d'étoiles et de mondes habités...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O Grand Architecte de l'Univers, en contemplant les myriades d'etoiles...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Great Creator of the Cosmos! As we contemplate the millions of stars and inhabited worlds in the immensity of space, we recognize the infinite greatness of your work and the universal brotherhood of all souls in continuous evolution throughout the worlds.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of the Chair of Light and Spiritual Healing (Mexican Trinitarian Spiritualism)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre Santísimo, Fuente Inagotable de Luz y Amor: derrama tu Santo Espíritu sobre esta asamblea...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Padre Santisimo, Fuente Inagotable de Luz y Amor...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Eternal Father, in this place of peace we ask that the light of your messengers descend upon our heads. It heals the sick in body and spirit, cleanses heavy fluids and awakens in us love for others and charity without distinction of creed.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer for Opening the Spiritual Cord (Spiritualist Tradition of Cuba)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Tomados de las manos en santa cadena de unión y concordia, pedimos la luz para los espíritus necesitados...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Tomados de las manos en santa cadena de union...
oraciones.textoTraducido: United in a fraternal chain of thought and love, we pray to the Great Creator and the protective guides to shed light and elevation on the souls that transit towards the spiritual world, dispelling the turmoil and bringing peace and tranquility to the living and the disembodied.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer for the Fraternidad and the Razón Iluminada (Sociedad Constancia - Argentina)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Dios de bondad, ilumina la razón humana para que la ciencia y la espiritualidad caminen juntas...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Dios de bondad, ilumina la razon humana...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, guide good men and women so that science, philosophy and evangelical morality are united for the benefit of suffering humanity, eradicating ignorance, fanaticism and pain through knowledge of the eternal laws of the spirit.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Pursuit of God and Service (Edgar Cayce - A.R.E. / Virginia Beach)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Lord, make me a channel of Thy blessings today, that wherever I go, someone may be lifted up and inspired by Thy love...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Lord, make me a channel of Thy blessings today...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord, make me a channel of your blessings on this day. May wherever I go, someone find comfort, encouragement and faith because of your presence in me. I surrender my mind and my heart to your Divine Spirit to be an instrument of healing and peace.

oraciones.titulo: The Gospel according to Spiritism – Prayer for Enemies and those who Slander us
oraciones.textoOriginal: Dieu Tout-Puissant, daigne envoyer de bons Esprits pour nous secourir, éclairer notre route et fortifier notre âme. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Dyeu Tu-Pwi-sã, dên-ye ãn-vwa-yé de bõz Es-prí pur nu se-ku-rír, e-kle-ré no-tre rut e for-ti-fyé no-tre am. A-mên.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Father of Infinite Goodness, Wisdom, and Mercy! In deep spiritual elevation, we lift our prayer for The Gospel according to Spiritism. We pray to the good spirits and our guardian angel to assist us with their beneficent light, dispel all turmoil from the soul, and grant us patience, resignation, and love to progress along the path of goodness. May the peace of God rest upon us. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: El Chant of the Caña and el Anhelo of the Amado (Jalal al-Din Muhammad Rumi)
oraciones.textoOriginal: بشنو این نی چون شکایت می‌کند / از جدایی‌ها حکایت می‌کند... هر کسی کو دور ماند از اصل خویش / باز جوید روزگار وصل خویش
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Beshno in ney chon shekayat mikonad / Az jodaiha hekayat mikonad... Har kasi ku door maand az asle khish / Baaz jooyad roozgare vasle khish ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the luminous presence of the Universal Source and the Creator of all life, we align our hearts with El Chant of the Caña and el Anhelo of the Amado (Jalal al. May the light of truth, the power of unconditional love, and profound peace flood our being, guiding our thoughts and actions toward harmony, serenity, and unity with all creation. So it is and so it shall be. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Hafez of Shiraz – 'At the Inn of Silence, God Offered Me a Cup of Peace'
oraciones.textoOriginal: دوش دیدم که ملایک در میخانه زدند / گل آدم بسرشتند و به پیمانه زدند...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Doosh didam ke malayek dare mey-khaneh zadand / Gele Adam besereshtand o be peymaneh zadand...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Last night I saw the angels knocking on the doors of the human heart, kneading the clay of the soul with the living water of divine love. Oh God of infinite Grace! Fill our cup with patience, benevolence and serene joy to serve our fellow human beings with tenderness.

oraciones.titulo: The Prophet (Khalil Gibran) – On the True Nature of Prayer
oraciones.textoOriginal: Vosotros oráis en vuestra necesidad y en vuestra angustia; ojalá pudierais orar también en la plenitud de vuestra alegría...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Vosotros orais en vuestra necesidad y en vuestra angustia...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Prayer is not asking for ephemeral favors, but rather expanding the heart towards the living ether of God. When you enter the temple of silence, may your words be nothing more than the echo of gratitude for the sacred gift of existing, loving and sharing life with all creation.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer for the Unidad of the Humanidad (Bahá'u'lláh / Bahá'í)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Oh mi Dios! ¡Oh mi Dios! Une los corazones de Tus siervos y revélales Tu gran propósito. Que sigan Tus mandamientos y permanezcan en Tu ley...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: ¡Oh mi Dios! ¡Oh mi Dios! Une los corazones de Tus siervos...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O gracious God! You have created all humanity from the same original lineage and have decreed that they all belong to the same cosmic family. Gather all peoples under the canopy of harmony, dissolve the prejudices of race, creed and nation, and make the earth as one home radiant with peace.

oraciones.titulo: Ashem Vohu & Ahuna Vairya (Avesta - Zoroastrianism) – Good Thoughts, Words and Actions
oraciones.textoOriginal: Aṣ̌əm vohū vahištəm astī, uštā astī, uštā ahmāi hyat aṣ̌āi vahištāi aṣ̌əm. Humata, Hukhta, Hvarshta.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ashem Vohu Vahishtam asti, Ushta asti, Ushta ahmai hyat ashai vahishtai ashem | Humata, Hukhta, Hvarshta ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: Righteousness and Truth (Asha) are the supreme good and perfect bliss. Blessed is he who chooses righteousness for the love of truth itself. We consecrate our lives to the three eternal pillars: Good Thoughts (Humata), Good Words (Hukhta) and Good Actions (Hvarshta).

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of the No-Violencia (Ahimsa) and the Verdad (Mahatma Gandhi)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Señor, concédeme el valor de no temer a nadie, la paciencia para responder con amor al odio y la fuerza para luchar por la justicia sin rencor...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Senor, concedeme el valor de no temer a nadie...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the luminous presence of the Universal Source and the Creator of all life, we align our hearts with Prayer of the No. May the light of truth, the power of unconditional love, and profound peace flood our being, guiding our thoughts and actions toward harmony, serenity, and unity with all creation. So it is and so it shall be. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Gitanjali (Rabindranath Tagore) – 'Where the Mind is Free from Fear'
oraciones.textoOriginal: Where the mind is without fear and the head is held high; Where knowledge is free; Where the world has not been broken up into fragments by narrow domestic walls...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Where the mind is without fear and the head is held high...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Where the mind is fearless and the head stands high; where knowledge is free; where the world has not been broken into fragments by narrow domestic walls; where words come from the depth of truth; where tireless effort stretches its arms towards perfection: in that heaven of freedom, my Father, awaken my country and my soul!

oraciones.titulo: Prayer for Universal Concord of Religions (Swami Vivekananda - Chicago 1893)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Como los diferentes ríos que tienen sus fuentes en diferentes lugares todos se mezclan en el océano, así, ¡oh Señor!, los diferentes caminos de fe conducen a Ti...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Como los diferentes rios que tienen sus fuentes en diferentes lugares...
oraciones.textoTraducido: May all flags of intolerance and sectarian hatred fall forever. May human beings recognize that above temples, rites and doctrines the same God of Love shines, and that true worship is active compassion towards all living beings.

oraciones.titulo: Tao Te Ching (Lao Tzu) – The Wisdom of the Agua and the No-Acción Serena (Wu Wei)
oraciones.textoOriginal: 上善若水。水善利萬物而不爭，處眾人之所惡，故幾於道。
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Shang shan ruo shui. Shui shan li wan wu er bu zheng, chu zhong ren zhi suo e, gu ji yu Dao ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the luminous presence of the Universal Source and the Creator of all life, we align our hearts with Tao Te Ching (Lao Tzu). May the light of truth, the power of unconditional love, and profound peace flood our being, guiding our thoughts and actions toward harmony, serenity, and unity with all creation. So it is and so it shall be. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: The Analects of Confucius – Supreme Benevolence (Ren) and Inner Righteousness
oraciones.textoOriginal: 己所不欲，勿施於人。德不孤，必有鄰。
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ji suo bu yu, wu shi yu ren. De bu gu, bi you lin ||
oraciones.textoTraducido: What you do not wish for yourself, do not do to others. Virtue never walks alone; She always finds like hearts that accompany her. Let us cultivate benevolence, sincerity in friendship, respect for elders and harmony in the human community.

oraciones.titulo: Norito Shintoísta of Purificación and Gratitude a the Naturaleza (Misogi / Kami)
oraciones.textoOriginal: 祓へ給へ 清め給へ 守り給へ 幸へ給へ。高天原に神留り坐す...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Harae tamae, kiyome tamae, mamori tamae, sakihae tamae. Takaama-hara ni kamu-zumarimasu...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Purify our hearts, remove all stains and shadows, protect us and grant us happiness and harmony! We revere the sacred presence of the Great Spirit in the mountains, rivers, forests, winds and in the rising sun. May we live in grateful reverence to Mother Earth.

oraciones.titulo: Canticle of Brother Sun and the Creatures (Saint Francis of Assisi)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Altissimu, onnipotente, bon Signore, Tue so' le laude, la gloria e l'honore et onne benedictione...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Altissimu, onnipotente, bon Signore...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Most high, omnipotent, good Lord! Praise you for brother Sun who illuminates the day, for sister Moon and the clear stars in the sky, for brother Wind and the serene air, for sister Water useful and humble, for brother Fire who brightens the night and for mother Earth who sustains us and produces fruits of blessing.

oraciones.titulo: Nothing Turbes You (Saint Teresa of Ávila / Universal Mystical Poetry)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Nada te turbe, nada te espante; todo se pasa, Dios no se muda. La paciencia todo lo alcanza; quien a Dios tiene nada le falta: ¡Sólo Dios basta!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Nada te turbe, nada te espante...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Nothing disturbs you, nothing frightens you; everything passes, God does not change. Patience achieves everything; He who has nothing lacks God: Only God is enough! In the center of the soul lives the castle of peace where no wind of this world can disturb the infinite calm.

oraciones.titulo: Canticle to the Green Force of Life / Viriditas (Saint Hildegard of Bingen)
oraciones.textoOriginal: O nobilissima viriditas, quae radicas in sole et quae in candida serenitate liques in rota...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O nobilissima viriditas, quae radicas in sole...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh most noble green vital force (Viriditas), who have your roots in the divine light and flow in the wheel of the cosmos! Breathe your healing vigor into us, regenerate tired bodies and fill our thoughts with spiritual freshness.

oraciones.titulo: Gratitude Matutina and Fortaleza Interior (Marco Aurelio - Meditaciones)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Al amanecer, dite a ti mismo: hoy me encontraré con personas difíciles, ingratas o precipitadas; pero nada de eso puede dañarme porque participamos de la misma naturaleza divina...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Al amanecer, dite a ti mismo: hoy me encontrare...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I accept with serene dignity everything that destiny brings my way. I will act justly, speak truthfully and treat my fellow men as members of a single cosmic body, knowing that the peace of the soul lies in governing one's own mind and doing good without expecting applause.

oraciones.titulo: The Immanent Presence of Divinity in Nature (Baruch Spinoza)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Dios no es un juez lejano, sino la Substancia Infinita y Viviente en la cual vivimos, nos movemos y existimos...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Dios no es un juez lejano, sino la Substancia Infinita...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I recognize the sacred presence of God in every blade of grass, in the course of the stars and in the beating of the human heart. By freeing myself from fear and superstition, I find supreme bliss in understanding the harmonious order of the universe and cultivating intellectual love for Life.

oraciones.titulo: Chant of the Belleza / Hózhó (Tradición Indígena Navajo - Diné)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Con belleza delante de mí, camino. Con belleza detrás de mí, camino. Con belleza arriba de mí, camino. Con belleza abajo de mí, camino. Con belleza a mi alrededor, camino. ¡En la belleza se ha completado todo!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Con belleza delante de mi, camino...
oraciones.textoTraducido: May my steps dance in harmony with the earth, the valleys and the skies. May my eyes contemplate the sacred in each being and may my voice sing the song of reconciliation and peace. Hózhóoji, everything is beauty and harmony!

oraciones.titulo: Lakota Prayer – 'Mitákuye Oyásin' (We Are All Cosmic Kin)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Mitákuye Oyásin! Wakan Tanka, Gran Espíritu: te damos gracias por el aire que respiramos, por el fuego que calienta, por el agua que fecunda y por la tierra que nos sostiene...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Mitakuye Oyasin! Wakan Tanka, Gran Espiritu...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Great Spirit Wakan Tanka! Help us to remember that the quadrupeds, the birds of the sky, the beings of the water and the trees are our sacred brothers in the circle of life. May we walk with respect and reverence on the face of the earth.

oraciones.titulo: Message from Chief Seattle – 'The Earth Does Not Belong to Man, Man Belongs to the Earth'
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¿Cómo se puede comprar o vender el calor de la tierra o el brillo del agua? El aire es precioso para nosotros, pues todas las cosas comparten el mismo aliento...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: ¿Como se puede comprar o vender el calor de la tierra?...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Father Creator, teach us to care for the earth as a kind mother. What happens to the earth will happen to the children of the earth. May we preserve clean rivers, lush forests and clear air for generations to come.

oraciones.titulo: The Sobre-Alma / The Over-Soul (Ralph Waldo Emerson - Transcendentalism)
oraciones.textoOriginal: En el silencio del bosque o bajo el cielo estrellado, el hombre se convierte en un ojo transparente: no soy nada, lo veo todo; las corrientes del Ser Universal circulan a través de mí...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: En el silencio del bosque o bajo el cielo estrellado...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I recognize that within each human being beats the same Supreme Intelligence that sustains the galaxies. By silencing the noise of selfishness, the soul is elevated to its divine dignity, living in communion with Truth, Beauty and eternal Goodness.

oraciones.titulo: Walden (Henry David Thoreau) – 'I Went to the Woods to Live Deliberately'
oraciones.textoOriginal: Fui a los bosques porque deseaba vivir deliberadamente, enfrentar sólo los hechos esenciales de la vida y ver si no podía aprender lo que ella tenía para enseñar...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Fui a los bosques porque deseaba vivir deliberadamente...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Teach me, Lord of Silence, the value of a simple life, free from excessive desire and empty consumption. May I learn to value the serenity of a clean morning, the honest work of my hands and the unbreakable peace of a sober heart.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer for the Justice, the Love Ágape and the Comunidad Amada (Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Padre nuestro, concédenos la fuerza para derribar los muros del odio con la fuerza del amor desinteresado (Ágape)...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Padre nuestro, concedenos la fuerza para derribar los muros del odio...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord God of Justice! Do not allow us to fall into the bitterness of revenge. Give us the faith to believe that the arc of the moral universe is long, but it bends inexorably toward justice. Help us build the 'Beloved Community' where all God's children sit at the table of brotherhood.

oraciones.titulo: Farid al-Din Attar – The Journey of the Seven Valleys to the Inner Simurgh
oraciones.textoOriginal: En la presencia luminosa del Creador y de la Fuente Infinita de la Vida, el Amor y la Consciencia Universal.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [En la pre-sén-cia lu-mi-nó-sa de la Fwén-te U-ni-ver-sál y del Kre-a-dór de tó-da vi-da, el A-mór y la Kons-sién-cia U-ni-ver-sál... A-mén.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the luminous presence of the Universal Source and the Creator of all life, we align our hearts with Farid al. May the light of truth, the power of unconditional love, and profound peace flood our being, guiding our thoughts and actions toward harmony, serenity, and unity with all creation. So it is and so it shall be. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Ibn Arabi – 'My Heart Has Become Capable of All Forms: the Religion of Love'
oraciones.textoOriginal: En la presencia luminosa del Creador y de la Fuente Infinita de la Vida, el Amor y la Consciencia Universal.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [En la pre-sén-cia lu-mi-nó-sa de la Fwén-te U-ni-ver-sál y del Kre-a-dór de tó-da vi-da, el A-mór y la Kons-sién-cia U-ni-ver-sál... A-mén.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the luminous presence of the Universal Source and the Creator of all life, we align our hearts with Ibn Arabi. May the light of truth, the power of unconditional love, and profound peace flood our being, guiding our thoughts and actions toward harmony, serenity, and unity with all creation. So it is and so it shall be. Amen.

oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Dyeu Tu-Pwi-sã, dên-ye ãn-vwa-yé de bõz Es-prí pur nu se-ku-rír, e-kle-ré no-tre rut e for-ti-fyé no-tre am. A-mên.]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Father of Infinite Goodness, Wisdom, and Mercy! In deep spiritual elevation, we lift our prayer for The Lord's Prayer Commented by the Spirit Emmanuel (Chico Xavier). May the peace of God rest upon us. Amen.
