oraciones.titulo: Prayer for the Fraternidad and the Justice (Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.)
oraciones.textoOriginal: O God, our Creator: make us instruments of thy peace. Where there is hatred, let us sow love; where there is injury, pardon. We pray for that day when all your children will join hands and sing the songs of freedom, when justice will roll down like waters and righteousness like a mighty stream. Break the chains of prejudice and grant us the courage to stand up for the truth in love. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O God, awr Kri-ey-tor: meyk as in-stru-ments of day pis... Let jas-tis rol dawn layk wa-ters... Ey-men.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Creator God! Make us instruments of your peace. May justice flow like crystal clear waters and righteousness like an inexhaustible river. Break the chains of prejudice and grant us the courage to defend human dignity with love and without violence. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Piano Gospel suave y coro afroamericano cantando himnos de libertad

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Abandono and Confianza (Saint Elizabeth Ann Seton)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Hazard what may, come what will, may the most high, the most holy, the most just and amiable Will of God be in all things fulfilled, praised, and magnified forever. O Lord, keep me in your presence, bless my family and grant me grace to meet your will with love and peace. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ha-zard wat mey, kam wat wil, mey di most hay, di most ho-li, di most jast Wil of God bi ful-fil-d... Ey-men.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Whatever happens, whatever comes, let the most holy, most just and most kind Will of God be fulfilled, praised and exalted forever in all things. Keep me in your presence, Lord, and grant me peace in all circumstances. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Campanas de Emmitsburg y melodía suave de cuerdas

oraciones.titulo: Mother Cabrini's Prayer for Immigrants and Walkers
oraciones.textoOriginal: O Sacred Heart of Jesus, in you I place all my trust. Saint Frances Xavier Cabrini, you who crossed oceans to embrace the poor, the migrant and the forgotten: look with tender care upon those who leave their homeland in search of bread and dignity. Protect them from all danger, soften the hearts of the nations and unite our families in the peace of Christ. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O Sey-kred Hart of Dji-zas, in yu Ay pleys ol may trast... Seynt Fran-ses Zey-vier Ka-bri-ni... Ey-men.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy Mother Cabrini, missionary heart and protector of migrants: accompanies the steps of those who leave their homeland in search of dignity and bread. Protect their paths, open doors of compassion and keep our families together. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Chiming bells of Chicago/Nueva York y violín suave

oraciones.titulo: Come, Come, Ye Saints (Song and Consolation of the Pioneer)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Come, come, ye Saints, no toil nor labor fear; but with joy wend your way. Though hard to you this journey may appear, grace shall be as your day. 'Tis better far for us to strive our useless cares from us to drive; do this, and joy your hearts will swell: All is well! All is well! Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Kam, kam, yi Seynts, no toyl nor ley-bor fir; bat wid joy wend yor wey... Ol is wel! Ol is wel! Ey-men.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Saints, come!, without fear or dread; with advanced value. Although the work is heavy, the grace of God will be enough for you. Forget vain sorrows and trust in the divine promise. Everything's fine! Everything's fine! Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Coro del Tabernáculo de Salt Lake y viento de las llanuras

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Saint André Bessette (Montreal Saint Joseph Oratory)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Saint Frère André, humble portier de Dieu qui avez dirigé tant de malades et d'affligés vers le cœur de saint Joseph: priez pour nous. Obtenez-nous la guérison du corps et la paix de l'âme. Avec l'huile de saint Joseph, oignez nos blessures, ranimez notre foi et apprenez-nous à aimer Dieu dans la simplicité et le service de nos frères. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Sen Frer An-dre, öm-ble por-tye de Dyeu ki a-ve di-ri-je tan de ma-lad... pri-ye pur nu]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Saint Brother Andrew, humble porter of God and apostle of Saint Joseph: intercede for the sick and helpless. Reach us from Saint Joseph health, relief from pain and the grace to always trust in divine Providence. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Gran carillón del Oratorio de San José de Montreal y órgano majestuoso

oraciones.titulo: Supplication to Saint Anne of Beaupré (The Good Saint Anne)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Bonne Sainte Anne, mère de la Vierge Marie et grand-mère de Jésus: vous qui accueillez depuis des siècles les marins naufragés et les malades guéris sur les rives du Saint-Laurent: regardez ma peine. Posez votre main bienfaisante sur ma famille, obtenez-moi la santé de l'âme et du corps et enseignez-moi la fidélité de l'Évangile. Amen.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Bon Sent An, mer de la Virzh Ma-ri e gran-mer de Je-zü]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Good Saint Anne of Beaupré, grandmother of Jesus and patron saint of families: help our weaknesses, heal our illnesses and protect our homes with your maternal goodness. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Campanas de Sainte-Anne-de-Beaupré y sonido del Río San Lorenzo

oraciones.titulo: The Huron Carol (Ieshous Ahatonnia - Saint John of Brébeuf)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Estennialon de tsonwe Ieshous ahatonnia. 'Twas in the moon of wintertime when all the birds were stilled, the great Spirit Gitchi Manitou sent angel choirs on high. In a lodge of broken bark the tender Babe was found, a ragged robe of rabbit skin enwrapped His beauty round. Jesus your King is born, Jesus is born: In excelsis gloria!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Es-ten-nia-lon de tson-we Ie-shous a-ha-ton-nia... Gi-tchi Ma-ni-tou sent eyn-jel kwayrs on hay... In ek-sel-sis glo-ria!
oraciones.textoTraducido: On the winter moon, when all the birds were silent, the Great Spirit (Gitchi Manitou) sent choirs of angels. In a humble birch bark hut they found the tender Child, wrapped in rabbit skins. Jesus, your Great Chief and Savior, has been born! Glory in the heights. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Tambor suave de corteza de abedul, flauta nativa y viento de la nieve canadiense

oraciones.titulo: The Seven Sacred Teachings of the Grandfathers (Anishinaabe)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Gichi-Manidoo: Grant that I walk with Love (Zaagi'idiwin), Respect (Minaadendimowin), Courage (Aakode'ewin), Honesty (Gwekwaadiziwin), Wisdom (Nibwaakaawin), Humility (Dabaadendiziwin), and Truth (Debwewin). May these Seven Sacred Teachings guide every breath, every word, and every deed in harmony with Mother Earth and all Creation. Miigwech.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Gi-chi Ma-ni-doo: Zaa-gi-i-di-win, Mi-naa-den-di-mo-win, Aa-ko-de-e-win, Gwe-kwaa-di-zi-win... Mii-gwech.
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the luminous presence of the Universal Source and the Creator of all life, we align our hearts with The Seven Sacred Teachings of the Grandfathers (Anishinaabe). May the light of truth, the power of unconditional love, and profound peace flood our being, guiding our thoughts and actions toward harmony, serenity, and unity with all creation. So it is and so it shall be. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Tambor de mano Anishinaabe, aroma de hierba dulce y canto del bosque de coníferas

oraciones.titulo: Missionary Prayer of Saint Junípero Serra (Always Forward!)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Siempre adelante, nunca atrás! Señor Dios, que me llamaste a plantar la cruz del amor en estas costas... Amén.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [¡Siempre adelante, nunca atrás! Señor Dios, q]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Through the intercession of Saint Junípero Serra (Always Forward!), may peace, reconciliation, and divine guidance descend upon our lives and communities. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Purity and Love to the Cross of Saint Kateri Tekakwitha
oraciones.textoOriginal: Jesus, Mary, I love you! I offer you my heart and my body, pure and holy, as a living sacrifice on the holy cross... Amén.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Jesus, Mary, I love you! I offer you my heart]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Through the blessing of this sacred song (Prayer of Purity and Love to the Cross of Saint Kateri Tekakwitha), may peace, reconciliation and divine guidance descend upon our lives and people. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer for the Protection of Families and Orphans
oraciones.textoOriginal: God, our Father, protector of the poor and defender of the widow and orphan: bless our families with unity and charity... Amén.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [God, our Father, protector of the poor and de]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Through the blessing of this sacred song (Prayer for the Protection of Families and Orphans), may peace, reconciliation and divine guidance descend upon our lives and people. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: The Prayer of Jabes (Blessing and Ensanchamiento of Territorio)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¡Oh, si me dieras bendición y ensancharas mi territorio, y si tu mano estuviera conmigo y me libraras del mal...! Amén.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [¡Oh, si me dieras bendición y ensancharas mi]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Through the blessing of this sacred song (The Prayer of Jabez (Blessing and Enlargement of Territory)), may peace, reconciliation and divine guidance descend upon our lives and people. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Supplication to Our Lady of the Cape (Queen of the Holy Rosary)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Notre-Dame-du-Cap, Reine du Très Saint Rosaire: écoutez notre prière, protégez nos familles et faites briller la foi au Canada... Amén.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Notre-Dame-du-Cap, Reine du Très Saint Rosair]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Through the blessing of this sacred song (Supplication to Our Lady of the Cape (Queen of the Holy Rosary)), may peace, reconciliation and divine guidance descend upon our lives and people. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Heroic Surrender of the Holy Canadian Martyrs
oraciones.textoOriginal: Seigneur Jésus, vous m'avez racheté par votre précieux Sang: que je souffre pour vous et que je meure pour vous... Amén.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Seigneur Jésus, vous m'avez racheté par votre]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Through the blessing of this sacred song (Prayer of Heroic Surrender of the Holy Canadian Martyrs), may peace, reconciliation and divine guidance descend upon our lives and people. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: A New Creed (Prayer of Fe, Confianza and Reconciliación Canadiense)
oraciones.textoOriginal: We are not alone, we live in God's world. We believe in God: who has created and is creating, who has come in Jesus... We trust in God. Amen. Amén.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [We are not alone, we live in God's world. We]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Through the blessing of this sacred song (A New Creed (Canadian Prayer of Faith, Trust and Reconciliation)), may peace, reconciliation and divine guidance descend upon our lives and people. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Qulliq Lighting Prayer (Gratitude for Arctic Light and Heat)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Quana Giti Manitou. We light this qulliq with gratitude for the flame that warms our igloo, the light that guides our elders and the return of the sun... Amén.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: [Quana Giti Manitou. We light this qulliq with]
oraciones.textoTraducido: Through the blessing of this sacred song (Prayer of the Ignition of the Qulliq (Gratitude for Light and Arctic Heat)), may peace, reconciliation and divine guidance descend upon our lives and people. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer for Peace and Fraternity of the Peoples of North America 01
oraciones.textoOriginal: Lord God of all nations, bless our lands with justice, heal our divisions and guide our steps in love and truth. (Plegaria Norteamericana 01)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Lord God of ol ney-shons, bles awr lends wid jas-tis... Ey-men.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord God of all nations: bless our lands with justice, heal our divisions and guide our steps in love and brotherhood. Amen.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Gregory of Narek: Elegy III - Sighs from the heart to the Physician of Souls
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ընկալ քաղցրութեամբ, Տէր Աստուած հզօր, զդառնացեալիս զաղաչանս. մատիր գթութեամբ առ պատկառեալս դիմօք: (Yngal kaghtsrutyamp, Der Asdvadz hzor, zkarnatsyalis zaghatshans...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Yngal kaght-srut-yamp, Der Asdvadz jzor, zkarnat-syalis zaghat-shans. Matir ktut-yamp ar bat-karyals timok...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Sweetly welcome, Lord God almighty, the bitter supplications of my contrite heart. Approach with pity those who appear with an embarrassed face. Dispel, oh infinite Goodness, the shameful sadness that oppresses me; Take away from me, oh Merciful One, the unbearable weight of my guilt. You who are the only Physician of souls, heal the invisible wounds of my spirit.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Duduk armenio tradicional y campanas de monasterio en las montañas

oraciones.titulo: Saint Gregory of Narek: Elegy XII - Confidence in Supreme Mercy
oraciones.textoOriginal: Արդ, մատուցանեմ զաղօթս ի խորոց սրտիս առ քեզ, ո՜վ ամենագութ Փրկիչ, որ ոչ կամիս զմահ մեղաւորին, այլ զդառնալ նորա եւ զկեալ: (Art, madutsanem zaghot-s i khorots srdits ar kez...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Art, madut-sanem zaghots i jo-rots sr-dits ar kez, ov a-me-na-gut Pr-kich...
oraciones.textoTraducido: From the depths of my heart I raise my cry to You, O Savior full of compassion, who does not desire the death of the sinner, but that he convert and live. Although my faults exceed the sand of the seas, a single drop of the dew of your grace is enough to purify my entire being. I trust in You and in your mantle I take refuge.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Duduk armenio y coro litúrgico armenio suave

oraciones.titulo: Saint Gregory of Narek: Elegy XXV - Invocation to the Uncreated Light
oraciones.textoOriginal: Լոյս ճշմարիտ, ծագումն անստուեր, ճառագայթ փառաց Հօր, Յիսուս Քրիստոս: (Luys tshshmarid, dzakumn ansdver, dzarakayt parats Hor...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Luys tshsh-ma-rid, dza-gumn an-sdver, dza-ra-gayt pa-rats Jor, Yi-sus Kris-dos...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh true Light, dawn without setting, radiance of the glory of the Father, Jesus Christ! Illuminate the darkness of my mind with the ray of your understanding. May your divine fire consume the weeds of my vanities and light in my chest the pure flame of love that never goes out.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Cantos litúrgicos de la Iglesia Apostólica Armenia

oraciones.titulo: Saint Gregory of Narek: Elegy XLI - Plea for Healing of Inner Wounds
oraciones.textoOriginal: Տէր բարերար, բժիշկ հոգւոց եւ մարմնոց, Քեզ է փառք եւ կարողութիւն յաւիտեանս: (Der parerar, pzhishk hokvots yev marmnots...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Der ba-re-rar, bzhishk hok-vots yev marm-nots, Kez e park yev ka-rogh-ut-yun ya-vid-yans...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Benefactor Lord, Heavenly Physician of souls and bodies: do not despise the supplication of the sick person who turns to You. Extend your sovereign hand over the wounded parts of my spirit; uproot the root of bitterness, restore the vigor of hope and make the health of your peace flourish in every corner of my being.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Duduk armenio solemne e incienso quemándose en silencio

oraciones.titulo: Saint Gregory of Narek: Elegy LXX - Offering of the Redemptive Blood and Peace
oraciones.textoOriginal: Մատուցանի զոհն անմահական յօրինակ կենաց եւ փրկութեան: (Madutsani zohn anmahakan yorinak genats yev prgutyan...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ma-dut-sa-ni zohn an-ma-ha-kan yo-ri-nak ge-nats yev pr-gut-yan...
oraciones.textoTraducido: The immortal Victim is offered for the life and salvation of the world. By the infinite merits of your most sacred Passion, grant me the stillness of conscience, the irrevocable forgiveness of my errors and the grace to walk in your holy justice every day of my pilgrimage.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Mesrop Mashtots: Prayer of Wisdom and Praise of the Creator of the Word
oraciones.textoOriginal: Տէր, որ ետուր զիմաստութիւն եւ զգիտութիւն, բաց զշրթունս մեր առ ի փառաբանել զանուն քո սուրբ: (Der, vor yedur zimastutyun yev zkidutyun...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Der, vor ye-dur zi-mas-tut-yun yev zki-dut-yun, bats zshrt-uns mer ar i pa-ra-ba-nel za-nun ko surp...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the Living God! Through the intercession of the Most Holy Theotokos and the blessed memory and help of Saint Mesrop Mashtots: Prayer of Wisdom and Praise of the Creator of the Word, pour out Your Holy Spirit upon our life. Purify our mind in the stillness of prayer, grant us health, patience and forgiveness of sins, and guide us to the eternal peace of Your heavenly Kingdom. Amen!

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Duduk armenio y lectura solemne de escrituras

oraciones.titulo: Armenian Sharakan: Hymn of the Light of the Holy See of Etchmiadzin
oraciones.textoOriginal: Էջ Միածինն ի Հօրէ եւ լոյս փառաց ընդ նմա. Ձայնք հնչեցին սանդարամետք երկրի: (Etsch Miadzinn i Hore yev luys parats ynt nma...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Etch Mi-ad-zinn i Jo-re yev luys pa-rats ynt n-ma. Dzaynk hn-che-tsin san-da-ra-metk yer-kri...
oraciones.textoTraducido: The Only Begotten of the Father descended and the light of glory with Him. Divine voices resounded in the sacred land. O people of believers, come and build the holy altar of light, for Christ has illuminated his people forever!

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Campanas catedralicias de Echmiadzin y coro polifónico

oraciones.titulo: Saint Nerses Shnorhali: 'With Faith I Confess' (Havadov Khosdovanim)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Հաւատով խոստովանիմ եւ երկիր պագանեմ քեզ, Հայր եւ Որդի եւ Սուրբ Հոգի: (Havadov khosdovanim yev yergir paganem kez...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ja-va-dov jos-do-va-nim yev yer-gir ba-ga-nem kez, Jayr yev Vor-ti yev Surp Jo-ki...
oraciones.textoTraducido: With faith I confess and adore before You, Father, Son and Holy Spirit, uncreated and immortal nature, Creator of angels, men and everything visible and invisible: have mercy on your creatures and forgive my countless sins.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Antonio Abad: Prayer for Spiritual Victory in the Nitria Desert
oraciones.textoOriginal: ⲠϭⲟⲒⲤ ⲒⲎⲤⲞⲨⲤ ⲠⲬⲢⲒⲤⲦⲞⲤ, ⲀⲢⲒⲞⲨⲒ ⲚⲞⲨⲚⲀⲒ ⲚⲈⲘⲎⲒ ⲀⲨⲰ ⲘⲠⲢⲬⲀⲦ ⲚⲤⲰⲔ: (Pchois Isous Pi-Khristos, ari-ou-nai nemi auw mper-kat n-sok...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: P-chois I-sus Pi-Jris-tos, a-ri-u-nai ne-mi a-uo m-per-kat n-sok...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the living God! Have mercy on me and do not forsake me in the hour of combat. May the sign of your Holy Cross dissipate every enemy shadow, may your peace dwell in my cell and may my heart remain fixed only in your heavenly love.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Cantos coptos antiguos con címbalos sagrados metálicos

oraciones.titulo: Saint Pachomius: Prayer of Charity and Cenobitic Community Life
oraciones.textoOriginal: ϨⲒⲚⲀ ⲚⲦⲈⲚϢⲰⲠⲒ ⲈⲨⲞⲨⲀⲒ ϦⲈⲚ ⲠⲒⲀⲄⲀⲠⲎ ⲚⲦⲈ ⲠⲬⲢⲒⲤⲦⲞⲤ: (Hina nten-shopi ev-ouai khen pi-agape nte Pi-Khristos...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ji-na n-ten-sho-pi ev-u-ai jen pi-a-ga-pe n-te Pi-Jris-tos...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Good Master, grant us to live in one heart and one soul under the perfect law of your love. Remove from us all murmuring, envy and selfishness; Teach us to bear with patience the burdens of our brothers and to serve with holy joy in your vineyard.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Vocalizaciones monásticas coptas del desierto egipcio

oraciones.titulo: Coptic Divine Liturgy of Saint Basil: Prayer of Reconciliation and Sacred Peace
oraciones.textoOriginal: ⲞⲨⲞⲚ ⲚⲒⲂⲈⲚ ⲈⲦϬⲞⲤⲒ ⲚⲦⲈ ⲦⲈⲔϨⲒⲢⲎⲚⲎ ⲘⲀⲦⲞⲨⲤ ⲚⲀⲚ: (Ouvon niben et-chosi nte tek-hirene matous nan...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: U-von ni-ben et-cho-si n-te tek-ji-re-ne ma-tus nan...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Great and Eternal God, who formed man in incorruptibility and destroyed death through the saving advent of your Son Jesus Christ: fill our hearts with your heavenly peace, cleanse us of all resentment and grant us to greet each other with the holy kiss of reconciliation.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Címbalos coptos y triángulo sagrado litúrgico

oraciones.titulo: Millennial Coptic Blessing of the Waters of the Nile River and the Harvest
oraciones.textoOriginal: ⲀⲢⲒϨⲘⲞⲦ ⲠϭⲞⲒⲤ ⲚⲚⲒⲘⲰⲞⲨ ⲚⲦⲈ ⲠⲒⲒⲈⲢⲞ ϦⲈⲚ ⲦⲞⲨⲘⲈⲦⲢⲰϢ: (Ari-hmot Pchois n-ni-moou nte pi-iero khen tou-met-rosh...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: A-ri-jmot P-chois n-ni-mo-u n-te pi-ie-ro jen tu-met-rosh...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Deign, Lord our God, to bless the currents of the waters and the rivers according to their just measure. Grant abundance to the fields, fertility to the earth and dew of blessing from heaven, so that you may satisfy the needy with bread and rejoice the heart of every living creature.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Sonido suave del agua del río y címbalos coptos lejanos

oraciones.titulo: Coptic Theotokia: Hymn to the Holy Virgin Mary Mother of Mercy
oraciones.textoOriginal: ⲦⲈⲚϬⲞⲤⲒ ⲈⲢⲞ ϦⲈⲚ ⲞⲨⲘⲈⲐⲘⲎⲒ Ⲱ ϮⲠⲀⲢⲐⲈⲚⲞⲤ ⲘⲀⲢⲒⲀ ϮⲐⲈⲞⲦⲞⲔՈՍ: (Ten-chosi ero khen ou-methmi o ti-parthenos Maria...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ten-cho-si e-ro jen u-met-mi o ti-par-te-nos Ma-ri-a ti-Te-o-to-kos...
oraciones.textoTraducido: We truly exalt you, oh Virgin Mary, Holy Mother of God!, bush that burned in Sinai without being consumed, ark of the holy alliance and unbreakable refuge of our souls. Intercede incessantly with your beloved Son for the comfort and salvation of the entire world.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Canto solemne mariano en copto con triángulo sagrado

oraciones.titulo: Saint Shenouda the Archimandrite: Supplication for the Helpless and Righteousness
oraciones.textoOriginal: ⲀⲢⲒⲠⲘⲈⲨⲒ ⲠϭⲞⲒⲤ ⲚⲚⲒϨⲎⲔⲒ ⲚⲈⲘ ⲚⲒⲈⲂⲒⲀⲒⲞⲨ: (Ari-p-mevi Pchois n-ni-heki nem ni-ebiaiov...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: A-ri-p-me-vi P-chois n-ni-je-ki nem ni-e-bi-ai-ov...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Remember, sovereign Lord, the poor, the orphans and the oppressed. Break the yoke of injustice and grant strength to those who suffer in silence. Give us the courage to defend the truth with righteousness and to consecrate our lives to the relief of our helpless brother.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Bell of monasterio del desierto y viento suave

oraciones.titulo: Saint Nino of Georgia: Prayer of the Cross of Sarmientos and Enlightenment
oraciones.textoOriginal: წმიდაო ნინო, ემსგავსე რა მოციქულთა და მქადაგებელ ექმენ ქართველთა ერსა: (Tsmidao Nino, emsgavse ra motsikul-ta...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ts-mi-da-o Ni-no, em-sgav-se ra mot-si-kul-ta yev m-ka-da-ge-bel ek-men kar-tvel-ta er-sa...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Holy Nino, equal to the Apostles and Illuminator of the land of Georgia! With the Holy Cross of branches intertwined with your own hair, you planted the unconquered faith of Christ in our mountains. Pray for us that we may be preserved in the fidelity of the Gospel and in spiritual strength.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Polifonía sacra georgiana tradicional a capela

oraciones.titulo: Panagia Portaitissa: Prayer to the Guardian of the Gate of Iveron
oraciones.textoOriginal: გიხაროდენ, კეთილმოღვაწეო მეკარეო, მორწმუნეთა ზეციურთა ბჭეთა განმღებელო: (Gikharoden, ketil-moghvatseo mekareo...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Gi-ja-ro-den, ke-til-mogh-vat-se-o me-ka-re-o, morts-mu-ne-ta ze-tsi-ur-ta bche-ta gan-mghe-be-lo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Rejoice, oh Holy Guardian of the Door! You keep watch night and day over your people and open the doors of the Celestial Kingdom for the faithful. Protect our homes against every storm visible and invisible, and guide our steps towards the safe harbor of salvation.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Polifonía sacra georgiana y campanas profundas de monte

oraciones.titulo: Saint David of Gareja: Prayer of Penance and Peace in the Desert Rocks
oraciones.textoOriginal: უფალო იესო ქრისტე, შემიწყალე მე ცოდვილი და დაიცევ სავანე ესე: (Upalo Ieso Kriste, shemitsqale me tsodvili...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: U-pa-lo I-e-so Kris-te, she-mits-qa-le me tsod-vi-li da da-i-tsev sa-va-ne e-se...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus Christ, have mercy on me and bless this wilderness of prayer. May the silence of these stones be testimony to the perpetual adoration of your Name, and may the spring of your grace quench the eternal thirst of our pilgrim souls.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Viento en las estepas del Cáucaso y Monastic chant solitario

oraciones.titulo: Shen Khar Venakhi ('You are the Vine'): Sacred Hymn of Georgia
oraciones.textoOriginal: შენ ხარ ვენახი, ახლად აყვავებული, მორჩი კეთილი, ედემში დანერგული: (Shen khar venakhi, akhlad aqvavebuli...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Shen jar ve-na-ji, aj-lad aq-va-ve-bu-li, mor-chi ke-ti-li, e-dem-shi da-ner-gu-li...
oraciones.textoTraducido: You are the newly blossomed Vine, a noble branch planted in Eden. You are the fragrant poplar of paradise, resplendent sun and crown of glory. We sing to You with gratitude, oh Most Pure Mother!

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Polifonía sacra georgiana tradicional (Shen Khar Venakhi)

oraciones.titulo: Saint Ephrem of Syria: Holy Lent Prayer ('Lord and Owner of my life')
oraciones.textoOriginal: ܡܪܝܐ ܘܡܪܐ ܕܚܝܝ. ܪܘܚܐ ܕܒܛܠܢܘܬܐ ܘܕܚܣܡܐ ܘܕܪܚܡܬ ܫܘܠܛܢܐ ܘܕܡܡܠܠܐ ܣܪܝܩܐ ܠܐ ܬܬܠ ܠܝ: (Moryo w-moro d-hayay...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Mor-yo w-mo-ro d-ja-yay, ru-jo d-bat-lo-nu-to w-djas-mo w-dra-jmat shul-to-no w-dma-mlo sri-qo lo tet-tel li...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord and Sovereign of my life! Remove from me the spirit of laziness, discouragement, ambition for power and vain words. Grant instead to your servant a spirit of chastity, humility, patience and love. Yes, Lord and King, grant me to see my own faults and not judge my brother, because You are blessed forever and ever. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Cantos siríacos arcaicos con arpa antigua

oraciones.titulo: Saint Isaac of Nineveh: Prayer of the Merciful Heart towards All Creation
oraciones.textoOriginal: ܐܝܢܐ ܗܝ ܠܒܐ ܡܪܚܡܢܐ: ܝܩܕܢܐ ܕܠܒܐ ܥܠ ܟܠܗ̇ ܒܪܝܬܐ: (Ayda hi leba mrahmono: yaqdana d-leba al kolah brito...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ay-da ji le-ba m-raj-mo-no: yaq-da-na d-le-ba al ko-lah bri-to...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the luminous presence of the Universal Source and the Creator of all life, we align our hearts with Saint Isaac of Nineveh: Prayer of the Merciful Heart towards All Creation. May the light of truth, the power of unconditional love, and profound peace flood our being, guiding our thoughts and actions toward harmony, serenity, and unity with all creation. So it is and so it shall be. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Música siríaca instrumental suave y silencio contemplativo

oraciones.titulo: Mar Jacob of Sarug: Hymn to the Mystery of the Tree of Life and Salvation
oraciones.textoOriginal: ܒܪܝܟ ܗܘ ܕܐܬܩܢ ܩܝܣܐ ܕܚܝܐ ܒܓܘ ܥܕܬܐ: (Brik hu d-atqen qaysa d-haye b-gaw idto...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Brik ju d-at-qen qay-sa d-ja-ye b-gaw id-to...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Blessed be He who planted the tree of life in the midst of His people. Where the shadow of pain reigned, the immortal fruit of hope sprouted. May your life-giving cross be our shield along the way and our eternal joy in the coming Kingdom.

oraciones.titulo: Saint Yared of Ethiopia: Hymn of Deggwa and Heavenly Song of Glory
oraciones.textoOriginal: ሃሌ ሉያ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ሰማያዊ ፡ ወምድራዊ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ዘይነግሥ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ (Halleluya le-Egziabher semayawi wemidrawi negus...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ja-le lu-ya le-Eg-zi-ab-jer se-ma-ya-wi we-mid-ra-wi ne-gus zey-neg-es le-a-lem...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Hallelujah to the Lord, heavenly and earthly King, who reigns forever and ever! With the sacred sistrum and the drum of praise we sing to you, O Creator of light, for your mercy covers the hills and your faithfulness endures forever.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Kebero (tambor sagrado etíope) y sistros metálicos tsenatsil

oraciones.titulo: Oharai no Kotoba: Great Shinto Prayer of Universal Purification
oraciones.textoOriginal: 高天原に神留り坐す 皇親我が皇賀見の命を以て 八百万の神等を神集へに集へ給ひ... (Takamagahara ni kamu-tsumarimasu...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ta-ka-ma-ga-ha-ra ni ka-mu-tsu-ma-ri-ma-su su-me-mi-ma-ga su-me-ro-ki no mi-ko-to wo mo-chite...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the high heavens where the heavenly and earthly Kami dwell, we gather in reverent purity. May all sin, impurity, discord and shadow be washed away by the waters of the heavenly river to the depths of the sea, and there dissolved forever, leaving our spirit clean, pure and full of peace.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Bamboo flute Shakuhachi y sonido de cascada cristalina

oraciones.titulo: Norito to Amaterasu Omikami: Gratitude for Sunlight and Life
oraciones.textoOriginal: 掛けまくも畏き天照大御神の大前を拝み奉りて恐み恐みも白さく... (Kakemakumo kashikoki Amaterasu Omikami...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ka-ke-ma-ku-mo ka-shi-ko-ki A-ma-te-ra-su O-mi-ka-mi no o-o-ma-ye wo o-ga-mi-ma-tsu-ri-te...
oraciones.textoTraducido: With deep reverence before the Great Divinity Amaterasu Omikami, source of light and beneficent heat over the heavens and the earth. We thank you for illuminating our daily paths, for sustaining the order of nature and for infusing our hearts with sincerity and kindness (*Magokoro*).

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Campanillas de viento shinto Furin y rumor de bosque de cedros

oraciones.titulo: Norito a Inari Okami: Blessing of the Sustento, the Cosecha and Peace of the Home
oraciones.textoOriginal: 稲荷大神の大前を拝み奉りて、家内安全、生業繁栄を祈り申す... (Inari Okami no oomae wo ogamimatsurite...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: I-na-ri O-ka-mi no o-o-ma-ye wo o-ga-mi-ma-tsu-ri-te, ka-na-i an-zen, sho-gyo han-ye-i wo i-no-ri mo-o-su...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the luminous presence of the Universal Source and the Creator of all life, we align our hearts with Norito a Inari Okami: Blessing of the Sustento, the Cosecha and Peace of the Home. May the light of truth, the power of unconditional love, and profound peace flood our being, guiding our thoughts and actions toward harmony, serenity, and unity with all creation. So it is and so it shall be. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Tambor Taiko suave y campanas Kagura Suzu

oraciones.titulo: Misogi Harae no Kotoba: Prayer of Purificación with the Agua Viva
oraciones.textoOriginal: 祓へ給ひ、清め給へ、神ながら守り給ひ、幸へ給へ。 (Harae tamai, Kiyome tamae, Kamu-nagara Mamori tamae, Sakiwae tamae.)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ja-ra-ye ta-ma-i, Ki-yo-me ta-ma-ye, Ka-mu-na-ga-ra Ma-mo-ri ta-ma-ye, Sa-ki-wa-ye ta-ma-ye.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Purify us and cleanse us, oh divinity; Protect us in sacred nature and fill us with blessing and true happiness. May the crystal clear water wash away all sorrow and renew our spirit.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Sonido continuo de agua viva de manantial y flauta dulce

oraciones.titulo: Shinran Shonin: Sacred Nembutsu and Trust in Amida's Grace
oraciones.textoOriginal: 南無阿弥陀仏 (Namu Amida Butsu) - 他力本願 (Tariki Hongan: Confiando plenamente en el Gran Voto de Compasión Infinita).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Na-mu A-mi-da But-su, Na-mu A-mi-da But-su, Na-mu A-mi-da But-su...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I take refuge in the Buddha of Infinite Light and Life (Amida Buddha). I do not trust in my own limited merits, but entirely in the Great Vow of Unconditional Love that embraces all beings without exception or judgment, transforming suffering into absolute peace.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Campana Tingsha y recitación solemne del Nembutsu

oraciones.titulo: Honen Shonin: Ichimai Kishomon (The Testament of Simple Faith)
oraciones.textoOriginal: 源空が信ずる所の念仏は、ただ南無阿弥陀仏と唱ふるの外は、別の儀式もなし。 (Genku ga shinzuru tokoro no Nembutsu wa...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Gen-ku ga shin-zu-ru to-ko-ro no Nem-but-su wa, ta-da Na-mu A-mi-da But-su to to-na-hu-ru no ho-ka wa...
oraciones.textoTraducido: The Nembutsu that I profess does not require complex meditations or scholarly knowledge; It consists only of reciting 'Namu Amida Butsu' from the heart, with the unwavering certainty that the Buddha welcomes whoever invokes him with sincerity and humility.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Bell of templo budista y canto de grillos nocturnos

oraciones.titulo: Nichiren Daishonin: Prayer of the Sacred Daimoku of the Lotus Sutra
oraciones.textoOriginal: 南無妙法蓮華経 (Nam-Myoho-Renge-Kyo) - 開目抄・立正安国論
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Nam Mio-jo Ren-ge Kio, Nam Mio-jo Ren-ge Kio, Nam Mio-jo Ren-ge Kio...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I dedicate my life and awaken my innate Buddha nature through the Great Mystical Law of Cause and Effect of the Lotus Sutra. May I awaken the unbreakable courage within me to overcome any obstacle and sow peace and justice in the world.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Gong zen profundo y resonancia de campana rin

oraciones.titulo: Gatha Zen of the Five Reflections of Gratitude (Gokan no Ge)
oraciones.textoOriginal: 一には功の多少を計り彼の来処を量る。二には己が徳行の全欠を忖って供に応ず... (Hitotsu ni wa kou no tashou wo hakari...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ji-to-tsu ni wa ko no ta-sho wo ja-ka-ri ka-no rai-sho wo ja-ka-ru...
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Gatha Zen of the Five Reflections of Gratitude (Gokan no Ge). May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Madera de Hyoshigi y silencio del dojo Zen

oraciones.titulo: Saint Paul Miki and Martyrs of Nagasaki: Prayer for Forgiveness from the Hill
oraciones.textoOriginal: Domine Jesu Christe, in manus tuas commendo spiritum meum. Perdono a todos los que han decretado mi muerte.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Do-mi-ne Ye-su Kris-te, in ma-nus tu-as com-men-do spi-ri-tum me-um...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus Christ, into your hands I entrust my spirit. I declare that I am Japanese, Jesuit and Christian; I am dying to proclaim the Gospel of Christ. I wholeheartedly forgive those who condemn us and I beseech God to pour out his grace on all the people of Japan so that they may attain truth and eternal salvation.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Campanas sacras y viento sobre la colina de Tateyama

oraciones.titulo: Saint Andrew Kim Taegon: Testament of Faith and Perseverance in Prisons
oraciones.textoOriginal: 하느님께서 우리를 위해 모든 것을 예비하셨으니 두려워하지 말고 굳건히 믿음을 지키십시오. (Haneunim-kkeseo urireul wihae...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ja-nu-nim-ke-so u-ri-rul wi-je mo-dun got-sul ye-bi-ha-syot-su-ni tu-ryo-wo ja-ji mal-go gut-gon-ji mi-dum-ul ji-ki-sip-si-o...
oraciones.textoTraducido: God has arranged all things for our good. Do not fear the present difficulties, for no suffering in this world can compare with the glory that awaits us. Stay united in love, persevere in prayer and keep faith as the most precious treasure of your existence.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Bamboo flute coreana Daegeum y campanas sacras

oraciones.titulo: Saint Paul Chong Hasang: Prayer for Peace and Reconciliation in Korea
oraciones.textoOriginal: 주여, 이 땅에 당신의 평화와 사랑의 빛을 비추소서. (Juyeo, i ttange dangsin-ui pyeonghwa-wa sarang-ui bicheul bichusoseo...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ju-yo, i tang-e dang-sin-ui pyong-jwa-wa sa-rang-ui bi-chul bi-chu-so-so...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord our God, shed the light of your holy peace and reconciliation on this people. Heal the wounds of division, comfort the troubled and make the seed watered with the blood of our ancestors blossom into fruits of brotherhood, justice and fraternal harmony.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Canto litúrgico coreano suave y Church bells

oraciones.titulo: Il-Won-Sang: Prayer of the Perfect Circle of Universal Truth of Korea
oraciones.textoOriginal: 일원상(一圓相)은 우주 만유의 본원이요, 제불 제성의 심인이니... (Il-Won-Sang eun uju manyu-ui bon-won-iyo...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Il-Won-Sang un u-ju man-yu-ui bon-won-i-yo, je-bul je-song-ui sim-in-i-ni...
oraciones.textoTraducido: The Sacred Circle (Il-Won-Sang) is the fundamental origin of the entire universe, the seal of the heart of all the wise and enlightened. As we contemplate this truth without beginning or end, we commit to using our body and mind with righteousness, wisdom, and compassion toward all beings.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Gong coreano Moktak y cuenco metálico de resonancia

oraciones.titulo: Laozi (Dao of Jing): Prayer of Stillness and Harmony with the Flow of the Tao
oraciones.textoOriginal: 致虛極，守靜篤。萬物並作，吾以觀復。 (Zhi xu ji, shou jing du. Wan wu bing zuo, wu yi guan fu...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Zhi shiu yi, sho-u yin-g du. Wan wu bin-g dzuo, wu yi guan fu...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I reach the supreme emptiness and maintain the imperturbable stillness. Although the ten thousand beings sprout and stir around me, I contemplate their return to the root. Returning to the root is finding peace; To find peace is to follow the natural course of the eternal Tao.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Guqin tradicional de siete cuerdas y viento en el bosque de bambú

oraciones.titulo: Zhuangzi: Sitting Forgetfulness Meditation (Zuowang) and Inner Freedom
oraciones.textoOriginal: 墮肢體，黜聰明，離形去知，同於大通，此謂坐忘。 (Duo zhi ti, chu cong ming, li xing qu zhi...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Duo zhi ti, chu tsong min-g, li shin-g chiu zhi, ton-g yu da ton-g, tsi wei dzuo-wan-g...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I let the body rest, I turn off the agitation of the senses, I abandon the ties of the ego and I join the Great Unity of the Cosmos. This is absolute stillness where the mind flies freely and without obstacles.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Guqin chino y gotas de agua cayendo en estanque

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Reverence to Heaven (Tian) and Virtue of Benevolence (Ren)
oraciones.textoOriginal: 天何言哉？四時行焉，百物生焉，天何言哉！ (Tian he yan zai? Si shi xing yan, bai wu sheng yan...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Tyen jo yen dzai? Si shi shin-g yen, bai wu shen-g yen, tyen jo yen dzai...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Does Heaven speak with sonorous words? However, the four seasons march in harmony and all beings grow and prosper. May our hearts practice benevolence (*Ren*), righteousness and veneration of elders in sincere service to the community.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Instrumentos ceremoniales de la corte china Bianzhong

oraciones.titulo: Padre Matteo Ricci: Prayer of Amistad and Fraternidad entre Oriente and Occidente
oraciones.textoOriginal: Deus, qui fecisti unum omne genus humanum: da nobis concordiam et amicitiam veram.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: De-us, kwi fe-chis-ti u-num om-ne ge-nus ju-ma-num: da no-bis kon-kor-di-am et a-mi-chi-ti-am ve-ram...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord God of Heaven (*Tianzhu*), who created all peoples under the same celestial vault: pour upon us the gift of mutual understanding, respect for cultures and sincere friendship, so that we recognize in each human being a dear brother.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Guqin chino y órgano renacentista suave entrelazados

oraciones.titulo: Our Lady of The Vang (Vietnam): Maternal Shelter in the Jungle
oraciones.textoOriginal: Lạy Đức Mẹ La Vang, Mẹ là nơi nương ẩn của những kẻ khốn cùng... (Lay Duc Me La Vang, Me la noi nuong an...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Lay Duk Me La Vang, Me la noi nu-ong an kua niung ke jon kung...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Holy Mother of La Vang! Just as you descended on the trees of the jungle to console and heal your persecuted children with medicinal herbs, spread your mantle over our families today. Relieve our ailments of body and soul and lead us in peace to the heavenly homeland.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Campanas sacras y brisa suave entre la selva tropical

oraciones.titulo: Santos Mártires of Vietnam: Prayer of Fidelidad and Fortaleza
oraciones.textoOriginal: Lạy các Thánh Tử Đạo Việt Nam, xin cầu cho chúng con được giữ vững đức tin. (Lay cac Thanh Tu Dao Viet Nam...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Lay kak Tan Tu Da-o Vi-et Nam, sin kaw cho chung kon duk giu vung duk tin...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh glorious Martyrs of Vietnam, who preferred to give up their lives rather than renounce the cross of Christ! Pray for us so that we have the courage to live with Christian integrity, loving our country and sowing harmony at all times.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Coro litúrgico vietnamita tradicional y campanas

oraciones.titulo: Thich Nhat Hanh: Gatha of Peace of the Heart and Connection with the Earth
oraciones.textoOriginal: Hơi thở vào, tâm tĩnh lặng. Hơi thở ra, miệng mỉm cười. Trú trong hiện tại, giây phút đẹp tuyệt vời.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Joi to vao, tam ting lang. Joi to ra, mi-eng mim cu-oi. Tru trong ji-en tai, giay fut dep tuyet voi.
oraciones.textoTraducido: As I inhale, I calm my body and mind. As I exhale, I smile with gratitude. As I dwell in the present moment, I recognize that this is a sacred and wonderful moment.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Tibetan singing bowl suave y sonido de arroyo en el bosque

oraciones.titulo: Thich Nhat Hanh: Tea Meditation and Gratitude for the Elements
oraciones.textoOriginal: Chén trà này trong hai tay tôi, chánh niệm đầy ắp... (Esta taza de té en mis manos contiene las nubes, la lluvia y la luz del sol).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Chen cha nay trong jai tai toy, chanh niem day ap...
oraciones.textoTraducido: This cup in my hands contains the clouds of the sky, the fertile rain and the loving effort of those who cultivated the earth. I drink with full presence, free from worries of the past and fears of the future, in deep communion with life.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Tibetan singing bowl de resonancia y lluvia fina

oraciones.titulo: Kuntuzangpo Monlam: Great Primal Prayer of Primordial Wisdom
oraciones.textoOriginal: ཧོཿ སྣང་སྲིད་འཁོར་འདས་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀུན། གཞི་གཅིག་ལམ་གཉིས་འབྲས་བུ་གཉིས། (Ho! Nangsi khordey thamche kün...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Jo! Nang-si kor-dey tam-che kun, zhi chik lam nyi drey-bu nyi, rik dang ma-rik cho-trul te...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Ho! Everything that exists in Samsara and Nirvana shares a single primordial basis. Through this prayer of pure wisdom, may all wandering beings dissolve the illusion of separation and recognize the natural light of their own enlightened consciousness.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Trompetas Dungchen tibetanas y campanas de monasterio en el Himalaya

oraciones.titulo: Supplication of Protection ante the 8 Grandes Miedos a the Noble Tara Verde
oraciones.textoOriginal: ཨོཾ་ཏཱ་རེ་ཏུཏྟཱ་རེ་ཏུ་རེ་སྭཱ་ཧཱ། (Om Tare Tuttare Ture Soha) - འཇིགས་པ་བརྒྱད་ལས་སྐྱོབ་མཛད་མ།
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Ta-re Tu-ta-re Tu-re So-ja. Om Ta-re Tu-ta-re Tu-re So-ja...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Tribute to the Noble and Swift Liberator Tara! Deliver us from the fire of wrath, the lion of pride, the elephant of ignorance, the serpent of envy, the thief of wrong opinions, the chains of greed, the waters of attachment and the demon of doubt. Protect us under your lotus feet!

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Recitación de monjes tibetanos y campana ghanta

oraciones.titulo: Weddase Maryam: Ethiopian Monday Praise to the Virgin of the Bush
oraciones.textoOriginal: ውዳሴ ፡ ዘሰኑይ ፡ ለማርያም ፡ እግዝእትነ ፡ ወላዲተ ፡ አምላክ ፡ (Weddase ze-Senuy le-Maryam...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Wed-da-se ze-Se-nuy le-Mar-yam eg-zit-ne we-la-di-te Am-lak...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the Living God! Through the intercession of the Most Holy Theotokos and the blessed memory and help of Weddase Maryam: Ethiopian Monday Praise to the Virgin of the Bush, pour out Your Holy Spirit upon our life. Purify our mind in the stillness of prayer, grant us health, patience and forgiveness of sins, and guide us to the eternal peace of Your heavenly Kingdom. Amen!

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Tambores Kebero y sistros litúrgicos de Etiopía

oraciones.titulo: Weddase Maryam: Ethiopian Friday Praise to the Ark of the New Covenant
oraciones.textoOriginal: ውዳሴ ፡ ዘዓርብ ፡ አንቲ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ታቦት ፡ ቅድስት ፡ (Weddase ze-Arb: Anti we'etu Tabot Qeddest...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Wed-da-se ze-Arb: An-ti we-e-tu Ta-bot Ked-dest...
oraciones.textoTraducido: You are the Holy Ark covered in pure gold of the Holy Spirit, who carried within you the heavenly Manna of eternal life. Pray for us before the throne of your beloved Son to forgive our sins and crown our lives with mercy.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Tambores etíopes y cantos en lengua Ge'ez

oraciones.titulo: King Saint Lalibela: Prayer of the Churches Carved in the Sacred Rock
oraciones.textoOriginal: ኦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላከ ፡ አበዊነ ፡ ዘሀነፅከ ፡ ዛተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ መቅደስ ፡ (O Egziabher Amlake abewine...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O Eg-zi-ab-jer Am-la-ke a-be-wi-ne ze-ja-nets-ke za-te be-te mek-des...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Lord, God of our fathers! You who guided your servants to carve out of the living rock temples of prayer and dwellings of peace: make our lives living stones raised in unwavering faith, and may this sanctuary be a refuge for all who seek your help.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Cantos litúrgicos dentro de las iglesias monolíticas de Lalibela

oraciones.titulo: Mezgebe Haymanot: Prayer of the Tesoro of the Fe Etíope Tewahedo
oraciones.textoOriginal: ንሴብሖ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ስቡሐ ፡ ዘተሰብሐ ፡ (Nisebho le-Egziabher sebuhe zetesebehe...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ni-seb-jo le-Eg-zi-ab-jer se-bu-je ze-te-seb-je...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Let us praise the Lord who is infinitely glorious. In Him dwells the salvation of the nations and the protection of the righteous. May his blessing guard our families, protect our fields and spread lasting peace on the earth.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Arpa Begena etíope tradicional y cánticos sagrados

oraciones.titulo: Saint Josefina Bakhita (Sudán): Prayer of Libertad Interior and Forgiveness Heroico
oraciones.textoOriginal: Se incontrassi quei negrieri che mi hanno rapita e anche quelli che mi hanno torturata, mi inginocchierei a baciare loro le mani...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Se in-con-tras-si kwey ne-grie-ri ke mi an-no ra-pi-ta e an-ke kwel-li ke mi an-no tor-tu-ra-ta...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Lord Jesus, my only Owner and Protector! If I met those who kidnapped me and chained me, I would kneel to kiss their hands, because thanks to that path I came to know your infinite love. Deliver me from resentment, heal every wound of oppression and grant all souls the true freedom of the children of God.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Canto coral africano suave y campanas de consuelo

oraciones.titulo: Beato Isidoro Bakanja (Congo): Prayer of the Escapulario and Caridad Inmortal
oraciones.textoOriginal: Nalobi: Nasambeli mpo na bango. Mfumu Yesu, limbisa bango mpo bayebi te nini basalaki.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Na-lo-bi: Na-sam-be-li mpo na ban-go. M-fu-mu Ye-su, lim-bi-sa ban-go mpo ba-ye-bi te ni-ni ba-sa-la-ki.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Mother of Carmen, under your holy scapular I lived and worked. Lord Jesus, forgive those who have hurt me; In heaven I will pray for them as You prayed on the cross. May the seed of the Gospel grow pure in our land of the Congo.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Canto coral congoleño y tambores tradicionales suaves

oraciones.titulo: Beata Anuarite Nengapeta (Congo): Prayer of Integridad and Fidelidad
oraciones.textoOriginal: Nakolinga te kokosa Nzambe. Nalimbisi yo na motema mobimba. (Prefiero morir antes que pecar).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Na-ko-lin-ga te ko-ko-sa N-zam-be. Na-lim-bi-si yo na mo-te-ma mo-bim-ba...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord my God, I consecrate my entire heart to your service. Grant us the women and young people of Africa the grace to remain firm in dignity, purity and forgiveness, transforming hatred into redemptive love.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Coro femenino africano y campana suave

oraciones.titulo: Blessed Cyprian Iwene Tansi (Nigeria): Consecration and Surrender to the Poor
oraciones.textoOriginal: Chukwu biko, nye anyi obi di nwayo na ike ikwusa ozioma gi na mba nile.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Chuk-wu bi-ko, nye an-yi o-bi di nwa-yo na i-ke ik-wu-sa o-zi-o-ma gi na mba ni-le.
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Creator God (*Chukwu*), grant us a humble heart and tireless strength to bring your good news to every village. May service to the sick and helpless be our highest honor and may we never seek earthly reward but your holy glory.

oraciones.titulo: Arzobispo Desmond Tutu: Prayer of the Bondad Invencible over the Oscuridad
oraciones.textoOriginal: Goodness is stronger than evil; love is stronger than hate; light is stronger than darkness; life is stronger than death.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Gud-nes is stron-guer dan i-vil; lav is stron-guer dan jeit; lait is stron-guer dan dark-nes...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Goodness is stronger than evil; love is stronger than hate; the light is stronger than the darkness; life is stronger than death. Victory is ours through Him who loved us. Grant us, Lord, to be instruments of reconciliation and architects of peace.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Canto coral africano suave a cuatro voces

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of the Humanidad Compartida: Ubuntu ('Yo soy porque nosotros somos')
oraciones.textoOriginal: Umuntu ngumuntu ngabantu (Una persona es persona a través de las demás personas).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: U-mun-tu ngu-mun-tu nga-ban-tu...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the luminous presence of the Universal Source and the Creator of all life, we align our hearts with Prayer of the Humanidad Compartida: Ubuntu ('Yo soy porque nosotros somos'). May the light of truth, the power of unconditional love, and profound peace flood our being, guiding our thoughts and actions toward harmony, serenity, and unity with all creation. So it is and so it shall be. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Tambores suaves y sonidos naturales de la sabana africana

oraciones.titulo: Nkosi Sikelel' iAfrika: Solemn Prayer of Blessing for Africa and its Peoples
oraciones.textoOriginal: Nkosi sikelel' iAfrika, Maluphakanyisw' uphondo lwayo, Yizwa imithandazo yethu, Nkosi sikelela, thina lusapho lwayo.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: N-ko-si si-ke-lel i-Af-ri-ka, Ma-lu-pa-kan-yisw up-jon-do lwa-yo, Yiz-wa i-mi-tan-da-zo ye-tu...
oraciones.textoTraducido: God bless Africa; May his horn of hope be exalted on high. Hear our fervent prayers, O Lord; bless us, who are the children of his family. Descend, Holy Spirit, and fill this land with peace.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Coro polifónico majestuoso africano (Nkosi Sikelel' iAfrika)

oraciones.titulo: African Ancestral Prayer for Rain and Fertility of the Savannah
oraciones.textoOriginal: Mwari Samatenga, titambirei mvura inonaya kuitira vana vako... (Plegaria Shona a Mwari por el agua de vida).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Mwa-ri Sa-ma-ten-ga, ti-tam-bi-rei mvu-ra i-no-na-ya ku-i-ti-ra va-na va-ko...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the luminous presence of the Universal Source and the Creator of all life, we align our hearts with African Ancestral Prayer for Rain and Fertility of the Savannah. May the light of truth, the power of unconditional love, and profound peace flood our being, guiding our thoughts and actions toward harmony, serenity, and unity with all creation. So it is and so it shall be. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Tambores y sonido de lluvia cayendo sobre la tierra seca

oraciones.titulo: Traditional Libation and Blessing of the Ancestors of Light
oraciones.textoOriginal: Asante sana wazee wetu, tunaomba mwongozo wenu na amani katika ukoo huu... (Gratitud a los antepasados sabios).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: A-san-te sa-na wa-ze-ye we-tu, tu-na-om-ba mwon-go-zo we-nu na a-ma-ni ka-ti-ka u-ko-o ju-u...
oraciones.textoTraducido: With this offering we honor the grandparents and ancestors who walked before us in righteousness. We ask you for wisdom to guide new generations, protection against all danger and that harmony and respect always flourish in our lineage.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Tambores tribales suaves y rumor de la naturaleza

oraciones.titulo: Saint Charles Lwanga and Martyrs of Uganda: Fire of Faith and Youth Protection
oraciones.textoOriginal: Katonda waffe, oyagala abantu bo bonna: tuwe amaanyi okunywerera mu mazima. (Dios nuestro, fortalécenos en la verdad).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ka-ton-da waf-fe, o-ya-ga-la a-ban-tu bo bon-na: tu-we a-ma-an-yi ok-un-ywe-re-ra mu ma-zi-ma...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Holy Martyrs of Uganda, Saint Charles Lwanga and companions, neither the threats nor the fire of Namugongo could separate you from the love of God. Protect the youth of the world, grant them purity of intention, heroic courage in the face of injustice and unwavering faith.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Tambores y cantos corales de Uganda

oraciones.titulo: Blessed Victoire Rasoamanarivo of Madagascar: Firmness in Trial and Charity
oraciones.textoOriginal: Andriamanitra ô, matoky Anao aho: Aza avela ho very ny finoana ato amin'ity firenena ity.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: An-dri-a-ma-ni-tra o, ma-to-ky A-na-o a-jo: A-za a-ve-la jo ve-ry ny fi-no-a-na a-to a-min i-ty fi-re-ne-na i-ty...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Dear God, I trust in You completely. When the churches were closed, you sustained your people in secret home prayer. Grant us families patience in trials, generosity with the poor and persevering fidelity in faith.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Canto coral malgache con arpa Valiha

oraciones.titulo: Pentecostal Apostolic Cry of Ghana: Fire of the Spirit and Harvest of Souls
oraciones.textoOriginal: Onyankopon Tweaduampon, hwie wo Honhom Kronkron gu yen so! (¡Oh Dios Todopoderoso, derrama tu Santo Espíritu!).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: On-yan-ko-pon Twe-a-du-am-pon, jwi-e wo Jon-jom Kron-kron gu yen so!...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Lord Mighty God of Creation! Pour out your Pentecostal fire on our lives, break all spiritual ties and raise up a generation of believers full of power, grace and anointing to transform the nations.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Alabanza y palmas de congregación pentecostal africana

oraciones.titulo: Nigerian Prayer of Triumphal Praise and Breaking of Chains
oraciones.textoOriginal: Olorun Olodumare, gbogbo ogo ati ope ni fun oruko Re titi lae! (Dios Soberano, tuya es la gloria perpetua).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O-lo-run O-lo-du-ma-re, gbo-gbo o-go a-ti o-pe ni fun o-ru-ko Re ti-ti la-ye!...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father Almighty! We declare that there is no giant or difficulty that can resist before your Holy Name. We proclaim breaking of chains, liberation for the oppressed, health for the sick and unspeakable joy in the Holy Spirit.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Alabanza victoriosa con instrumentos africanos y júbilo

oraciones.titulo: Maasai Blessing of Peace, Wisdom and Protection of Livestock and Children
oraciones.textoOriginal: Enkai eishoru iyiook seriani, metaa enkop o olong nabo... (Que Enkai nos conceda paz y vida larga).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: En-ka-i e-i-sho-ru i-yi-o-ok se-ri-a-ni, me-ta-a en-kop o o-long na-bo...
oraciones.textoTraducido: May God the Creator (*Enkai*) shower upon us the blessing of peace (*Seriani*). May he protect our children in their paths, multiply the flocks in the pastures and grant wisdom to the elders to guide our community in harmony.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Vocalizaciones tradicionales rítmicas Maasai y viento de la sabana

oraciones.titulo: Cheikh Amadou Bamba (Muridiyya of Senegal): Munajat of Peace and Holy Work
oraciones.textoOriginal: يَا رَبِّ بِالْمُصْطَفَى بَلِّغْ مَقَاصِدَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا مَا مَضَى يَا وَاسِعَ الْكَرَمِ (Ya Rabbi bil-Mustafa balligh maqasidana...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Rab-bi bil-Mus-ta-fa bal-ligh ma-qa-si-da-na wagh-fir la-na ma ma-da ya Wa-si-al-Ka-ram...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O our Lord, for the honor of the Chosen One (SAW), grant us to achieve our noblest desires for peace and forgive our past faults, O inexhaustible Source of generosity! Let our daily work be prayer and our resistance be forgiveness and wisdom.

oraciones.titulo: Dhu al-Nun al-Misri: Sufi Prayer of Ecstasy and Reverence before Creation
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي مَا سَمِعْتُ صَوْتَ رِيحٍ وَلَا خَرِيرَ مَاءٍ إِلَّا وَجَدْتُهُ شَاهِدًا بِوَحْدَانِيَّتِكَ (Allahumma inni ma sami'tu sawta rihin...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Al-la-jum-ma in-ni ma sa-mi-tu saw-ta ri-jin wa la ja-ri-ra ma-in il-la wa-jad-tu-ju sha-ji-dan bi-waj-da-niy-ya-tik...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh my God! I have never heard the whisper of the wind, the murmur of water or the song of birds without recognizing in them an eloquent testimony of your Absolute Unity and a manifestation of your infinite beauty.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Laúd árabe Oud suave y murmullo de agua

oraciones.titulo: Rabbi Nachman of Breslov: Hitbodedut - Spontaneous Prayer in the Field
oraciones.textoOriginal: רִבּוֹנוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם, תֵּן לִי אֶת הַזְּכוּת לָצֵאת לַשָּׂדֶה בֵּין הָעֲשָׂבִים וְהָאִילָנוֹת וּלְדַבֵּר אִתְּךָ מִלֵּב אֶל לֵב... (Ribono shel Olam...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ri-bo-no shel O-lam, ten li et ja-ze-jut la-tzet la-sa-de bein ja-a-sa-vim ve-ja-i-la-not ul-da-ber it-ja mi-lev el lev...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Sovereign of the Universe! Grant me the merit of going out into the fields, among the grasses and trees that sing their own praise, and pour out my heart before You in simple and sincere conversation as a son speaks with his beloved father. Renew me with your joy and do not allow despair to touch my soul.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Viento en el bosque y violín klezmer suave y contemplativo

oraciones.titulo: Rabbi Nachman of Breslov: Solemn Prayer for World Peace
oraciones.textoOriginal: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ ה' אֱלֹהֵינוּ שֶׁתְּבַטֵּל מִלְחָמוֹת וּשְׁפִיכוּת דָּמִים מִן הָעוֹלָם וְתַמְשִׁיךְ שָׁלוֹם גָּדוֹל וְנִפְלָא... (Yehi ratzon milfanekha...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ye-ji ra-tzon mil-fa-ne-ja A-do-nay E-lo-hei-nu she-te-ba-tel mil-ja-mot u-she-fi-jut da-mim min ja-o-lam...
oraciones.textoTraducido: May your holy will, Lord our God, eradicate wars and bloodshed from the face of the earth, and spread immense and wonderful peace throughout the entire world. May all nations and peoples unite in friendship, recognizing that we are all the work of your hands.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Violín hebreo y arpa de David suave

oraciones.titulo: Rabbi Isaac Luria (The Holy Ari): Kavanah of Love of Neighbor before Praying
oraciones.textoOriginal: הֲרֵינִי מְקַבֵּל עָלַי מִצְוַת עֲשֵׂה שֶׁל וְאָהַבְתָּ לְרֵעֲךָ כָּמוֹךָ (Hareini mekabel alay mitzvat aseh shel Veahavta lereakha kamokha).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ja-rei-ni me-ka-bel a-lay mitz-vat a-sej shel Ve-a-jav-ta le-re-a-ja ka-mo-ja...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Behold, I take upon myself the divine precept: 'You shall love your neighbor as yourself.' I declare my love and brotherhood with every created soul before presenting my supplications before the Creator, blessed be He.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Arpa hebrea tradicional y canto matutino de aves

oraciones.titulo: Rabbi Moisés Cordovero (Tomer Dévora): Prayer of the 13 Rules of Patience
oraciones.textoOriginal: מִי אֵל כָּמוֹךָ נֹשֵׂא עָוֹן וְעֹבֵר עַל פֶּשַׁע (Mi El kamokha noseh avon veover al pesha...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Mi El ka-mo-ja no-se a-von ve-o-ver al pe-sha...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Who is like You, compassionate God, who forgives the fault and overlooks the offense? Teach us to imitate your thirteen attributes of kindness: to respond gently to wrongs, not to hold grudges and to always wish well to those who have harmed us.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Violín cabalístico de Safed y brisa de Galilea

oraciones.titulo: Baal Shem Tov: Prayer of Dvekut and Alegría in the Presencia Divina
oraciones.textoOriginal: שִׁוִּיתִי ה' לְנֶגְדִּי תָמִיד (Shiviti Adonai lenegdi tamid - Pongo al Señor siempre ante mis ojos).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Shi-vi-ti A-do-nay le-neg-di ta-mid...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I continually place the light of the Creator before my gaze. In every heartbeat of life, in every joy and in every challenge, I recognize his loving presence. I expel sadness and complaint, and choose to serve the Almighty with overflowing joy and perpetual gratitude.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Niggun jasídico tradicional sin palabras entonado con alegría

oraciones.titulo: Prayer and Sacred Chant to Orisha Oko: Prosperity of the Earth and Harvest
oraciones.textoOriginal: Orisha Oko afefe irawo, tani mogba ire aye. Orisha Oko iku afefe, baba gbogbo aye ewa.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O-ri-sha O-ko a-fe-fe i-ra-wo, ta-ni mog-ba i-re a-ye. O-ri-sha O-ko i-ku a-fe-fe, ba-ba gbo-gbo a-ye e-wa.
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Olofin and the Holy Orishas, we lift our devotion and prayer for Prayer and Sacred Chant to Orisha Oko: Prosperity of the Earth and Harvest. We come with reverence before the blessed spiritual powers to remove all negativity, disturbance and heavy burdens, firmly opening the pathways to health, peace, progress and abundance in our home. Ashé to iban Eshu! Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Tambores Batá sagrados tocando ritmo para Orisha Oko

oraciones.titulo: Moyugba and Suyere a Osanyin (Ozain): Blessing of the Hierbas Curativas and Health
oraciones.textoOriginal: Osanyin kuele kuele, ewe o, ewe gbogbo ti nbe ninu igbo. Ati omo Osanyin, fun wa ni ilera.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O-san-yin kue-le kue-le, e-we o, e-we gbo-gbo ti n-be ni-nu ig-bo. A-ti o-mo O-san-yin, fun wa ni i-le-ra.
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Olofin and the Holy Orishas, we lift our devotion and prayer for Moyugba and Suyere a Osanyin (Ozain): Blessing of the Hierbas Curativas and Health. We come with reverence before the blessed spiritual powers to remove all negativity, disturbance and heavy burdens, firmly opening the pathways to health, peace, progress and abundance in our home. Ashé to iban Eshu! Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Canto a Osanyin con güiro y sonidos de la selva virgen

oraciones.titulo: Solemn Prayer to Olokun: Firmness, Mystery and Stability of the Deep Waters
oraciones.textoOriginal: Olokun loba omi aye, agana eri, omi dide. Olokun baba mi, fun mi ni alafia ati oro nla.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O-lo-kun lo-ba o-mi a-ye, a-ga-na e-ri, o-mi di-de. O-lo-kun ba-ba mi, fun mi ni a-la-fi-a a-ti o-ro n-la.
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Olofin and the Holy Orishas, we lift our devotion and prayer for Solemn Prayer to Olokun: Firmness, Mystery and Stability of the Deep Waters. We come with reverence before the blessed spiritual powers to remove all negativity, disturbance and heavy burdens, firmly opening the pathways to health, peace, progress and abundance in our home. Ashé to iban Eshu! Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Olas solemnes del mar y tambores profundos Batá

oraciones.titulo: Canto and Salutación a the Sagrados Ibejis: Alegría, Health and Protection Infantil
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ibeji oro, Taiwo ati Kehinde, omo edun, omo alaafia. E wa fun wa ni ayo ati ilera.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: I-be-ji o-ro, Tai-wo a-ti Ke-jin-de, o-mo e-dun, o-mo a-la-a-fi-a. E wa fun wa ni a-yo a-ti i-le-ra.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Holy Ibejis, divine twins of fortune, Taiwo and Kehinde! Bring joy to our home, take away sorrow and sadness, protect children in their growth and fill our lives with laughter, well-being and blessings.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Campanitas alegres, maracas y tambores festivos Batá

oraciones.titulo: Invocation to Aggayú Solá: Strength of the Volcano and Firmness on Arduous Roads
oraciones.textoOriginal: Aggayu Sola kiniye wara, baba omo mi, orisha nla ti nse gbe aye duro.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ag-ga-yu So-la ki-ni-ye wa-ra, ba-ba o-mo mi, o-ri-sha n-la ti n-se gbe a-ye du-ro.
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Olofin and the Holy Orishas, we lift our devotion and prayer for Invocation to Aggayú Solá: Strength of the Volcano and Firmness on Arduous Roads. We come with reverence before the blessed spiritual powers to remove all negativity, disturbance and heavy burdens, firmly opening the pathways to health, peace, progress and abundance in our home. Ashé to iban Eshu! Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Tambores Batá de ritmo firme y enérgico

oraciones.titulo: Prayer to Inle and Abbata: Médico Divino, Health Integral and Prosperity
oraciones.textoOriginal: Inle Abata omo onirere, onisegun orisha, wa fun wa ni ara lile ati alaafia.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: In-le A-ba-ta o-mo o-ni-re-re, o-ni-se-gun o-ri-sha, wa fun wa ni a-ra li-le a-ti a-la-a-fi-a.
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Olofin and the Holy Orishas, we lift our devotion and prayer for Inle and Abbata: Médico Divino, Health Integral and Prosperity. We come with reverence before the blessed spiritual powers to remove all negativity, disturbance and heavy burdens, firmly opening the pathways to health, peace, progress and abundance in our home. Ashé to iban Eshu! Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Sonido suave del río desembocando en el mar y Batá suave

oraciones.titulo: Dr. Adolfo Bezerra of Menezes: Prayer of Asistencia Médica Espiritual and Health
oraciones.textoOriginal: Nós Te rogamos, Pai de Infinita Bondade e Justiça, as graças de Jesus Cristo através do Dr. Bezerra de Menezes e sua legião de companheiros...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Nos Te ro-ga-mos, Pai de In-fi-ni-ta Bon-da-de e Jus-ti-ça, as gra-ças de Je-sus Cris-to a-tra-vés do Dr. Be-zer-ra de Me-ne-zes...
oraciones.textoTraducido: We pray to you, Father of Infinite Goodness and Justice, that you pour out, through the mediation of Dr. Bezerra de Menezes and his spiritual phalanxes, life-giving fluids of health on the sick. May the balm of consolation descend to the beds of pain and may hope be reborn in each dejected soul.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Gentle piano espiritista y melodía de paz

oraciones.titulo: Prece of Fluidification and Spiritual Blessing of Water
oraciones.textoOriginal: Senhor Deus, pedimos aos bons espíritos que depositem nesta água os remédios e fluidos salutares necessários ao nosso restabelecimento.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Se-nhor De-us, pe-di-mos aos bons es-pí-ri-tos ke de-po-si-tem nes-ta á-gua os re-mé-dios e flui-dos sa-lu-ta-res...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Father of Infinite Goodness, Wisdom, and Mercy! In deep spiritual elevation, we lift our prayer for Prece of Fluidification and Spiritual Blessing of Water. We pray to the good spirits and our guardian angel to assist us with their beneficent light, dispel all turmoil from the soul, and grant us patience, resignation, and love to progress along the path of goodness. May the peace of God rest upon us. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Música instrumental de piano y sonido suave de agua cristalina

oraciones.titulo: Pray for Souls in Affliction and Spiritual Turmoil
oraciones.textoOriginal: Deus Todo-Poderoso, lançai um olhar de compaixão sobre os nossos irmãos que sofrem nos planos da perturbação...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: De-us To-do-Po-de-ro-so, lan-çai um ol-har de com-pai-xão so-bre os nos-sos ir-mãos ke so-frem...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Father of Infinite Goodness, Wisdom, and Mercy! In deep spiritual elevation, we lift our prayer for Pray for Souls in Affliction and Spiritual Turmoil. We pray to the good spirits and our guardian angel to assist us with their beneficent light, dispel all turmoil from the soul, and grant us patience, resignation, and love to progress along the path of goodness. May the peace of God rest upon us. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Música clásica suave de cuerdas y piano

oraciones.titulo: Praise the Gospel in the Home for Family Harmony
oraciones.textoOriginal: Mestre Jesus, rogamos Tua presença e a proteção dos mentores amigos em nosso lar...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Mes-tre Je-sus, ro-ga-mos Tu-a pre-sen-ça e a pro-te-ção dos men-to-res a-mi-gos em nos-so lar...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Father of Infinite Goodness, Wisdom, and Mercy! In deep spiritual elevation, we lift our prayer for Praise the Gospel in the Home for Family Harmony. We pray to the good spirits and our guardian angel to assist us with their beneficent light, dispel all turmoil from the soul, and grant us patience, resignation, and love to progress along the path of goodness. May the peace of God rest upon us. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Música suave de piano para el ambiente familiar

oraciones.titulo: Cairbar Schutel: Prayer of Difusión of the Bien and Fraternidad Universal
oraciones.textoOriginal: Senhor, fazei-nos instrumentos fiéis do Teu amor, espalhando a verdade que liberta e o consolo que restaura...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Se-nhor, fa-zei-nos ins-tru-men-tos fi-éis do Teu a-mor, es-pa-lhan-do a ver-da-de ke li-ber-ta...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord, make us humble and persevering workers of your flock. May we bring the clarity of the doctrine of love to where there is doubt, the word of encouragement to where despair reigns, and active brotherhood to every corner of the world.

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Welcome and Delight on Holy Saturday
oraciones.textoOriginal: Señor Dios Creador: 'Si retrajeres del día de reposo tu pie, de hacer tu voluntad en mi día santo, y lo llamares delicia...' (Isaías 58:13).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Se-ñor Dios Cre-a-dor: Si re-tra-je-res del dí-a de re-po-so tu pie...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father, we thank you for the blessed gift of Holy Saturday, eternal memorial of your creation and sanctuary in time. We put aside secular cares and tasks to rest in your grace, enjoy family communion and renew our spiritual forces.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Himnos de Pipe organ adventista y coro solemne

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of Despedida of the Sábado and Consecration of the Semana
oraciones.textoOriginal: Al ocultarse el sol, despedimos las santas horas del reposo con corazones agradecidos.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Al o-cul-tar-se el sol, des-pe-di-mos las san-tas jo-ras del re-po-so...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord, as you conclude the sacred hours of your day of rest, we ask that the peace and blessing received accompany us throughout the days of work. May our lives bear witness to your love and may we keep the blessed hope of the glorious return of Jesus.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Himno instrumental suave de atardecer y campana

oraciones.titulo: J.N. Andrews: Prayer of Consagración Misionera Total ('Todo for the Maestro')
oraciones.textoOriginal: Lord, take my life, my talents, my everything. I hold nothing back from Thy cause.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Lord, teik mai laif, mai ta-lents, mai ev-ri-ting...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Heavenly Father, we come with confidence before the throne of Thy grace, anchored in the promises of Thy Holy Word and in the blessed hope of Christ's soon return. We present this earnest prayer for J.N. Andrews: Prayer of Consagración Misionera Total ('Todo for the Maestro'): guard our lives, establish our steps in Thy holy commandments, and fill us with Thy heavenly peace. Through the merits of Jesus Christ. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Solemn organ y coro cantando himnos misioneros

oraciones.titulo: Uriah Smith: Prayer of Firmness in the Heavenly Sanctuary and the Faith of Jesus
oraciones.textoOriginal: Look up to the Most Holy Place, where our Great High Priest intercedes for us.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Luk ap tu de Most Jo-li Pleis, jwer aur Greit Jai Prist in-ter-sids for as...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Great High Priest Jesus, who minister for us in the Most Holy Place of the Heavenly Sanctuary! Purify our hearts with your atoning blood, write your law on our minds and grant us perseverance to keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.

oraciones.titulo: Stewardship Prayer for Health and Care of the Temple of the Spirit
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¿O ignoráis que vuestro cuerpo es templo del Espíritu Santo, el cual está en vosotros? (1 Corintios 6:19).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: ¿O ig-no-rá-is ke vues-tro cuer-po es tem-plo del Es-pí-ri-tu San-to...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Dear Father, we recognize that our health and vigor are precious gifts entrusted to our care. Give us temperance, wisdom in our daily habits and self-control, so that with healthy bodies and clear minds we can faithfully serve You and our neighbors.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Piano acústico suave y ambiente sereno

oraciones.titulo: Relief Society (1842): 'Charity Never Ceases'
oraciones.textoOriginal: Charity Never Faileth - Relieve the poor, save souls, and strengthen the family.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Cha-ri-ti ne-ver fei-leth - Ri-liv de pur, seiv souls, and streng-then de fa-mi-li...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Heavenly Father, we come before Thee in the sacred and reverent name of Thy Son, Jesus Christ. We present our humble petition and gratitude for Relief Society (1842): 'Charity Never Ceases'. We pray that Thou wilt pour out Thy Holy Spirit upon our home, strengthen our testimony, bless our daily labors, and guide us in righteousness along the covenant path. In the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Coro del Tabernáculo de la Manzana del Templo y órgano

oraciones.titulo: Blessing of Healing the Sick with Consecrated Oil
oraciones.textoOriginal: ¿Está alguno enfermo entre vosotros? Llame a los ancianos de la iglesia, y oren por él, ungiéndole con aceite... (Santiago 5:14 / D. y C. 42:44).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: ¿Es-tá al-gu-no en-fer-mo en-tre vo-so-tros? Lla-me a los an-cia-nos de la i-gle-sia...
oraciones.textoTraducido: By the authority of the Holy Melchizedek Priesthood, we anoint and seal this blessing upon your head for health, strength, and comfort. May the life-giving hand of the Lord restore your body and fill your spirit with heavenly peace.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Himnos de cuerdas y Gentle piano de reverencia

oraciones.titulo: Prayer for Holiness and Strength in the House of the Lord (Holy Temple)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Holiness to the Lord — The House of the Lord (Santidad al Señor — La Casa del Señor).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Jo-li-nes tu de Lord - De Jaus of de Lord...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Beloved Heavenly Father, we come before Thee in the sacred and reverent name of Thy Son, Jesus Christ. We present our humble petition and gratitude for Holiness and Strength in the House of the Lord (Holy Temple). We pray that Thou wilt pour out Thy Holy Spirit upon our home, strengthen our testimony, bless our daily labors, and guide us in righteousness along the covenant path. In the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Órgano monumental del Tabernáculo de Salt Lake

oraciones.titulo: Lema and Prayer of Valentía Juvenil ('Iré and Haré')
oraciones.textoOriginal: Iré y haré lo que el Señor ha mandado, porque sé que el Señor nunca da mandamientos a los hijos de los hombres sin prepararles una vía... (1 Nefi 3:7).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: I-ré y ja-ré lo ke el Se-ñor ja man-da-do, por-ke sé ke el Se-ñor nun-ca da man-da-mien-tos...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord, with the faith of Nephi we declare that we will go and do whatever You ask of us. Give us courage to stand for truth, purity to resist temptations, and love to serve those around us, trusting that You will always prepare the way.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Himno juvenil de piano y cuerdas inspirador

oraciones.titulo: Spiritual Warfare Prayer and Covering of the Armor of God
oraciones.textoOriginal: Vestíos de toda la armadura de Dios, para que podáis estar firmes contra las asechanzas del diablo (Efesios 6:11).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ves-tí-os de to-da la ar-ma-du-ra de Dios, pa-ra ke po-dá-is es-tar fir-mes...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the Name of Jesus I take today the belt of truth, the breastplate of righteousness, the shoes of the gospel of peace, the shield of faith to quench every fiery dart of the enemy, the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit which is the living Word of God! No weapon formed against my home will prosper.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Música de clamor y guerra espiritual con teclado pads y shofar

oraciones.titulo: Cry of Baptism in the Holy Spirit and Tongues of Fire
oraciones.textoOriginal: Señor, bautízame con tu Santo Espíritu y fuego, conforme a tu promesa en Hechos 2.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Se-ñor, bau-tí-za-me con tu San-to Es-pí-ri-tu y fue-go...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Heavenly Father! I long for more of your presence; immerse me in the living waters of your Holy Spirit. Unleash in my mouth tongues of praise and heavenly edification, fill me with your gifts and ignite in my soul a holy zeal that will never go out.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Clamor de congregación pentecostal y música de adoración espontánea

oraciones.titulo: Cry of Faith and Authority for Supernatural Healing and Miracles
oraciones.textoOriginal: Mas él herido fue por nuestras rebeliones, molido por nuestros pecados... y por su llaga fuimos nosotros curados (Isaías 53:5).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Mas él je-ri-do fue por nues-tras re-be-lio-nes, mo-li-do por nues-tros pe-ca-dos...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the Name of Jesus Christ, by the power of his redeeming wounds, I declare complete healing over my body and over the body of my brother! I rebuke all sickness, pain and affliction; I order the cells and organs to function in perfect divine health.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Adoración suave de teclado y oración de intercesión ungida

oraciones.titulo: Navagraha Stotram: Prayer for Harmonization of the 9 Cosmic Forces
oraciones.textoOriginal: नमामि सूर्यम् सोमम् मङ्गलम् बुधम् गुरुम् शुक्रम् शनिम् च राहुम् केतुम् च प्रणमाम्यहम् (Namami Suryam Somam Mangalam...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Na-ma-mi Sur-yam So-mam Man-ga-lam Bud-jam Gu-rum Shuk-ram Sha-nim cha Ra-jum Ke-tum cha pra-na-mam-ya-jam...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I pay homage to the Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rahu and Ketu. May all cosmic influences harmonize in peace on my path, dissolving obstacles, attracting wisdom and promoting health and well-being in my life.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Canto védico tradicional de pandits con tanpura

oraciones.titulo: Durga Suktam (Rig Veda): Invocation of the Fuego Sagrado and Protection
oraciones.textoOriginal: जातवेदसे सुनवाम सोममरातीयतो निदहाति वेदः। स नः पर्षदति दुर्गाणि विश्वा नावेव सिन्धुं दुरिताऽत्यग्निः॥ (Jatavedase sunavama somam...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ja-ta-ve-da-se su-na-va-ma so-mam a-ra-ti-ya-to ni-da-ja-ti ve-dah. Sa nah par-sha-da-ti dur-ga-ni vish-wa na-ve-va sin-dhum du-ri-tat-yag-nih...
