oraciones.textoTraducido: We offer our prayers to Agni, the fire of omniscient knowledge. May He consume the forces of negativity and lead us through all difficulties and dangers, just as a ship safely crosses the stormy ocean.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Recitación védica solemne con Bell of templo y fuego sagrado

oraciones.titulo: Karuna Bhavana: Meditación and Prayer of Compasión Infinita hacia the Seres
oraciones.textoOriginal: Sabbe satta dukkha pamuccantu. (Que todos los seres sintientes queden libres del dolor y de las causas del sufrimiento).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Sab-be sat-ta duk-kha pa-mut-chan-tu. Sab-be sat-ta a-ve-ra jon-tu...
oraciones.textoTraducido: May all suffering sentient beings find relief; May those who are prisoners of anguish and fear be comforted. May my heart not remain indifferent to the tears of the world and may each of my actions relieve the burden of those around me.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Tibetan singing bowl suave y Bell of meditación Theravada

oraciones.titulo: Ayat ash-Shifa: The Six Quranic Verses of Healing and Holistic Health
oraciones.textoOriginal: وَيَشْفِ صُدُورَ قَوْمٍ مُّؤْمِنِينَ ۝ وَشِفَاءٌ لِّمَا فِي الصُّدُورِ ۝ يَخْرُجُ مِن بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهُ فِيهِ شِفَاءٌ لِّلنَّاسِ ۝ وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ ۝ وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ ۝ قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا هُدًى وَشِفَاءٌ
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Wa yash-fi su-du-ra qaw-mim mu'-mi-nin... Wa shi-fa-ul li-ma fis-su-dur... Wa i-dha ma-rid-tu fa-ju-wa yash-fin...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Allah, Supreme Healer! By the blessing of your holy verses: 'And heal the breasts of the believing people', 'And when I am sick, He is the One Who heals me', 'And We send down from the Qur'an that which is medicine and mercy': shower complete health on our bodies and restore tranquility to our souls.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Recitación suave y reverente del Corán y laúd Oud

oraciones.titulo: Da Bei Zhou (大悲咒): Great Dharani of Infinite Compassion of Guan Yin
oraciones.textoOriginal: 南無喝囉怛那哆囉夜耶。南無阿唎耶。婆盧羯帝爍缽囉耶。菩提薩埵婆耶... (Namo ratna-trayaya, Namo arya-valokiteshvaraya bodhisattvaya...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Na-mo je-la da-na duo-la ye-ye. Na-mo a-li-ye. Po-lu jie-di shuo-bo-la-ye. Pu-ti sa-duo po-ye...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Tribute to the sacred Triple Jewel! Homage to the Noble Avalokiteshvara (Guan Yin), the Bodhisattva of Infinite Compassion. By the power of this Great Dharani, may all sufferings be dissolved, all diseases of soul and body cured, and all beings find refuge, peace and liberation.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Bell of templo budista chino, cuenco metálico y canto solemne del Da Bei Zhou

oraciones.titulo: Sutra of the Loto (Pu Men Pin): Prayer of Auxilio a Guan Yin Bodhisattva
oraciones.textoOriginal: 妙音觀世音，梵音海潮音，勝彼世間音，是故須常念... (Miao yin Guan-shi-yin, fan yin hai chao yin...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Mi-ao yin Guan-shi-yin, fan yin jai cha-o yin, sheng bi shi-jian yin, shi gu shu chang nian...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Wonderful voice of Guan Yin who listens to the cry of the world, pure and sublime voice like the murmur of the ocean tides. In the midst of storms, fires, persecutions and afflictions, by invoking His Holy Name with a sincere heart, the light of His mercy dispels the danger and restores peace to the heart.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Música budista china de bambú y Bell of bronce

oraciones.titulo: Lu Xiang Zan (炉香赞): Hymn of Ofrenda of Incienso and Purificación
oraciones.textoOriginal: 爐香乍爇，法界蒙熏，諸佛海會悉遙聞，隨處結祥雲... (Lu xiang zha re, fa jie meng xun...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Lu shi-ang zha re, fa jie meng shiun, zhu fo jai jui si ya-o wen, sui chu jie shiang yun...
oraciones.textoTraducido: As soon as the incense burns in the sacred cauldron, the entire universe is filled with its pure fragrance. The infinite gathered Buddhas perceive the offering from afar, forming clouds of auspicious blessing. Homage to the Bodhisattvas of the fragrant clouds!

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Canto litúrgico monástico chino Lu Xiang Zan y madera Muyu

oraciones.titulo: Liu Zi Da Ming Zhou (六字大明咒): The Six Luminous Characters of Guan Yin
oraciones.textoOriginal: 唵嘛呢叭咪吽 (Om Mani Padme Hum / ōng mā nī bāi mī hōng)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ong ma ni bei mi jong, Ong ma ni bei mi jong, Ong ma ni bei mi jong...
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Liu Zi Da Ming Zhou (六字大明咒): The Six Luminous Characters of Guan Yin. May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Bell of bronce china y repetición rítmica del mantra

oraciones.titulo: Wang Sheng Zhou (往生咒): Dharani of Rebirth and Spiritual Peace
oraciones.textoOriginal: 南無阿彌多婆夜。哆他伽多夜。哆地夜他。阿彌利都婆毗... (Namo amitabhaya tathagataya...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Na-mo a-mi-duo-po ye, duo-ta-qie-duo ye, duo-di-ye-ta, a-mi-li-duo-po-pi...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Homage to Amitabha Buddha of Infinite Light. May this sacred dharani purify all past karmas, bring eternal rest and light to the ancestors, and ensure the bliss of the Pure Land of Peace for all souls.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Campanilla Tingsha y recitación monástica en chino

oraciones.titulo: Qingjing Jing (常清静经): Prayer of the Claridad and Quietud Mental
oraciones.textoOriginal: 人能常清靜，天地悉皆歸。夫人神好清，而心擾之；人心好靜，而欲牽之... (Ren neng chang qing jing...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ren neng chang ching yin-g, tyen di shi jie gui. Fu ren shen ja-o ching, er shin ra-o zhi...
oraciones.textoTraducido: If the human being can maintain constant stillness and purity, all of Heaven and Earth return to harmony within. It appeases desires, calms thoughts and dissolves the agitation of the ego; By emptying the mind, the heavenly clarity of the Tao shines eternally.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Guqin tradicional taoísta y susurro del viento en la montaña Wudang

oraciones.titulo: Taishang Ganying Pian: Prayer of Virtud Moral and Blessing of the Cielo
oraciones.textoOriginal: 禍福無門，唯人自召；善惡之報，如影隨形。 (Huo fu wu men, wei ren zi zhao...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Juo fu wu men, wei ren dzi zha-o; shan e zhi ba-o, ru yin-g sui shin-g...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Happiness and misfortune have no fixed doors; It is human beings who attract them with their actions. The retribution of good and evil follows the person as the shadow follows the body. May we walk the path of righteousness, compassionate toward those in need and honest in all actions.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Música taoísta suave de flauta Dizi y campanas de jade

oraciones.titulo: Sanqing Baiguan (三清拜官): Invocation to the Three Pure Ones of the Cosmos
oraciones.textoOriginal: 志心皈命禮，玉清聖境，清微天宮，原始天尊... (Zhi xin gui ming li, Yuqing sheng jing...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Zhi shin gui ming li, Yu-ching sheng yin-g, Ching-wei tyen gong, Yuan-shi Tyen-dzun...
oraciones.textoTraducido: With sincere hearts we pay reverence to the Celestial Venerable of Primordial Origin (Yuanshi Tianzun), the Lord of the Sacred Treasure (Lingbao Tianzun), and the Lord of Tao and Virtue (Daode Tianzun). May his cosmic breath harmonize the Yin and Yang in our lives and ward off all calamity.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Música ceremonial taoísta de templo con campanas y cítara

oraciones.titulo: Norito to the God of the Home (Zao Jun): Peace, Health and Family Abundance
oraciones.textoOriginal: 一家之主，五祀之神。司命灶君，保佑家宅平安，衣食豐足。 (Yi jia zhi zhu, wu si zhi shen...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Yi jia zhi zhu, wu si zhi shen. Si ming Zao Jun, ba-o you jia zhai ping an, yi shi feng dzu...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Lord and Guardian of the Home and Kitchen (*Zao Jun*)! Watch over our family day and night. Keep discord and illness away from our roof, bless our food with health and prosperity, and present our good intentions and works of kindness before Heaven.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Instrumentos tradicionales chinos suaves y sonido hogareño

oraciones.titulo: Men Shen (门神): Prayer for Protection of the Threshold and Peace of the Home
oraciones.textoOriginal: 門神戶尉，護衛家門。邪祟速去，福氣常臨。 (Men shen hu wei, hu wei jia men...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Men shen ju wei, ju wei jia men. Shie sui su chu, fu chi chang lin...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Noble Guardians of the Doors and the Threshold (*Men Shen*)! Guard the entrance to our home against all danger, damage or bad intentions. May he who enters do so with peace and blessing, and whoever leaves be protected in his ways.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Tambor suave ceremonial y campanillas de viento

oraciones.titulo: Wang Daiyu and Liu Zhi: Supplication of Han Kitab (Tawhid and Virtue)
oraciones.textoOriginal: 真主至大，獨一無偶。修身齊家，順應天命。 (Zhenzhu zhi da, du yi wu ou. Xiu shen qi jia...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Zhen-zhu zhi da, du yi wu ou. Shi-u shen chi jia, shun ying tyen ming. Al-la-ju Ak-bar...
oraciones.textoTraducido: The True Lord (*Zhenzhu*) is Supreme and Unique without associates! Grant us to purify our conduct, govern our homes in harmony and rightly obey your holy law, uniting pure devotion to You with benevolence towards all beings.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Recitación coránica suave con fondo de instrumentos chinos

oraciones.titulo: Hui Muslim Prayer for Peace, Decent Work and Prosperity
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ بَلَدَنَا هَذَا آمِنًا مُطْمَئِنًّا وَسَائِرَ بِلَادِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ (Allahumma ij'al baladana hadha aminan...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Al-la-jum-maj-al ba-la-da-na ja-dha a-mi-nan mut-ma-in-nan... Qifu heping jiayuan...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Allah! Make our land a safe, peaceful home filled with bliss. Bless the fruit of our honest labors, foster friendship and harmony between all ethnicities and beliefs, and always guide us along the path of justice.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Canto de Dua en árabe y notas de guzheng suave

oraciones.titulo: Sri Hanuman Chalisa: The 40 Verses of Strength, Protection and Courage
oraciones.textoOriginal: जय हनुमान ज्ञान गुन सागर। जय कपीस तिहुँ लोक उजागर॥ राम दूत अतुलित बल धामा। अंजनि पुत्र पवनसुत नामा॥ (Jaya Hanumana jnana guna sagara...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ja-ya Ja-nu-ma-na gya-na gu-na sa-ga-ra. Ja-ya ka-pi-sa ti-hun lo-ka u-ja-ga-ra. Ra-ma du-ta a-tu-li-ta ba-la dha-ma...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Glory to Sri Hanuman, ocean of wisdom and virtues! Incomparable messenger of Lord Rama, abode of infinite strength, son of the wind and destroyer of all suffering. Whoever meditates on your name with pure devotion is free from all fear, danger and illness.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Canto devocional indio de Hanuman Chalisa con armonio y mridanga

oraciones.titulo: Maha Mrityunjaya Mantra (Rig Veda): Healing and Victory over the Muerte
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम्। उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय मामृतात्॥ (Om Tryambakam yajamahe sugandhim pushtivardhanam...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Tryam-ba-kam ya-ja-ma-je su-gan-dhim push-ti-var-dha-nam. Ur-va-ru-ka-mi-va ban-dha-nan mrit-yor muk-shi-ya mam-ri-tat.
oraciones.textoTraducido: We worship the Lord of the Three Eyes (Shiva), of divine fragrance, who nourishes and sustains all beings. Just as the ripe fruit gently detaches from its stem, free us from the bonds of illness and death, but never from divine immortality.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Canto védico solemne y tanpura profunda

oraciones.titulo: Expanded Gayatri Mantra: Enlightenment of the Mind and Intellect
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात्॥ (Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah Tat Savitur Varenyam...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Bhur Bhu-vah Svah, Tat Sa-vi-tur Va-ren-yam, Bhar-go De-vas-ya Dhi-ma-hi, Dhi-yo Yo Nah Pra-cho-da-yat.
oraciones.textoTraducido: We meditate on the supreme glory of that Divine Creator, spiritual Sun of the universe that illuminates the three planes of existence (physical, astral and celestial). May its divine light awaken, guide and purify our understanding and intellect towards the supreme truth.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Tanpura clásica india y sonido del amanecer en el río Ganges

oraciones.titulo: Ganapati Atharvashirsha: Supplication to Remove All Obstacles
oraciones.textoOriginal: ॐ नमस्ते गणपतये। त्वमेव प्रत्यक्षं तत्त्वमसि। त्वमेव केवलं कर्ताऽसि... (Om Namaste Ganapataye...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Na-mas-te Ga-na-pa-ta-ye. Tvam-e-va prat-yak-sham tat-tvam-a-si. Tvam-e-va ke-va-lam kar-ta-si...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Homage to You, Lord Ganesha! You are the manifested Supreme Truth, the Creator, Sustainer and Protector of all that exists. Clear every visible and invisible obstacle from our path, bless our projects and grant us wisdom, discernment and success in good.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Campanilla de puja india y canto védico de pandits

oraciones.titulo: Shiva Tandava Stotram: The Hymn of the Danza Cósmica of Shiva
oraciones.textoOriginal: जटाटवीगलज्जलप्रवाहपावितस्थले गलेऽवलम्ब्य लम्बितां भुजङ्गतुङ्गमालिकाम्... (Jatatavee galajjala pravaha pavitasthale...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ja-ta-ta-vi ga-laj-ja-la pra-va-ja pa-vi-tas-tha-le, ga-le-va-lam-bya lam-bi-tam bhu-jan-ga-tun-ga-ma-li-kam...
oraciones.textoTraducido: From Shiva's tangled hair the sacred waters of the Ganges flow, purifying the earth. With his cosmic dance he destroys ignorance, limitation and fear, renewing the universe in a symphony of light and infinite beauty.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Tambor Damaru de Shiva y recitación rítmica poderosa

oraciones.titulo: Mahalakshmi Ashtakam: Supplication of Abundance, Pureza and Gracia
oraciones.textoOriginal: नमस्तेऽस्तु महामाये श्रीपीठे सुरपूजिते। शङ्खचक्रगदाहस्ते महालक्ष्मि नमोऽस्तु ते॥ (Namastestu Mahamaye Shreepithe surapoojite...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Na-mas-tes-tu Ma-ja-ma-ye Shri-pi-the su-ra-pu-ji-te, Shan-kha-chak-ra-ga-da-jas-te Ma-ja-laksh-mi na-mo-stu te...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Homage to You, Great Mother Mahalakshmi, worshiped by the sages and deities! You who dwell in the lotus and spread prosperity, health and harmony in the home: bless our abode with purity, drive away lack and fill our lives with generosity and peace.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Bamboo flute Bansuri y campanas ceremoniales de plata

oraciones.titulo: Saraswati Vandana: Prayer for the Wisdom, Memoria and Creatividad
oraciones.textoOriginal: या कुन्देन्दुतुषारहारधवला या शुभ्रवस्त्रावृता या वीणावरदण्डमण्डितकरा... (Ya Kundendu tushara hara dhavala...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Kun-den-du tu-sha-ra ja-ra dha-va-la, ya shub-hra vas-tra-vri-ta, ya vi-na va-ra dan-da man-di-ta ka-ra...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om Tat Sat! We invoke the supreme divine light and grace in this sacred contemplation of Saraswati Vandana: Prayer for the Wisdom, Memoria and Creatividad. May transcendent wisdom and pure knowledge dispel all darkness and ignorance from our mind, filling our life with inner peace, equanimity, discernment, and spiritual elevation. Om Shanti, Shanti, Shanti.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Veena india clásica y canto devocional suave

oraciones.titulo: Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti (Ajmer Sharif): 'Love for all, hate for none'
oraciones.textoOriginal: محبت سب کے لئے، نفرت کسی سے نہیں۔ یا غریب نواز، کرم فرما... (Mohabbat sab ke liye, nafrat kisi se nahi...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Mo-jab-bat sab ke li-ye, naf-rat ki-si se na-jin. Ya Gha-rib Na-waz, ka-ram far-ma...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Lord of Infinite Generosity! Grant us a heart with the generosity of the river, the tenderness of the sun and the hospitality of the land. Love for all, hate for none. May no poor or afflicted leave without comfort from our presence.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Qawwali acústico suave de Ajmer Sharif con armonio

oraciones.titulo: Nizamuddin Auliya and Amir Khusrau: Prayer of Mystical Surrender of the Soul
oraciones.textoOriginal: چھاپ تلک سب چھینی رے موسے نیناں ملائیکے... (Chhap tilak sab chhini re mose naina milai ke...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Chhap ti-lak sab chhi-ni re mo-se nai-na mi-lai ke...
oraciones.textoTraducido: With a single glance of your divine love you have erased all my vanities and earthly appearances. I have given myself completely to You, Source of all beauty. Make my life seek no other desire than your holy presence and pleasure.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Armonio sufí y palmas rítmicas suaves de Qawwali

oraciones.titulo: Dua from Jama Masjid Grand Mosque of Delhi: Peace and Brotherhood
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالإِكْرَامِ (Allahumma Antas-Salam wa minkas-salam...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Al-la-jum-ma An-tas-Sa-lam wa min-kas-sa-lam, ta-ba-rak-ta ya Dhal-Ja-la-li wal-Ik-ram...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes all true Peace! Blessed are you, Owner of Majesty and Honor. Pour out your serenity on this ancient land; Remove discord between brothers and grant us to live in harmony, mutual respect and prosperity.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Llamada a la oración Adhan de Delhi y murmullo reverente

oraciones.titulo: Mool Mantar (Guru Nanak): The Primordial Truth of the One Creator
oraciones.textoOriginal: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ॥ (Ik Onkar Satnam Karta Purakh Nirbhau Nirvair...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ik On-kar Sat-nam Kar-ta Pu-rakh Nir-bha-u Nir-vair A-kal Mu-rat A-ju-ni Sai-bhang Gur Pra-sad.
oraciones.textoTraducido: There is only one Universal Creator; the Truth is his Name. He is the Supreme Creator, Fearless, Hateless, Immortal Image, Unborn, Self-existent, known by the Grace of the True Master. Meditate on its eternal Truth.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Kirtan sagrado del Templo Dorado de Amritsar con armonio y rabab

oraciones.titulo: Japji Sahib: Morning Prayer of Wisdom and Righteousness
oraciones.textoOriginal: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਚਲਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ॥ (Hukami rajai chalna Nanak likhia naal...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ju-kam ra-za-i chal-na Na-nak likh-i-a naal...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the luminous presence of the Universal Source and the Creator of all life, we align our hearts with Japji Sahib: Morning Prayer of Wisdom and Righteousness. May the light of truth, the power of unconditional love, and profound peace flood our being, guiding our thoughts and actions toward harmony, serenity, and unity with all creation. So it is and so it shall be. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Recitación matutina solemne del Japji Sahib

oraciones.titulo: Sikh Ardas: Standing Prayer for the Uplifted Spirit (Chardi Kala)
oraciones.textoOriginal: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਚੜ੍ਹਦੀ ਕਲਾ, ਤੇਰੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਸਰਬੱਤ ਦਾ ਭਲਾ॥ (Nanak Naam Chardi Kala, tere bhane sarbat da bhala...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Na-nak Naam Char-di Ka-la, te-re bha-ne sar-bat da bha-la.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Lord! Through the Holy Name proclaimed by Nanak, grant us to always maintain the high and unbreakable spirit (*Chardi Kala*), and may through your blessing there be prosperity, peace and well-being for all humanity without exception.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Coro Sikh de pie entonando la Ardas con campanas

oraciones.titulo: Tav-Prasad Savaiye (Guru Gobind Singh): 'Only He Who Loves Reaches God'
oraciones.textoOriginal: ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੋਂ ਸੁਨ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਭੈ ਜਿਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀਓ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਇਓ॥ (Saach kahon sun leho sabhai jin prem kio tin hee prabh paio...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Saach ka-jon sun le-jo sa-bhai jin prem ki-o tin ji prabh pa-i-o.
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the luminous presence of the Universal Source and the Creator of all life, we align our hearts with Tav. May the light of truth, the power of unconditional love, and profound peace flood our being, guiding our thoughts and actions toward harmony, serenity, and unity with all creation. So it is and so it shall be. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Kirtan acústico con Taus y Tabla

oraciones.titulo: Lal Shahbaz Qalandar (Sehwan Sharif): Supplication of Éxtasis and Libertad
oraciones.textoOriginal: حیدریم قلندرم مستم، بندۂ مرتضیٰ علی ہستم... (Haidariyam qalandaram mastam...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Jai-da-ri-yam qa-lan-da-ram mas-tam, ban-da-ye Mur-ta-za A-li jas-tam. Da-ma-dam Mast Qa-lan-dar...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the ecstasy of sacred love I dance free from the bonds of the world. Oh Lord! Break the shackles of my pride and fill me with the intoxicating fire of your eternal love, where there is no fear or sadness.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Nobbath y tambores místicos de Sehwan Sharif

oraciones.titulo: Hazrat Sultan Bahoo (Abyat-e-Bahoo): The Jasmine of Divine Love ('Hoo')
oraciones.textoOriginal: الف اللہ چمبے دی بوٹی من میرے وچ لائی ہو... (Alif Allah chambey di booti mann mere vich laayi Hoo...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: A-lif Al-lah cham-bey di bu-ti mann me-re vich la-yi Ju...
oraciones.textoTraducido: My Master has planted the jasmine of divine love of Allah in my heart. Watered with the water of continuous memory, its heavenly fragrance floods my entire being. Hoo! May he who planted this light in my soul live forever.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Kafi tradicional punyabí suave con Reed flute

oraciones.titulo: Shah Abdul Latif Bhittai: Prayer for the Abundance and Peace of Humanity
oraciones.textoOriginal: سائين سدائين ڪرين مٿي سنڌ سڪار، دوست مٺا دلدار عالم سڀ آباد ڪرين... (Saeen sadayeen karein mathe Sindh sukaar...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Sa-yeen sa-da-yeen ka-rein ma-the Sindh su-kar, dost mi-tha dil-dar a-lam sabh a-baad ka-rein...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Lord and Beloved Sovereign! May fertility and abundance always bless Sindh, and O Sweet Friend, fill the entire world with peace, prosperity and well-being.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Instrumento Danburo tradicional de Sindh y cantos poéticos de Bhit Shah

oraciones.titulo: Baba Bulleh Shah: Prayer of the Corazón Limpio and Fraternidad Humana
oraciones.textoOriginal: مسجد ڈھا دے، مندر ڈھا دے، ڈھا دے جو کچھ ڈہندا، پر کسے دا دل نہ ڈھاویں... (Masjid dha de, mandir dha de...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Mas-jid dha de, man-dir dha de, dha de jo kuchh dahn-da, par ki-se da dil na dha-veen, rab di-laan vich rahnda...
oraciones.textoTraducido: The walls of temples and mosques may fall, but never hurt the heart of a fellow human being, because it is in the sincere and broken heart where God truly lives. Cleanse us of all prejudice and teach us to love without divisions.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Reed flute Bansuri punyabí y cuerdas de Iktara

oraciones.titulo: Dua of the Great Mosques of Pakistan: Peace and National Protection
oraciones.textoOriginal: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ (Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Rab-ba-na a-ti-na fid-dun-ya ja-sa-na-tan wa fil-a-khi-ra-ti ja-sa-na-tan wa qi-na a-dha-ban-nar...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Our Lord! Grant us what is good and noble in this present life and blessedness in the Hereafter, and preserve us from the punishment of fire. Keep our nation in justice, protect our families and spread peace in every home.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Recitación coránica en la gran nave de la Mezquita Faisal

oraciones.titulo: Dua Kumayl (Imam Ali): Supplication of the Mercy Infinita and Refugio
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ، وَبِقُوَّتِكَ الَّتِي قَهَرْتَ بِهَا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ... (Allahumma inni as'aluka bi-rahmatika...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Al-la-jum-ma in-ni as-a-lu-ka bi-raj-ma-ti-kal-la-ti wa-si-at kul-la shay, wa bi-quw-wa-ti-kal-la-ti qa-jar-ta bi-ja kul-la shay...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh my God! I beg you for your infinite, all-encompassing mercy, for your sovereign power to which everything bows, and for your forgiveness that knows no limits. Who but You can forgive my faults and heal my afflicted heart? I take refuge in You, oh my Lord and my Hope.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Recitación solemne y emotiva de Dua Kumayl en la noche

oraciones.titulo: Hadith al-Kisa: Prayer of the Mantle of Purification and Descent of Angels
oraciones.textoOriginal: إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنكُمُ الرِّجْسَ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيرًا (Innama yuridullahu liyudh-hiba 'ankumur-rijsa...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: In-na-ma yu-ri-dul-la-ju li-yudh-ji-ba an-ku-mur-rij-sa Aj-lal-Bay-ti wa yu-tah-ji-ra-kum tat-ji-ra...
oraciones.textoTraducido: By the blessing of the Holy Mantle under which the Prophet Muhammad, Ali, Fatima, Hassan and Hussain were gathered: may the peace of the angels descend upon our home, the shadows of sadness be dispelled and harmony and heavenly grace always abide.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Recitación suave de Hadith al-Kisa en familia

oraciones.titulo: Ziyarat Ashura: Prayer of Firmeza in the Justice and Lealtad Moral
oraciones.textoOriginal: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَعَلَى الأَرْوَاحِ الَّتِي حَلَّتْ بِفِنَائِكَ... (Assalamu 'alayka ya Aba 'Abdillah...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: As-sa-la-mu a-lay-ka ya A-ba Ab-dil-lah, wa a-lal-ar-wa-hil-la-ti jal-lat bi-fi-na-ik...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Peace be upon you, O Imam Hussain, martyr of human dignity and justice. May your example of integrity and courage inspire our lives to never kneel before oppression and always defend the defenseless.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Recitación conmovedora de Ziyarat y Reverent silence

oraciones.titulo: Mariamabad (Punjab): Prayer to Mariam Mai for Peace and the Sick
oraciones.textoOriginal: اے مریم مائی، ہماری مددگار، اپنے بیٹے یسوع سے ہمارے لئے امن اور شفا مانگ... (Ae Mariam Mai, hamari madadgar...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ae Ma-ri-am Mai, ja-ma-ri ma-dad-gar, ap-ne be-te Ya-su se ja-ma-re li-ye amn aur shi-fa mang...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Mother Mary (*Mariam Mai*), help and comfort in Mariamabad! Intercede with your beloved Son Jesus Christ for our families, heal the sick who come with faith to your sanctuary and spread the blessing of peace and fraternal coexistence on all the people of Pakistan.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Campanas del santuario de Mariamabad y cantos litúrgicos en urdu (Geet)

oraciones.titulo: Prayer of the Church of Pakistan for Concord and Dignity
oraciones.textoOriginal: اے قادرِ مطلق خدا، ہمارے ملک پاکستان پر اپنا رحم فرما اور ہمیں ایک دوسرے کے ساتھ پیار اور سچائی سے رہنا سکھا... (Ae Qadir-e-Mutlaq Khuda...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ae Qa-dir-e-Mut-laq Khu-da, ja-ma-re mulk Pa-kis-tan par ap-na ra-jam far-ma aur ja-mein ek dus-re ke saath py-aar aur sach-a-yi se rah-na sikha...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Almighty God (*Khuda-e-Taala*)! Pour out your mercy on our nation; protect us in the truth and teach us to love one another with mutual respect. May the seed of justice and human dignity flourish in each province.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Himno cristiano en urdu con armonio y tabla

oraciones.titulo: Hinglaj Mata (Balochistán): Prayer of Protection a the Peregrinos
oraciones.textoOriginal: जय माता हिंगलाज, रक्षा करो हमारे मार्गों की। (Jaya Mata Hinglaj, raksha karo hamare margon ki...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ja-ya Ma-ta Jing-laj, rak-sha ka-ro ja-ma-re mar-gon ki. Om Jing-la-ja Ma-ta-ye Na-ma-ja...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Glory to the Holy Mother Hinglaj (*Kottari Devi*) in the holy mountains of Balochistan! Guard the steps of the pilgrims who cross the deserts, remove the dangers from the path and spread your mantle of protection and harmony over all the inhabitants of the earth.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Bell of templo en la cueva de Hinglaj y eco del viento en el desierto

oraciones.titulo: Hazrat Shah Jalal (Sylhet): Supplication for Protection in Rivers and Crops
oraciones.textoOriginal: হে আল্লাহ! আমাদের এই নদীমাতৃক বাংলাকে প্রাকৃতিক দুর্যোগ ও তুফান হইতে রক্ষা করো... (He Allah! Amader ei nodimatrik Banglake...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Je Al-lah! A-ma-der ei no-di-mat-rik Bang-la-ke prak-ri-tik dur-yog o tu-fan hoi-te rok-kha ko-ro... Ya Rab-bal A-la-min...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Allah, Lord of the Worlds and Creator of rivers! By the barakah of your saints who planted faith in Sylhet: protect our valleys against monsoon floods and storms, bless the rice and tea fields with abundant fruit and shower our families with peace and generous hospitality.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Sonido del río Surma, lluvia monzónica suave y canto sufí en Sylhet

oraciones.titulo: Hazrat Khan Jahan Ali (Bagerhat): Prayer of Caridad and Concordia
oraciones.textoOriginal: হে পরম করুণাময় আল্লাহ, মানবসেবায় আমাদের জীবন উৎসর্গ করার তৌফিক দান করো... (He Porom Korunamoy Allah...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Je Po-rom Ko-ru-na-moy Al-lah, ma-nob-se-bay a-ma-der ji-bon ut-sor-go ko-rar tou-fik dan ko-ro...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Merciful God! Grant us to serve humanity with works of lasting good: digging wells of clean water for the thirsty, building bridges of reconciliation between peoples and building spaces of worship and peace where everyone finds shelter.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Eco reverente dentro de la Mezquita de las 60 Cúpulas y agua de estanque

oraciones.titulo: Fakir Lalon Shah: 'The Unknown Bird in the Body Cage' (Ochin Pakhi)
oraciones.textoOriginal: খাঁচার ভিতর অচিন পাখি কেমনে আসে যায়। তারে ধরতে পারলে মনবেড়ি দিতাম পাখির পায়... (Khachar bhitor ochin pakhi kemne ashe jay...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Kha-char bhi-tor o-chin pa-khi kem-ne a-she jay. Ta-re dhor-te par-le mon-be-ri di-tam pa-khir pay...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the luminous presence of the Universal Source and the Creator of all life, we align our hearts with Fakir Lalon Shah: 'The Unknown Bird in the Body Cage' (Ochin Pakhi). May the light of truth, the power of unconditional love, and profound peace flood our being, guiding our thoughts and actions toward harmony, serenity, and unity with all creation. So it is and so it shall be. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Instrumento Ektara de una cuerda, Dotara y campanas de tobillo de los Bauls

oraciones.titulo: Bishwa Ijtema (Akheri Munajat): Great Cry of Millions for World Peace
oraciones.textoOriginal: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ... হে আল্লাহ, সারা দুনিয়ায় শান্তি দান করো... (Rabbana zalamna anfusana...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Rab-ba-na za-lam-na an-fu-sa-na wa il-lam tagh-fir la-na wa tar-jam-na la-na-ku-nan-na mi-nal-kha-si-rin... Je Al-lah, sa-ra du-ni-yay shan-ti dan ko-ro...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Our Lord! We have been unfair to ourselves; If You do not forgive us and have no mercy on us, we will certainly be among the lost. O Allah! Unite the hearts of all humanity, stop wars and suffering, alleviate the hunger of the helpless and spread your blessing and peace over every corner of the earth.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Murmullo reverente de millones de peregrinos diciendo 'Ameen' al unísono en Tongi

oraciones.titulo: Mezquita Nacional Baitul Mukarram: Prayer for the Prosperity of the Nación
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي أَرْضِنَا وَثِمَارِنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا شَاكِرِينَ لِنِعَمِكَ (Allahumma barik lana fi ardina...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Al-la-jum-ma ba-rik la-na fi ar-di-na wa thi-ma-ri-na waj-al-na sha-ki-ri-na li-ni-a-mik...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Allah! Bless our fertile land, our rivers and the fruit of our crops. Make us always grateful servants of your innumerable favors, free us from scarcity and discord, and guide our society along paths of dignity, justice and shared well-being.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Adhan resonando en la mezquita nacional de Dhaka y brisa sobre el río Buriganga

oraciones.titulo: Baba Lokenath (Barodi): 'In Danger and Affliction, Remember Me and I will Save You'
oraciones.textoOriginal: রণে, বনে, জলে, জঙ্গলে যখনই বিপদে পড়িবে, আমাকে স্মরণ করিবে, আমিই রক্ষা করিব। (Rone, bone, jole, jongole jokhoni bipode poribe...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ro-ne, bo-ne, jo-le, jon-go-le jok-ho-ni bi-po-de po-ri-be, a-ma-ke smo-ron ko-ri-be, a-mi-i rok-kha ko-ri-bo. Joy Ba-ba Lo-ke-nath...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om Tat Sat! We invoke the supreme divine light and grace in this sacred contemplation of Baba Lokenath (Barodi): 'In Danger and Affliction, Remember Me and I will Save You'. May transcendent wisdom and pure knowledge dispel all darkness and ignorance from our mind, filling our life with inner peace, equanimity, discernment, and spiritual elevation. Om Shanti, Shanti, Shanti.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Canto solemne de 'Jai Baba Lokenath' con campanas y caracola sagrada Shankha

oraciones.titulo: Sri Dhakeshwari Durga: Pushpanjali and Victory over the Oscuridad
oraciones.textoOriginal: सर्वमङ्गलमङ्गल्ये शिवे सर्वार्थसाधिके। शरण्ये त्र्यम्बके गौरि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥ (Sarva mangala mangalye Shive sarvartha sadhike...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Sar-va man-ga-la man-gal-ye Shi-ve sar-var-tha sa-dhi-ke, Sha-ran-ye Tryam-ba-ke Gou-ri Na-ra-ya-ni na-mo-stu te...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Divine Mother Sri Dhakeshwari, source of all good and auspiciousness, supreme protector and fulfiller of all pure purposes! Before You we offer fresh flowers and reverent hearts. Dispel the shadows of ignorance, conquer adversity and fill our homes with peace and lasting joy.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Tambores Dhak sagrados del Durga Puja de Dhaka y caracola Shankha

oraciones.titulo: Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu: Sikshashtakam (Purification of the Heart)
oraciones.textoOriginal: चेतोदर्पणमार्जनं भवमहादावाग्नि-निर्वापणम्। श्रेयःकैरवचन्द्रिकावितरणं विद्यावधूजीवनम्॥ (Ceto-darpana-marjanam bhava-maha-davagni-nirvapanam...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Che-to-dar-pa-na mar-ja-nam bha-va ma-ja-da-vag-ni nir-va-pa-nam, shre-yah kai-ra-va chan-dri-ka vi-ta-ra-nam vid-ya-va-dhu ji-va-nam...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Supreme glory to the Holy Song of the Name of God that cleanses the mirror of the heart of all earthly dust, extinguishes the ravenous fire of suffering of material existence and sheds the light of the full moon of bliss in the soul!

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Kirtan de Bengala con Mridanga de arcilla y platillos Karatalas

oraciones.titulo: Anandamayi Ma: Prayer of Alegría Pura and Entrega a the Voluntad Divina
oraciones.textoOriginal: ভগবানকে লাভ করাই জীবনের একমাত্র উদ্দেশ্য। যা কিছু ঘটে সবই তাঁর মঙ্গল বিধান... (Bhagabanke labh korai...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Bha-ga-ban-ke labh ko-ra-i ji-bo-ner ek-mat-ro ud-de-sho. Ja ki-chhu gho-te sa-bi tanr mon-gol bi-dhan...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Knowing God and abiding in his love is the only supreme purpose of life. Everything that happens under the sun is for our supreme good guided by its infinite wisdom. Remain silent, trust like a child in its mother's arms and be happy at all times.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Canto devocional bengalí suave y armonio clásico

oraciones.titulo: Atiśa Dīpaṃkara (Bikrampur): Prayer of Iluminación and Compasión Suprema
oraciones.textoOriginal: བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་མཆོག་རིན་པོ་ཆེ། མ་སྐྱེས་པ་རྣམས་སྐྱེ་གྱུར་ཅིག (Jangchub semchok rinpoche ma kye pa nam kye gyur chik...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Jang-chub sem-chok rin-po-che ma kye pa nam kye gyur chik, kye-pa nyam-pa me-pa yang, gong ne gong du pel-war shok...
oraciones.textoTraducido: May the precious mind of awakening and infinite compassion (*Bodhicitta*), where it has not yet been born, sprout and flourish; and where it has already been born, may it never decline, but rather increase more and more to free all sentient beings from suffering!

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Campana budista de Bikrampur y cuenco de resonancia suave

oraciones.titulo: Rangamati Paritta (Ratana Sutta): Communal Protection and Blessing
oraciones.textoOriginal: ਯਾਨੀਧ ਭੂਤਾਨਿ ਸਮਾਗਤਾਨਿ ਭੁਮ੍ਮਾਨਿ ਵਾ ਯਾਨਿ ਵਾ ਅਨ੍ਤਲਿਕ੍ਖੇ... (Yanidha bhutani samagatani... Etena saccena suvatthi hotu!)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya-ni-dha bhu-ta-ni sa-ma-ga-ta-ni, bhum-ma-ni va ya-ni va an-ta-lik-khe... E-te-na sac-ce-na su-vat-thi jo-tu!
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Rangamati Paritta (Ratana Sutta): Communal Protection and Blessing. May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Canto rítmico Paritta en Pali de los monjes de Chittagong y Bell of pagoda

oraciones.titulo: Kathina Chibar Dan: Gatha of Generosidad Pura and Gratitude
oraciones.textoOriginal: ইমং কথিন চীবরং সঙ্ঘস্স দেম। (Imang kathina chibarang sanghassa dema...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: I-mang ka-thi-na chi-ba-rang sang-ghas-sa de-ma, sang-gho i-mang pa-ti-gga-nha-tu...
oraciones.textoTraducido: We offer this sacred Kathina robe to the venerable Sangha of monks. May this offering born of pure generosity bring inexhaustible merit, blessing to our ancestors and peace to our entire community.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Campanillas de templo budista y murmullo de fieles en el festival de Kathina

oraciones.titulo: Panjora Shrine (Gazipur): Supplication to Saint Anthony for Miracles and Health
oraciones.textoOriginal: হে সাধু আন্তনী, দীন-দরিদ্রের সহায়ক, আমাদের অসুস্থতা ও বিপদে ঈশ্বরের কাছে সুপারিশ করো... (He Sadhu Antoni...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Je Sa-dhu An-to-ni, din-do-rid-rer so-ja-yok, a-ma-der o-sush-to-ta o bi-po-de Ish-wo-rer ka-chhe su-pa-rish ko-ro...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh blessed Saint Anthony of Panjora, protection of the poor and consolation of the afflicted of all beliefs! Intercede before God for the healing of our sick, find what we have lost along the way and pour out miraculous peace on our families.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Campanas campestres de la iglesia de Panjora y cantos litúrgicos en bengalí

oraciones.titulo: Rabindranath Tagore (Gitanjali): 'Where the Mind Has No Fear' (Chitto Jetha Bhayshunyo)
oraciones.textoOriginal: চিত্ত যেথা ভয়শূন্য, উচ্চ যেথা শির, জ্ঞান যেথা মুক্ত, যেথা গৃহের প্রাচীর... (Chitto jetha bhayshunyo, uchho jetha shir...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Chit-to je-tha bhay-shun-yo, uch-chho je-tha shir, gyan je-tha muk-to, je-tha gri-jer pra-chir...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Where the mind is fearless and the head is held high; where knowledge is free; where the world is not fragmented by narrow dividing walls; Towards that heaven of freedom, my Father, awaken my nation and all humanity.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Sitar suave, Bamboo flute y lectura poética de Gitanjali

oraciones.titulo: Sunan Kalijaga: Lir-Ilir (Javanese Song of the Awakening of the Soul)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Lir-ilir, lir-ilir, tandure wus sumilir, tak ijo royo-royo tak senggo temanten anyar... (Despierta, el follaje ha florecido en verde vida).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Lir-i-lir, lir-i-lir, tan-du-re wus su-mi-lir, tak i-jo ro-yo-ro-yo tak seng-go te-man-ten a-nyar...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Wake up, wake up, my soul! See how the fields of the spirit bloom with sacred greenery. Wash your clothes on the shore of virtue, climb the hill of perseverance and welcome the light of God while the full moon shines in the firmament.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Gamelán javanés suave, flauta Suling y canto melódico tradicional

oraciones.titulo: Sunan Kalijaga: Kidung Rumekso ing Wengi (Protection Nocturna Sagrada)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ana kidung rumeksa ing wengi, teguh ayu luputa ing lara, luputa bilahi kabeh... (Hay un canto que vela en la noche...).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: A-na ki-dung ru-mek-sa ing weng-i, te-guh a-yu lu-pu-ta ing la-ra, lu-pu-ta bi-la-ji ka-beh...
oraciones.textoTraducido: There is a prayer that watches over the stillness of the night: it confers unbreakable health, wards off illnesses, banishes the snares of evil and wards off all misfortune. Whoever rests under the protection of God wakes up in peace and blessing.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Gamelán suave de medianoche y canto solemne javanés

oraciones.titulo: Gran Mezquita Istiqlal of Yakarta: Prayer for Harmony and Convivencia
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ya Allah Yang Maha Pengasih, berkahilah bangsa kami dengan persatuan, kedamaian, dan kerukunan antarumat beragama...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Al-lah Yang Ma-ja Pe-nga-sih, ber-ka-ji-lah bang-sa ka-mi de-ngan per-sa-tu-an, ke-da-mai-an...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Allah, the Most Compassionate and Protector! Bless our nation of thousands of islands with lasting peace, tolerance and mutual respect among all faiths and cultures (*Bhinneka Tunggal Ika*). Unite our hearts in justice and common well-being.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Bell of paz y llamada solemne a la oración Adhan de Yakarta

oraciones.titulo: Bali Tri Sandhya Puja: Solar Prayer for Purification and Forgiveness
oraciones.textoOriginal: Om bhur bhuvah svah, tat savitur varenyam... Om Narayana evedam sarvam... Om ksamasva mam Mahadeva... (Om Shanti, Shanti, Shanti, Om).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om bhur bhu-vah svah, tat sa-vi-tur va-ren-yam... Om Na-ra-ya-na e-ve-dam sar-vam... Om ksha-mas-va mam Ma-ja-de-va... Om Shan-ti, Shan-ti, Shan-ti, Om.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Om, Supreme God, source of the three worlds. Everything that exists comes from You, Supreme Lord Narayana. Forgive, O Mahadeva, my faults committed by body, word or thought; Cleanse us of all stains and fill the cosmos with peace, peace, infinite peace.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Campana balinesa Genta, incienso y canto ceremonial de sacerdotes Pedanda

oraciones.titulo: Kramaning Sembah (Bali): Prayer of the Five Offerings of Pure Flowers
oraciones.textoOriginal: Om atma tattvatma suddha mam svaha. Om hrang hring sah Paramasiva Radityaya namo namah...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om at-ma tat-tvat-ma sud-dha mam sva-ja. Om jrang jring sah Pa-ra-ma-shi-va Ra-dit-ya-ya na-mo na-mah...
oraciones.textoTraducido: With hands joined in lotus and scented flower petals we pay obeisance to the Supreme Creator (*Sang Hyang Widhi Wasa*) and the Sun of truth. May our soul (*Atman*) remain clean of selfishness and aligned with the divine order of the universe (*Dharma*).

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Gamelán balinés Gong Kebyar suave y sonido de agua de fuente sagrada Tirta Empul

oraciones.titulo: Hari Raya Saraswati (Bali): Prayer of Wisdom and Conocimiento Santo
oraciones.textoOriginal: Om Saraswati namastubhyam varade kama rupini, siddhirambham karisyami siddhir bhavantu me sada.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Sa-ras-wa-ti na-mas-tub-hyam va-ra-de ka-ma ru-pi-ni, sid-dhi-ram-bham ka-ris-ya-mi sid-dhir bha-van-tu me sa-da.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Homage to You, Goddess Saraswati, endowment of blessings and form of sacred knowledge! As we begin our studies and work, grant us success, clear memory, and the wisdom to use knowledge for the good of all beings.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Gamelán balinés Selonding y sonido de brisa entre palmeras

oraciones.titulo: Tuan Ma of Larantuka (Flowers): Maternal Supplication and Protection of the Seas
oraciones.textoOriginal: O Ina Maria, Tuan Ma yang berbelas kasih, lindungilah anak-anakmu di laut dan di darat...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O I-na Ma-ri-a, Tu-an Ma yang ber-be-las ka-sih, lin-du-ngi-lah a-nak-a-nak-mu di la-ut dan di da-rat...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Holy Mother Mary, Tuan Ma full of compassion! You who watch over the sailors and fishermen of our islands: calm the wild waves of the sea, comfort mothers in their sorrows and guide our families in fidelity to your beloved Son Jesus Christ.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Cantos solemnes de la procesión marítima de Larantuka y rumor de olas

oraciones.titulo: Tangiang Batak (Sumatra): Prayer of Gratitude and Blessing Familyr
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ale Debata Amanami na di banuaginjang, sai pasupasu ma hami pomparanmon di bagasan dame dohot holong...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: A-le De-ba-ta A-ma-na-mi na di ba-nu-a-gin-jang, sai pa-su-pa-su ma ja-mi pom-pa-ran-mon di ba-ga-san da-me...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh God our Father who art in Heaven (*Debate*)! Pour out your blessing on our families and lineages. May sincere love and peace dwell in our homes on the shores of Lake Toba, and may our children grow in righteousness and wisdom.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Instrumento Taganing batak tradicional y coro a cuatro voces

oraciones.titulo: Mystical Kejawen: Sangkan Paraning Dumadi (Origin and Sacred Return)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Urip iku mung mampir ngombe. Eling marang Gusti Kang Akarya Jagad, bali marang sangkan paraning dumadi.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: U-rip i-ku mung mam-pir ngom-be. E-ling ma-rang Gus-ti Kang A-kar-ya Ja-gad, ba-li ma-rang sang-kan pa-ra-ning du-ma-di.
oraciones.textoTraducido: This earthly life is brief like someone who stops for a moment to drink water on the road. Always remember the Lord Creator of the Universe (*Gusti Kang Akarya Jagad*); live with righteousness, kindness and detachment, preparing the soul for its luminous return to the Origin of all being.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Bamboo flute Suling solitaria y agua de arroyo de montaña javanesa

oraciones.titulo: Holy Child of Cebu: Bato Balani sa Gugma (Magnet of Divine Love)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Bato balani sa gugma, sa daang tawo kaluoy; Kanimo nangayo kami'g tabang, abawi sa among kasakit... Pit Señor!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ba-to ba-la-ni sa gug-ma, sa da-ang ta-wo ka-lu-oy; Ka-ni-mo nang-a-yo ka-mig ta-bang, a-ba-wi sa a-mong ka-sa-kit... Pit Se-ñor!
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Holy Child of Cebu, magnet of divine love and consolation of the people! We come to You begging for your help: relieve our pain, protect our children and families, and attract our hearts with the magnet of your infinite mercy. Long live the Santo Niño! Hoot Lord!

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Canto solemne con vaivén de manos del 'Bato Balani sa Gugma' y campanas de Cebú

oraciones.titulo: Our Father Jesus Nazarene of Quiapo: Prayer for Strength and Healing
oraciones.textoOriginal: Poong Hesus Nazareno, Kaawaan Mo po kami. Patawarin Mo ang aming mga kasalanan at pagalingin ang aming karamdaman...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Po-ong Je-sus Na-za-re-no, Ka-a-wa-an Mo po ka-mi. Pa-ta-wa-rin Mo ang a-ming m-ga ka-sa-la-nan...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Our Father Jesus Nazarene of Quiapo! Who carried the heavy cross for our salvation: look with mercy at our suffering, heal our physical and spiritual ailments, forgive our guilt and give us strength to carry our daily crosses with unbreakable faith.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Clamor y cantos devocionales de la multitud en Quiapo y campanas

oraciones.titulo: Our Lady of Peñafrancia (Bicol): Refuge in Storms and Floods
oraciones.textoOriginal: O Ina nin Peñafrancia, danay kaming tabangan asin kurahawan nin bilog na puso: Viva la Virgen!
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O I-na nin Pe-ña-fran-cia, da-nay ka-ming ta-ba-ngan a-sin ku-ra-ja-wan nin bi-log na pu-so: Vi-va la Vir-gen!
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Mother of Peñafrancia (*Ina*), protection of Bicolandia! We cry to You in the midst of typhoons and storms: spread your sacred mantle over our houses and fields, protect the sailors and spread the dew of peace over our entire homeland. Long live the Virgin!

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Grito jubiloso '¡Viva la Virgen!' y repique de campanas de Naga City

oraciones.titulo: Our Lady of Manaoag: Supplication for the Sick and Travelers
oraciones.textoOriginal: O Birhen na Manaoag, Ina na panangasi, ipikasi mo kami ed Anak mo ya si Hesukristo...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O Bir-jen na Ma-na-o-ag, I-na na pa-nang-a-si, i-pi-ka-si mo ka-mi ed A-nak mo ya si Je-su-kris-to...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Virgin of Manaoag, Mother who listens to the call of her children! We come to your sanctuary in search of health for the body and relief for the soul. Protect those who travel, dispel all illness and lead us along the path of your Holy Rosary.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Rezo del Santo Rosario en Tagalog y campanas de Manaoag

oraciones.titulo: Saint Lorenzo Ruiz: 'If I Had a Thousand Lives, I Would Give All of Them to God'
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ako'y isang Kristiyano, at mamamatay ako para sa Diyos; kung ako man ay may sanlibong buhay, lahat ay aking iaalay sa Kanya.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: A-koy i-sang Kris-ti-ya-no, at ma-ma-ma-tay a-ko pa-ra sa Di-yos; kung a-ko man ay may san-li-bong bu-jay, la-hat ay a-king i-a-a-lay sa Kan-ya.
oraciones.textoTraducido: I am a Christian and I will die for God; and if I had a thousand lives, I would offer all of them with joy to my Lord Jesus Christ. Pray for us, Saint Lorenzo Ruiz, so that we never renounce our faith in the face of any earthly trial.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Campanas sacras y coro litúrgico filipino solemne

oraciones.titulo: Saint Pedro Calungsod: Prayer of Consecration of the Juventud
oraciones.textoOriginal: San Pedro Calungsod, batan-ong saksi ni Kristo, i-ampo mo ang mga kabataan nga magmatinud-anon sa pagtuo...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: San Ped-ro Ca-lung-sod, ba-tan-ong sak-si ni Kris-to, i-am-po mo ang m-ga ka-ba-ta-an nga mag-ma-ti-nud-a-non sa pag-tu-o...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Saint Peter Calungsod, young martyr who gave your life serving with joy! Intercede for the youth of our time so that they resist the temptations of the world, love the truth of the Gospel, and be courageous witnesses of charity and purity.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Canto juvenil acústico de guitarra y coro

oraciones.titulo: Panalangin ng Pamilya: Filipino Home Blessing Prayer
oraciones.textoOriginal: Panginoong Diyos, itinataas po namin ang aming tahanan sa Iyo. Pagharian Mo ng pagmamahalan, kapayapaan at kasaganaan...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Pang-i-no-ong Di-yos, i-ti-na-ta-as po na-min ang a-ming ta-ha-nan sa I-yo. Pag-ja-ri-an Mo ng pag-ma-ma-ha-lan...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord our God! We consecrate our home to your sovereignty. May sincere love, mutual respect and peace reign in our house. Deliver us from scarcity, protect our children and give us wisdom to always walk in integrity.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Acoustic guitar suave y melodía cristiana en tagalog

oraciones.titulo: Bangsamoro (Cotabato): Dua for Peace and Justice in Mindanao
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا (Allahumma allif bayna qulubina... Ya Allah, pamagayunan kami sa kalilintad).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Al-la-jum-ma al-lif bay-na qu-lu-bi-na wa as-lih dha-ta bay-ni-na... Ya Al-lah, pa-ma-ga-yu-nan ka-mi sa ka-li-lin-tad.
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Allah, Source of all Peace! It unites the hearts of all the inhabitants of Mindanao and the southern islands. Heal the wounds of past conflicts, make justice and brotherhood flourish between Muslims and Christians, and fill our land with well-being and tranquility.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Instrumento Kulintang tradicional de gongs de bronce y Adhan suave

oraciones.titulo: Espíritu Bayanihan: Prayer for the Solidaridad and the Fuerza Comunitaria
oraciones.textoOriginal: Diyos ng aming lahi, pagkalooban Mo kami ng pusong handang tumulong at magbuhat ng pasanin ng aming kapwa...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Di-yos ng a-ming la-ji, pag-ka-lo-o-ban Mo ka-mi ng pu-song jan-dang tu-mu-long at mag-bu-hat ng pa-sa-nin...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the luminous presence of the Universal Source and the Creator of all life, we align our hearts with Espíritu Bayanihan: Prayer for the Solidaridad and the Fuerza Comunitaria. May the light of truth, the power of unconditional love, and profound peace flood our being, guiding our thoughts and actions toward harmony, serenity, and unity with all creation. So it is and so it shall be. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Sonido de la comunidad filipina cantando al unísono con guitarras

oraciones.titulo: Sheikh Uthman dan Fodio (Sokoto): Supplication of Wisdom and Justice
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا وَفَهْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ (Allahumma zidni 'ilman wa fahman... Ya Allah, ka ba mu shugabanci na adalci).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Al-la-jum-ma zid-ni il-man wa faj-man wa al-jiq-ni bis-sa-li-jin... Ya Al-lah, ka ba mu shu-ga-ban-ci na a-dal-ci.
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Allah! Increase in me useful knowledge and moral discernment, and join us to the company of the righteous. Grant righteousness to our leaders, eradicate oppression from our Sahel lands and make justice the shield of the helpless.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Recitación coránica clásica del Sahel con laúd Kakaki lejano

oraciones.titulo: Kano Grand Mosque: Prayer for Fertility and Safety of Families
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ya Allah, Ka albarkaci kasuwanmu da gonakinmu, Ka tsare iyalinmu daga dukkan sharri...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Al-lah, Ka al-bar-ka-ci ka-su-wan-mu da go-na-kin-mu, Ka tsa-re i-ya-lin-mu da-ga duk-kan shar-ri...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Sovereign Allah! Bless our ancient markets and our farm fields; Protect our families against all visible and invisible dangers and shower the city of Kano and all of Nigeria with lasting peace and clean abundance.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Ambiente sereno de mezquita en Kano y murmullo reverente de oración

oraciones.titulo: Tijaniyya Sufism of Nigeria: Salat al-Fatih (The Opening of the Light)
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الْفَاتِحِ لِمَا أُغْلِقَ، وَالْخَاتِمِ لِمَا سَبَقَ... (Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadinil-fatihi lima ughliq...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Al-la-jum-ma sal-li a-la Say-yi-di-na Mu-jam-ma-di-nil-fa-ti-ji li-ma ugh-liq, wal-kha-ti-mi li-ma sa-baq...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Allah! Bless our Master Muhammad, the opener of what was closed, the seal of what went before, the defender of Truth with Truth and the guide to your straight path. Open before us the doors of your grace and dispel all darkness.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Canto solemne de Zikr Tijaniyya al unísono

oraciones.titulo: RCCG Lagos: Cry of Supernatural Victory and Breaking of Chains
oraciones.textoOriginal: In the mighty Name of Jesus, every generational yoke is broken today! Olugbala mi, let Your fire fall and make a way...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: In de may-ti Neim of Ji-sas, ev-ri je-ne-rey-shon-al yok is bro-ken tu-dey! O-lug-ba-la mi, let Yur fayr fol...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the glorious Name of Jesus, every generational yoke of limitation or illness is broken today! Heavenly Father, pour out your holy fire, open doors that no man can close and fill my life with testimony, abundance and divine favor.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Alabanza pentecostal multitudinaria de Lagos con teclados y palmas de júbilo

oraciones.titulo: Church of Nigeria: Prayer for National Harmony and End of Violence
oraciones.textoOriginal: Almighty God, healer of the nations: bind the wounds of Nigeria, grant our people the grace to live in harmony...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Al-may-ti God, ji-ler of de ney-shons: baynd de wunds of Nay-ji-ri-a...
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the luminous presence of the Universal Source and the Creator of all life, we align our hearts with Church of Nigeria: Prayer for National Harmony and End of Violence. May the light of truth, the power of unconditional love, and profound peace flood our being, guiding our thoughts and actions toward harmony, serenity, and unity with all creation. So it is and so it shall be. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Coro sacro anglicano nigeriano con tambores sutiles

oraciones.titulo: Our Lady of Aokpe (Nigeria): Prayer for Purity and Family Peace
oraciones.textoOriginal: Our Lady Mediatrix of All Graces of Aokpe, pray for us and protect our families from moral decay...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Aur Ley-di Me-di-ey-triks of Ol Grey-ses of A-ok-pe, prey for as...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Virgin Mary, Mediatrix of All the Graces of Aokpe! Pray for us before the heavenly throne; defends the innocence of children and young people, removes discord from our homes and sows lasting peace throughout Africa.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Rosario rezado en coros de mujeres nigerianas y campana

oraciones.titulo: Oriki a Osun Oshogbo: Belleza, Fertilidad and Blessing of the Agua Dulce
oraciones.textoOriginal: Osun Osogbo, yeye omi toto, alabiyamo ti nfun ni lomo, oore yeye o! Fun mi ni alaafia ati oro.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O-sun O-shog-bo, ye-ye o-mi to-to, a-la-bi-ya-mo ti n-fun ni lo-mo, o-o-re ye-ye o! Fun mi ni a-la-a-fi-a a-ti o-ro.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Mother Osun of the sweet and healing waters of Oshogbo! Generous mother who embraces children and gives fertility to wombs: sweeten our lives with your love, remove the heaviness of the soul and fill our home with health, beauty and clean prosperity. Oore Yeye Osun!

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Agua de río fluyendo en la arboleda sagrada de Oshogbo y campanillas de latón

oraciones.titulo: Orunmila in Ile-Ife: Prayer for the Wisdom and Buen Carácter (Iwa Pele)
oraciones.textoOriginal: Orunmila Eleri Ipin, Ibikeji Olodumare, fun mi ni Iwa Pele ati ogbon lati bori gbogbo idanwo aye.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O-run-mi-la E-le-ri I-pin, I-bi-ke-ji O-lo-du-ma-re, fun mi ni I-wa Pe-le a-ti og-bon la-ti bo-ri gbo-gbo i-dan-wo a-ye.
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the name of Olofin and the Holy Orishas, we lift our devotion and prayer for Orunmila in Ile. We come with reverence before the blessed spiritual powers to remove all negativity, disturbance and heavy burdens, firmly opening the pathways to health, peace, progress and abundance in our home. Ashé to iban Eshu! Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Sonido del Iroke Ifá golpeando el tablero Opon Ifá y tambores sagrados

oraciones.titulo: Niger-Benue Confluence: Ancestral Blessing of the Land and Rivers
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ojo k'omomi, k'olodumare busi ayo wa... Que el encuentro de las dos grandes aguas traiga bendición a toda la tierra.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O-jo ko-mo-mi, ko-lo-du-ma-re bu-si a-yo wa...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Just as the waters of the great Niger River and the Benue River embrace each other in peace without destroying each other: may all peoples and lineages live together in fertile harmony, watering the crops with prosperity and filling the earth with abundant life.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Sonido caudaloso de grandes ríos y tambores tradicionales suaves

oraciones.titulo: Jinapanjara Gatha: The Great Sacred Armor of Protection of Thailand
oraciones.textoOriginal: ชินะปัญชะระ ปะริตตัง มัง รักขะตุ สัพพะทา... (Chinapanjara parittam mang rakkhatu sabbada...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Chi-na-pan-ja-ra pa-rit-tang mang rak-kha-tu sab-ba-da. Shi-na-san-ta-na cha-ran-to...
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Jinapanjara Gatha: The Great Sacred Armor of Protection of Thailand. May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Monastic chant solemne del Jinapanjara en Wat Rakhang y Bell of templo

oraciones.titulo: Wat Phra Kaew (Bangkok): Prayer before the Sacred Emerald Buddha
oraciones.textoOriginal: วาละลุกัง สังฆัง นะมามิ... ขอเดชะพระแก้วมรกตคุ้มครองรักษา (Namo tassa bhagavato...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Na-mo tas-sa bha-ga-va-to a-ra-ja-to sam-ma-sam-bud-dhas-sa. Kho de-cha Phra Kaew Mo-ra-kot...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I pay homage to the sacred Emerald Buddha (*Phra Kaew Morakot*), spiritual guardian of the land and the people. May its serene light dispel all epidemics, discord and shadows; May it grant peace to homes, wisdom to rulers and health to all beings.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Música clásica cortesana tailandesa Piphat suave y campanas de pagoda

oraciones.titulo: Wat Pho: Prayer before the Reclining Buddha for Absolute Stillness
oraciones.textoOriginal: อนิจจา วะตะ สังขารา อุปปาทะวะยะธัมมิโน... (Anicca vata sankhara uppadavayadhammino...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: A-nic-ca va-ta san-kha-ra up-pa-da-va-ya-dham-mi-no, up-paj-jit-va ni-ruj-jhan-ti, te-sam vu-pa-sa-mo su-kho.
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Wat Pho: Prayer before the Reclining Buddha for Absolute Stillness. May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Sonido de las monedas cayendo en los 108 cuencos de bronce de Wat Pho

oraciones.titulo: Ajahn Chah (Forest Tradition): 'Let It Go and You Will Know True Peace'
oraciones.textoOriginal: ถ้าปล่อยวางได้นิดหน่อย จะมีความสงบนิดหน่อย... (Si sueltas un poco, tendrás un poco de paz. Si sueltas todo, tendrás paz perfecta).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Tha ploy wang dai nid noy, ja mi khwam sang-ob nid noy. Tha ploy wang dai thang mot, ja mi khwam sang-ob yang ying...
oraciones.textoTraducido: If you let go a little, you will have a little peace. If you let go a lot, you will have a lot of peace. If you let go of everything completely, you will know perfect, unchanging peace. Be like a tree in the silent forest: the leaves fall, but the trunk remains in serene stillness.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Viento entre los árboles de la selva tailandesa y canto de aves del bosque

oraciones.titulo: Luang Pu Mun: Gatha of Purification of the Mind and Spiritual Courage
oraciones.textoOriginal: พุทโธ พุทโธ พุทโธ (Buddho, Buddho, Buddho - La mente despierta que todo lo trasciende).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Bud-dho, Bud-dho, Bud-dho. Jai sa-at, jai sa-wang, jai sang-ob...
oraciones.textoTraducido: We take refuge in the Buddha, in the Dharma, and in the Noble Sangha as we contemplate the sacred teaching of Luang Pu Mun: Gatha of Purification of the Mind and Spiritual Courage. May boundless compassion and awakening wisdom free our minds from all attachment and suffering, radiating peace, harmony, and well-being to all sentient beings. Om Mani Padme Hum!

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Silencio del bosque monástico y repetición rítmica suave de 'Buddho'

oraciones.titulo: Erawan Shrine (Phra Phrom): Prayer of the Four Faces of Blessing
oraciones.textoOriginal: โอม พรหมมายะ นะมะฮา... ขอพรสี่ประการ: เมตตา กรุณา มุทิตา อุเบกขา (Om Brahmaya namaha...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Om Brah-ma-ya na-ma-ja... Kho porn si pra-kan: Met-ta, Ka-ru-na, Mu-di-ta, U-pek-kha.
oraciones.textoTraducido: In the luminous presence of the Universal Source and the Creator of all life, we align our hearts with Erawan Shrine (Phra Phrom): Prayer of the Four Faces of Blessing. May the light of truth, the power of unconditional love, and profound peace flood our being, guiding our thoughts and actions toward harmony, serenity, and unity with all creation. So it is and so it shall be. Amen.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Música tradicional de danza tailandesa con címbalos Ching y jazmín fragante

oraciones.titulo: Pattani (Southern Thailand): Dua for Village Peace and Livelihood
oraciones.idiomaLiturgicoOriginal: Yawi (Malayo-Arabic del Sur de Tailandia) / Arabic
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ya Allah Tuhan kami, kurniakanlah keamanan dan rezeki yang halal di bumi Pattani ini...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Al-lah Tu-han ka-mi, kur-ni-a-kan-lah ke-a-ma-nan dan re-ze-ki yang ja-lal di bu-mi Pat-ta-ni i-ni...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Allah, our Lord! Grant unbreakable peace to our villages, bless our fishermen in their work at sea and fill our homes with lawful sustenance, harmony and friendship with all our neighbors.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Llamada Adhan en la mezquita de Pattani y brisa de palmerales

oraciones.titulo: Thai Maha Metta: Song of Love and Peace for All Beings
oraciones.textoOriginal: สัพเพ สัตตา อะเวรา โหนตุ, อัพยาปัชฌา โหนตุ, อะนีฆา โหนตุ, สุขี อัตตานัง ปะริหะรันตุ... (Sabbe satta avera hontu...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Sab-be sat-ta a-ve-ra jon-tu, ab-hya-paj-jha jon-tu, a-ni-gha jon-tu, su-khi at-ta-nang pa-ri-ja-ran-tu.
oraciones.textoTraducido: May all sentient beings be free from hatred and enmity; may they be free from suffering and oppression; may they be free from affliction and pain; May all beings take care of themselves with joy, well-being and supreme peace.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Canto coral suave de monjes tailandeses entonando Metta

oraciones.titulo: Al-Azhar (El Cairo): Prayer for the Moderación, Ciencia and Peace Universal
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنَا فَهْمَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَحِفْظَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَاجْعَلْ أَلْسِنَتَنَا عَامِرَةً بِذِكْرِكَ... (Allahummar-zuqna fahman-nabiyyin...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Al-la-jum-mar-zuq-na faj-man-na-biy-yin wa jif-zal-mur-sa-lin, waj-al al-si-na-ta-na a-mi-ra-tan bi-dhik-rik...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Allah! Grant us the understanding of the Prophets, the custody of the Messengers and the closeness of the angels. May our tongues always speak with wisdom and truth, may we be heralds of moderation and peace, and free us from extremism and ignorance.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Adhan solemne del minarete de Al-Azhar y lectura coránica melódica

oraciones.titulo: Sayyida Zeinab (The Cairo): Prayer of Paciencia Heroica and Consuelo
oraciones.textoOriginal: يَا رَبِّ بِحَقِّ الصَّبْرِ الزَّيْنَبِيِّ، ارْبِطْ عَلَى قُلُوبِ الْمَحْزُونِينَ (Ya Rabbi bi-haqqis-sabriz-zaynabiyy...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Rab-bi bi-jaq-qis-sab-riz-zay-na-biyy, ir-bit a-la qu-lu-bil-maj-zu-nin wa a-ghith kul-la mak-rub...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Lord of the Universe! By the merit of Sayyida Zeinab's heroic patience in the face of pain: she strengthens broken hearts, consoles mothers in their tears, alleviates the sorrows of the oppressed and spreads unbreakable serenity in our lives.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Laúd Oud clásico egipcio y cánticos de Madih Nabawi

oraciones.titulo: Sayyidna Al-Hussein (El Cairo): Prayer of Integridad and Dignidad
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِزَّةَ النَّفْسِ وَثَبَاتًا عَلَى الْحَقِّ (Allahumma inni as'aluka 'izzatan-nafsi wa thabatan 'alal-haqq...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Al-la-jum-ma in-ni as-a-lu-ka iz-za-tan-naf-si wa tha-ba-tan a-lal-jaqq...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Allah! I ask you for the nobility of the soul, the dignity of the believer and firmness in the truth. Do not allow us to give in to injustice or let fear separate us from good; make us brave defenders of the defenseless.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Recitación sufí solemne en El Cairo antiguo

oraciones.titulo: Saint Cyril of Alexandria: Liturgical Epiclesis for the Peace of the Church
oraciones.textoOriginal: ⲒⲎⲤⲞⲨⲤ ⲠⲬⲢⲒⲤⲦⲞⲤ ⲠϢⲎⲢⲒ ⲘⲪⲚⲞⲨϮ ⲘⲀⲦⲞⲨⲤ ⲚⲀⲚ ⲚⲦⲈⲔϨⲒⲢⲎⲚⲎ... (Isous Pi-Khristos P-sheri m-P-Nouti matous nan n-tek-hirene...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: I-sus Pi-Jris-tos P-she-ri m-P-Nu-ti ma-tus nan n-tek-ji-re-ne...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the living God! Grant your people your holy peace, dispel heresies and divisions, heal broken hearts, and allow us to worship you in one spirit of love and truth.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Címbalos coptos metálicos y coro sacerdotal de Alejandría

oraciones.titulo: Saint Macarius of Egypt: Morning Prayer of the Hermit in the Desert
oraciones.textoOriginal: ⲠϭⲞⲒⲤ ⲀⲒⲚⲈϨⲤⲒ ϦⲈⲚ ⲠⲒⲦⲰⲞⲨⲒ ⲈⲒⲈⲢϨⲨⲘⲚⲞⲤ ⲈⲢⲞⲔ: (Pchois ai-nehsi khen pi-tooui eier-hymnos erok...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: P-chois ai-nej-si jen pi-to-u-i ei-er-jym-nos e-rok...
oraciones.textoTraducido: I wake up from my bed, Lord my God, before dawn to sing your praises. Cleanse me from the shadows of sin, illuminate my understanding with the light of your Gospel and guide my hands and thoughts in your holy will throughout this new day.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Silencio del desierto de Wadi El Natrun y campana monástica solitaria

oraciones.titulo: Papa Cirilo VI of Egipto: Prayer of Fe Sencilla and Milagros Cotidianos
oraciones.textoOriginal: كن مطمئناً جداً جداً ولا تفكر في الأمر كثيراً، بل دع الأمر لمن بيده الأمر... (Kun mutma'innan jiddan...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Kun mut-ma-in-nan jid-dan jid-dan wa la tu-fak-kir fil-am-ri ka-thi-ran, bal da-il-am-ra li-man bi-ya-di-hil-amr...
oraciones.textoTraducido: 'Remain totally in peace and tranquility; Do not be distressed by thinking too much about the problem, but leave it entirely in the hands of Him who governs all things.' Lord God, in your sovereign hands I place all my worries.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Canto litúrgico del Monasterio de San Mina en Maryut

oraciones.titulo: Summit of Mount Sinai: Prayer before the Bush of Fire and Divine Law
oraciones.textoOriginal: Descálzate, porque el lugar que pisas tierra santa es (Éxodo 3:5). שַׁל נְעָלֶיךָ מֵעַל רַגְלֶיךָ...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Shal ne-a-ley-kha me-al rag-ley-kha, ki ha-ma-qom a-sher at-tah o-med a-lav ad-mat qo-desh hu.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh God of Sinai and the Burning Bush that burns without being consumed! I barefoot the attachments of my mind before your holy presence. Inscribe on the tablets of my heart your eternal law of love, justice and reverence for creation.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Viento sobre los picos de granito del Sinaí y Bell ofl monasterio

oraciones.titulo: Cairo Nilometer: Blessing of the Fertile Waters and the Harvest
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ فِي مِيَاهِ النِّيلِ وَاجْعَلْهَا سَبَبًا لِلْخَيْرِ وَالنَّمَاءِ (Allahumma barik fi miyahin-Nil...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Al-la-jum-ma ba-rik fi mi-ya-jin-Nil waj-al-ja sa-ba-ban lil-khay-ri wan-na-ma'...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Blessed be the Creator who sends the living waters of the Nile to fertilize the earth, give life to the crops of the delta and quench the thirst of the valleys. May honest sustenance and generosity never be lacking on our tables.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Corriente suave del río Nilo al atardecer y flauta Ney tradicional

oraciones.titulo: Mevlana Rumi: 'Come, Whoever You Are, Come...'
oraciones.textoOriginal: باز آ باز آ هر آنچه هستی باز آ، گر کافر و گبر و بت‌پرستی باز آ... (Gel, gel, ne olursan ol yine gel...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Gel, gel, ne o-lur-san ol yi-ne gel; is-ter ka-fir, is-ter me-cu-si, is-ter put-pe-rest ol yi-ne gel...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Come, come, whoever you are, come. Even if you are unbelieving, devout or have broken your promises a thousand times, this is not an abode of despair. Our door is always open: come, draw closer to the unconditional love of the Creator.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Flauta Ney sufí de caña solitaria de Konya y resonancia mística

oraciones.titulo: Dervishes of Konya: Prayer of the Sacred Turn (Sema) and Cosmic Love
oraciones.textoOriginal: Hak'tan alır, halka saçarız; hiçbir şeyi kendimize mal etmeyiz... (Recibimos de la Verdad, repartimos a la creación).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Hak-tan a-lir, hal-ka sa-cha-riz; hich-bir she-yi ken-di-mi-ze mal et-me-yiz. Ya Hazreti Mevlana...
oraciones.textoTraducido: With our right hand open towards the sky we receive the grace of the Creator (*Al-Haqq*); With our left hand directed to the earth we deliver it without reservation to all humanity. We spin like the planets in a cosmic dance of pure love, dissolving the ego in eternal light.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Ceremonia de Ney sufí, tambor Kudüm y giro del Sema

oraciones.titulo: Yunus Emre: 'Let us Love and Be Loved; The Earth Belongs to No One
oraciones.textoOriginal: Gelin tanış olalım, işi kolay kılalım, sevelim sevilelim, dünya kimseye kalmaz.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ge-lin ta-nish o-la-lim, i-shi ko-lay ki-la-lim, se-ve-lim se-vi-le-lim, dun-ya kim-se-ye kal-maz.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Let us come and know each other as brothers; let's make things easy for others; Let us sincerely love and let ourselves be loved, because this passing world will not remain anyone's property.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Instrumento Baglama turco acústico y canto poético tradicional

oraciones.titulo: Haci Bektas-i Veli: 'Do not hurt anyone even if you are hurt'
oraciones.textoOriginal: İncinsen de incitme. Her ne ararsan kendinde ara. Dili, dini, rengi ne olursa olsun iyiler iyidir.
oraciones.guiaFonetica: In-jin-sen de in-jit-me. Jer ne a-rar-san ken-din-de a-ra. Di-li, di-ni, ren-gi ne o-lur-sa ol-sun i-yi-ler i-yi-dir.
oraciones.textoTraducido: Even if you are hurt, never hurt another. Whatever you seek in the universe, seek it first in your own heart. Whatever their language, creed or color, noble people are noble: be a temple of mercy for all.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Música clásica otomana suave de cuerda Tanbur

oraciones.titulo: Hagia Sophia (Ayasofya): Solemn Supplication for Mercy and Peace
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ يَا فَتَّاحُ افْتَحْ لَنَا أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ وَيَسِّرْ لَنَا كُلَّ خَيْرٍ (Allahumma ya Fattahu iftah lana...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Al-la-jum-ma ya Fat-ta-ju if-tah la-na ab-wa-ba raj-ma-ti-ka wa yas-sir la-na kul-la khayr...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh God, the Great Door Opener! Open before us the doors of your infinite mercy; Unite the people of East and West in mutual respect, protect the city of Istanbul and fill our hearts with your holy light.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Adhan resonando entre las cúpulas milenarias de Santa Sofía y brisa del mar de Mármara

oraciones.titulo: Mezquita Azul (Sultanahmet): Salavat Otomano and Peace in the Home
oraciones.textoOriginal: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ طِبِّ الْقُلُوبِ وَدَوَائِهَا وَعَافِيَةِ الأَبْدَانِ وَشِفَائِهَا (Salawat Tibbil Qulub)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Al-la-jum-ma sal-li a-la Say-yi-di-na Mu-jam-ma-din tib-bil-qu-lu-bi wa da-wa-i-ja, wa a-fi-ya-til-ab-da-ni wa shi-fa-i-ja...
oraciones.textoTraducido: O Allah! Bless our Master Muhammad, medicine and balm of hearts, health and well-being of bodies, and resplendent light of looks. Heal our ailments and fill our home with serenity.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Canto de Salavat coral otomano y fuentes de agua de Sultanahmet

oraciones.titulo: Eyüp Sultan (Estambul): Supplication of Blessing, Nuevos Comienzos and Éxito
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ya Rabbi, Eyüp Sultan hürmetine dualarımızı kabul eyle, işlerimizi kolaylaştır...
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Ya Rab-bi, E-yup Sul-tan jur-me-ti-ne du-a-la-ri-mi-zi ka-bul ey-le, ish-le-ri-mi-zi ko-lay-lash-tir...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Lord our God! For the honor of your noble and pious servants: accept our sincere supplications, smooth the difficult paths, bless our new beginnings and grant noble success to our honest projects.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Palomas volando en el patio de Eyüp Sultan y canto de oración sereno

oraciones.titulo: Saint Basil of Cappadocia: Prayer for Creation and Animals
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ὁ Θεός, σῶσον τοὺς ἀνθρώπους καὶ τὰ κτήνη, καὶ εὐλόγησον πάντα τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν σου... (O Theos, soson tous anthropous...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O The-os, so-son tus an-thro-pus kai ta kti-ni, kai ev-lo-gi-son pan-ta ta er-ga ton ji-ron su...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh Creator God! We pray to you for our younger brothers, the animals, whom you entrusted to our care. May they never suffer from our cruelty or carelessness; Teach us to understand that every living creature participates in the breath of your life and deserves respect and love.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Church bells de Capadocia e instrumentos de viento de Anatolia

oraciones.titulo: Saint Gregory Nazianzus: Hymn to God Beyond Every Name
oraciones.textoOriginal: Ὦ πάντων ἐπέκεινα· τί γὰρ θέμις ἄλλο σε μέλπειν; Πῶς λόγος ὑμνήσει σε; σὺ γὰρ οὐδενὶ ῥητός... (O panton epekeina...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: O pan-ton e-pe-kei-na: ti gar the-mis al-lo se mel-pein? Pos lo-gos jym-ni-sei se? Sy gar u-de-ni rji-tos...
oraciones.textoTraducido: Oh You who are beyond everything! What other song is worthy of You? How can any word praise You, if You are inexpressible by all human language? Towards You converges the sigh of every being; The fullness of the soul rests in You.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Byzantine chant solemne a capela de la tradición de Capadocia

oraciones.titulo: Heart Sutra (般若波罗蜜多心经): Form is Void, Void is Form
oraciones.textoOriginal: 觀自在菩薩，行深般若波羅蜜多時，照見五蘊皆空，度一切苦厄。舍利子，色不異空，空不異色... 揭諦揭諦，波羅揭諦，波羅僧揭諦，菩提薩婆訶。 (Gate gate paragate parasamgate bodhi svaha).
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Guan zi zai pu sa, xing shen bo re bo luo mi duo shi, zhao jian wu yun jie kong, du yi qie ku e. She li zi, se bu yi kong, kong bu yi se... Jie di jie di, bo luo jie di, bo luo seng jie di, pu ti sa po he.
oraciones.textoTraducido: When the Noble Avalokiteshvara contemplated in profound wisdom, he saw that the five aggregates are void of intrinsic existence, transcending all suffering. Form is emptiness, emptiness is form. Without obstacles in the mind there is no fear. Go, go, go beyond, cross to the other shore of supreme awakening!

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Bell of bronce china, Muyu de madera y recitación monástica del Xinjing

oraciones.titulo: Di Zang Wang Pu Sa (地藏菩萨): Infinite Vow for the Peace of the Ancestors
oraciones.textoOriginal: 地獄不空，誓不成佛；眾生度盡，方證菩提。南無大願地藏王菩薩。 (Di yu bu kong, shi bu cheng fo...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Di yu bu kong, shi bu cheng fo; zhong sheng du jin, fang zheng pu ti. Na-mo da yuan Di-zang Wang Pu-sa.
oraciones.textoTraducido: 'If the hells are not completely empty, I swear not to attain Buddhahood; Only when all beings have been freed from pain, will I certify the supreme awakening!' Homage to Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha of the Great Vow: shed your beneficent light on our ancestors and undo the chains of suffering.

ritualesAsociados.paisajeSonoroRecomendado: Campana solemne del Monte Jiuhua e Sandalwood incense

oraciones.titulo: Yao Shi Guan Ding Zhen Yan (药师灌顶真言): Mantra of Healing and Health Pura
oraciones.textoOriginal: 南無薄伽伐帝。鞞殺社。窶嚕薜琉璃。缽喇婆。喝囉闍也... (Namo bhagavate bhaisajyaguru vaidurya prabharajaya...)
oraciones.guiaFonetica: Na-mo bo-qie-fa-di, pi-sha-she, ju-lu pi-liu-li, bo-la-po, je-la-zhe-ye, da-ta-jie-duo-ye... Da-zhi-ta: Om, pi-sha-shi, pi-sha-shi, pi-sha-she, san-mo-jie-di suo-ja.
